confirm:0.hook: The door sealed shut behind her with a soft, final click.
confirm:0.line: 'Did you really think pressing *confirm* would set you free?'

sentences.cn: 阿栗走到终端前，快速敲击键盘。

sentences.en: The screen flashed a single prompt: CONFIRM IDENTITY.

'That date means someone hid this here on purpose,' she whispered. Dust on the envelope said otherwise.
date:0.cnHint: 调查员在服务器室发现一个旧信封，信封上的____揭开了零点消失的秘密。
date:0.hook: The dust had been disturbed — very recently.
date:0.line: 'Check the *date* — it matches the night the system was wiped.'

sentences.cn: 一个破信封躺在服务器机房的地板上。

sentences.en: I picked it up.
sentences.cn: 我捡起来。

sentences.en: The *date* stamped on it was three years ago — the same day Zero disappeared from official records.

fly:0.en: Inside the signal tower, a single dead *fly* rested on the transmitter lens. Ali said that was Zero's mark — a sign the device had been armed. I had read about it in old case files. One small insect, placed just so, and every broadcast in the city would go dark.
fly:0.cnHint: 调查员在信号塔内发现一只____，这是零点留下的暗号，意味着城市广播即将中断。
fly:0.hook: Ali's hand froze one centimetre above the transmitter.
fly:0.line: 'One dead *fly* on the lens — he has been here already.'

sentences.en: Inside the signal tower, a single dead *fly* rested on the transmitter lens.

sentences.cn: 阿栗说那是零点的标记——装置已经被激活的信号。

sentences.en: I had read about it in old case files.
sentences.cn: 我在旧案卷里读过这个。

sentences.en: One small insect, placed just so, and every broadcast in the city would go dark.
sentences.cn: 一只小昆虫，放在恰好的位置，整个城市的广播就会黑屏。

judge:0.en: The hearing room was empty except for a single chair and a screen. Text rolled across it: YOU ARE THE *JUDGE* NOW. CHOOSE. Two file names blinked below the message. One would expose Grey Crow. One would expose Zero. I sat down slowly. The cursor waited, patient as a held breath.
judge:0.cnHint: 调查员独自面对屏幕，被迫以____的身份在两个秘密之间做出抉择。
judge:0.hook: Both files could not be true — but both could destroy everything.
judge:0.line: 'I never asked to be a *judge*, but here I sit.'

sentences.en: The hearing room was empty except for a single chair and a screen.
sentences.cn: 听证室空荡荡的，只有一把椅子和一个屏幕。

sentences.en: Text rolled across it: YOU ARE THE *JUDGE* NOW.
CHOOSE.
sentences.cn: 选择。

sentences.en: One would expose Zero.
sentences.cn: 一个会曝露零点。

sentences.en: The cursor waited, patient as a held breath.
sentences.cn: 光标在等，像是屏住的一口气。

store:0.en: The safe house sat behind a closed *store* — dusty shelves, broken lights, the smell of old metal. Ali pressed her ear to the back wall. Somewhere beyond it, a server hummed. Grey Crow had said the data cache was here. I pulled the door. It swung open without a sound.
store:0.cnHint: 我们在一家废弃的____后面找到了藏匿点，阿里发现了可疑的声音。
store:0.hook: The server held one file, and it had my name on it.
store:0.line: 'This *store* is cover — the real prize is behind that wall.'

sentences.en: The safe house sat behind a closed *store* — dusty shelves, broken lights, the smell of old metal.
Ali pressed her ear to the back wall.

sentences.cn: 墙那边某处，一台服务器在嗡嗡响。

sentences.cn: 灰鸦说数据缓存在这里。

sentences.en: I pulled the door.
sentences.cn: 我拉了一下门。

sentences.en: It swung open without a sound.
sentences.cn: 门无声地打开了。

budget:0.en: Zero had hacked the city grid using a ghost account with a tiny *budget* — barely enough credits to run three commands. But three commands were all he needed. Ali stared at the transfer log. 'He spent almost nothing,' she said. That was the terrifying part. Cheap and perfect.
budget:0.cnHint: 零点只用了极少的____就入侵了城市电网，阿里看着记录倒吸一口冷气。
budget:0.hook: If he did this on three credits, imagine what he does with more.
budget:0.line: 'A *budget* this small means he planned every single move.'

sentences.en: Zero had hacked the city grid using a ghost account with a tiny *budget* — barely enough credits to run three commands.
But three commands were all he needed.
sentences.cn: 但三条命令就够了。

sentences.cn: 阿栗盯着传输日志。

sentences.en: 'He spent almost nothing,' she said.
sentences.cn: 他花的钱几乎没有，她说。

sentences.en: That was the terrifying part.
sentences.cn: 这就是恐怖的地方。

sentences.en: Cheap and perfect.
sentences.cn: 便宜又完美。

grant:0.cnHint: 引路人把一把能____所有权限的密钥推给了我，警告我使用后将暴露身份。

grant:0.line: 'That key will *grant* you one door — choose the right one.'

zone:0.hook: Then Ali's scanner picked up a single, impossible ping.
zone:0.line: 'Stay in the *zone* — one step out and Zero hears everything.'

sentences.en: The basement was divided by yellow tape into sections.
sentences.cn: 地下室被黄色警戒线分成了几个区域。

sentences.en: Ali called the middle section the dead *zone* — no signal, no cameras, no record of anyone who stepped inside.
Grey Crow had chosen it for that reason.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦就是因为这个原因选中了它。

sentences.en: We spread the plans across the floor and spoke in low, careful voices.
sentences.cn: 我们把计划铺在地上，用低沉、谨慎的声音交谈。

afraid:0.en: I stood at the door of Zero's empty office. Every drawer had been pulled open, every screen wiped. Ali spoke from behind me. 'Are you *afraid*?' she asked. I thought about it honestly. 'Not of him,' I said. 'Of what we find next.' She nodded and stepped inside.
afraid:0.cnHint: 面对零点已清空的办公室，阿栗问我是否____，我说我怕的不是他本人。
afraid:0.hook: Inside the last drawer lay a key with my apartment number.
afraid:0.line: 'I am not *afraid* of Zero — I am afraid of what he planned for us.'

sentences.en: I stood at the door of Zero's empty office.
sentences.cn: 我站在零点空荡荡的办公室门口。

sentences.en: Every drawer had been pulled open, every screen wiped.
sentences.cn: 每个抽屉都被拉开了，每块屏幕都被擦干净了。

sentences.en: Ali spoke from behind me.
sentences.cn: 阿栗从我身后说话。

sentences.en: 'Are you *afraid*?' she asked.
I thought about it honestly.
sentences.cn: 我诚实地想了想。

sentences.en: 'Not of him,' I said.
sentences.cn: 我说，不怕他。

sentences.en: 'Of what we find next.'
sentences.cn: 怕接下来会发现什么。

sentences.en: She nodded and stepped inside.
sentences.cn: 她点了点头，走了进去。

couple:0.en: The safe house smelled of cold coffee. A *couple* of burned data chips lay on the table — Zero had been here. Ali pressed her back to the wall. 'He cleared everything,' she whispered. I scanned the room: two chairs, two cups, two exits. Someone had shared this space.
couple:0.cnHint: 安全屋里，我们发现零点留下的痕迹，桌上有一____已损毁的芯片。
couple:0.line: 'A *couple* of hours ago, someone sat right where you are standing.'

sentences.en: The safe house smelled of cold coffee.
sentences.cn: 安全屋里弥漫着冷咖啡的味道。

sentences.en: A *couple* of burned data chips lay on the table — Zero had been here.
Ali pressed her back to the wall.
sentences.cn: 阿栗贴着墙站着。

sentences.en: 'He cleared everything,' she whispered.
sentences.cn: 她低声说，他把一切都清空了。

sentences.en: I scanned the room: two chairs, two cups, two exits.
sentences.cn: 我扫了一眼房间：两把椅子，两个杯子，两个出口。

sentences.en: Someone had shared this space.
sentences.cn: 有人在这个地方待过。

definition:0.en: Grey Crow pulled up the old city charter on a cracked wall screen. 'Read the *definition* of a restricted zone,' he said quietly. The words were sharp, precise — and they drew a line straight through the building we were standing in. We had no legal right to be here.
definition:0.cnHint: 灰鸦让我读限制区的____，我们才意识到自己正身处违禁地带。
definition:0.hook: The door lock clicked — from the outside.
definition:0.line: 'The *definition* is clear: anyone inside after midnight is a target.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow pulled up the old city charter on a cracked wall screen.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在一块裂纹斑斑的墙面屏幕上调出了旧城市宪章。

sentences.en: 'Read the *definition* of a restricted zone,' he said quietly.
The words were sharp, precise — and they drew a line straight through the building we were standing in.
sentences.cn: 字句锋利而准确——它们在我们所站的这栋建筑正中间划了一道线。

sentences.en: We had no legal right to be here.
sentences.cn: 我们没有合法权利待在这里。

imagination:0.en: Zero's hideout looked ordinary — bare walls, a folding chair, a single dim light. But Grey Crow said, 'Use your *imagination*.' I looked again: chalk marks on the floor, a mirror angled at the vent, wires taped flat under the rug. The ordinary room was a listening machine.
imagination:0.cnHint: 这间空屋看似普通，灰鸦让我发挥____，我才发现隐藏的监听装置。
imagination:0.hook: The mirror moved — and nothing had touched it.
imagination:0.line: 'Without *imagination*, you will never see what Zero actually built here.'

sentences.en: Zero's hideout looked ordinary — bare walls, a folding chair, a single dim light.
sentences.cn: 零点的藏身处看起来很普通——光秃秃的墙，一把折叠椅，一盏昏暗的灯。

sentences.en: But Grey Crow said, 'Use your *imagination*.'
I looked again: chalk marks on the floor, a mirror angled at the vent, wires taped flat under the rug.
sentences.cn: 我再看一遍：地上的粉笔记号，对着通风口的镜子，地毯下贴着的电线。

sentences.en: The ordinary room was a listening machine.
sentences.cn: 这个普通的房间其实是个窃听装置。

journey:0.en: The file on the table mapped every step I had taken since day one. My *journey* through Harbor City — every signal I had followed, every door I had opened — was recorded in cold blue ink. Someone had been tracking me the whole time. I felt the walls tighten.
journey:0.cnHint: 桌上的档案记录了我在城市中的整段____，说明我从未摆脱监视。
journey:0.hook: My own name was circled in red at the end.
journey:0.line: 'Your *journey* was never an investigation — it was a test.'

sentences.en: The file on the table mapped every step I had taken since day one.
sentences.cn: 桌上的文件标注了我从第一天开始的每一步。

sentences.en: My *journey* through Harbor City — every signal I had followed, every door I had opened — was recorded in cold blue ink.

sentences.en: I felt the walls tighten.

nearby:0.en: The power went out. I stood still, listening. A *nearby* server rack hummed — steady, alive, unaffected by the blackout. That rack was running on a separate line. Ali found the cable: it ran under the floor toward the east wall and kept going. Somewhere beyond it, something was waiting.

nearby:0.hook: The cable was still warm under my hand.
nearby:0.line: 'That *nearby* rack is the only thing in this building Zero never touched.'

sentences.en: I stood still, listening.

perspective:0.cnHint: 灰鸦让我换一个____，四张照片拼在一起竟指向一栋无记录的建筑。
perspective:0.hook: The building's address matched the one burned into the last chip.
perspective:0.line: 'From my *perspective*, Zero has been leading us here from the very beginning.'

sentences.cn: 灰鸦把四张照片贴到了墙上。

sentences.en: 'Change your *perspective*,' he said.

requirement:0.en: The encrypted door had one *requirement*: a voice print recorded before the city banned private channels. Grey Crow reached into his coat and drew out a small player. 'I kept it,' he said. The red light above the door turned green. Some old habits, it turns out, are lifelines.

requirement:0.hook: Behind the door came a sound — steady, rhythmic, breathing.
requirement:0.line: 'The only *requirement* is a voice the city tried very hard to erase.'

sentences.cn: 灰鸦伸手进大衣，掏出了一个小型播放器。

sentences.en: The red light above the door turned green.

sentences.en: Some old habits, it turns out, are lifelines.
sentences.cn: 看来有些旧习惯，最后都成了救命的东西。

signal:0.en: Zero sat at the far end of the room, back to us, hands on a console. Without turning, he raised one finger and *signaled* us to stop. Every screen in the room went dark at once. Then, in the silence, a single frequency tone rang out — clean, sharp, final. The game had changed.
signal:0.cnHint: 零点背对着我们，用一个手势向我们____，随后所有屏幕同时熄灭。
signal:0.hook: The tone was a countdown — and we had no idea from what.
signal:0.line: 'I *signaled* you to stop because the next step cannot be taken back.'

sentences.en: Zero sat at the far end of the room, back to us, hands on a console.
sentences.cn: 零点坐在房间的最远端,背对着我们,双手放在控制台上。

sentences.en: Without turning, he raised one finger and *signaled* us to stop.
Every screen in the room went dark at once.

sentences.en: The game had changed.

behave:0.en: Inside the signal lab, Grey Crow watched the data streams with cold eyes. 'You need to understand something,' he said quietly. 'Every agent we send in must *behave* as if they belong there — no sudden moves, no fear in the eyes. Zero is watching the feeds.' I nodded and fixed my face into calm.

behave:0.hook: But my hands were already shaking.
behave:0.line: '*Behave* like you own the room, or Zero will spot you in seconds.'

sentences.en: Inside the signal lab, Grey Crow watched the data streams with cold eyes.
sentences.cn: 在信号实验室里,灰鸦用冷漠的眼神盯着数据流。

sentences.en: 'You need to understand something,' he said quietly.

sentences.en: 'Every agent we send in must *behave* as if they belong there — no sudden moves, no fear in the eyes.
Zero is watching the feeds.'

sentences.en: I nodded and fixed my face into calm.
sentences.cn: 我点了点头,努力让自己看起来平静。

cent:0.en: The server room smelled of burnt wiring. Ali cracked open a hidden wall panel and pulled out a small tin box. Inside lay a single coin — one *cent*, old and scratched, with a micro-chip sealed under the metal. 'This is what Zero paid someone to betray us,' Ali said, voice flat. 'One cent.'

cent:0.line: 'They sold your life for one *cent* and a clean escape route.'

sentences.cn: 阿栗撬开了隐藏的墙板,掏出一个小铁盒。

sentences.en: Inside lay a single coin — one *cent*, old and scratched, with a micro-chip sealed under the metal.

commercial:0.hook: I hit play, and the signal screamed.
commercial:0.line: 'That *commercial* has run four hundred times today — four hundred orders delivered.'

sentences.en: On it looped a bright *commercial* for a Harbor City energy drink — smiling faces, loud music, fake sky.

death:0.en: The archive room was silent and cold. I found the file under a loose floor tile — a thin folder marked only with a date. Inside was a list of names. Mine was third. Ali put a hand on my shoulder. 'This is Zero's *death* list,' she said. 'Everyone on it disappears within a week.'

death:0.line: 'A *death* list with your name on it is not a warning — it is a deadline.'

sentences.en: Inside was a list of names.

escape:0.en: The corridor lights cut out. In the dark, I heard boots on metal stairs — Zero's team, moving fast. Ali grabbed my arm and pulled me toward a narrow vent in the wall. 'This is our only *escape*,' she whispered. The vent was barely wide enough for one person. We had maybe thirty seconds.

escape:0.hook: Behind us, the door lock beeped once.
escape:0.line: 'Our *escape* runs through that vent — move now or we stay forever.'

'Tonight we *expose* Zero's network to the city council,' he said. 'Every hidden line, every bought official.' Ali looked at the stack and let out a slow breath. 'He will not let that happen.'
expose:0.cnHint: 灰鸦准备向市议会____零点的地下网络，但风险极大。
expose:0.hook: A red light blinked on Grey Crow's comm device.
expose:0.line: 'We *expose* him tonight, or he buries us before morning.'

reduction:0.line: 'The *reduction* is live — nine floor cameras are blind, go now.'

season:0.en: 'This is the dry *season* for honest cops,' Grey Crow said, staring at the rain hammering the window. He meant the city's anti-corruption sweep was over and the dirty officers were back at their desks. That made our next move far more dangerous. Every badge in Harbor City was now a possible threat.
season:0.cnHint: 引路人说现在是危险的____，腐败警察重新掌权。
season:0.hook: And one of those badges was already climbing the stairs.
season:0.line: 'In this *season*, trust nobody wearing a uniform.'

sector:0.cnHint: 阿栗的地图显示零点完全掌控着某个____，我们只有一条退路。
sector:0.hook: The single free exit faced the river — and the river was rising.
sector:0.line: 'Every signal in that *sector* belongs to Zero — we transmit and we die.'

sentences.cn: 阿栗屏幕上的地图把港城分成八个区域。

sentences.en: She tapped the red one.

setting:0.en: The server room was an odd *setting* for a last stand: humming white boxes, cold blue light, the smell of recycled air. Yet here we were. I pushed a rack of drives against the door. Ali killed the main console. Grey Crow spread his hands and said quietly, 'Now we wait.'
setting:0.cnHint: 我们在服务器室这个特殊的____中做好了最后的准备。
setting:0.hook: Something heavy pressed against the blocked door and did not stop.
setting:0.line: 'Not the heroic *setting* I imagined, but it will have to do.'

sentences.en: The server room was an odd *setting* for a last stand: humming white boxes, cold blue light, the smell of recycled air.
Yet here we were.
sentences.cn: 但我们就在这儿。

sentences.en: I pushed a rack of drives against the door.
sentences.cn: 我把一排硬盘架推向门。

shrink:0.en: Zero's voice came through the wall speaker, smooth and unhurried. 'There is nowhere left.' I felt the room *shrink* around me, walls pressing in without moving an inch. Ali gripped my arm. Grey Crow did not blink. The speaker clicked off. Silence was somehow louder than the words had been.
shrink:0.cnHint: 零点的声音让整个房间仿佛在____，压迫感扑面而来。
shrink:0.hook: Then a second voice — one I recognized — answered Zero.
shrink:0.line: 'Don't let his words make you *shrink* — that is exactly what he wants.'

sentences.en: Zero's voice came through the wall speaker, smooth and unhurried.
sentences.cn: 零点的声音从墙上的扬声器里传来，光滑而不紧不慢。

sentences.en: 'There is nowhere left.'

relax:0.en: The safe house smelled of damp concrete and old code. Ali pressed her back against the wall and told me to *relax*. 'The signal won't come for twenty minutes,' she said. I tried. But every drip from the ceiling sounded like a countdown timer reaching zero.
relax:0.cnHint: 在藏身处等待信号时，伙伴叫我____，但我的神经已经绷紧到极点。
relax:0.hook: Then the signal came — sixteen minutes early.
relax:0.line: '*Relax* — if Zero knew we were here, the lights would already be dead.'

sentences.en: The safe house smelled of damp concrete and old code.

release:0.hook: His finger hovered — and someone knocked on the door.
release:0.line: 'I will *release* it on your word, and not one second before.'

sight:0.hook: His lips moved, forming two words I could not hear.
sight:0.line: 'First *sight* of the enemy — don't freeze, act.'

sentences.en: The monitor flickered on, and there it was: Zero's face, clear and cold, in the center of the screen.

species:0.hook: The chip was warm, as if someone had just pulled it from a running machine.
species:0.line: 'Our *species* survives by knowing when to talk and when to vanish.'

lower:0.en: The signal room sat on the *lower* floor of the archive tower, below the public halls. Grey Crow led me down a tight staircase. The air grew cold. Rows of dead screens lined the walls. One screen still blinked — a single red cursor, waiting for input.

lower:0.hook: Someone had been here within the last hour.
lower:0.line: 'The *lower* floor is where they hid the real records,' Grey Crow said.

somewhat:0.line: 'The message is *somewhat* clear — clear enough to scare me.'

sentences.en: The safe house server room hummed with cold machines.
sentences.cn: 安全屋的服务器机房里冷机器嗡嗡作响。

sentences.en: Ali pulled up Zero's last broadcast on the cracked screen.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在那块破裂的屏幕上调出了零点最后一次广播。

sentences.en: The signal was *somewhat* broken — half the words missing, like teeth knocked from a jaw — but enough remained to confirm our fear.
Zero had already moved.
sentences.cn: 零点已经转移了。

stable:0.en: Ali locked the server room door and killed the lights. On the floor, a small device pulsed with a slow green glow — a signal anchor, Grey Crow had called it. 'As long as that light stays green, our channel is *stable*,' Ali said. I watched it. The green light flickered once. Then went dark.
stable:0.cnHint: 阿栗说只要那台小设备的绿灯亮着，通讯频道就是____的——然后灯灭了。
stable:0.hook: Without a stable channel, Grey Crow's warning would never reach us.
stable:0.line: 'Keep it *stable* or we lose Grey Crow for good.'

sentences.en: Ali locked the server room door and killed the lights.
sentences.cn: 阿栗锁上了服务器机房的门，关掉了灯。

agriculture:0.line: '*Agriculture* is the perfect cover — nobody ever checks the fields.'

broad:0.hook: A light on the broadcast tower went suddenly dark.
broad:0.line: 'This *broad* view is exactly why Zero chose this building.'

careful:0.hook: The clock jumped — someone had reset the timer remotely.
careful:0.line: 'Be *careful* with that file — it may be watching you back.'

combination:0.line: 'Only the right *combination* opens it — and only together.'

constant:0.en: The signal did not stop. A *constant* low tone pulsed through my earpiece, steady as a heartbeat, for the entire hour I sat at the terminal. Grey Crow said it meant the line was live. Ali said it meant we were being tracked. They were both right. The tone was a leash.
constant:0.cnHint: 耳机里____不断的低音信号既表示线路畅通，也意味着我们正被追踪。
constant:0.hook: The tone suddenly doubled in speed.
constant:0.line: 'That *constant* signal is not a comfort — it is a chain.'

direct:0.line: 'Take the *direct* route — and Zero will be waiting at the end.'

essentially:0.hook: One key, one door, one person standing between us and it.
essentially:0.line: 'You are *essentially* trapped — every path leads back to me.'

extent:0.hook: Not one dark corner remained beyond Zero's reach.
extent:0.line: 'The *extent* of his power is every light you see from this window.'

sentences.en: My hidden-signal sense fired all at once — sharp, bright, wrong.
sentences.cn: 我的隐信感突然拉起警报——尖锐、清晰、诡异。

sentences.en: 'Do not open it here,' I said.
sentences.cn: 别在这儿打开。

sentences.en: Grey Crow arrived at a run, her coat soaked through.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦冲过来，大衣湿透了。

sentences.en: The look on her face was not *surprise*.
She had known this would be here.
sentences.cn: 她知道这东西会在这里。

topic:1.en: On every corner, the screens were locked to one *topic*: a city-wide signal failure reported at midnight. I knew better. Ali read the text aloud and then stopped. Hidden in the news bulletin, between every third word, was a different message entirely — one meant only for us. The night felt suddenly smaller.
topic:1.cnHint: 城市屏幕上只显示一个____，但阿里在每隔三个词的间隙里发现了另一条秘密信息。
topic:1.hook: The hidden message ended with our names.
topic:1.line: 'That *topic* is a cover — read the spaces between the words.'

sentences.en: On every corner, the screens were locked to one *topic*: a city-wide signal failure reported at midnight.
I knew better.
sentences.cn: 我心知肚明。

sentences.en: Ali read the text aloud and then stopped.
sentences.cn: 阿栗大声读了文本，然后停住了。

sentences.en: Hidden in the news bulletin, between every third word, was a different message entirely — one meant only for us.
sentences.cn: 隐藏在新闻公告里，每隔第三个词，有一条完全不同的信息——只为我们准备的。

sentences.en: The night felt suddenly smaller.
sentences.cn: 夜晚突然感觉更紧凑了。

meat:1.en: The night market was still open, steam rising from every stall. I followed Grey Crow past rows of *meat* hanging on iron hooks, their shadows swinging like slow clocks. 'Zero chose this place on purpose,' she murmured. 'Too much noise. Too many people.' Then I heard it — a signal, thin and sharp, threading through the crowd.
meat:1.cnHint: 灰鸦带我穿过夜市，悬挂的____投下摇摆的阴影，我在嘈杂人群中捕捉到一个微弱信号。
meat:1.hook: The signal was coming from directly above us.
meat:1.line: 'He hides his codes where the smell of *meat* covers every other trace.'

sentences.en: The night market was still open, steam rising from every stall.
sentences.cn: 夜市还没打烊，每个摊位上都飘着热气。

sentences.en: I followed Grey Crow past rows of *meat* hanging on iron hooks, their shadows swinging like slow clocks.
'Zero chose this place on purpose,' she murmured.
sentences.cn: "零点选这地方是有目的的，"她低声说。

sentences.en: 'Too much noise.
sentences.cn: "太吵了。

sentences.en: Too many people.'
sentences.cn: 人太多了。"

sentences.en: Then I heard it — a signal, thin and sharp, threading through the crowd.
sentences.cn: 然后我听到了——一声讯号，细而尖锐，穿过人群。

drink:1.en: A street vendor handed me a cup without being asked. I did not *drink* it. Grey Crow had taught me that rule on my first night: nothing given freely in Harbor City is actually free. I set the cup down on the pavement and watched it. A thin wire of steam rose from it in a shape I recognised — a signal glyph.
drink:1.cnHint: 小贩主动递给我一杯饮料，我没有____它，因为杯中升起的雾气形成了一个信号符文。
drink:1.hook: Someone nearby was watching to see if I understood.
drink:1.line: 'Never *drink* what the city offers you without reading it first.'

sentences.en: A street vendor handed me a cup without being asked.
sentences.cn: 一个街边小贩递给我一杯东西，我都没问。

sentences.en: I did not *drink* it.
Grey Crow had taught me that rule on my first night: nothing given freely in Harbor City is actually free.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在我第一晚就教过我这条规则：在港湾市，天上掉下来的东西没有一样是免费的。

sentences.en: I set the cup down on the pavement and watched it.
sentences.cn: 我把杯子放在路面上，盯着它看。

sentences.en: A thin wire of steam rose from it in a shape I recognised — a signal glyph.
sentences.cn: 一缕细细的热气从杯子里升起来，形状我认得——一个讯号符号。

sleep:1.en: I had not found *sleep* in two days. The street was quiet now, the neon reflecting in long ribbons on the wet road. Zero had gone silent. That was worse than noise. Ali leaned against the wall beside me and closed her eyes for one moment. 'He is not resting,' she said. 'He is resetting.'
sleep:1.cnHint: 我已经两天没有____了，零点突然沉默让我更加不安，阿里说他不是在休息，而是在重新布局。
sleep:1.hook: Then every screen in the street went black at once.
sleep:1.line: 'Forget *sleep* — Zero never stops, and tonight neither do we.'

sentences.en: I had not found *sleep* in two days.
The street was quiet now, the neon reflecting in long ribbons on the wet road.
sentences.cn: 街道现在安静了下来，霓虹灯在湿漉漉的路面上映出长长的倒影。

sentences.en: Zero had gone silent.
sentences.cn: 零点没了声音。

sentences.en: That was worse than noise.
sentences.cn: 这比噪音还要糟。

sentences.en: Ali leaned against the wall beside me and closed her eyes for one moment.
sentences.cn: 阿栗靠在我旁边的墙上，闭了一会儿眼睛。

sentences.en: 'He is not resting,' she said.
sentences.cn: "他不是在休息，"她说。

sentences.en: 'He is resetting.'
sentences.cn: "他在重启。"

shop:1.en: The rain hammered the street. I pushed open the door of a narrow *shop* wedged between two crumbling walls. Shelves lined every surface — old data chips, cracked visors, broken signal boosters. Ali had told me to look for a blue mark above the counter. I found it, still wet.
shop:1.cnHint: 我走进一家狭窄的____，在货架后面发现了一个还未干透的蓝色暗记。
shop:1.hook: Behind the counter, something moved in the dark.
shop:1.line: 'This *shop* sells more than junk — look closer,' Ali whispered.

sentences.en: The rain hammered the street.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在街道上。

sentences.en: I pushed open the door of a narrow *shop* wedged between two crumbling walls.
Shelves lined every surface — old data chips, cracked visors, broken signal boosters.
sentences.cn: 货架堆满了整间铺子——旧数据芯片、裂开的护目镜、坏掉的讯号增强器。

sentences.en: Ali had told me to look for a blue mark above the counter.
sentences.cn: 阿栗叫我找柜台上方的蓝色记号。

sentences.en: I found it, still wet.
sentences.cn: 我找到了，还湿漉漉的。

electronic:1.en: Grey Crow led me down a back alley where every wall buzzed with *electronic* signals — thin wires threaded through cracked paint, tiny lights blinking in patterns too fast for the eye. The city was speaking in code. I pressed my ear to the wall and heard a name: Zero.
electronic:1.cnHint: 在布满____信号的小巷里，我从嗡嗡作响的墙壁中听到了一个名字。
electronic:1.hook: That name was supposed to be dead and buried.
electronic:1.line: 'Every *electronic* pulse here is a message — read them,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow led me down a back alley where every wall buzzed with *electronic* signals — thin wires threaded through cracked paint, tiny lights blinking in patterns too fast for the eye.
The city was speaking in code.
sentences.cn: 城市在用密码说话。

sentences.en: I pressed my ear to the wall and heard a name: Zero.
sentences.cn: 我把耳朵贴在墙上，听到了一个名字：零点。

wild:1.en: The outer ring of Harbor City was *wild* — no lights, no signals, just broken ground and wind that cut like wire. I ran across the open space, coat flat against my back. Ali had marked a shelter on my map. I reached it. The door was already open.
wild:1.cnHint: 在城市边缘那片____的荒地上，我跑向阿栗标记的藏身处，却发现门已经开着。
wild:1.line: 'Out here it goes *wild* — trust nothing, not even the map,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The outer ring of Harbor City was *wild* — no lights, no signals, just broken ground and wind that cut like wire.
I ran across the open space, coat flat against my back.
sentences.cn: 我跑过开阔的地面，大衣紧贴着背。

sentences.en: Ali had marked a shelter on my map.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在我的地图上标了个避难所。

sentences.en: I reached it.
sentences.cn: 我到了。

sentences.en: The door was already open.
sentences.cn: 门已经开着。

rich:1.en: Zero operated from the bright center of the city, where the towers were tall and the data was *rich* — deep streams of encrypted finance, identity records, city contracts. Grey Crow said anyone who cracked that core could own Harbor City. I was beginning to believe it.
rich:1.cnHint: 零点藏身于数据____的城市核心地带，据说掌控那里就能掌控整座城市。
rich:1.hook: Grey Crow had been inside that core once before.
rich:1.line: 'The data here is *rich* — one file could end Zero's game,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Zero operated from the bright center of the city, where the towers were tall and the data was *rich* — deep streams of encrypted finance, identity records, city contracts.
Grey Crow said anyone who cracked that core could own Harbor City.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说，谁能破解那个核心系统，谁就能掌控港湾市。

sentences.en: I was beginning to believe it.
sentences.cn: 我开始相信了。

special:1.en: Ali handed me a small device with no markings. 'It has a *special* frequency,' she said quietly. 'Zero's team cannot detect it.' I clipped it to my collar and stepped into the open street. The rain had stopped. That felt wrong — the silence was too clean, too still.
special:1.cnHint: 阿栗给了我一个有____频率的装置，但我走上街头时，那片异常的寂静让我不安。
special:1.hook: In Harbor City, silence was never a good sign.
special:1.line: 'This has a *special* frequency — Zero cannot hear it,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Ali handed me a small device with no markings.
sentences.cn: 阿栗递给我一个没有任何标记的小装置。

sentences.en: 'It has a *special* frequency,' she said quietly.
'Zero's team cannot detect it.'
sentences.cn: "零点的队伍查不到。"

sentences.en: I clipped it to my collar and stepped into the open street.
sentences.cn: 我把它夹在领口上，走进了开放的街道。

sentences.en: The rain had stopped.
sentences.cn: 雨停了。

sentences.en: That felt wrong — the silence was too clean, too still.
sentences.cn: 这感觉不对——沉默太干净了，太死寂了。

text:1.en: A small screen on the wall flickered to life as I passed. One line of *text* appeared, white on black: THEY KNOW YOU ARE HERE. Then it went dark. I kept walking, steady pace, eyes forward. If I ran, I was finished. If I stopped, same result.
text:1.cnHint: 墙上的屏幕突然亮起，一行____出现后立刻熄灭，内容让我心跳加速。
text:1.hook: My next step could be my last free one.
text:1.line: 'Read that *text* again — every word is a warning,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: A small screen on the wall flickered to life as I passed.
sentences.cn: 我走过时，墙上的小屏幕闪亮了。

sentences.en: One line of *text* appeared, white on black: THEY KNOW YOU ARE HERE.
Then it went dark.
sentences.cn: 然后灭了。

sentences.en: I kept walking, steady pace, eyes forward.
sentences.cn: 我继续往前走，步伐稳定，眼睛直视。

sentences.en: If I ran, I was finished.
sentences.cn: 要是我跑了，就完了。

sentences.en: If I stopped, same result.
sentences.cn: 要是我停下来，结果一样。

front:1.en: I came around the corner and stopped. Zero was standing at the *front* of the old signal tower, back straight, hood down, facing me directly. No guards. No cover. Just the two of us on a wet empty street under a sky full of dead satellites.
front:1.cnHint: 转过街角，我看见零点就站在旧信号塔的____，直视着我。
front:1.hook: Zero smiled, and that was the most frightening thing yet.
front:1.line: 'Meet me at the *front* of the tower — come alone,' Zero had said.

sentences.en: I came around the corner and stopped.
sentences.cn: 我转过街角，停住了。

sentences.en: Zero was standing at the *front* of the old signal tower, back straight, hood down, facing me directly.
No guards.
sentences.cn: 没有保镖。

sentences.en: No cover.
sentences.cn: 没有掩护。

sentences.en: Just the two of us on a wet empty street under a sky full of dead satellites.
sentences.cn: 就我们两个站在湿漉漉的空街上，头顶是满天的死卫星。

law:1.en: Grey Crow spread his hands. 'You cannot use the *law* against Zero here — the city council is bought, the judges are blind, the records are forged.' I stared at the wet pavement. Then I looked up. There was one channel left that Zero had not yet closed.
law:1.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我，在这座城市里____已经失效，对付零点只剩最后一条路。
law:1.hook: That last channel was the most dangerous one of all.
law:1.line: 'The *law* won't touch Zero — we have to find another way,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow spread his hands.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦摊开了双手。

sentences.en: 'You cannot use the *law* against Zero here — the city council is bought, the judges are blind, the records are forged.'
I stared at the wet pavement.
sentences.cn: 我盯着湿漉漉的人行道。

sentences.en: Then I looked up.
sentences.cn: 然后我抬起头。

sentences.en: There was one channel left that Zero had not yet closed.
sentences.cn: 还有一条频道，零点还没堵死。

himself:0.en: The signal room was silent except for the hum of old machines. Grey Crow stood at the center console, checking every wire *himself*. He trusted no one else with this. One wrong connection and the whole broadcast would collapse — and with it, our only chance to expose Zero.
himself:0.cnHint: 灰鸦亲自在信号室检查每一根线路，因为这次任务容不得任何差错。
himself:0.hook: Then one wire glowed red — and it was not supposed to.
himself:0.line: 'I do this *himself* — no one touches these wires but me.'

sentences.en: The signal room was silent except for the hum of old machines.
sentences.cn: 讯号室里只有旧机器的嗡鸣声。

sentences.en: Grey Crow stood at the center console, checking every wire *himself*.
He trusted no one else with this.
sentences.cn: 他不信任任何人来做这事。

sentences.en: One wrong connection and the whole broadcast would collapse — and with it, our only chance to expose Zero.
sentences.cn: 一根线接错了，整个广播就会崩溃——我们揭露零点的唯一机会也就没了。

landscape:0.en: Ali pulled up the city map on the cracked screen. The data *landscape* spread before us like a glowing grid — every encrypted node, every dead signal, every hidden route Zero had used. It was beautiful and terrifying at once. Somewhere in that web was the answer.
landscape:0.cnHint: 阿栗展开了城市的数据____，我们试图从中找到零点的藏身之处。
landscape:0.hook: One node pulsed twice, then went dark forever.
landscape:0.line: 'Look at this *landscape* — Zero left his marks everywhere.'

sentences.en: Ali pulled up the city map on the cracked screen.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在破裂的屏幕上调出了城市地图。

sentences.en: The data *landscape* spread before us like a glowing grid — every encrypted node, every dead signal, every hidden route Zero had used.
It was beautiful and terrifying at once.
sentences.cn: 那既美得令人窒息，又骇人听闻。

sentences.en: Somewhere in that web was the answer.
sentences.cn: 答案就藏在那张网里的某个角落。

mentally:0.en: I sat in the corner of the safe room, eyes closed. Grey Crow said to rest, but I was *mentally* mapping every move Zero had made in the last three days. Each step, each signal, each silence. When I opened my eyes, I knew which door he would use.
mentally:0.cnHint: 调查员在休息室里____推演零点的每一步行动，试图预判他的下一个目标。
mentally:0.hook: The door at the end of the hall clicked open.
mentally:0.line: 'I am *mentally* three steps ahead of him already.'

sentences.en: I sat in the corner of the safe room, eyes closed.
sentences.cn: 我坐在安全屋的角落里，闭上眼睛。

sentences.en: Grey Crow said to rest, but I was *mentally* mapping every move Zero had made in the last three days.
Each step, each signal, each silence.
sentences.cn: 每一步，每一个信号，每一段沉默。

sentences.en: When I opened my eyes, I knew which door he would use.
sentences.cn: 当我睁开眼睛时，我已经知道他会用哪扇门。

neither:0.en: Grey Crow laid two data chips on the table. *Neither* one held the full code — Zero had split it on purpose. Without both chips active at the same time, the locked broadcast would stay dark. Ali and I looked at each other. We had only one chip.
neither:0.cnHint: 桌上的两块芯片____单独包含完整密码，零点显然早有安排。
neither:0.hook: Ali's hand moved to her coat pocket and stopped cold.
neither:0.line: '*Neither* chip works alone — he planned this from the start.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow laid two data chips on the table.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在桌上放下两块数据芯片。

sentences.en: *Neither* one held the full code — Zero had split it on purpose.
Without both chips active at the same time, the locked broadcast would stay dark.
sentences.cn: 没有两块芯片同时激活，那条上锁的广播就永远黑着。

sentences.en: Ali and I looked at each other.
sentences.cn: 阿栗和我互看一眼。

sentences.en: We had only one chip.
sentences.cn: 我们只有一块芯片。

onto:0.en: Ali threw the decryption key *onto* the console screen and it landed in the active slot with a sharp click. The room filled with static, then a voice — cold and flat — began to read coordinates. Grey Crow grabbed his earpiece. This was the signal we had waited days to hear.
onto:0.cnHint: 阿栗将解密密钥投____控制台，隐藏的信号终于开始播报坐标。
onto:0.hook: The coordinates pointed to a place we had already burned.
onto:0.line: 'Drop it *onto* the slot — now, before the window closes.'

sentences.en: Ali threw the decryption key *onto* the console screen and it landed in the active slot with a sharp click.
The room filled with static, then a voice — cold and flat — began to read coordinates.
sentences.cn: 房间里充满了静电噪音，然后一个声音——冷漠而生硬——开始读出坐标。

sentences.en: Grey Crow grabbed his earpiece.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦抓起耳机。

sentences.en: This was the signal we had waited days to hear.

plus:0.en: Grey Crow wrote the equation on the fogged glass: signal strength *plus* location data equals Zero's next broadcast point. It was simple math, but no one had tried it before. Ali ran the numbers twice. The result was a single address in the lower port district.
plus:0.cnHint: 灰鸦用一个简单公式——信号强度____位置数据——锁定了零点的下一个广播地点。
plus:0.hook: The address matched a building we thought was empty.
plus:0.line: 'Frequency *plus* position — that is how we find him tonight.'

It was simple math, but no one had tried it before.
sentences.cn: 这只是简单的数学，但从没人试过。

sentences.en: Ali ran the numbers twice.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把数字验算了两遍。

sentences.en: The result was a single address in the lower port district.

root:0.cnHint: 调查员终于找到了零点虚假信号的____，只要切断它，整个网络就会崩溃。
root:0.hook: Grey Crow finally spoke: 'Don't touch it yet.'
root:0.line: 'This is the *root* — cut it and his whole web falls.'

sentences.cn: 我终于找到了那行损坏的代码。

sentences.en: It was buried deep, but this was the *root* of every false signal Zero had sent us over the past week.
Pull this one thread and his whole network would unravel.
sentences.cn: 拉开这一根线，他整个网络就会崩塌。

sentences.en: Grey Crow leaned over my shoulder and said nothing for a long moment.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦靠在我肩膀上，长时间没有说话。

satisfy:0.en: Zero's message was short: meet at the old relay station or he would erase every piece of evidence we had collected. It did not *satisfy* Grey Crow. He read it three times, jaw tight, then set it down. 'It is a trap,' he said. 'But we have no other road.'

satisfy:0.hook: Ali was already checking her gear by the back door.
satisfy:0.line: 'This deal does not *satisfy* me — but we move anyway.'

sentences.en: Zero's message was short: meet at the old relay station or he would erase every piece of evidence we had collected.

sentences.en: 'But we have no other road.'

earth:1.en: Zero's broadcast cut through every channel at once: 'There is no safe ground left in Harbor City. The *earth* under your feet is already ours.' earth:1.line: 'They planted sensors in the *earth* along every route you know.'

sentences.en: Zero's broadcast cut through every channel at once: 'There is no safe ground left in Harbor City.
sentences.cn: 零点的广播同时切入了每一个频道："港湾城已经没有安全的地方了。

I stood at the edge of the district square, rain soaking through my jacket, and felt the cracked pavement shift — just slightly — beneath me.

paper:1.en: A thin sheet of *paper* was pinned to the lamp post at the corner of Dock Nine — an almost forgotten thing in a city of screens. The words were handwritten in pale ink: a meeting point, a time, a warning. Ali had left it. I pulled it free, read it twice, then held it over a heat vent until it was gone.
paper:1.cnHint: 阿栗在路灯柱上留下了一张____，上面手写着碰面地点和一个警告。
paper:1.hook: The ink, I realized too late, had already transferred to my fingers.
paper:1.line: 'The *paper* looks blank — but heat will show you what Ali wrote.'

sentences.en: A thin sheet of *paper* was pinned to the lamp post at the corner of Dock Nine — an almost forgotten thing in a city of screens.
The words were handwritten in pale ink: a meeting point, a time, a warning.
sentences.cn: 句子用淡色墨水手写而成：一个碰头点，一个时间，一个警告。

sentences.en: Ali had left it.
sentences.cn: 是阿栗留的。

sentences.en: I pulled it free, read it twice, then held it over a heat vent until it was gone.
sentences.cn: 我把它扯下来，读了两遍，然后在热风口上烧到消失。

art:1.en: The coded graffiti covering the sub-station wall was not random noise. Grey Crow had called it *art* — a living cipher that rewrote itself each night. I scanned each layer, peeling the visual signals apart in my mind. The outermost marks were decoys. The real message sat underneath, painted in a frequency only I could read.
art:1.cnHint: 格雷·克罗告诉我，变电站墙上的加密涂鸦是一种____，每晚都会自我改写，表层只是伪装。
art:1.hook: The innermost layer spelled out my own case number.
art:1.line: 'Zero turned code into *art* — that is what makes him so hard to catch.'

sentences.en: The coded graffiti covering the sub-station wall was not random noise.
sentences.cn: 覆盖在地下站墙面上的编码涂鸦不是随机噪音。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had called it *art* — a living cipher that rewrote itself each night.
I scanned each layer, peeling the visual signals apart in my mind.
sentences.cn: 我扫描了每一层，在脑子里剥离了那些视觉信号。

sentences.en: The outermost marks were decoys.
sentences.cn: 最外层的标记是诱饵。

sentences.en: The real message sat underneath, painted in a frequency only I could read.
sentences.cn: 真正的信息在下面，用一种只有我能读懂的频率涂上去的。

street:1.en: Every *street* in the harbor district had a sound — a low hum coded into the traffic signals. I had learned to tell them apart. Tonight the hum on Canal Row was wrong, half a tone too high. Someone had rewritten the signal grid. I walked slower, scanning doorways, roof edges, the dark space between parked transport pods.
street:1.cnHint: 港区每条____都有独特的编码信号音，今晚运河街的信号音被篡改了，有人动了手脚。
street:1.hook: At the far end of the block, a figure stepped into the light and stopped.
street:1.line: 'Clear the *street* — this whole grid is a trap set for you.'

sentences.en: Every *street* in the harbor district had a sound — a low hum coded into the traffic signals.
I had learned to tell them apart.
sentences.cn: 我已经学会了区分它们。

sentences.en: Tonight the hum on Canal Row was wrong, half a tone too high.
sentences.cn: 今晚运河街上的嗡鸣声不对，高了半个音。

sentences.en: Someone had rewritten the signal grid.
sentences.cn: 有人重写了信号网格。

sentences.en: I walked slower, scanning doorways, roof edges, the dark space between parked transport pods.
sentences.cn: 我走得更慢，扫描着门廊、屋顶边缘、停泊运输舱之间的暗处。

talent:1.en: Grey Crow looked me over in the grey pre-dawn light, rain still falling. 'Your *talent* is rare,' they said, quiet and flat. 'Most people hear noise. You hear structure.' I did not answer. Somewhere below, Zero's network was already shifting, erasing tracks, building new walls of code. Rare was not the same as ready.
talent:1.cnHint: 格雷·克罗评价我有罕见的____——别人只听到噪音，而我能听出其中的结构。
talent:1.hook: 'But talent without speed,' Grey Crow added, 'is just a slow way to lose.'
talent:1.line: 'Raw *talent* means nothing if Zero finishes the upload first.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow looked me over in the grey pre-dawn light, rain still falling.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在灰蒙蒙的黎明前光线下打量我，雨还在下。

sentences.en: 'Your *talent* is rare,' they said, quiet and flat.
'Most people hear noise.
sentences.cn: "大多数人听到的是噪音。

sentences.en: You hear structure.'
sentences.cn: 你听到的是结构。"

sentences.en: I did not answer.
sentences.cn: 我没有回答。

sentences.en: Somewhere below, Zero's network was already shifting, erasing tracks, building new walls of code.
sentences.cn: 在下面的某处，零点的网络已经在变化、抹去痕迹、构建代码的新墙。

sentences.en: Rare was not the same as ready.
sentences.cn: 稀有不等于做好准备。

overall:1.en: I stopped at the mouth of the alley and ran a quick count: three patrol arcs, two dead signal zones, one open gap near the east fence. *Overall*, the odds were not in my favor — but the gap was real, and it would close in four minutes. Ali's marker glowed faint on my scanner, just past the fence line. Four minutes was enough.
overall:1.cnHint: 我快速评估了整体____形势，发现胜算不大，但东围栏附近有一个真实的突破口，只有四分钟窗口期。
overall:1.hook: My scanner flickered once — Ali's marker had just gone dark.
overall:1.line: '*Overall* the path looks clear, but Zero controls the lights on that block.'

sentences.en: I stopped at the mouth of the alley and ran a quick count: three patrol arcs, two dead signal zones, one open gap near the east fence.
sentences.cn: 我在小巷口停下，快速数了一遍：三道巡逻弧线，两个死信号区，一个靠东篱笆的开口。

sentences.en: *Overall*, the odds were not in my favor — but the gap was real, and it would close in four minutes.
Ali's marker glowed faint on my scanner, just past the fence line.
sentences.cn: 阿栗的标记在我的扫描仪上微弱地闪烁，就在篱笆线外。

sentences.en: Four minutes was enough.
sentences.cn: 四分钟足够了。

satisfaction:1.en: The broadcast tower loomed above the flooded street. I cracked Zero's cipher in under a minute. A quiet *satisfaction* settled in my chest — not pride, just the clean feeling of a lock giving way. Ali watched the decrypted text scroll across my screen and said nothing. That silence felt like a reward.
satisfaction:1.cnHint: 我破解了零点的密码，胸中涌起一种____。
satisfaction:1.hook: But the message inside was addressed to me.
satisfaction:1.line: 'There is a small *satisfaction* in knowing your enemy underestimated you,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The broadcast tower loomed above the flooded street.
sentences.cn: 广播塔在泛滥的街道上高耸入云。

sentences.en: I cracked Zero's cipher in under a minute.
sentences.cn: 我在一分钟内破解了零点的密码。

sentences.en: A quiet *satisfaction* settled in my chest — not pride, just the clean feeling of a lock giving way.
Ali watched the decrypted text scroll across my screen and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 阿栗看着解密后的文字在我屏幕上滚动，什么也没说。

sentences.en: That silence felt like a reward.
sentences.cn: 那沉默感像是一份奖赏。

cultivate:1.en: Grey Crow met me under the broken rail bridge, rain hammering the concrete. 'You don't find sources in Harbor City,' he said. 'You *cultivate* them — slowly, like something fragile growing in bad soil.' He pressed a data chip into my palm. Somewhere above us, Zero's drones circled the block.
cultivate:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在桥下告诉我，如何在这座城市____线人。
cultivate:1.hook: The chip was warm, as if someone had just ripped it free.
cultivate:1.line: '*Cultivate* trust before you ask for secrets,' Grey Crow warned, not looking up.

sentences.en: Grey Crow met me under the broken rail bridge, rain hammering the concrete.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在断裂的铁路桥下与我相遇，雨声击打着混凝土。

sentences.en: 'You don't find sources in Harbor City,' he said.
sentences.cn: "你在港口城找不到信息来源，"他说。

sentences.en: 'You *cultivate* them — slowly, like something fragile growing in bad soil.'
He pressed a data chip into my palm.
sentences.cn: 他把一枚数据芯片塞进我的手心。

sentences.en: Somewhere above us, Zero's drones circled the block.
sentences.cn: 我们上方某处，零点的无人机在街区周围盘旋。

productive:1.en: Ali and I swept three blocks in forty minutes, tagging every coded sign Zero's crew had stencilled on the walls. It was the most *productive* hour I'd had since joining the unit — clean data, clear patterns, a map forming in my head. Then the lights on the whole street went out at once.
productive:1.cnHint: 阿栗和我在街上收集情报，这是最____的一个小时，直到……
productive:1.hook: In the sudden dark, someone behind us started counting down.
productive:1.line: 'Stay focused — *productive* work now saves lives later,' Ali said sharply.

sentences.en: Ali and I swept three blocks in forty minutes, tagging every coded sign Zero's crew had stencilled on the walls.
sentences.cn: 阿栗和我在四十分钟内扫过三个街区，给零点队伍在墙上喷的每一个编码标记做了标记。

sentences.en: It was the most *productive* hour I'd had since joining the unit — clean data, clear patterns, a map forming in my head.
Then the lights on the whole street went out at once.
sentences.cn: 然后整条街的灯一下子全灭了。

vision:1.en: The fog rolled in off the harbour and swallowed the street whole. My *vision* dropped to a few metres; beyond that, only neon smears and moving shadows. I heard Zero's voice somewhere ahead, calm and close, as if the fog carried it directly to my ear. I stopped moving and listened.
vision:1.cnHint: 大雾笼罩街道，我的____只剩几米，但零点的声音清晰传来。
vision:1.hook: He was describing exactly where I was standing.
vision:1.line: 'Good *vision* is not your eyes — it is what you choose to see,' Grey Crow once told me.

sentences.en: The fog rolled in off the harbour and swallowed the street whole.
sentences.cn: 雾气从港口滚滚而来，吞没了整条街。

sentences.en: My *vision* dropped to a few metres; beyond that, only neon smears and moving shadows.
I heard Zero's voice somewhere ahead, calm and close, as if the fog carried it directly to my ear.
sentences.cn: 我听到零点的声音从前方某处传来，平静而清晰，仿佛雾气把它直接送到我的耳边。

sentences.en: I stopped moving and listened.
sentences.cn: 我停止了移动，静静地听着。

distance:1.en: Zero stood at the far end of Harbour Lane. I could not read his face at that *distance*, only the still way he held his shoulders — patient, certain. Ali gripped my arm. 'He wants you to close the gap,' she whispered. 'Don't.' The lane stretched between us like a dare.
distance:1.cnHint: 零点在街道另一头，____太远，我看不清他的表情。
distance:1.hook: He raised one hand and beckoned, slowly.
distance:1.line: 'Keep your *distance* — that is how he wins,' Ali whispered into my ear.

sentences.en: Zero stood at the far end of Harbour Lane.
sentences.cn: 零点站在港口巷的远端。

sentences.en: I could not read his face at that *distance*, only the still way he held his shoulders — patient, certain.
Ali gripped my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗紧紧抓住我的手臂。

sentences.en: 'He wants you to close the gap,' she whispered.
sentences.cn: "他想让你缩小距离，"她低声说。

sentences.en: 'Don't.'
sentences.cn: "别动。"

sentences.en: The lane stretched between us like a dare.
sentences.cn: 那条街像一场挑战一样在我们之间展开。

forward:1.en: Every street in this quarter was blocked — barriers, flooded tunnels, Zero's watchers on the rooftops. There was only one way left: straight through the market crowd, lights blazing overhead, no cover. I made the decision fast. Moving *forward* was the only choice that cost me nothing I couldn't recover. I walked.
forward:1.cnHint: 四处被封锁，我决定向____走，穿过人群。
forward:1.hook: A hand caught my shoulder before I reached the first stall.
forward:1.line: 'The only safe move is *forward* — hesitation is a gift to your enemy,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Every street in this quarter was blocked — barriers, flooded tunnels, Zero's watchers on the rooftops.
sentences.cn: 这个街区的每条街都被封锁了——路障、被淹没的隧道、零点在屋顶上的守望者。

sentences.en: There was only one way left: straight through the market crowd, lights blazing overhead, no cover.
sentences.cn: 只有一条路可走：直接穿过市场人群，头顶灯火通明，没有任何掩护。

sentences.en: I made the decision fast.
sentences.cn: 我快速做出了决定。

sentences.en: Moving *forward* was the only choice that cost me nothing I couldn't recover.
I walked.
sentences.cn: 我走了。

harmful:1.en: The coded graffiti looked simple — a crow, a zero, a wave. But Grey Crow pulled me back before I could photograph it. 'The ink is laced with a signal tag,' he said. 'One scan and they know your device.' Even a picture could be *harmful* here. I lowered my lens and stepped away.
harmful:1.cnHint: 格雷·克劳阻止我拍照，因为这样做可能是____的。
harmful:1.hook: My lens had already auto-scanned for half a second.
harmful:1.line: 'In this city, even looking too long can be *harmful*,' Grey Crow said quietly.

sentences.en: The coded graffiti looked simple — a crow, a zero, a wave.
sentences.cn: 编码涂鸦看起来很简单——一只乌鸦，一个零，一道波浪。

sentences.en: But Grey Crow pulled me back before I could photograph it.
sentences.cn: 但灰鸦在我拍照前把我拉了回来。

sentences.en: 'The ink is laced with a signal tag,' he said.
sentences.cn: "墨水里掺了信号标签，"他说。

sentences.en: 'One scan and they know your device.'
sentences.cn: "扫一下，他们就知道你的设备。"

sentences.en: Even a picture could be *harmful* here.
I lowered my lens and stepped away.
sentences.cn: 我放下了镜头，退了开来。

impossible:1.en: Zero had locked the bridge gate with a six-layer cipher, a crowd of rain-soaked civilians behind me, and a thirty-second window before the patrol looped back. Ali stared at the lock. 'This is *impossible*,' she breathed. I was already working, fingers moving, counting the layers down. Twenty-eight seconds. Twenty-seven.
impossible:1.cnHint: 零点设置了六层密码锁，阿栗说这____破解，但我已经开始了。
impossible:1.hook: The patrol's lights swept around the corner at twenty seconds.
impossible:1.line: '*Impossible* just means no one has been desperate enough yet,' I said, and kept working.

sentences.en: Zero had locked the bridge gate with a six-layer cipher, a crowd of rain-soaked civilians behind me, and a thirty-second window before the patrol looped back.
sentences.cn: 零点用六层密码锁住了桥门，我身后是一群被雨淋湿的平民，还有三十秒时间在巡逻循环回来前完成。

sentences.en: Ali stared at the lock.
sentences.cn: 阿栗盯着那把锁。

sentences.en: 'This is *impossible*,' she breathed.
I was already working, fingers moving, counting the layers down.
sentences.cn: 我已经开始破解了，手指在跳动，层层递减。

sentences.en: Twenty-eight seconds.
sentences.cn: 还有二十八秒。

sentences.en: Twenty-seven.
sentences.cn: 二十七秒。

admit:1.en: The checkpoint gate stood between me and the lower docks. Rain hammered the iron. Grey Crow pressed a cold chip into my palm. 'Show this. They will *admit* you without question.' I walked forward, heart loud, the chip warm against my wet fingers.
admit:1.cnHint: 灰鸦给了我一枚芯片，让我能____进入下层码头的检查站。
admit:1.hook: The guard's scanner beeped once — then went silent.
admit:1.line: 'They will *admit* you, but only if you do not look back.'

sentences.en: The checkpoint gate stood between me and the lower docks.
sentences.cn: 检查站大门挡在我和下层码头之间。

sentences.en: Rain hammered the iron.
sentences.cn: 雨敲打着铁门。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pressed a cold chip into my palm.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把一枚冷冰冰的芯片塞进我的手心。

sentences.en: 'Show this.
sentences.cn: "把这个拿出来。

sentences.en: They will *admit* you without question.'
I walked forward, heart loud, the chip warm against my wet fingers.
sentences.cn: 我往前走，心跳声很大，芯片在我湿漉漉的手指间温热。

association:1.en: Coded graffiti covered the bridge wall — a circle, three lines, a broken key. Ali crouched beside me, voice low. 'That mark belongs to the *Association* of Silent Channels. They run every hidden signal in this district.' I had heard the name once, in a warning.
association:1.cnHint: 阿里辨认出桥墙上的暗号，那是某个地下____留下的标记。
association:1.hook: Someone had painted it fresh — the ink was still wet.
association:1.line: 'The *Association* does not leave marks unless they want to be found.'

sentences.en: Coded graffiti covered the bridge wall — a circle, three lines, a broken key.
sentences.cn: 编码涂鸦覆盖了桥墙——一个圆圈，三条线，一把断裂的钥匙。

sentences.en: Ali crouched beside me, voice low.
sentences.cn: 阿栗蹲在我身边，声音很低。

sentences.en: 'That mark belongs to the *Association* of Silent Channels.
They run every hidden signal in this district.'
sentences.cn: 他们经营这个地区的每一条隐藏信号。

sentences.en: I had heard the name once, in a warning.
sentences.cn: 我曾经听过一次这个名字，在一个警告中。

brand:1.en: A iron sign hung above the night market stall, its letters burned away except one. Grey Crow traced the scar on the metal. 'Every safe house in Harbor City carries this *brand* — you just have to know where the heat touched deepest.' I memorised the shape fast.
brand:1.cnHint: 灰鸦指着铁牌上的烙印告诉我，这个____是秘密据点的标志。
brand:1.hook: Behind the stall, a door opened into total darkness.
brand:1.line: 'Learn this *brand* — it is the only sign you can trust tonight.'

sentences.en: A iron sign hung above the night market stall, its letters burned away except one.
sentences.cn: 一块铁牌挂在夜市摊位上方，它的字母被烧得焦黑，只剩下一个。

sentences.en: Grey Crow traced the scar on the metal.

sentences.en: 'Every safe house in Harbor City carries this *brand* — you just have to know where the heat touched deepest.'
I memorised the shape fast.
sentences.cn: 我很快记住了那个形状。

deep:1.en: We dropped through a service hatch into the understreet. Pipes groaned above. The passage cut *deep* beneath the market crowd, far from any camera, far from any patrol. Ali kept one hand on the wall, guiding us by touch. The air tasted of rust and old rain.
deep:1.cnHint: 我们钻入地下通道，越走越____，远离了所有摄像头。
deep:1.hook: Somewhere ahead, a single light blinked and died.
deep:1.line: 'Go *deep* enough and even Zero cannot hear your steps.'

sentences.en: We dropped through a service hatch into the understreet.
sentences.cn: 我们从服务舱口掉进了地下街道。

sentences.en: Pipes groaned above.
sentences.cn: 头顶的管道呜呜作响。

sentences.en: The passage cut *deep* beneath the market crowd, far from any camera, far from any patrol.
Ali kept one hand on the wall, guiding us by touch.
sentences.cn: 阿栗一只手贴着墙壁，用触觉引领我们前进。

sentences.en: The air tasted of rust and old rain.
sentences.cn: 空气里弥漫着铁锈和陈年雨水的味道。

discover:1.en: I pulled back a sheet of loose metal on the alley wall and *discovered* a row of tiny transmitters, each no bigger than a button, each still blinking. Someone had built a listening web here — patient, quiet, invisible to anyone who did not know to look.
discover:1.cnHint: 我掀开铁皮，____了一排隐藏在巷墙里的微型发射器。
discover:1.hook: One transmitter was pointed directly at our safe house.
discover:1.line: 'If Zero managed to *discover* this spot, we have very little time.'

sentences.en: I pulled back a sheet of loose metal on the alley wall and *discovered* a row of tiny transmitters, each no bigger than a button, each still blinking.
Someone had built a listening web here — patient, quiet, invisible to anyone who did not know to look.
sentences.cn: 有人在这里织了一张监听网——耐心、无声、对任何不知道该看哪里的人都隐形无踪。

essential:1.en: Grey Crow spread a rough map on the wet ground. Rain blurred the ink fast. 'Three exits, two power lines, one clean route out — these are the *essentials*. Forget everything else.' I pressed the details into memory before the next gust of wind erased the map entirely.
essential:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在雨中展开地图，告诉我撤退的几个____要素。
essential:1.hook: The map dissolved — but one exit was already marked with a cross.
essential:1.line: 'Speed and silence — those two are the *essentials* tonight, nothing more.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow spread a rough map on the wet ground.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在湿漉漉的地面铺开一张粗糙的地图。

sentences.en: Rain blurred the ink fast.
sentences.cn: 雨很快就把墨迹模糊了。

sentences.en: 'Three exits, two power lines, one clean route out — these are the *essentials*.
Forget everything else.'
sentences.cn: 忘掉其他所有的。

sentences.en: I pressed the details into memory before the next gust of wind erased the map entirely.
sentences.cn: 我拼命把细节烙进脑子里，下一阵风就要把地图彻底吹散。

fine:1.en: Patrol drones swept the boulevard in slow arcs. Ali touched my arm. 'Walk steady. Look *fine*.' I straightened, slowed my breath, matched the pace of every tired worker heading home under the neon. The drone passed two metres above my head and moved on without a sound.
fine:1.cnHint: 阿里提醒我保持镇定，看起来一切____，以骗过巡逻无人机。
fine:1.hook: The drone circled back — it had caught something on its scan.
fine:1.line: 'Look *fine*, keep walking, and it will pass right over you.'

sentences.en: Patrol drones swept the boulevard in slow arcs.
sentences.cn: 巡逻无人机在林荫道上缓缓扫过。

sentences.en: Ali touched my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗碰了碰我的胳膊。

sentences.en: 'Walk steady.
sentences.cn: 脚步要稳。

sentences.en: Look *fine*.'
I straightened, slowed my breath, matched the pace of every tired worker heading home under the neon.
sentences.cn: 我挺直身体，放缓呼吸，跟上每一个疲惫地在霓虹灯下往家赶的工人的节奏。

sentences.en: The drone passed two metres above my head and moved on without a sound.
sentences.cn: 无人机从我头顶两米处飞过，无声地消失在夜色里。

It sounded almost too clean.
sentences.cn: 听起来好得有点不真实。

sentences.en: In Harbor City, clean plans rarely stayed clean.
sentences.cn: 在港城，顺利的计划很少能保持顺利。

respond:1.en: Rain hammered the street. I pressed my back against the cold wall and broadcast a coded signal into the dark. Nothing. Then, forty seconds later, a light on the far roof blinked twice. Grey Crow had chosen to *respond* in the old way — no words, just light. It meant: I see you. Move now.
respond:1.cnHint: 我发出暗号信号后，灰鸦用屋顶的灯光____了，示意我立刻行动。
respond:1.hook: But the third blink never came, and the roof went dark for good.
respond:1.line: 'I will *respond* only once — so listen carefully.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the street.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在街道上。

sentences.en: I pressed my back against the cold wall and broadcast a coded signal into the dark.
sentences.cn: 我把后背贴上冷冰冰的墙，向黑暗里广播了一个密码信号。

sentences.en: Nothing.
sentences.cn: 没反应。

sentences.en: Then, forty seconds later, a light on the far roof blinked twice.
sentences.cn: 然后，四十秒后，远处屋顶上的一盏灯闪烁了两下。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had chosen to *respond* in the old way — no words, just light.
It meant: I see you.
sentences.cn: 意思是：我看到你了。

sentences.en: Move now.
sentences.cn: 现在就动。

welcome:1.en: The neon arch above the east gate read HARBOR CITY in three dead languages. Nobody had repaired it in years. Ali stood beneath it, collar up, rain running off her shoulders. She gave me a short nod — the only *welcome* I was going to get in this part of town. I walked faster.
welcome:1.cnHint: 在破旧的霓虹拱门下，阿栗用一个点头给了我唯一的____，示意我快走。
welcome:1.hook: Then I noticed the shadow behind her that she clearly had not seen.
welcome:1.line: 'A nod is the only *welcome* you earn on this street.'

sentences.en: The neon arch above the east gate read HARBOR CITY in three dead languages.
sentences.cn: 东门上方的霓虹拱门用三种死了的语言写着"港城"。

sentences.en: Nobody had repaired it in years.
sentences.cn: 没人修过它好多年了。

sentences.en: Ali stood beneath it, collar up, rain running off her shoulders.
sentences.cn: 阿栗站在拱门下，竖起衣领，雨水沿着肩膀滑下。

sentences.en: She gave me a short nod — the only *welcome* I was going to get in this part of town.
I walked faster.
sentences.cn: 我走得更快了。

appeal:1.en: Zero's voice cut through the static on every public speaker along the canal road. It was a broadcast *appeal* — calm, cold, aimed at every resident who could hear: turn in the signal runner or lose power for a week. People stopped walking. They looked at each other. Then they looked at me.
appeal:1.cnHint: 零点通过广播向全体市民发出____，要求举报信号员，周围的人开始把目光投向我。
appeal:1.hook: I had about thirty seconds before someone raised a hand.
appeal:1.line: 'This *appeal* is simple: give us the runner, keep your lights.'

sentences.en: Zero's voice cut through the static on every public speaker along the canal road.
sentences.cn: 零点的声音切过运河路每一个公共扬声器里的静电噪音。

sentences.en: It was a broadcast *appeal* — calm, cold, aimed at every resident who could hear: turn in the signal runner or lose power for a week.
People stopped walking.
sentences.cn: 人们停止了脚步。

sentences.en: They looked at each other.
sentences.cn: 他们互相看了一眼。

sentences.en: Then they looked at me.
sentences.cn: 然后他们看向我。

finally:1.en: Three nights of dead ends. Three nights of wrong tunnels and cold leads. Then, on the rain-slicked corner of Seventh and Canal, I *finally* picked up the signal I had been chasing — a short pulse buried inside the traffic noise, repeating every nine seconds. My hands stopped shaking. My mind went sharp.
finally:1.cnHint: 经过三个夜晚的徒劳追踪，我____在路口捕捉到了那个一直在寻找的隐藏信号。
finally:1.hook: The pulse shifted frequency once, then went completely silent.
finally:1.line: 'You *finally* found it — but so did someone else.'

sentences.en: Three nights of dead ends.
sentences.cn: 三个夜晚的死路。

sentences.en: Three nights of wrong tunnels and cold leads.
sentences.cn: 三个夜晚的错误隧道和冷冰冰的线索。

sentences.en: Then, on the rain-slicked corner of Seventh and Canal, I *finally* picked up the signal I had been chasing — a short pulse buried inside the traffic noise, repeating every nine seconds.
My hands stopped shaking.
sentences.cn: 我的手不再发抖。

sentences.en: My mind went sharp.
sentences.cn: 我的思维变得敏锐。

guess:1.en: Grey Crow pulled me into a doorway and spoke low. 'The coded graffiti on the east wall — what does it mean?' I looked at the marks: a circle, three lines, an arrow. I could only *guess* from the pattern that it was a warning, not a meeting point. Grey Crow's silence told me I was right.
guess:1.cnHint: 灰鸦考我东墙上密码涂鸦的含义，我只能根据图案____它是一个警告。
guess:1.hook: Then Grey Crow said there was a second message hidden inside the first.
guess:1.line: '*Guess* wrong once out here and there is no second chance.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow pulled me into a doorway and spoke low.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把我拉进一个门洞，压低声音说话。

sentences.en: 'The coded graffiti on the east wall — what does it mean?'
sentences.cn: 东墙上的密码涂鸦——什么意思？

sentences.en: I looked at the marks: a circle, three lines, an arrow.
sentences.cn: 我看着那些标记：一个圆圈，三条线，一个箭头。

sentences.en: I could only *guess* from the pattern that it was a warning, not a meeting point.
Grey Crow's silence told me I was right.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦的沉默告诉我我猜对了。

protection:1.en: The signal market ran openly at night on Dry Dock Lane. Sellers offered codes, keys, hidden frequencies — and, for the right price, *protection* from Zero's broadcast sweeps. Ali had paid for that cover once. Tonight the seller's stall was empty, the awning torn, the lock cut clean. Cover was gone.
protection:1.cnHint: 阿栗曾经购买过免遭零点扫描的____，但今晚那个摊位已被洗劫一空。
protection:1.hook: Which meant Zero already knew exactly where we planned to meet.
protection:1.line: 'Without *protection*, your signal lasts maybe two minutes before they find you.'

sentences.en: The signal market ran openly at night on Dry Dock Lane.
sentences.cn: 信号市场每晚都在干船坞巷开门营业。

sentences.en: Sellers offered codes, keys, hidden frequencies — and, for the right price, *protection* from Zero's broadcast sweeps.
Ali had paid for that cover once.
sentences.cn: 阿栗曾经为那种掩护付过钱。

sentences.en: Tonight the seller's stall was empty, the awning torn, the lock cut clean.
sentences.cn: 今晚卖家的摊位空了，帐篷破了，锁被切得干干净净。

sentences.en: Cover was gone.
sentences.cn: 掩护没了。

resident:1.en: The building had been dark for a month. I climbed to the fourth floor and found one light on — a single lamp behind a fogged window. The old *resident* inside opened the door before I knocked. She already knew my face. She pressed a folded card into my hand and said nothing at all.
resident:1.cnHint: 那栋废弃楼里唯一的____在我敲门前就开了门，把一张折叠卡片塞给了我。
resident:1.hook: The card held one word, and that word was my own name.
resident:1.line: 'Every *resident* on this block has been watching you since yesterday.'

sentences.en: The building had been dark for a month.
sentences.cn: 这栋楼已经黑了一个月。

sentences.en: I climbed to the fourth floor and found one light on — a single lamp behind a fogged window.
sentences.cn: 我爬到四楼，发现有一盏灯亮着——一盏灯在一扇雾蒙蒙的窗后。

sentences.en: The old *resident* inside opened the door before I knocked.
She already knew my face.
sentences.cn: 她已经认识我的脸。

sentences.en: She pressed a folded card into my hand and said nothing at all.
sentences.cn: 她把一张折起来的卡片塞进我手里，什么话都没说。

willing:1.en: I needed someone to carry the signal core across the bridge checkpoint. Ali looked at the core in my palm — small, warm, worth ten years in a labor block if caught. She was quiet for a long moment. Then she closed my fingers around it and said she was *willing*. I did not know what to say.
willing:1.cnHint: 阿栗看着那枚危险的信号核心沉默片刻后，说她____承担这次风险，我一时语塞。
willing:1.hook: Her eyes said something else entirely, and I almost asked what it was.
willing:1.line: 'I am *willing* — but you owe me the truth when this is over.'

sentences.en: I needed someone to carry the signal core across the bridge checkpoint.
sentences.cn: 我需要有人把信号核心运过检查站桥。

sentences.en: Ali looked at the core in my palm — small, warm, worth ten years in a labor block if caught.
sentences.cn: 阿栗看着我掌心里的核心——小小的，暖暖的，被抓住的话能判十年劳动营。

sentences.en: She was quiet for a long moment.
sentences.cn: 她沉默了好一阵。

sentences.en: Then she closed my fingers around it and said she was *willing*.
I did not know what to say.
sentences.cn: 我不知道该说什么。

machine:1.en: The rain hit the street like static. I crouched behind a broken vending unit on Fifth Canal. The *machine* that ran Harbor City's traffic grid sat exposed in the open — wires cut, screen dark. Someone had already been here. The silence was wrong.
machine:1.cnHint: 调查员在街头发现控制城市交通的____已被人动过手脚。
machine:1.hook: A fresh boot-print in the oil told me I was not alone.
machine:1.line: Grey Crow said, 'The *machine* does not forget who touched it last.'

sentences.en: The rain hit the street like static.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在街道上，像静电一样。

sentences.en: I crouched behind a broken vending unit on Fifth Canal.
sentences.cn: 我蜷缩在第五运河一台破损的自动售货机后面。

sentences.en: The *machine* that ran Harbor City's traffic grid sat exposed in the open — wires cut, screen dark.
Someone had already been here.
sentences.cn: 已经有人来过这里了。

sentences.en: The silence was wrong.
sentences.cn: 这寂静不对劲。

observe:1.en: Ali pulled me into a doorway on Ash Street. 'We *observe* the old protocol tonight,' she said. Every agent who worked this district knew the rule: lights off, hoods up, no names spoken aloud. The neon above us buzzed and died. Then we saw the figure cross below.
observe:1.cnHint: 调查员和阿栗在街头____约定好的旧规矩，悄悄等待目标出现。
observe:1.hook: The figure stopped, turned, and looked straight up at us.
observe:1.line: Ali said, 'We *observe* the rule or we do not leave this street.'

sentences.en: Ali pulled me into a doorway on Ash Street.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把我拉进灰烬街的一个门廊里。

sentences.en: 'We *observe* the old protocol tonight,' she said.
Every agent who worked this district knew the rule: lights off, hoods up, no names spoken aloud.
sentences.cn: 在这片区域工作的每个特工都知道这条规则：灯灭，兜帽拉上，名字别出声。

sentences.en: The neon above us buzzed and died.
sentences.cn: 我们头顶的霓虹嗡鸣一声，熄灭了。

sentences.en: Then we saw the figure cross below.
sentences.cn: 然后我们看见一个身影在下面穿过。

fat:1.en: The market stalls on Copper Row were dark except for one lamp. A man with rings on every finger sat eating from a tin. Grey Crow had warned me about him — the *fat* profit he made selling signal keys meant he knew every move Zero planned. I needed him to talk.
fat:1.cnHint: 调查员在街头市场找到一个靠出卖信号密钥赚取____利润的线人。
fat:1.hook: He looked up slowly, grease on his chin, and smiled like he expected me.
fat:1.line: Grey Crow said, 'The *fat* in this city belongs to those who hold the keys.'

sentences.en: The market stalls on Copper Row were dark except for one lamp.
sentences.cn: 铜行的市集摊位都黑着，除了一盏灯。

sentences.en: A man with rings on every finger sat eating from a tin.
sentences.cn: 一个手指上戴满戒指的男人坐在吃罐头里的东西。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned me about him — the *fat* profit he made selling signal keys meant he knew every move Zero planned.
I needed him to talk.
sentences.cn: 我需要他开口说话。

helpful:1.en: Zero's courier dropped a folded card on the wet pavement of Bridge Lane and walked on without slowing. I picked it up. The card was blank except for a single coordinate. It was almost *helpful* — almost. Any lead Zero left in the open was also a trap. I stood still and thought.
helpful:1.cnHint: 调查员捡到零点留下的线索卡片，这个____的提示很可能是个圈套。
helpful:1.hook: Across the lane, a shadow peeled itself off the wall and moved toward me.
helpful:1.line: Ali said, 'That card is only *helpful* if you already know what it costs.'

sentences.en: Zero's courier dropped a folded card on the wet pavement of Bridge Lane and walked on without slowing.
sentences.cn: 零点的信使在桥巷的湿漉漉路面上放下一张折叠的卡片，然后没有放慢速度就继续走了。

sentences.en: I picked it up.
sentences.cn: 我捡起了它。

sentences.en: The card was blank except for a single coordinate.
sentences.cn: 卡片除了一个单独的坐标什么都没有。

sentences.en: It was almost *helpful* — almost.
Any lead Zero left in the open was also a trap.
sentences.cn: 零点在开放的地方留下的任何线索也都是陷阱。

sentences.en: I stood still and thought.
sentences.cn: 我站着不动，思考着。

position:1.en: Grey Crow met me under the broken clock at North Wharf. He pointed up at the roof line. 'Zero has taken a *position* on the high platform — clear view of the whole square.' My throat tightened. From that height Zero could track anyone. There was no cover worth trusting below.
position:1.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉调查员，零点已经占据了广场上方的有利____，可以监视一切。
position:1.hook: The clock above us gave one dead tick, then stopped forever.
position:1.line: Grey Crow said, 'That *position* gives Zero every exit in a single glance.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow met me under the broken clock at North Wharf.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在北码头破损的钟下和我见了面。

sentences.en: He pointed up at the roof line.
sentences.cn: 他指向屋顶线。

sentences.en: 'Zero has taken a *position* on the high platform — clear view of the whole square.'
My throat tightened.
sentences.cn: 我的喉咙紧了。

sentences.en: From that height Zero could track anyone.
sentences.cn: 从那个高度零点可以追踪任何人。

sentences.en: There was no cover worth trusting below.
sentences.cn: 下面没有值得信任的掩护。

threat:1.en: A line of coded graffiti ran down the wall of Transit Alley — fresh paint, still wet. Ali read it faster than I could. 'It is a *threat*,' she said quietly. 'Signed by Zero. Directed at anyone who reports to the bureau tonight.' My hand went to my collar comm and stayed there.
threat:1.cnHint: 涂鸦巷里出现了零点留下的____，警告所有向当局报告的人。
threat:1.hook: Somewhere behind the wall, a door opened with a sound like a held breath.
threat:1.line: Ali said, 'A *threat* written in public means Zero wants us frightened before we act.'

sentences.en: A line of coded graffiti ran down the wall of Transit Alley — fresh paint, still wet.
sentences.cn: 一排编码的涂鸦沿着运输巷的墙壁往下——新鲜的油漆，还湿着。

sentences.en: Ali read it faster than I could.
sentences.cn: 阿栗比我快得多地读出来了。

sentences.en: 'It is a *threat*,' she said quietly.
'Signed by Zero.
sentences.cn: 由零点签名。

sentences.en: Directed at anyone who reports to the bureau tonight.'
sentences.cn: 指向今晚任何向局里报告的人。

sentences.en: My hand went to my collar comm and stayed there.
sentences.cn: 我的手摸向了我的领口通讯器，停在那里。

trend:1.en: I had tracked every move Zero made over the past six weeks. The pattern was clear once you mapped it: each strike was closer to the Central Relay. Grey Crow called it a *trend* toward control — whoever held the Relay held the city's voice. Tonight the line finally reached its end point.
trend:1.cnHint: 调查员发现零点的行动有一个明显的____，每次都更靠近城市的核心中继站。
trend:1.hook: The Central Relay tower blinked once on the skyline, then went completely dark.
trend:1.line: Grey Crow said, 'This *trend* ends at the Relay — or it ends us.'

sentences.en: I had tracked every move Zero made over the past six weeks.
sentences.cn: 过去六周，我追踪了零点做的每一个动作。

sentences.en: The pattern was clear once you mapped it: each strike was closer to the Central Relay.
sentences.cn: 一旦你把它绘制出来，这个模式就很清楚了：每次打击都离中央中继更近一些。

sentences.en: Grey Crow called it a *trend* toward control — whoever held the Relay held the city's voice.
Tonight the line finally reached its end point.
sentences.cn: 今晚这条线终于到达了终点。

ultimately:1.en: Ali and I split at the East Gate. Every route we had traced, every coded signal we had cracked, every risk we had taken in the wet streets of Harbor City — it all led here. *Ultimately*, the city would survive or fall on what happened in the next ten minutes. I stepped forward.
ultimately:1.cnHint: 调查员意识到一切调查和冒险____都指向此刻的决定性行动。
ultimately:1.hook: The gate swung open before I touched it — someone knew I was coming.
ultimately:1.line: Ali said, 'We *ultimately* answer for this city, you and I, right now.'

sentences.en: Ali and I split at the East Gate.
sentences.cn: 阿栗和我在东门分开了。

sentences.en: Every route we had traced, every coded signal we had cracked, every risk we had taken in the wet streets of Harbor City — it all led here.
sentences.cn: 我们追踪过的每条路线，我们破解过的每个编码信号，我们在港城的湿漉漉街道上冒过的每个风险——都导向了这里。

sentences.en: *Ultimately*, the city would survive or fall on what happened in the next ten minutes.
I stepped forward.
sentences.cn: 我向前走去。

slightly:1.en: The rain had stopped. I moved through the market alley, my coat *slightly* damp from the last shower. Grey Crow waited near a broken lamp post, eyes scanning the crowd. Something was off. The stalls were too quiet, the vendors too still. Someone had cleared this street before we arrived.
slightly:1.cnHint: 我穿过市场小巷，感觉气氛不对，灰鸦已在等我，街道____ 有些异样。
slightly:1.hook: Grey Crow whispered one word, then vanished into the dark.
slightly:1.line: 'The air feels *slightly* wrong — someone swept this street clean.'

sentences.en: The rain had stopped.
sentences.cn: 雨停了。

sentences.en: I moved through the market alley, my coat *slightly* damp from the last shower.
Grey Crow waited near a broken lamp post, eyes scanning the crowd.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在一个破损的灯柱边等着，眼睛扫过人群。

sentences.en: Something was off.
sentences.cn: 哪里不对。

sentences.en: The stalls were too quiet, the vendors too still.
sentences.cn: 市集太安静了，小贩太静止了。

sentences.en: Someone had cleared this street before we arrived.
sentences.cn: 有人在我们到达之前清空了这条街。

vital:1.en: Grey Crow pressed a folded note into my hand between two market stalls. 'This address,' he said. Outside, coded graffiti covered every wall. One symbol matched the note exactly. That symbol was *vital* — without it, the whole network of hidden drops stayed invisible to any outsider trying to map them.
vital:1.cnHint: 灰鸦给了我一张纸条，上面的地址对整个行动____。
vital:1.hook: The symbol began to fade, as if the wall itself was erasing it.
vital:1.line: 'That mark is *vital* — lose it and we lose everything.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow pressed a folded note into my hand between two market stalls.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在两个市集摊位之间把一张折叠的纸条塞进我手里。

sentences.en: 'This address,' he said.
sentences.cn: 这个地址，他说。

sentences.en: Outside, coded graffiti covered every wall.
sentences.cn: 外面，编码的涂鸦覆盖了每面墙。

sentences.en: One symbol matched the note exactly.
sentences.cn: 一个符号和纸条完全匹配。

sentences.en: That symbol was *vital* — without it, the whole network of hidden drops stayed invisible to any outsider trying to map them.

mention:1.en: Ali caught up with me at the edge of the night market, out of breath. She had heard a broadcast — scrambled, but clear enough. There was one *mention* of my name inside it, buried between static and noise. One mention was enough. Zero knew I was here, and Zero never warned without reason.
mention:1.cnHint: 阿栗听到一段广播，里面有一次对我名字的____，这让我们都紧张起来。
mention:1.hook: Ali grabbed my arm: 'That broadcast is still looping.'
mention:1.line: 'One *mention* of your name — Zero put it there on purpose.'

sentences.en: Ali caught up with me at the edge of the night market, out of breath.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在夜间市集的边缘赶上了我，上气不接下气。

sentences.en: She had heard a broadcast — scrambled, but clear enough.
sentences.cn: 她听到了一条广播——加密的，但足够清楚。

sentences.en: There was one *mention* of my name inside it, buried between static and noise.
One mention was enough.
sentences.cn: 一提就够了。

sentences.en: Zero knew I was here, and Zero never warned without reason.
sentences.cn: 零点知道我在这里，零点从来不警告无缘无故。

rare:1.en: The upper streets of Harbor City were almost empty at this hour. Clean air up here was *rare*; most nights the smog sat heavy over the lower markets. I spotted Zero standing on a bridge above the transit lines, coat still, watching me. He had chosen this spot carefully. High ground. Clear sight.
rare:1.cnHint: 高处街道的清洁空气____，零点就站在那里的桥上，居高临下地注视着我。
rare:1.hook: Zero raised one hand — not a wave, a signal to someone behind me.
rare:1.line: 'Clear air is *rare* up here — enjoy it while you can.'

sentences.en: The upper streets of Harbor City were almost empty at this hour.
sentences.cn: 港湾城上城区在这个时间段几乎空无一人。

sentences.en: Clean air up here was *rare*; most nights the smog sat heavy over the lower markets.
I spotted Zero standing on a bridge above the transit lines, coat still, watching me.
sentences.cn: 我看到零点站在高架上方的桥上，大衣纹丝不动，看着我。

sentences.en: He had chosen this spot carefully.
sentences.cn: 他精心选择了这个位置。

sentences.en: High ground.
sentences.cn: 居高临下。

sentences.en: Clear sight.
sentences.cn: 视野开阔。

useful:1.en: Ali handed me a small drive she had pulled from a crack in the market wall. 'Could be nothing,' she said. I turned it over. It was warm, recently placed. Grey Crow had told me that old drops like this were still *useful* — the network hid its most sensitive data in the lowest-tech spots.
useful:1.cnHint: 阿栗找到一个藏在墙缝里的小设备，灰鸦说这类旧藏点依然____。
useful:1.hook: The drive's single light blinked once, then held steady.
useful:1.line: 'Old drops are still *useful* — Zero's crew forgot about them.'

sentences.en: Ali handed me a small drive she had pulled from a crack in the market wall.
sentences.cn: 阿栗从市场墙的裂缝里拉出一个小芯片递给我。

sentences.en: 'Could be nothing,' she said.
sentences.cn: "可能什么都不是，"她说。

sentences.en: I turned it over.
sentences.cn: 我翻转了一下。

sentences.en: It was warm, recently placed.
sentences.cn: 还是热的，刚放不久。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told me that old drops like this were still *useful* — the network hid its most sensitive data in the lowest-tech spots.
