sentences.en: Grey Crow grabbed my arm before I could move.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在我还没来得及动弹前就抓住了我的手臂。

sentences.en: 'They will delete the file in sixty seconds,' he said.
sentences.cn: 他说，文件会在六十秒内被删除。

sentences.en: I tried to turn back.
sentences.cn: 我试图转身回去。

sentences.en: He did not let go.
sentences.cn: 他没有松开。

sentences.en: He would *insist* we go forward, no matter the cost.

investigation:1.en: Neon signs bled color across the wet pavement of South Ring Road. Ali knelt beside a cracked data terminal, copying its last log. 'This *investigation* started with one stolen signal,' she said quietly. Three blocks away, a siren woke up. Someone knew we were here.
investigation:1.cnHint: 阿里在破旧的终端旁，回顾这场____的起点。
investigation:1.hook: The siren cut off — silence is always worse.
investigation:1.line: 'This *investigation* will either free us or finish us.'

sentences.en: Neon signs bled color across the wet pavement of South Ring Road.
sentences.cn: 霓虹灯在南环路的湿润路面上渗透出颜色。

sentences.en: Ali knelt beside a cracked data terminal, copying its last log.
sentences.cn: 阿栗蹲在一台破损的数据终端旁，复制它最后的日志。

sentences.en: 'This *investigation* started with one stolen signal,' she said quietly.
Three blocks away, a siren woke up.
sentences.cn: 三个街区外，警笛声醒了。

sentences.en: Someone knew we were here.
sentences.cn: 有人知道我们在这里。

limited:1.en: Zero stood at the far end of Bridge Nine, coat whipping in the wind off the bay. He smiled. 'Your time is *limited*,' he called across the gap. I checked the signal jammer in my pocket — forty seconds of power left. The bridge lights flickered and died.
limited:1.cnHint: 零点提醒我，我的时间是____的，令我倍感压力。
limited:1.hook: Forty seconds — then the whole city would hear us.

sentences.en: Zero stood at the far end of Bridge Nine, coat whipping in the wind off the bay.
sentences.cn: 零点站在九号桥的远端，外套在来自海湾的风中飘动。

sentences.en: He smiled.
sentences.cn: 他笑了。

sentences.en: 'Your time is *limited*,' he called across the gap.
I checked the signal jammer in my pocket — forty seconds of power left.
sentences.cn: 我检查了口袋里的信号干扰器——还有四十秒的电量。

sentences.en: The bridge lights flickered and died.
sentences.cn: 桥上的灯闪烁了一下，然后全灭了。

listen:1.en: Coded graffiti covered the wall of the old port tunnel. Grey Crow touched a painted ear symbol and whispered, '*Listen*.' I held still. Beneath the rain and traffic noise, a low broadcast pulsed — numbers, then a name. My name. The tunnel felt suddenly much smaller.
listen:1.cnHint: 灰鸦让我____，隧道深处传来了令人不安的信号。
listen:1.hook: Someone had been broadcasting my name for hours.
listen:1.line: '*Listen* carefully — the signal only repeats three times.'

sentences.en: Coded graffiti covered the wall of the old port tunnel.
sentences.cn: 密码涂鸦覆盖了老港口隧道的墙。

sentences.en: Grey Crow touched a painted ear symbol and whispered, '*Listen*.'
I held still.
sentences.cn: 我静静地站着。

sentences.en: Beneath the rain and traffic noise, a low broadcast pulsed — numbers, then a name.
sentences.cn: 在雨声和车流噪音下，一阵低沉的广播脉动着——数字，然后是一个名字。

sentences.en: My name.
sentences.cn: 我的名字。

sentences.en: The tunnel felt suddenly much smaller.
sentences.cn: 隧道突然感觉小了很多。

master:1.en: The plaza outside Central Archive was empty at this hour. Ali pointed to a small bronze plate by the door — it read: ZERO, *MASTER* OF NETWORK SYSTEMS, 2091. We looked at each other. Our enemy had built this place. Every alarm inside was his.
master:1.cnHint: 阿里发现零点曾是这栋建筑的____，我们陷入了他的地盘。
master:1.hook: Every camera above us tilted — slowly — toward us.
master:1.line: 'He is the *master* here — we follow his rules now.'

sentences.en: The plaza outside Central Archive was empty at this hour.
sentences.cn: 中央档案馆外的广场在这个时间空荡荡的。

sentences.en: Ali pointed to a small bronze plate by the door — it read: ZERO, *MASTER* OF NETWORK SYSTEMS, 2091.
We looked at each other.
sentences.cn: 我们互相看了一眼。

sentences.en: Our enemy had built this place.
sentences.cn: 我们的敌人建造了这个地方。

sentences.en: Every alarm inside was his.
sentences.cn: 里面的每一个警报都属于他。

newly:1.en: I found the *newly* painted mark on the pillar at Harbor North Station just before dawn. The paint was still soft under my finger. Grey Crow had been here minutes ago. He had left a direction — east, platform zero — and nothing else. I ran.
newly:1.cnHint: 我在车站柱子上发现了____涂上的记号，灰鸦刚刚离开。
newly:1.hook: Platform zero did not appear on any official map.
newly:1.line: 'The *newly* placed mark means he is still alive — move.'

sentences.en: I found the *newly* painted mark on the pillar at Harbor North Station just before dawn.
The paint was still soft under my finger.
sentences.cn: 油漆在我的手指下还是软的。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had been here minutes ago.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦几分钟前在这里。

sentences.en: He had left a direction — east, platform zero — and nothing else.
sentences.cn: 他留下了一个方向——东边，零号站台——别的什么都没有。

sentences.en: I ran.
sentences.cn: 我跑了起来。

north:1.en: Ali's map showed one safe route: straight *north*, through the flooded market district. Zero's drones swept every other street. We moved fast, boots loud on standing water, neon reflections breaking at our feet. Halfway through, Ali stopped and grabbed my sleeve. 'Someone is following,' she breathed.
north:1.cnHint: 我们向____穿越积水的市场区，却感觉有人在跟踪我们。
north:1.hook: The footsteps behind us matched ours — perfectly.
north:1.line: 'Head *north* and do not stop, whatever you hear.'

sentences.en: Ali's map showed one safe route: straight *north*, through the flooded market district.
Zero's drones swept every other street.
sentences.cn: 零点的无人机扫遍了其他每一条街道。

sentences.en: We moved fast, boots loud on standing water, neon reflections breaking at our feet.
sentences.cn: 我们快速移动，靴子踩在积水上发出沉闷的声音，霓虹灯的倒影在脚下碎裂。

sentences.en: Halfway through, Ali stopped and grabbed my sleeve.
sentences.cn: 走到中途，阿栗突然停下来，抓住我的袖子。

sentences.en: 'Someone is following,' she breathed.
sentences.cn: "有人在跟踪我们，"她低声说。

obviously:1.en: The cargo door at Pier Eleven was open. *Obviously* someone had left in a hurry — a cold coffee cup, a live terminal, a coat still on the chair. Zero had been working here tonight. I touched the terminal screen. One folder was still open: my case file.
obviously:1.cnHint: 码头的现场____表明零点匆忙离开，而我的案件档案赫然在屏幕上。
obviously:1.hook: My own photograph stared back at me from his screen.
obviously:1.line: 'He *obviously* knew we were coming — this is a trap.'

sentences.en: The cargo door at Pier Eleven was open.
sentences.cn: 十一号码头的货舱门是开着的。

sentences.en: *Obviously* someone had left in a hurry — a cold coffee cup, a live terminal, a coat still on the chair.
Zero had been working here tonight.
sentences.cn: 零点今晚在这里工作过。

sentences.en: I touched the terminal screen.
sentences.cn: 我摸了摸终端屏幕。

sentences.en: One folder was still open: my case file.
sentences.cn: 有一个文件夹还开着：我的案卷。

pose:1.en: Rain hit the street in sheets. Zero stood under a broken light, arms crossed, chin up — a *pose* so still it looked carved from the wet dark. I studied every angle. That kind of stillness was not rest. It was calculation. My earpiece crackled with a hidden signal, and I knew he was waiting for me to move first.
pose:1.cnHint: 零在街灯下摆出一个静止的____，叙述者感觉这是一个陷阱。
pose:1.line: 'That *pose* of yours tells me everything, investigator.'

sentences.en: Rain hit the street in sheets.
sentences.cn: 雨像幕布一样砸在街道上。

sentences.en: Zero stood under a broken light, arms crossed, chin up — a *pose* so still it looked carved from the wet dark.
I studied every angle.

sentences.en: That kind of stillness was not rest.
sentences.cn: 那种静止不是休息。

sentences.cn: 我的耳机里传来一个隐蔽的信号，劈啪作响，我知道他在等我先动。

stimulate:1.en: Grey Crow pressed a small device into my hand on the wet corner of Fifth and Neon. 'Broadcast this,' he said. Coded words could *stimulate* a sleeping network of hidden agents — push them awake, push them into action. The rain swallowed his footsteps before I could ask a single question.

stimulate:1.hook: I pressed the button, and the whole street went silent.
stimulate:1.line: 'These words will *stimulate* every agent still loyal to the cause.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow pressed a small device into my hand on the wet corner of Fifth and Neon.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在第五街和霓虹街的湿漉漉的角落把一个小装置塞进我的手里。

sentences.en: 'Broadcast this,' he said.
sentences.cn: "播放这个，"他说。

The rain swallowed his footsteps before I could ask a single question.

switch:1.en: The market was alive with noise and neon, but I caught it — one coded sign above a fish stall that told me to *switch* channels on my receiver. I turned the dial. A voice cut through the static, low and urgent. It was Ali, and she was not where she was supposed to be.
switch:1.cnHint: 叙述者在市场中收到暗号，被指示____频道。
switch:1.hook: Ali's voice said, 'Don't come. It's already too late.'
switch:1.line: '*Switch* channels now — Zero is listening to this one.'

sentences.en: The market was alive with noise and neon, but I caught it — one coded sign above a fish stall that told me to *switch* channels on my receiver.
I turned the dial.
sentences.cn: 我转动了表盘。

sentences.en: A voice cut through the static, low and urgent.
sentences.cn: 一个声音切穿了静电噪音，低沉而急促。

sentences.en: It was Ali, and she was not where she was supposed to be.
sentences.cn: 是阿栗，她不在她应该在的地方。

treatment:1.en: I found Ali sitting on a wet curb outside the old signal tower. A burn marked her left arm where a security scanner had tagged her. She shook her head when I reached out. 'The *treatment* for that kind of wound,' she said quietly, 'is time — not a clinic. Clinics ask questions.' Above us, a red drone circled.
treatment:1.cnHint: 阿里受了轻伤，告诉叙述者她需要的____并不是去诊所。
treatment:1.hook: The drone's light locked onto us both.
treatment:1.line: 'The only *treatment* I trust right now is getting out of here fast.'

sentences.en: I found Ali sitting on a wet curb outside the old signal tower.
sentences.cn: 我在旧信号塔外的湿漉漉的马路牙子上找到了阿栗。

sentences.en: A burn marked her left arm where a security scanner had tagged her.
sentences.cn: 一道烧伤标记了她的左臂，那是安全扫描仪打上的。

sentences.en: She shook her head when I reached out.
sentences.cn: 我伸出手时她摇了摇头。

sentences.en: 'The *treatment* for that kind of wound,' she said quietly, 'is time — not a clinic.
Clinics ask questions.'

sentences.en: Above us, a red drone circled.
sentences.cn: 在我们头顶上，一架红色的无人机在盘旋。

union:1.en: The graffiti on the underpass wall read: SIGNAL *UNION* — two words that meant nothing to most people but everything to us. A loose group of coders and investigators, sharing encrypted keys, sharing risk. Grey Crow had painted it himself, years ago. I pressed my hand to the letters and felt the cold truth of what I was now part of.
union:1.cnHint: 叙述者在地下通道看到暗语涂鸦，意识到自己已经加入了某个____。
union:1.hook: Then the wall behind me started to hum.
union:1.line: 'The *union* is the only reason either of us is still free.'

sentences.en: The graffiti on the underpass wall read: SIGNAL *UNION* — two words that meant nothing to most people but everything to us.
A loose group of coders and investigators, sharing encrypted keys, sharing risk.
sentences.cn: 一群松散的编码员和调查者，共享加密钥匙，共享风险。

sentences.cn: 我把手按在那些字母上，感到了我现在成为其中一部分的冰冷真相。

acknowledge:1.en: Zero appeared at the mouth of the alley, just long enough to be seen. He did not speak. He did not need to. A slight tilt of the head — that was enough to *acknowledge* that he had read my last signal, that the game between us had moved to a new level. I felt cold that had nothing to do with the rain.
acknowledge:1.cnHint: 零用一个细微的动作向叙述者____收到了信号，令人不寒而栗。
acknowledge:1.hook: He turned and vanished before I could record his face.
acknowledge:1.line: 'I *acknowledge* your move, investigator — and I raise you one.'

sentences.en: Zero appeared at the mouth of the alley, just long enough to be seen.
sentences.cn: 零点出现在巷口，只停留了一会儿足以被看见。

sentences.en: He did not speak.
sentences.cn: 他没有说话。

sentences.cn: 他不需要说话。

I felt cold that had nothing to do with the rain.
sentences.cn: 我感到了一种与雨无关的寒冷。

alike:1.en: Grey Crow met me at the bridge and said something that stayed with me. 'You and Zero think *alike* — same patterns, same blind spots. That is why you can find him. That is also why he can find you.' The neon reflected on the black water below. I did not want to believe it, but I had no counter-argument ready.
alike:1.cnHint: 灰鸦警告叙述者，他和零的思维方式____，这既是优势也是危险。
alike:1.hook: My own reflection in the water looked suddenly unfamiliar.
alike:1.line: 'You two think *alike* — and that should frighten you more than him.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow met me at the bridge and said something that stayed with me.

sentences.cn: 正是因为这个，你才能找到他。

analyze:1.en: I spread the stolen data-chips on a dry section of rooftop and began to *analyze* the pattern of signals hidden inside each one. Frequencies, gaps, repeat codes — they mapped a route through Harbor City, a route that ended at one building I recognized. Ali crouched beside me, her breath steady, her eyes fast.

analyze:1.hook: The building on the map was the one Grey Crow told us never to enter.
analyze:1.line: '*Analyze* the gaps between signals — that is where the real message hides.'

sentences.en: Ali crouched beside me, her breath steady, her eyes fast.
sentences.cn: 阿栗蹲在我身边，呼吸平稳，眼神敏捷。

belong:1.en: The alley wall was covered in coded graffiti. Ali pointed at a symbol near the drain. 'That mark doesn't *belong* here,' she said. 'It was placed last night.' I looked closer. The symbol matched the signal pattern Grey Crow had warned us about. Someone was leaving a trail.

belong:1.hook: The trail led straight to a door we feared opening.
belong:1.line: 'That sign doesn't *belong* here — someone left it for us.'

'It was placed last night.'

beneficial:1.en: Grey Crow met us under the broken streetlight. Rain hammered the pavement. 'Leaking that frequency map to Zero's crew,' he said, 'would seem *beneficial* to them at first.' He pulled up his collar. 'But it carries a hidden signature. Every step they take will ping our tracker.' The trap was set.

sentences.cn: 灰鸦在那盏破损的路灯下和我们碰头。

He pulled up his collar.

sentences.en: Every step they take will ping our tracker.'

characteristic:1.en: I had studied Zero for months. The forged broadcast had one *characteristic* that gave it away: a slight delay on the third beat, like a held breath. No machine did that. It was human. It was Zero. Ali confirmed the match. We were close now, standing in the wet street, listening.
characteristic:1.cnHint: 我发现伪造信号有一个零点特有的____，从而锁定了他的身份。
characteristic:1.hook: Knowing his habit meant knowing his next move.
characteristic:1.line: 'That pause is his *characteristic* — he always hesitates on three.'

sentences.en: We were close now, standing in the wet street, listening.
sentences.cn: 我们已经很接近了，站在湿漉漉的街道上，耳朵竖起来听。

director:1.en: The black car stopped at the far end of the plaza. A figure stepped out. Grey Crow grabbed my arm. 'That is the *director* of the Signal Bureau,' he whispered. 'He should be locked in his tower, not standing in the open.' Rain blurred the figure's face. Ali raised her scanner.

director:1.hook: A director in the street meant the tower was already gone.
director:1.line: 'Why is the *director* out here — who is running the tower?'

'He should be locked in his tower, not standing in the open.'

emerge:1.en: We waited behind the cargo stacks at the dock entrance. The fog was thick. Then a shape began to *emerge* from the mist — slow, tall, moving without sound. Ali's hand found my shoulder. Grey Crow did not move. The shape stepped into the orange light of the harbor lamp. Zero.

emerge:1.hook: He was looking straight at us, and he was smiling.
emerge:1.line: 'I watched you *emerge* from the fog — I have been here longer.'

Ali's hand found my shoulder.

exact:1.en: Ali cross-checked the broadcast logs twice. 'I have the *exact* corner,' she said, marking it on the map with one tap. 'Third and Canal. The signal peaks there for eleven seconds every hour.' I checked the time. We had four minutes. Grey Crow was already moving through the crowd ahead of us.

exact:1.hook: Four minutes was either enough time or far too little.
exact:1.line: 'I have the *exact* corner — move now or we lose the window.'

sentences.en: She spread a paper map across a rusted barrel — paper, not digital.

sentences.en: 'Not habit.

Zero has eyes on every signal in the grid.

sentences.en: Paper is the only thing he cannot read.'

stuff:1.en: Grey Crow was already at the alley junction when I arrived. He had a worn bag open on the ground, checking its contents in the grey light. 'What is all that *stuff*?' I asked. 'Frequency blockers, a spare receiver, wire.' He zipped the bag shut fast. 'Enough to get us inside the broadcast tower. Move.'

It took three passes to *translate* the last line — it was not slang, it was a frequency map. A map pointing straight to Zero's next broadcast point. My hands went cold.

warn:1.en: Grey Crow stepped out of the shadow beside the rail station entrance. He grabbed my arm before I reached the door. 'I came to *warn* you,' he said quietly. 'Zero switched the meeting point an hour ago. That door leads to his people, not ours.' I looked at the door. The handle was already turning.

warn:1.hook: The handle turned all the way, and light spilled out.

campaign:1.en: Rain hammered the steel bridges of Harbor City. A painted banner stretched across Neon Row: END THE SILENCE. Grey Crow pulled me close. 'This *campaign* started three years ago,' he said, 'one coded message at a time. Zero hijacked it. Now every signal in the city carries his orders.'

sentences.en: 'If it is not fixed *properly*, the rain will knock it loose,' she said, pressing hard.
The night market crowd pushed past us, loud and warm.
sentences.cn: 夜市的人群从我们身边涌过，嘈杂而温暖。

sentences.en: Nobody looked twice.
sentences.cn: 没人看我们一眼。

sentences.en: Above the noise, I caught the first pulse of Zero's frequency.
sentences.cn: 在噪音之上，我捕捉到了零点频率的第一个脉冲。

render:1.en: Zero had scattered false data nodes across three city blocks. Each node alone meant nothing, but together they *rendered* the whole grid unreadable — a wall of noise where real coordinates should have been. I stared at the map on Ali's screen. Somewhere inside that wall was the drop point.
render:1.cnHint: 零点散布的虚假数据节点将整个网格____得无法读取。
render:1.hook: Ali's screen flickered, then went dark.
render:1.line: 'Enough nodes *render* the whole map blind — that's the plan.'

sentences.en: Zero had scattered false data nodes across three city blocks.
sentences.cn: 零点在整个城市的三个街区散布了假数据节点。

sentences.en: Each node alone meant nothing, but together they *rendered* the whole grid unreadable — a wall of noise where real coordinates should have been.
I stared at the map on Ali's screen.
sentences.cn: 我盯着阿栗屏幕上的地图。

sentences.en: Somewhere inside that wall was the drop point.
sentences.cn: 在那堵噪音墙的某个地方，是落点。

resolve:1.en: I stood at the mouth of the alley, rain running into my collar. Grey Crow was already inside the shadow ahead. For a moment my feet would not move. Then I remembered why I had started all this — and that memory sharpened into *resolve*, hard and clean, like a blade finding its edge.
resolve:1.cnHint: 在黑暗的巷口，我从记忆中找到了____，迈步向前。
resolve:1.hook: Something in the dark shifted — and it wasn't Grey Crow.
resolve:1.line: 'Hold your *resolve* — we are almost at the end.'

sentences.en: I stood at the mouth of the alley, rain running into my collar.
sentences.cn: 我站在巷口，雨水流进我的衣领。

sentences.en: Grey Crow was already inside the shadow ahead.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦已经在前面的阴影里了。

sentences.en: For a moment my feet would not move.
sentences.cn: 有一瞬间我的脚动不了。

sentences.en: Then I remembered why I had started all this — and that memory sharpened into *resolve*, hard and clean, like a blade finding its edge.

seemingly:1.en: The plaza was *seemingly* empty — just wet stone, dead signboards, and a single light swinging in the wind. Ali checked her scanner twice. No heat, no movement. Grey Crow walked ahead without slowing. I followed, neck tight. An empty plaza in Zero's territory was never just empty. It was an invitation.
seemingly:1.cnHint: 广场____空无一人，但在零点的地盘上，空旷从来都是一种陷阱。
seemingly:1.hook: Behind the dead signboards, something breathed.
seemingly:1.line: 'It is *seemingly* clear — which means it is anything but.'

sentences.en: The plaza was *seemingly* empty — just wet stone, dead signboards, and a single light swinging in the wind.
Ali checked her scanner twice.
sentences.cn: 阿栗检查了两次扫描仪。

sentences.en: No heat, no movement.
sentences.cn: 没有热源，没有移动。

sentences.en: Grey Crow walked ahead without slowing.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦向前走去，速度不减。

sentences.en: I followed, neck tight.
sentences.cn: 我跟在后面，脖子绷紧。

sentences.en: An empty plaza in Zero's territory was never just empty.
sentences.cn: 在零点的地盘里，一个空旷的广场永远不会只是空旷。

sentences.en: It was an invitation.
sentences.cn: 这是个邀请。

therefore:1.en: The rain hit the street like static from a broken radio. Zero's men blocked every exit. I had one signal and three seconds. The route north was clear; *therefore* I ran, boots cracking against wet stone, Grey Crow's voice cutting through the noise: 'Don't stop.'
therefore:1.cnHint: 我判断出唯一的逃脱方向，____向北狂奔。
therefore:1.hook: But the street ahead was already changing.
therefore:1.line: 'The south gate is sealed — *therefore* we move now.'

sentences.en: The rain hit the street like static from a broken radio.
sentences.cn: 雨打在街道上，像是破收音机里的静电。

sentences.en: Zero's men blocked every exit.
sentences.cn: 零点的人堵住了每一个出口。

sentences.en: I had one signal and three seconds.
sentences.cn: 我只有一个信号和三秒钟。

sentences.en: The route north was clear; *therefore* I ran, boots cracking against wet stone, Grey Crow's voice cutting through the noise: 'Don't stop.'

truth:1.en: Grey Crow stopped beneath a broken light post. Around us, coded graffiti covered every wall — half lies, half signals. 'In this city,' he said quietly, 'one sentence of *truth* is worth more than a hundred encrypted files.' I stared at the words on the wall and felt something cold settle in my chest.
truth:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在街头警告我，这座城市里一句____价值连城。
truth:1.hook: Then he pointed at a single line of graffiti and walked away.
truth:1.line: 'That broadcast holds the *truth* — and Zero knows it.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow stopped beneath a broken light post.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在一根破裂的灯柱下停了下来。

sentences.en: Around us, coded graffiti covered every wall — half lies, half signals.
sentences.cn: 我们周围，编码涂鸦覆盖了每一面墙——半是谎言，半是信号。

sentences.en: 'In this city,' he said quietly, 'one sentence of *truth* is worth more than a hundred encrypted files.'
I stared at the words on the wall and felt something cold settle in my chest.
sentences.cn: 我盯着墙上的字，感觉有什么冷的东西沉进了我的胸腔。

protein:1.en: Ali passed me a small grey packet through the rusted fence. 'Synthetic *protein* block,' she said. 'Street ration. Eat it or your hands will shake when you need them most.' I ate without tasting. Three blocks away, a siren woke the wet dark and I knew our window was closing fast.
protein:1.cnHint: 阿栗在铁栅栏边递给我一块合成____，提醒我保持体力。
protein:1.hook: The siren was getting closer, and it was not the police.
protein:1.line: 'One *protein* block — that is all that stands between you and failure.'

sentences.en: Ali passed me a small grey packet through the rusted fence.
sentences.cn: 阿栗通过生锈的栅栏递给我一个小灰色的包裹。

sentences.en: 'Synthetic *protein* block,' she said.
'Street ration.
sentences.cn: 街头配给。

sentences.en: Eat it or your hands will shake when you need them most.'
sentences.cn: 吃掉它，不然你最需要稳定的时候手会发抖。

sentences.en: I ate without tasting.
sentences.cn: 我吃了，尝不出味道。

sentences.en: Three blocks away, a siren woke the wet dark and I knew our window was closing fast.
sentences.cn: 三个街区外，一声警笛划破湿漉漉的夜色，我知道我们的窗口快关闭了。

traffic:1.en: Zero had shut the main boulevard. Steel barriers cut the *traffic* into a frozen wall of delivery drones and transport pods, all stalled, all watched. I slipped between two idle pods, hood low, heart loud. Ali's voice crackled once in my earpiece: 'Camera at the second pole. Duck. Now.'
traffic:1.cnHint: 零点封锁了主干道，我趁____堵塞的混乱穿越封锁线。
traffic:1.hook: The camera turned, and I was not yet past the second pole.
traffic:1.line: 'Use the *traffic* jam — it is the only cover we have left.'

sentences.en: Zero had shut the main boulevard.
sentences.cn: 零点封锁了主干道。

sentences.en: Steel barriers cut the *traffic* into a frozen wall of delivery drones and transport pods, all stalled, all watched.
I slipped between two idle pods, hood low, heart loud.
sentences.cn: 我在两辆闲置的运输舱之间穿过去，帽子压低，心跳如鼓。

sentences.en: Ali's voice crackled once in my earpiece: 'Camera at the second pole.
sentences.cn: 阿栗的声音在我的耳机里嗞啦一声响起：摄像头在第二根杆子那儿。

sentences.en: Duck.
sentences.cn: 低身。

sentences.en: Now.'
sentences.cn: 现在。

cat:1.en: A thin grey *cat* crossed the alley ahead of me and stopped, staring back as if it knew something I did not. Grey Crow had once said that in Harbor City even animals learned to read the street. I followed it on instinct. It led me to a narrow gap in the surveillance grid.
cat:1.cnHint: 一只____横穿小巷，我跟着它找到了监控盲区。
cat:1.hook: Beyond the gap, a light was on that should have been dark.
cat:1.line: 'Follow the *cat* — in this city nothing moves without a reason.'

sentences.en: A thin grey *cat* crossed the alley ahead of me and stopped, staring back as if it knew something I did not.
Grey Crow had once said that in Harbor City even animals learned to read the street.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦曾经说过，在港城连动物都学会了读懂街道。

sentences.en: I followed it on instinct.
sentences.cn: 我凭直觉跟了上去。

sentences.en: It led me to a narrow gap in the surveillance grid.
sentences.cn: 它把我带到了监控网格的一道窄缝。

sugar:1.en: The night stall was still open, steam rising from a small pot. The vendor slid a cup across without being asked. One sip — sharp, sweet, unmistakably laced with something. '*Sugar* and a tracer,' Ali said in my ear, voice flat. I set the cup down and stepped back into the rain without turning around.
sugar:1.cnHint: 摊贩递来加了____的饮料，阿栗提醒我那是一个追踪陷阱。
sugar:1.hook: Someone nearby had already marked my position.
sugar:1.line: 'That *sugar* in your cup is how they paint a target on you.'

sentences.en: The night stall was still open, steam rising from a small pot.
sentences.cn: 夜间小摊还开着，小锅里冒出蒸汽。

sentences.en: The vendor slid a cup across without being asked.
sentences.cn: 摊主没等我说话，就把一杯东西滑到我面前。

sentences.en: One sip — sharp, sweet, unmistakably laced with something. '*Sugar* and a tracer,' Ali said in my ear, voice flat.
I set the cup down and stepped back into the rain without turning around.
sentences.cn: 我放下杯子，转身走回雨里，没有回头。

balance:1.en: The walkway above the flooded underpass was no wider than my shoulders. One wrong step and I would drop six meters into black water. I slowed my breathing and tried to *balance* the weight of my kit against each careful stride. Zero's drone swept below, its light cutting white lines across the flood.
balance:1.cnHint: 我在狭窄天桥上努力____身体，无人机就在脚下扫视。
balance:1.hook: The drone reversed, and its light began to rise.
balance:1.line: '*Balance* your load or the bridge will make the choice for you.'

sentences.en: The walkway above the flooded underpass was no wider than my shoulders.
sentences.cn: 淹没的地下通道上方的走道，宽度只有我的肩膀那么宽。

sentences.en: One wrong step and I would drop six meters into black water.
sentences.cn: 一步踏错就会掉进六米深的黑水里。

sentences.en: I slowed my breathing and tried to *balance* the weight of my kit against each careful stride.
Zero's drone swept below, its light cutting white lines across the flood.
sentences.cn: 零点的无人机在下面扫过，光线在洪水上划出白色的线条。

baby:1.en: She sat against the cold wall, a bundle held close, eyes wide and tired. In this city you did not stop — every second was a cost. But even I could not walk past a mother holding a *baby* in a surveillance sweep zone. I pulled them into the shadow of a doorway and checked the sky.
baby:1.cnHint: 我在扫荡区看到一位怀抱____的母亲，无法视而不见。
baby:1.hook: The sweep light found the doorway three seconds after we moved.
baby:1.line: 'There is a *baby* in the grid zone — we change the route right now.'

sentences.en: She sat against the cold wall, a bundle held close, eyes wide and tired.
sentences.cn: 她靠着冰冷的墙坐着，紧紧抱着一个包裹，眼睛睁得很大，疲惫不堪。

sentences.en: In this city you did not stop — every second was a cost.
sentences.cn: 在这座城市里你不能停下来——每一秒都是代价。

sentences.en: But even I could not walk past a mother holding a *baby* in a surveillance sweep zone.
I pulled them into the shadow of a doorway and checked the sky.
sentences.cn: 我把他们拉进门廊的阴影里，抬头看了看天空。

teenager:1.en: The rain hit the cracked street hard. A *teenager* — maybe fifteen, hood up, eyes sharp — slipped a folded note into my coat pocket and vanished around the corner before I could speak. Grey Crow's voice crackled in my earpiece: 'That kid just saved your life.'
teenager:1.cnHint: 一个年轻的____悄悄塞给调查员一张纸条，随即消失在雨夜中。
teenager:1.hook: The note had only three words: 'Zero knows you.'
teenager:1.line: 'That *teenager* moved like someone trained to disappear,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The rain hit the cracked street hard.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在裂开的街道上。

sentences.en: A *teenager* — maybe fifteen, hood up, eyes sharp — slipped a folded note into my coat pocket and vanished around the corner before I could speak.
Grey Crow's voice crackled in my earpiece: 'That kid just saved your life.'
sentences.cn: 灰鸦的声音在我耳机里噼啪作响："那小子刚救了你的命。"

patient:1.en: Ali crouched behind a broken vendor cart, perfectly still. 'Be *patient*,' she whispered, gripping my sleeve. Across the wet street, Zero's courier stood under a red lamp, waiting for a signal. One wrong move and the whole exchange would vanish into the dark like smoke.
patient:1.cnHint: 阿栗提醒调查员要____，因为对方的信使正在街对面等待暗号。
patient:1.hook: Then the courier looked directly at us.
patient:1.line: 'Stay *patient* — the moment we rush, we lose everything,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Ali crouched behind a broken vendor cart, perfectly still.
sentences.cn: 阿栗蜷缩在一辆破损的摊车后面，一动不动。

sentences.en: 'Be *patient*,' she whispered, gripping my sleeve.
Across the wet street, Zero's courier stood under a red lamp, waiting for a signal.
sentences.cn: 街对面湿漉漉的地上，零点的信使站在红灯下，等待信号。

sentences.en: One wrong move and the whole exchange would vanish into the dark like smoke.
sentences.cn: 一个错误的举动，整个交易就会像烟雾一样消失在黑暗里。

classroom:1.en: The old building had once been a school. I stepped through a broken wall into what remained of a *classroom*: cracked boards, burnt desks, and on the wall, fresh coded graffiti glowing faint blue. Someone had been here tonight, teaching — or warning.
classroom:1.cnHint: 调查员走进废弃学校的____，发现墙上有新鲜的加密涂鸦。
classroom:1.hook: The chalk on the floor spelled out my case number.
classroom:1.line: 'This *classroom* hasn't been empty as long as they told us,' I said.

sentences.en: The old building had once been a school.
sentences.cn: 那栋老建筑曾经是所学校。

sentences.en: I stepped through a broken wall into what remained of a *classroom*: cracked boards, burnt desks, and on the wall, fresh coded graffiti glowing faint blue.
Someone had been here tonight, teaching — or warning.
sentences.cn: 有人今晚来过这里，在教什么——或者在警告什么。

vehicle:1.en: A heavy *vehicle* rolled slow down the flooded street, lights off, engine nearly silent. Grey Crow's signal cut out the moment it passed. Ali grabbed my arm and pulled me flat against the wall. Whatever was inside that truck, it was jamming every frequency we had.
vehicle:1.cnHint: 一辆可疑的____驶过时，调查员与灰鸦的通讯突然中断。
vehicle:1.hook: The truck stopped directly in front of our hiding spot.
vehicle:1.line: 'That *vehicle* is not city patrol — it has no markings at all,' Ali said.

sentences.en: A heavy *vehicle* rolled slow down the flooded street, lights off, engine nearly silent.
Grey Crow's signal cut out the moment it passed.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦的信号在它经过的一刻断掉了。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my arm and pulled me flat against the wall.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住我的胳膊，把我压贴在墙上。

sentences.en: Whatever was inside that truck, it was jamming every frequency we had.
sentences.cn: 那辆车里装的不管是什么东西，它正在干扰我们的每一个频道。

remote:1.en: Zero's base was not in the city centre. Every trace pointed somewhere *remote*, far past the port where the neon stopped and the dark began. Ali spread the map on a wet crate. The location was almost off the edge of the paper. Almost.
remote:1.cnHint: 线索指向一个____的地方，远离霓虹灯和人群。
remote:1.hook: Grey Crow's message read: 'Do not go there alone.'
remote:1.line: 'A *remote* site means no backup and no way out fast,' Grey Crow warned.

sentences.en: Zero's base was not in the city centre.
sentences.cn: 零点的基地不在城市中心。

sentences.en: Every trace pointed somewhere *remote*, far past the port where the neon stopped and the dark began.
Ali spread the map on a wet crate.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在一个湿漉漉的木板箱上摊开了地图。

sentences.en: The location was almost off the edge of the paper.
sentences.cn: 位置几乎在纸的边缘了。

sentences.en: Almost.
sentences.cn: 几乎。

zoo:1.en: The meet was set at the old *zoo*, sealed since the city floods of 2087. Iron gates, dead trees, empty cages staring like open mouths. Ali said it felt like a trap. I said every good lead does. We pushed the gate open anyway and walked in.
zoo:1.cnHint: 调查员和阿栗前往废弃的____，赴一个很可能是圈套的约定。
zoo:1.hook: Something moved inside the largest cage.
zoo:1.line: 'The *zoo* has been locked twelve years — so why is that lock new?' Ali asked.

sentences.en: The meet was set at the old *zoo*, sealed since the city floods of 2087.
Iron gates, dead trees, empty cages staring like open mouths.
sentences.cn: 铁门、枯树、空荡荡的笼子像张开的嘴巴。

sentences.en: Ali said it felt like a trap.
sentences.cn: 阿栗说这感觉像个陷阱。

sentences.en: I said every good lead does.
sentences.cn: 我说每条好线索看起来都像陷阱。

sentences.en: We pushed the gate open anyway and walked in.
sentences.cn: 我们还是推开门走了进去。

card:1.en: Grey Crow slid a small *card* across the wet table outside the night market. No name, no number — just a line of binary pressed into the surface. 'Scan it only once,' he said, then stood and walked away without looking back. Ali stared at it. 'Once?'
card:1.cnHint: 灰鸦交给调查员一张神秘的____，并警告只能扫描一次。
card:1.hook: The card felt warm, as if it had already been activated.
card:1.line: 'This *card* carries a signal that burns itself out on second read,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow slid a small *card* across the wet table outside the night market.
No name, no number — just a line of binary pressed into the surface.
sentences.cn: 没有名字，没有号码——只有一行二进制印在表面。

sentences.en: 'Scan it only once,' he said, then stood and walked away without looking back.
sentences.cn: "只扫一次，"他说完站起来，头也不回地走了。

sentences.en: Ali stared at it.
sentences.cn: 阿栗盯着那张卡。

sentences.en: 'Once?'
sentences.cn: "只扫一次？"

gene:1.en: The street doctor spoke low and fast. The virus spreading through Sector Nine was not natural — someone had rewritten a *gene* deep in its code to make it respond to specific broadcast frequencies. It was a weapon designed for one target. Ali looked at me. We both knew who.
gene:1.cnHint: 街头医生透露，病毒中某个____被人为修改，成为针对特定目标的武器。
gene:1.hook: The target's file had my partner's name on it.
gene:1.line: 'Whoever rewrote that *gene* understood both biology and broadcast code,' the doctor said.

sentences.en: The street doctor spoke low and fast.
sentences.cn: 街道医生说话既低又快。

sentences.en: The virus spreading through Sector Nine was not natural — someone had rewritten a *gene* deep in its code to make it respond to specific broadcast frequencies.
It was a weapon designed for one target.
sentences.cn: 这是一件专门为某个目标设计的武器。

sentences.en: Ali looked at me.
sentences.cn: 阿栗看着我。

sentences.en: We both knew who.
sentences.cn: 我们都知道那个目标是谁。

store:1.en: Rain hammered the street. I ducked under the broken sign of a small *store* on Ninth Avenue, its shelves still packed with old signal-jammers and coded maps. Ali pressed close behind me. Somewhere in those dusty goods was the one device Grey Crow said could crack Zero's broadcast. I reached for the shelf.
store:1.cnHint: 我在一家街边____里寻找能破解零点广播的装置，阿栗紧随其后。
store:1.hook: My fingers closed around something cold — and the lights went out.
store:1.line: 'This *store* has what we need — if Zero's crew hasn't found it first.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the street.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在街道上。

sentences.en: I ducked under the broken sign of a small *store* on Ninth Avenue, its shelves still packed with old signal-jammers and coded maps.
Ali pressed close behind me.
sentences.cn: 阿栗紧紧贴在我身后。

sentences.en: Somewhere in those dusty goods was the one device Grey Crow said could crack Zero's broadcast.
sentences.cn: 那些蒙满灰尘的货物里，藏着灰鸦说能破解零点广播的那个设备。

sentences.en: I reached for the shelf.
sentences.cn: 我伸手去够货架。

budget:1.en: The city's emergency *budget* had been cut to almost nothing. That meant no working street lights past the old port, which meant Zero owned the dark. Ali showed me the numbers on her cracked screen — three credits left for the whole investigation. Grey Crow had warned us it would come to this.
budget:1.cnHint: 城市紧急____几乎被削减殆尽，零点掌控着黑暗，我们只剩三个信用点。
budget:1.hook: Ali's screen flickered once, then went completely black.
budget:1.line: 'Our *budget* runs out tonight — after that, we're on our own.'

sentences.en: The city's emergency *budget* had been cut to almost nothing.
That meant no working street lights past the old port, which meant Zero owned the dark.
sentences.cn: 这意味着旧港口以外没有路灯能用，零点掌控了黑暗。

sentences.en: Ali showed me the numbers on her cracked screen — three credits left for the whole investigation.
sentences.cn: 阿栗给我看她那块裂纹屏幕上的数字——整个调查只剩三个信用点。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned us it would come to this.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦早就警告过我们会走到这一步。

grant:1.en: The Harbor City Council had issued a *grant* to fund Grey Crow's signal research — but Zero had intercepted the transfer code. Without that money, the lab would shut down before dawn. I stood at the council door in the pouring rain, the forged access card cold in my hand.
grant:1.cnHint: 市议会的____被零点截获，格雷·克劳的实验室即将关闭，我手持伪造的通行证站在门外。
grant:1.hook: The door opened — but it was not a council officer who stood there.
grant:1.line: 'The *grant* is gone — Zero took it before the transfer finished.'

sentences.en: The Harbor City Council had issued a *grant* to fund Grey Crow's signal research — but Zero had intercepted the transfer code.
Without that money, the lab would shut down before dawn.
sentences.cn: 没有那笔钱，实验室会在天亮前关门。

sentences.en: I stood at the council door in the pouring rain, the forged access card cold in my hand.
sentences.cn: 我站在议会大门前，大雨倾盆，伪造的通行卡在我手里冰冷刺骨。

hospital:1.en: The coded signal led me three blocks east to the old *hospital*, its cracked windows glowing faint green from the backup power inside. Ali said the lower floors had been empty for years. Grey Crow's last known location was somewhere in that building. I crossed the empty street toward it.
hospital:1.cnHint: 加密信号将我引向旧____，格雷·克劳最后的已知位置就在那栋楼里。
hospital:1.hook: A shadow moved across a third-floor window — someone was already inside.
hospital:1.line: 'Grey Crow sent one word before going silent: *hospital*.'

sentences.en: The coded signal led me three blocks east to the old *hospital*, its cracked windows glowing faint green from the backup power inside.
Ali said the lower floors had been empty for years.
sentences.cn: 阿栗说下面几层楼已经空了好多年。

sentences.en: Grey Crow's last known location was somewhere in that building.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦最后出现的地方在那栋楼的某个地方。

sentences.en: I crossed the empty street toward it.
sentences.cn: 我穿过空荡荡的街道朝它走去。

island:1.en: Zero's broadcast tower stood on a small concrete *island* in the middle of the harbor, cut off from the shore by thirty meters of black water. No bridge, no boat in sight. Ali scanned the gap and said nothing. The signal we needed to kill was still transmitting, steady and cold, into every ear in Harbor City.
island:1.cnHint: 零点的广播塔矗立在港湾中央一座孤立的____上，与岸边相隔三十米。
island:1.hook: Then Ali pointed at something beneath the water's surface — it was moving.
island:1.line: 'The only way to the tower is across to that *island* — fast.'

sentences.en: Zero's broadcast tower stood on a small concrete *island* in the middle of the harbor, cut off from the shore by thirty meters of black water.
No bridge, no boat in sight.
sentences.cn: 没有桥，看不到船。

sentences.en: Ali scanned the gap and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 阿栗扫描了那片间隙，什么都没说。

sentences.en: The signal we needed to kill was still transmitting, steady and cold, into every ear in Harbor City.
sentences.cn: 我们要杀死的信号仍在稳定而冰冷地向整个港湾城传播。

native:1.en: Grey Crow was a *native* of this quarter, born in the narrow streets below the signal towers. He knew every back path and hidden wire in Harbor City. That knowledge was why Zero wanted him gone. I followed the old chalk marks he had left on the wall — his private code from childhood.
native:1.cnHint: 格雷·克劳是这个街区的____，零点因他熟知每一条秘密路径而想除掉他。
native:1.hook: The chalk marks stopped — and a fresh red line had been drawn over them.
native:1.line: 'Only a *native* of this district could read those wall marks.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow was a *native* of this quarter, born in the narrow streets below the signal towers.
He knew every back path and hidden wire in Harbor City.
sentences.cn: 他认识港湾城的每条后巷和隐蔽的电线。

sentences.en: That knowledge was why Zero wanted him gone.
sentences.cn: 这就是零点想除掉他的原因。

sentences.en: I followed the old chalk marks he had left on the wall — his private code from childhood.
sentences.cn: 我跟着他留在墙上的旧粉笔记号走——他从小就用的私密暗码。

tradition:1.en: By old *tradition*, Harbor City's investigators met once a year at the canal bridge to burn coded files — a ritual meant to protect sources. Zero had learned the date. I arrived to find the bridge empty, the usual fire unlit, and one small folded note sitting on the stone rail in the rain.
tradition:1.cnHint: 按照旧____，调查员们每年在运河桥举行焚烧文件的仪式，但今晚桥上空无一人。
tradition:1.hook: I unfolded the note and read the three words Zero had left for me.
tradition:1.line: 'Zero broke our *tradition* — tonight, that works in our favour.'

sentences.en: By old *tradition*, Harbor City's investigators met once a year at the canal bridge to burn coded files — a ritual meant to protect sources.
Zero had learned the date.
sentences.cn: 零点了解到了这个日期。

sentences.en: I arrived to find the bridge empty, the usual fire unlit, and one small folded note sitting on the stone rail in the rain.
sentences.cn: 我到达时桥上空无一人，往年的篝火没有点燃，雨中的石栏杆上只有一张小纸条折叠放着。

africa:1.en: The signal tag on the intercepted file read *Africa* — a single word that Grey Crow used as a key. In our code it meant a dead drop under the port market. Ali spotted it first. Zero's crew would decode it within the hour. We had maybe twenty minutes to reach the market and pull the data before they did.
africa:1.cnHint: 截获文件上的信号标签写着____——这是格雷·克劳的暗语，指向港口市场下的秘密据点。
africa:1.hook: Ali grabbed my arm — a black drone was already circling above the market.
africa:1.line: 'When you see the word *Africa* in his files, run — it means now.'

sentences.en: The signal tag on the intercepted file read *Africa* — a single word that Grey Crow used as a key.
In our code it meant a dead drop under the port market.
sentences.cn: 在我们的密码里，它意味着一个死信箱就在港口市场下面。

sentences.en: Ali spotted it first.
sentences.cn: 阿栗最先发现了。

sentences.en: Zero's crew would decode it within the hour.
sentences.cn: 零点的人会在一小时内破译它。

sentences.en: We had maybe twenty minutes to reach the market and pull the data before they did.
sentences.cn: 我们最多只有二十分钟赶到市场去抢在他们之前拿到数据。

modern:1.en: The street grid of Harbor City was a *modern* maze — neon signs stacked forty floors high, every corner watched by a dozen camera eyes. I moved through it fast, head down. Grey Crow had marked this block on my map. Whatever he needed me to find was buried somewhere in this bright, cold machine.
modern:1.cnHint: 我在城市的____迷宫中穿行，寻找引路人留下的标记。
modern:1.hook: The mark on the wall was still wet.
modern:1.line: Grey Crow said, 'This *modern* city hides old sins.'

sentences.en: The street grid of Harbor City was a *modern* maze — neon signs stacked forty floors high, every corner watched by a dozen camera eyes.
I moved through it fast, head down.
sentences.cn: 我快速穿过它，低着头。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had marked this block on my map.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在我的地图上标记了这个街区。

sentences.en: Whatever he needed me to find was buried somewhere in this bright, cold machine.
sentences.cn: 无论他需要我找什么，都埋在这个光彩夺目、冰冷如机器的地方。

officer:1.en: A city *officer* in a grey coat stood at the checkpoint, scanning faces with a handheld reader. I slowed my steps. Ali had warned me about this one — he worked for Zero, not the law. One wrong move and my cover would shatter like cheap glass on wet concrete.
officer:1.cnHint: 一名____挡在检查站前，我怀疑他听命于对手。
officer:1.hook: His scanner paused on my face a second too long.
officer:1.line: Ali whispered, 'That *officer* is not what he seems.'

sentences.en: A city *officer* in a grey coat stood at the checkpoint, scanning faces with a handheld reader.
I slowed my steps.
sentences.cn: 我放慢了脚步。

sentences.en: Ali had warned me about this one — he worked for Zero, not the law.
sentences.cn: 阿栗提醒过我这个人——他效忠于零点，而不是法律。

sentences.en: One wrong move and my cover would shatter like cheap glass on wet concrete.
sentences.cn: 一个错误的举动，我的伪装就会像廉价玻璃一样在湿润的混凝土上碎裂。

convince:1.en: I had three minutes to *convince* the gate guard that my access card was valid. My hands stayed still. Grey Crow had coached me on what to say, word by word, but standing here in the rain, with Zero's men one block away, the script felt very thin.
convince:1.cnHint: 我必须____守卫相信我的证件是真的，时间只剩三分钟。
convince:1.hook: The guard's finger hovered over the alarm button.
convince:1.line: I told him, 'Let me *convince* you — check the second code.'

sentences.en: I had three minutes to *convince* the gate guard that my access card was valid.
My hands stayed still.
sentences.cn: 我的手保持静止。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had coached me on what to say, word by word, but standing here in the rain, with Zero's men one block away, the script felt very thin.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦一字一句地教过我该说什么，但现在站在雨中，零点的人就在一个街区外，这套说辞显得非常单薄。

directly:1.en: Ali ran *directly* toward the burning relay tower instead of taking cover. I shouted her name into the rain. She had a reason — she always had a reason — but from where I stood, it looked exactly like the kind of move that ends a story early and badly.
directly:1.cnHint: 伙伴____冲向燃烧的中继塔，令我大惊失色。
directly:1.hook: The tower groaned and began to lean.
directly:1.line: Ali called back, 'Go *directly* to the roof — now!'

sentences.en: Ali ran *directly* toward the burning relay tower instead of taking cover.
I shouted her name into the rain.
sentences.cn: 我在雨中喊出了她的名字。

sentences.en: She had a reason — she always had a reason — but from where I stood, it looked exactly like the kind of move that ends a story early and badly.
sentences.cn: 她总有她的理由——但从我所在的位置看，这看起来正好像那种会让故事提前结束的举动，而且结局很糟。

extend:1.en: Zero had managed to *extend* his signal block across the entire eastern quarter. My comm unit showed nothing but static. I pressed my back against a cold wall, rain hammering the pavement. Without a signal, Grey Crow could not reach me, and I was alone in the dark with bad odds.
extend:1.cnHint: 对手将信号屏蔽范围____到了整个东区，我与引路人失联。
extend:1.hook: Then one broken word crackled through the static.
extend:1.line: Zero broadcast coldly, 'I will *extend* the silence until you surrender.'

sentences.en: Zero had managed to *extend* his signal block across the entire eastern quarter.
My comm unit showed nothing but static.
sentences.cn: 我的通讯器只显示杂音。

sentences.en: I pressed my back against a cold wall, rain hammering the pavement.
sentences.cn: 我把背靠在冰冷的墙上，雨敲打着人行道。

sentences.en: Without a signal, Grey Crow could not reach me, and I was alone in the dark with bad odds.
sentences.cn: 没有信号，灰鸦联系不上我，我独自一人困在黑暗里，局面很糟。

rat:1.en: Someone had told Zero which route I planned to use tonight. I turned the facts over in my mind as I crouched behind a rusted bin. Grey Crow said trust no one new. I had trusted one person new this week. The word *rat* sat in my chest like a cold stone.
rat:1.cnHint: 有人出卖了我的行动路线，我心中那个____的念头越来越重。
rat:1.hook: I heard familiar footsteps behind me in the dark.
rat:1.line: Grey Crow said quietly, 'Find the *rat* before dawn comes.'

sentences.en: Someone had told Zero which route I planned to use tonight.
sentences.cn: 有人把我今晚的路线告诉了零点。

sentences.en: I turned the facts over in my mind as I crouched behind a rusted bin.
sentences.cn: 我蹲在生锈的垃圾桶后面，脑子里反复思考这些事实。

sentences.en: Grey Crow said trust no one new.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说过不要相信任何新认识的人。

sentences.en: I had trusted one person new this week.
sentences.cn: 这周我只新信任过一个人。

sentences.en: The word *rat* sat in my chest like a cold stone.

saturday:1.en: It was *Saturday* and the night market was packed — the best cover I could ask for. Crowds, noise, a hundred faces under coloured lights. I moved through the stalls toward the drop point Grey Crow had marked. Zero's people would have a harder time tracking one body through all this colour and heat.
saturday:1.cnHint: ____夜晚的集市人群密集，我借机向接头地点靠近。
saturday:1.hook: But the drop point box was already open and empty.
saturday:1.line: Ali said, 'Every *Saturday* they change the patrol path — move fast.'

sentences.en: It was *Saturday* and the night market was packed — the best cover I could ask for.
Crowds, noise, a hundred faces under coloured lights.
sentences.cn: 人群、喧闹、百张脸在五彩灯光下晃动。

sentences.en: I moved through the stalls toward the drop point Grey Crow had marked.
sentences.cn: 我穿过摊位朝灰鸦标记的交接点走去。

sentences.en: Zero's people would have a harder time tracking one body through all this colour and heat.
sentences.cn: 零点的人在这么多色彩和热度里追踪一个身体会更困难。

april:1.en: *April* in Harbor City meant acid rain and low cloud, the kind of sky that swallowed signal drones whole. I stood at the old bridge where Grey Crow said the final data cache was buried. The river below ran orange under the neon glow. Time was short and the cache was deep.
april:1.cnHint: ____的暴雨天气掩护了我前往旧桥寻找最终数据的行动。
april:1.hook: A shadow stepped out from under the bridge arch.
april:1.line: Grey Crow said, 'In *April* the old bridge floods — dig fast.'

sentences.en: *April* in Harbor City meant acid rain and low cloud, the kind of sky that swallowed signal drones whole.
I stood at the old bridge where Grey Crow said the final data cache was buried.
sentences.cn: 我站在灰鸦说的那座老桥上，最后的数据缓存就埋在这里。

sentences.en: The river below ran orange under the neon glow.
sentences.cn: 下面的河在霓虹光辉下闪着橙色。

sentences.en: Time was short and the cache was deep.
sentences.cn: 时间很紧，缓存埋得很深。

childhood:1.en: The coded graffiti on the alley wall spelled out a street name I knew — the block where I grew up. My *childhood* home. Someone had reached deep into my past to plant this signal. Grey Crow stepped beside me, rain dripping from her hood. 'They know who you were before the badge,' she said quietly.
childhood:1.cnHint: 巷墙上的暗语指向调查员童年住过的街区，灰鸦警告对方已掌握其____信息。
childhood:1.hook: The address was right, but the door had a lock I had never seen before.
childhood:1.line: 'They used your *childhood* address as the encryption key.'

sentences.en: The coded graffiti on the alley wall spelled out a street name I knew — the block where I grew up.
sentences.cn: 小巷墙上的密码涂鸦写出了一个街道名字——我长大的那个街区。

sentences.en: My *childhood* home.
Someone had reached deep into my past to plant this signal.
sentences.cn: 有人深入我的过去，留下了这个信号。

sentences.en: Grey Crow stepped beside me, rain dripping from her hood.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦站到我身边，雨水从她的兜帽滑下。

sentences.en: 'They know who you were before the badge,' she said quietly.
sentences.cn: "他们知道你戴上证章之前是谁，"她轻声说。

equal:1.en: Zero's broadcast jammed half the street grid. I pushed through static, matching signal for signal. Grey Crow had told me the only way to beat a ghost in the network was to become one. We were *equal* now — two invisible voices in Harbor City's broken air — but equality in the dark is still dangerous.
equal:1.cnHint: 调查员与零点在信号层正面交锋，双方实力____，但黑暗中的对等并不意味着安全。
equal:1.hook: Then Zero's signal split into three, and mine stayed one.
equal:1.line: 'We are *equal* in the grid — which means neither of us can hide.'

sentences.en: Zero's broadcast jammed half the street grid.
sentences.cn: 零点的广播干扰了半条街的电网。

sentences.en: I pushed through static, matching signal for signal.
sentences.cn: 我冲破静电，用信号对抗信号。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told me the only way to beat a ghost in the network was to become one.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦告诉过我，要战胜网络里的幽灵，唯一的办法就是成为幽灵。

sentences.en: We were *equal* now — two invisible voices in Harbor City's broken air — but equality in the dark is still dangerous.

inspire:1.en: Ali knelt by the storm drain, fingers tracing the neon letters carved into the stone. 'Someone left this for us,' she said. The message was short, raw, and fierce. Whatever fear I had carried to this street corner began to lift. A stranger's courage can *inspire* you in ways no training ever does.
inspire:1.cnHint: 阿栗在排水沟旁发现了一条暗语留言，那份勇气____了调查员，驱散了心中的恐惧。
inspire:1.hook: The letters began to glow, then went dark one by one.
inspire:1.line: 'These words *inspire* me — someone risked everything to write them.'

sentences.en: Ali knelt by the storm drain, fingers tracing the neon letters carved into the stone.
sentences.cn: 阿栗跪在风暴排水沟旁，手指轻轻描过刻在石头上的霓虹字母。

sentences.en: 'Someone left this for us,' she said.
sentences.cn: "有人给我们留下这个，"她说。

sentences.en: The message was short, raw, and fierce.
sentences.cn: 信息很短，很原始，很凶狠。

sentences.en: Whatever fear I had carried to this street corner began to lift.
sentences.cn: 我一直带来的那些恐惧开始消散。

sentences.en: A stranger's courage can *inspire* you in ways no training ever does.

narrow:1.en: The passage between the two towers was barely wide enough for my shoulders. A *narrow* gap in Harbor City's concrete spine, invisible on any map. Grey Crow had promised the signal source was here. Rain hammered the walls on both sides as I pressed forward, and then the walls began to move.
narrow:1.cnHint: 调查员挤进两座大楼间极为____的夹缝，按灰鸦指引寻找信号源，墙壁却开始移动。
narrow:1.hook: The gap was closing, one slow centimeter at a time.
narrow:1.line: 'This *narrow* path is the only route Zero has not watched.'

sentences.en: The passage between the two towers was barely wide enough for my shoulders.
sentences.cn: 两座塔楼之间的通道窄得几乎卡不进我的肩膀。

sentences.en: A *narrow* gap in Harbor City's concrete spine, invisible on any map.
Grey Crow had promised the signal source was here.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦承诺信号源就在这里。

sentences.en: Rain hammered the walls on both sides as I pressed forward, and then the walls began to move.
sentences.cn: 雨敲打着两边的墙，然后我感觉到墙开始移动。

quantity:1.en: The data drop contained line after line of numbers. Ali leaned over my shoulder, rain spotting the small screen. 'It is not the content that matters,' she said, 'it is the *quantity*.' Too many signals meant someone was flooding the channel on purpose — burying one true message inside a thousand false ones.
quantity:1.cnHint: 阿栗提醒调查员，数据包里信号的____才是关键线索，零点正用海量假信号掩盖真相。
quantity:1.hook: One signal repeated exactly seven times, and seven was Zero's number.
quantity:1.line: 'The *quantity* of noise tells us where the real message is hiding.'

sentences.en: The data drop contained line after line of numbers.
sentences.cn: 数据包里全是一行行的数字。

sentences.en: Ali leaned over my shoulder, rain spotting the small screen.
sentences.cn: 阿栗靠在我肩膀上，雨点溅在小屏幕上。

sentences.en: 'It is not the content that matters,' she said, 'it is the *quantity*.'
Too many signals meant someone was flooding the channel on purpose — burying one true message inside a thousand false ones.
sentences.cn: 太多信号意味着有人在故意淹没频道——把一条真消息埋在千条假消息里。

sustainable:1.en: Grey Crow spread a hand-drawn map across the wet hood of a parked vehicle. 'The old relay towers,' she said. 'They run on city power — *sustainable*, hard to kill.' Zero had been broadcasting from somewhere permanent, somewhere the city itself kept alive. I stared at the map and felt the net closing around us both.
sustainable:1.cnHint: 灰鸦指出零点选择靠城市供电、____运行的旧中继塔作为广播据点，调查员感到形势紧迫。
sustainable:1.hook: One tower on the map was already circled in red ink — and the ink was still wet.
sustainable:1.line: 'A *sustainable* power source means Zero can broadcast forever if we fail.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow spread a hand-drawn map across the wet hood of a parked vehicle.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把手绘的地图铺在停着的车的湿漉漉的引擎盖上。

sentences.en: 'The old relay towers,' she said.
sentences.cn: "老中继塔，"她说。

sentences.en: 'They run on city power — *sustainable*, hard to kill.'
Zero had been broadcasting from somewhere permanent, somewhere the city itself kept alive.
sentences.cn: 零点一直在某个永久的地方广播，某个城市本身维持着的地方。

sentences.en: I stared at the map and felt the net closing around us both.
sentences.cn: 我盯着地图，感觉到猎网在向我们两人逼近。

delay:1.en: The green light on the junction box blinked once, then held steady. I checked the timer. Thirty seconds. Ali's voice crackled in my ear: 'Do not *delay* — the signal window closes hard.' I had one move left and no room for second thoughts. The rain came down harder, as if the city itself was counting.
delay:1.cnHint: 信号窗口即将关闭，阿栗在耳机里警告调查员不要____，必须立刻行动。
delay:1.hook: I reached for the switch and found two wires where there should have been one.
delay:1.line: 'Any *delay* now and Zero walks free into the dark.'

sentences.en: The green light on the junction box blinked once, then held steady.
sentences.cn: 接线盒上的绿灯闪了一下，然后保持稳定。

sentences.en: I checked the timer.
sentences.cn: 我检查了计时器。

sentences.en: Thirty seconds.
sentences.cn: 三十秒。

sentences.en: Ali's voice crackled in my ear: 'Do not *delay* — the signal window closes hard.'
I had one move left and no room for second thoughts.
sentences.cn: 我只有一步棋，没有回头的余地。

sentences.en: The rain came down harder, as if the city itself was counting.
sentences.cn: 雨下得更大了，仿佛这座城市本身也在倒计时。

artificial:1.en: The street lamps above Canal Row were *artificial*, powered by a buried grid Zero had hacked three nights ago. Their cold white light turned every face into a mask. I pulled my hood low. Grey Crow had told me this block was blind — no city sensors. That made it the perfect place to listen.
artificial:1.cnHint: 运河街的路灯是____的，被零点入侵控制，调查员在此秘密等待情报。
artificial:1.hook: Then one lamp blinked twice — a signal I had not agreed to.
artificial:1.line: Grey Crow: 'Every *artificial* light on this street belongs to us tonight.'

sentences.en: The street lamps above Canal Row were *artificial*, powered by a buried grid Zero had hacked three nights ago.
Their cold white light turned every face into a mask.
sentences.cn: 它们冰冷的白光把每张脸都变成了一张面具。

sentences.en: I pulled my hood low.
sentences.cn: 我压低了兜帽。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told me this block was blind — no city sensors.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦告诉我这个街区是盲区——没有城市传感器。

sentences.en: That made it the perfect place to listen.
sentences.cn: 这使它成了最完美的窃听地。

confirm:1.en: Ali pressed her wrist unit against the wet wall and waited. A single green pulse. She turned to me. 'Signal received.' I needed more than a pulse. I needed words, a code, a face. Until someone could *confirm* the drop point, we were standing in the rain for nothing.
confirm:1.cnHint: 阿栗收到信号，但调查员坚持要____接头地点才肯行动。
confirm:1.hook: A shadow crossed the far end of the alley and stopped.
confirm:1.line: Ali: 'I can *confirm* the package moved through this street an hour ago.'

sentences.en: Ali pressed her wrist unit against the wet wall and waited.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把腕上的装置贴在湿漉漉的墙面上，等待。

sentences.en: A single green pulse.
sentences.cn: 一束绿色的脉冲。

sentences.en: She turned to me.
sentences.cn: 她转身看向我。

sentences.en: 'Signal received.'
sentences.cn: "信号已收到。"

sentences.en: I needed more than a pulse.
sentences.cn: 我需要的不仅仅是脉冲。

sentences.en: I needed words, a code, a face.
sentences.cn: 我需要言语、暗语、一张面孔。

sentences.en: Until someone could *confirm* the drop point, we were standing in the rain for nothing.

context:1.en: Coded graffiti covered the underpass wall from end to end. Most people walked past it like paint. I could not. Each symbol carried *context* — a time, a name, a warning — if you knew how to read the layers underneath. Grey Crow had taught me that. Now I wished he had not.
context:1.cnHint: 地下通道的涂鸦暗藏____，调查员读懂其中隐藏的警告后感到不安。
context:1.hook: The newest symbol, still wet, had my own code name in it.
context:1.line: Grey Crow: 'Without *context*, those marks are just noise on stone.'

sentences.en: Coded graffiti covered the underpass wall from end to end.
sentences.cn: 密码涂鸦覆盖了地下通道的整面墙，从头到尾。

sentences.en: Most people walked past it like paint.
sentences.cn: 大多数人走过时把它们当成了漆。

sentences.en: I could not.
sentences.cn: 我不能。

sentences.en: Each symbol carried *context* — a time, a name, a warning — if you knew how to read the layers underneath.
Grey Crow had taught me that.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦教过我这些。

sentences.en: Now I wished he had not.
sentences.cn: 现在我希望他没有。

date:1.en: The envelope had no name, only a *date* stamped in red ink: three days from now. I found it pinned under a loose brick at the base of the old harbour steps, exactly where Zero's last message had pointed. Three days. Not much time to learn what Harbor City was about to lose.
date:1.cnHint: 调查员在台阶砖缝中找到只写着____的信封，距所标时间只剩三天。
date:1.hook: On the back, in small letters: 'You are already too late.'
date:1.line: Ali: 'That *date* matches the city-wide blackout drill — that can't be chance.'

sentences.en: The envelope had no name, only a *date* stamped in red ink: three days from now.
I found it pinned under a loose brick at the base of the old harbour steps, exactly where Zero's last message had pointed.
sentences.cn: 我在老港口台阶底部的松动砖块下找到了它，正好在零点最后一条信息指向的地方。

sentences.en: Three days.
sentences.cn: 三天。

sentences.en: Not much time to learn what Harbor City was about to lose.
sentences.cn: 没有太多时间去弄清楚港口城即将失去什么。

flexible:1.en: The fence around the relay tower was new, but its lower corner had been pulled loose and bent back. *Flexible* enough for a person to slide through without a sound. Someone had come this way recently — the mud inside showed fresh boot prints heading toward the service door.
flexible:1.cnHint: 围栏底部被弯开了，____得足以让人悄悄钻过，泥地里有新鲜脚印。
flexible:1.hook: The service door was already open, and the light inside was red.
flexible:1.line: Ali: 'The wire is *flexible*; I can hold it while you go through.'

sentences.en: The fence around the relay tower was new, but its lower corner had been pulled loose and bent back.
sentences.cn: 继电塔周围的栅栏是新的，但下角已经被拉开弯折了回去。

sentences.en: *Flexible* enough for a person to slide through without a sound.
Someone had come this way recently — the mud inside showed fresh boot prints heading toward the service door.
sentences.cn: 最近有人来过这边——里面的泥土上留下了指向服务门的新靴印。

fly:1.en: I watched the small drone — no bigger than my fist — rise above the market stalls and vanish into the low cloud. In Harbor City a *fly* on the wall was never just a fly. Grey Crow touched my arm. 'That unit was watching us,' he said quietly. 'It has what it came for.'
fly:1.cnHint: 一架小型无人机像____一样悄悄升空离去，灰鸦说它已经拿到了想要的东西。
fly:1.hook: My face was now in Zero's hands, and I knew it.
fly:1.line: Grey Crow: 'A *fly* that small can carry a full voice record — remember that.'

sentences.en: I watched the small drone — no bigger than my fist — rise above the market stalls and vanish into the low cloud.
sentences.cn: 我看着那个无人机——不比我的拳头大多少——升起到市集摊位上方，消失在低矮的云层里。

sentences.en: In Harbor City a *fly* on the wall was never just a fly.
Grey Crow touched my arm.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦碰了碰我的手臂。

sentences.en: 'That unit was watching us,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: "那个装置在监视我们，"他轻声说。

sentences.en: 'It has what it came for.'
sentences.cn: "它已经得到了想要的东西。"

judge:1.en: The crowd outside the city court parted fast. A broadcast drone hovered above, repeating a name — mine. I had no time to wonder who had filed the order. In Harbor City, it did not matter what was true. What mattered was who got to *judge* first, and Zero had moved before I could.
judge:1.cnHint: 调查员的名字被公开广播，零点抢先出手，率先____了局势。
judge:1.hook: Grey Crow grabbed my sleeve: 'Move now or you lose everything.'
judge:1.line: Grey Crow: 'Let me *judge* the best exit before you run.'

sentences.en: The crowd outside the city court parted fast.
sentences.cn: 城市法庭外的人群迅速散开。

sentences.en: A broadcast drone hovered above, repeating a name — mine.
sentences.cn: 一架广播无人机悬停在上方，重复播放一个名字——我的。

sentences.en: I had no time to wonder who had filed the order.
sentences.cn: 我没有时间想谁提交了这份命令。

sentences.en: In Harbor City, it did not matter what was true.
sentences.cn: 在港口城，真实是什么并不重要。

sentences.en: What mattered was who got to *judge* first, and Zero had moved before I could.

oil:1.en: The harbour road gleamed under the rain, a thin film of *oil* spreading from a cracked drum near the loading dock. I crossed it carefully. One slip and Zero's people at the far gate would hear me fall. The drum was marked with a port authority seal — a fake, I was certain.
oil:1.cnHint: 码头路面有____污迹，调查员小心穿越，不敢发出任何声响。
oil:1.hook: Beyond the gate, a figure was already turning toward me.
oil:1.line: Ali: 'That *oil* came from inside the sealed warehouse — someone is running machines in there.'

sentences.en: The harbour road gleamed under the rain, a thin film of *oil* spreading from a cracked drum near the loading dock.
I crossed it carefully.
sentences.cn: 我小心地穿过去。

sentences.en: One slip and Zero's people at the far gate would hear me fall.
sentences.cn: 一旦滑倒，零点在远处大门的人就会听到我摔下来的声音。

sentences.en: The drum was marked with a port authority seal — a fake, I was certain.
sentences.cn: 油桶上标有港口管理局的印章——假的，我很确定。

passion:1.en: The coded graffiti covered every wall on Dock Street. Ali stopped at one tag — a burning crow, red on black. 'This took *passion*,' she said quietly. Someone had poured their whole self into this warning. The signal was meant to be found. By us. Tonight.
passion:1.cnHint: 码头街的涂鸦中隐藏着某种强烈的____，阿栗感到这是一个专门为我们留下的信号。
passion:1.hook: But the paint was still wet.
passion:1.line: 'Whoever left this had *passion* — and a death wish.'

sentences.en: The coded graffiti covered every wall on Dock Street.
sentences.cn: 码头街上到处都是密码涂鸦。

sentences.en: Ali stopped at one tag — a burning crow, red on black.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在一个标签前停了下来——一只燃烧的乌鸦，红色在黑色上。

sentences.en: 'This took *passion*,' she said quietly.
Someone had poured their whole self into this warning.
sentences.cn: 有人把整个自己都倾注在这个警告里。

sentences.en: The signal was meant to be found.
sentences.cn: 这个信号是想被找到的。

sentences.en: By us.
sentences.cn: 被我们。

sentences.en: Tonight.
sentences.cn: 今晚。

temperature:1.en: The rain had stopped but the street stayed cold. My scanner read the wall where the tag had been burned off. The surface *temperature* was still high — someone had erased it minutes ago. Zero was here. Watching. The alley ahead was dark and perfectly still.
temperature:1.cnHint: 扫描仪显示墙面____异常，说明零点刚刚抹去了某个关键标记。
temperature:1.hook: Then a shadow moved at the far end.
temperature:1.line: 'The *temperature* reading tells us we missed him by two minutes.'

sentences.en: The rain had stopped but the street stayed cold.
sentences.cn: 雨停了，但街道仍然很冷。

sentences.en: My scanner read the wall where the tag had been burned off.
sentences.cn: 我的扫描仪读取了标签被烧掉的墙面。

sentences.en: The surface *temperature* was still high — someone had erased it minutes ago.
Zero was here.
sentences.cn: 零点在这里。

sentences.en: Watching.
sentences.cn: 在看着。

sentences.en: The alley ahead was dark and perfectly still.
sentences.cn: 前面的小巷黑漆漆的，完全静止。

board:1.en: Grey Crow pointed to the cracked wooden *board* nailed above the old market gate. Three symbols were carved into it — our next coordinates. 'Zero leaves nothing by accident,' he said. I reached up and pulled it free. Behind it, a small data chip caught the neon light.
board:1.cnHint: 市场大门上的旧____后面藏着一枚数据芯片，那是我们苦寻的线索。
board:1.hook: The chip was already warm in my hand.
board:1.line: 'Check the back of that *board* — Grey Crow said it would be there.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow pointed to the cracked wooden *board* nailed above the old market gate.
Three symbols were carved into it — our next coordinates.
sentences.cn: 三个符号被刻在上面——我们的下一个坐标。

sentences.en: 'Zero leaves nothing by accident,' he said.
sentences.cn: "零点从不做偶然的事，"他说。

sentences.en: I reached up and pulled it free.
sentences.cn: 我伸手将它拉了下来。

sentences.en: Behind it, a small data chip caught the neon light.
sentences.cn: 在它后面，一个小数据芯片在霓虹灯下闪闪发光。

handle:1.en: The iron door at the end of Canal Row had no lock — only a heavy *handle* shaped like a bird's wing. Ali pressed it slowly. A low hum rose from below the street. 'Sub-level broadcast,' I said. Grey Crow had told us this place existed. We had not believed him.
handle:1.cnHint: 运河街尽头的铁门只有一个形似鸟翼的____，门后传来地下广播的嗡鸣声。
handle:1.hook: The hum shifted into a voice we recognized.
handle:1.line: 'Turn the *handle* slowly — one wrong move and the signal cuts.'

sentences.en: The iron door at the end of Canal Row had no lock — only a heavy *handle* shaped like a bird's wing.
Ali pressed it slowly.
sentences.cn: 阿栗慢慢按了下去。

sentences.en: A low hum rose from below the street.
sentences.cn: 一声低沉的嗡鸣声从街下升起。

sentences.en: 'Sub-level broadcast,' I said.
sentences.cn: "地下广播，"我说。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told us this place existed.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦告诉过我们这个地方的存在。

sentences.en: We had not believed him.
sentences.cn: 我们没有相信他。

ideal:1.en: Zero had chosen this intersection well. Four streets met here; every exit was visible from the centre. '*Ideal* ground for a trap,' Grey Crow murmured beside me. Neon signs blinked above us in three languages. Ali scanned the rooftops. Somewhere up there, eyes were already on us.
ideal:1.cnHint: 零点选择这个十字路口设伏，灰鸦低声说这是____的陷阱地形。
ideal:1.hook: Ali's scanner gave one short beep.
ideal:1.line: 'This spot is *ideal* — Zero planned every step.'

sentences.en: Zero had chosen this intersection well.
sentences.cn: 零点选择这个十字路口选得很好。

sentences.en: Four streets met here; every exit was visible from the centre. '*Ideal* ground for a trap,' Grey Crow murmured beside me.
Neon signs blinked above us in three languages.
sentences.cn: 霓虹灯牌在我们上方用三种语言闪烁。

sentences.en: Ali scanned the rooftops.
sentences.cn: 阿栗扫描了屋顶。

sentences.en: Somewhere up there, eyes were already on us.
sentences.cn: 在那上面的某个地方，眼睛已经盯上了我们。

ride:1.en: The cargo lift on the outer wall of the port tower offered a slow *ride* to the upper walkway. I stepped on alone; Ali and Grey Crow would take the stairs. Wind cut across the open platform. Halfway up, the lift stopped. Below me, a figure crossed the empty dock at a run.
ride:1.cnHint: 我独自乘升降机前往高层走廊，途中升降机突然停住，码头上出现了一个飞奔的身影。
ride:1.hook: The figure was heading straight for our exit.
ride:1.line: 'That *ride* up gave me a clear view — Zero knows we are here.'

sentences.en: The cargo lift on the outer wall of the port tower offered a slow *ride* to the upper walkway.
I stepped on alone; Ali and Grey Crow would take the stairs.
sentences.cn: 我独自踏上了升降梯；阿栗和灰鸦会走楼梯。

sentences.en: Wind cut across the open platform.
sentences.cn: 风在开放的平台上呼啸而过。

sentences.en: Halfway up, the lift stopped.
sentences.cn: 升到一半时，升降梯停了下来。

sentences.en: Below me, a figure crossed the empty dock at a run.
sentences.cn: 我下方，一个身影在空荡荡的码头上奔跑而过。

adjust:1.en: Grey Crow knelt beside the signal post and began to *adjust* the small dial on its base. 'The frequency drifts every hour,' he said, not looking up. Rain started again, soft and steady. I watched the street. Every person who passed seemed to slow for half a second near the post.
adjust:1.cnHint: 灰鸦蹲下来____信号柱底部的频率盘，而过路人的举动让我起疑。
adjust:1.hook: One of them did not keep walking.
adjust:1.line: 'I need thirty seconds to *adjust* this — keep your eyes on the street.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow knelt beside the signal post and began to *adjust* the small dial on its base.
'The frequency drifts every hour,' he said, not looking up.
sentences.cn: "频率每小时都会漂移，"灰鸦说着，头都没抬。

sentences.en: Rain started again, soft and steady.
sentences.cn: 雨又开始下了，柔和而稳定。

sentences.en: I watched the street.
sentences.cn: 我盯着街道。

sentences.en: Every person who passed seemed to slow for half a second near the post.
sentences.cn: 每个经过的人都会在信号柱附近放慢脚步，停留半秒钟。

basis:1.en: 'We move on this *basis*,' Grey Crow said, pressing his finger to the damp map spread across the crate: Zero changed routes only when he believed he had been seen. We had let him see us — on purpose. Ali nodded. The plan was thin and the street was quiet. Too quiet.
basis:1.cnHint: 灰鸦以零点的行动规律为____制定了计划，但寂静的街道让人不安。
basis:1.hook: Then every light on the block went out.
basis:1.line: 'On what *basis* do we trust this map is still accurate?'

sentences.en: 'We move on this *basis*,' Grey Crow said, pressing his finger to the damp map spread across the crate: Zero changed routes only when he believed he had been seen.
We had let him see us — on purpose.
sentences.cn: 我们让他看到了我们——故意的。

sentences.en: Ali nodded.
sentences.cn: 阿栗点了点头。

sentences.en: The plan was thin and the street was quiet.
sentences.cn: 计划很单薄，街道很安静。

sentences.en: Too quiet.
sentences.cn: 太安静了。

comfortable:1.en: Rain hammered the steel bridge over Black Canal. I crouched behind a broken sign, watching Zero's courier cross toward the old port. Nothing about this felt *comfortable* — the cold metal, the open sky, the courier's hand resting near a hidden device. Every second I stayed still was a second the signal could vanish.
comfortable:1.cnHint: 我躲在桥上，监视着零点的信使，感觉完全不____。
comfortable:1.hook: The courier stopped mid-bridge and looked straight at me.
comfortable:1.line: 'Nothing here is *comfortable*, and that is exactly how Zero wants it.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the steel bridge over Black Canal.
sentences.cn: 雨敲打着黑运河上的钢铁大桥。

sentences.en: I crouched behind a broken sign, watching Zero's courier cross toward the old port.
sentences.cn: 我蜷缩在一个破旧的招牌后面，注视着零点的信使朝旧港走去。

sentences.en: Nothing about this felt *comfortable* — the cold metal, the open sky, the courier's hand resting near a hidden device.
Every second I stayed still was a second the signal could vanish.
sentences.cn: 我静止不动的每一秒，信号都可能消失。

conclusion:1.en: Coded graffiti covered the wall outside Dock Nine. Grey Crow traced each symbol with one finger, eyes sharp. 'Read the pattern,' he said quietly. I studied the marks until a single *conclusion* hit me like cold rain: the meeting point was not the dock at all — it was the signal tower two blocks north.
conclusion:1.cnHint: 我在码头外解读涂鸦密码，终于得出了一个____。
conclusion:1.hook: A light blinked once from the tower, then went dark.
conclusion:1.line: 'There is only one *conclusion*, and Zero already knows we have reached it.'

sentences.en: Coded graffiti covered the wall outside Dock Nine.
sentences.cn: 九号码头外的墙上布满了密码涂鸦。

sentences.en: Grey Crow traced each symbol with one finger, eyes sharp.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦用一根手指描过每个符号，眼神锐利。

sentences.en: 'Read the pattern,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: "读懂这个图案，"他轻声说。

sentences.en: I studied the marks until a single *conclusion* hit me like cold rain: the meeting point was not the dock at all — it was the signal tower two blocks north.

formal:1.en: The checkpoint at Gate Seven looked almost *formal* — guards in clean coats, a printed sign, a desk with a blue lamp. But Ali grabbed my sleeve before I stepped forward. 'Those coats are wrong,' she whispered. No real city officer had worn blue since the Language Decree. This was Zero's crew in disguise.
formal:1.cnHint: 关卡看起来很____，但阿栗发现了破绽。
formal:1.hook: The guard behind the desk slowly raised his scanner.
formal:1.line: 'A *formal* checkpoint at midnight — that alone should tell you something is wrong.'

sentences.en: The checkpoint at Gate Seven looked almost *formal* — guards in clean coats, a printed sign, a desk with a blue lamp.
But Ali grabbed my sleeve before I stepped forward.
sentences.cn: 但阿栗在我踏前之前扯住了我的袖子。

sentences.en: 'Those coats are wrong,' she whispered.
sentences.cn: "那些大衣不对，"她低声道。

sentences.en: No real city officer had worn blue since the Language Decree.
sentences.cn: 自从《语言法令》以来，没有真正的城市警察穿过蓝色制服。

sentences.en: This was Zero's crew in disguise.
sentences.cn: 这是零点的人伪装的。

happiness:1.en: Street vendors packed up fast when the rain returned. One old woman kept selling paper lanterns, humming softly. For one unguarded moment I felt something close to *happiness* — warm light, quiet music, the smell of hot food. Then my receiver crackled: Zero's signal was moving, and it was heading straight down this street.
happiness:1.cnHint: 街头的温暖让我短暂感受到____，但信号打破了这一切。
happiness:1.hook: The lanterns went out all at once, every single one.
happiness:1.line: '*Happiness* is a gap in your focus — Zero counts on moments like this.'

sentences.en: Street vendors packed up fast when the rain returned.
sentences.cn: 雨再次降临时，街边小贩快速收摊。

sentences.en: One old woman kept selling paper lanterns, humming softly.
sentences.cn: 一位老妇人还在卖纸灯笼，轻声哼着歌。

sentences.en: For one unguarded moment I felt something close to *happiness* — warm light, quiet music, the smell of hot food.
Then my receiver crackled: Zero's signal was moving, and it was heading straight down this street.
sentences.cn: 随后我的接收器劈啪作响：零点的信号在移动，正朝这条街笔直而来。

intelligent:1.en: Zero had set four false trails across the market district. Most operatives would chase at least two. I followed none. Grey Crow had told me once that the most *intelligent* move is often the one that looks like doing nothing. So I stood still at the fountain and waited for Zero to come to me.
intelligent:1.cnHint: 我站在喷泉边一动不动，这才是最____的选择。
intelligent:1.hook: Footsteps behind me, precise and unhurried, grew louder.
intelligent:1.line: 'An *intelligent* hunter does not run — he makes the prey come to him.'

sentences.en: Zero had set four false trails across the market district.
sentences.cn: 零点在市场区设了四条假线索。

sentences.en: Most operatives would chase at least two.
sentences.cn: 大多数特工至少会追两条。

sentences.en: I followed none.
sentences.cn: 我一条都没追。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told me once that the most *intelligent* move is often the one that looks like doing nothing.
So I stood still at the fountain and waited for Zero to come to me.
sentences.cn: 所以我站在喷泉边，等待零点来找我。

novel:1.en: The broadcast tower on Silt Street was old, but Zero had found a *novel* use for it — hiding live data inside the static of dead music channels. Ali cracked the first layer in under a minute. What came through was not code. It was a list of names, and mine was near the top.
novel:1.cnHint: 零点用发射塔做了一件____的事，播出的内容令我震惊。
novel:1.hook: Ali's face went pale as she read the rest of the list.
novel:1.line: 'A *novel* trick — but hiding your plan inside old music was always going to leave a trace.'

sentences.en: The broadcast tower on Silt Street was old, but Zero had found a *novel* use for it — hiding live data inside the static of dead music channels.
Ali cracked the first layer in under a minute.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在一分钟内破解了第一层。

sentences.en: What came through was not code.
sentences.cn: 传来的不是代码。

sentences.en: It was a list of names, and mine was near the top.
sentences.cn: 是一份名单，我的名字靠近顶部。

political:1.en: The mural stretched half a block: bright colors, bold lines, and hidden *political* symbols that only certain eyes could decode. Grey Crow had painted it years ago as a warning. I finally understood what it said — the Harbor City council was not fighting Zero. Three of its members were funding him.
political:1.cnHint: 壁画里藏着____信息，揭示了令人震惊的秘密。
political:1.hook: A black car with council plates turned the corner toward us.
political:1.line: 'Every *political* map in this city has a hidden side — you are looking at it now.'

sentences.en: The mural stretched half a block: bright colors, bold lines, and hidden *political* symbols that only certain eyes could decode.
Grey Crow had painted it years ago as a warning.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦多年前画过这幅壁画，是作为警告。

sentences.en: I finally understood what it said — the Harbor City council was not fighting Zero.
sentences.cn: 我终于明白它说的是什么——港湾城议会不是在对抗零点。

sentences.en: Three of its members were funding him.
sentences.cn: 它的三名成员在资助他。

property:1.en: The block between Wire Lane and the old canal had been marked as city *property* for twenty years — empty, fenced, forgotten. But Ali's scan showed heat, power, and movement underground. Zero had built something beneath public land no one ever checked. The entrance was behind the fence, disguised as a water pipe.
property:1.cnHint: 这块被标记为城市____的废地下面，藏着零点的秘密基地。
property:1.hook: A lock clicked open from the inside before we touched it.
property:1.line: 'City *property*, zero activity on record — the perfect place to hide an operation this size.'
