sentences.en: The block between Wire Lane and the old canal had been marked as city *property* for twenty years — empty, fenced, forgotten.
But Ali's scan showed heat, power, and movement underground.
sentences.cn: 但阿栗的扫描显示地下有热源、电源和活动迹象。

sentences.en: Zero had built something beneath public land no one ever checked.
sentences.cn: 零点在没人检查的公共土地下建造了什么东西。

sentences.en: The entrance was behind the fence, disguised as a water pipe.
sentences.cn: 入口在栅栏后面，伪装成水管。

attribute:1.en: The cracked wall near the old harbour gate was covered in symbols. Grey Crow crouched beside me and traced one with a finger. 'Don't *attribute* this to random vandals,' he said quietly. 'Every mark is a message. Someone is mapping the city's blind spots.'
attribute:1.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我，不能把墙上的符号____为随机涂鸦，每一个都是有意为之的信息。
attribute:1.hook: The last symbol still glowed faintly in the rain.
attribute:1.line: 'Don't *attribute* this to chance — someone planned every mark.'

sentences.en: The cracked wall near the old harbour gate was covered in symbols.
sentences.cn: 旧港门附近的裂纹墙上布满了符号。

sentences.en: Grey Crow crouched beside me and traced one with a finger.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦蹲在我身边，用手指描过其中一个。

sentences.en: 'Don't *attribute* this to random vandals,' he said quietly.
'Every mark is a message.
sentences.cn: "每一个记号都是一条信息。

sentences.en: Someone is mapping the city's blind spots.'
sentences.cn: 有人在绘制这座城市的盲点。"

badly:1.en: Rain hammered the street outside the signal tower. Ali was crouched behind a rusted barrier, her left arm *badly* cut from climbing the fence. She pressed the wound against her jacket and kept moving. I followed, watching the shadows between the lamp-posts for any sign of Zero.
badly:1.cnHint: 阿里在攀爬围栏时受伤，我们仍要在信号塔附近继续追踪零号。
badly:1.hook: A shadow peeled away from the wall ahead of us.
badly:1.line: 'My arm is *badly* cut, but I'm not stopping here.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the street outside the signal tower.
sentences.cn: 雨砸向信号塔外的街道。

sentences.en: Ali was crouched behind a rusted barrier, her left arm *badly* cut from climbing the fence.
She pressed the wound against her jacket and kept moving.
sentences.cn: 她把伤口贴在夹克上，继续前进。

sentences.en: I followed, watching the shadows between the lamp-posts for any sign of Zero.
sentences.cn: 我跟在后面，在路灯间的阴影里搜寻零点的踪迹。

bridge:1.en: We met Grey Crow at the old canal *bridge* just before midnight. The stone arch was tagged with fresh coded graffiti, still wet. He spread a map on the railing and circled three points. 'Zero will cross here,' he said. 'This is the only route left open.'
bridge:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在运河____上展开地图，指出零号唯一的逃跑路线。
bridge:1.hook: Somewhere below, a boat engine cut to silence.
bridge:1.line: 'Zero will cross this *bridge* — it is the only way out.'

sentences.en: We met Grey Crow at the old canal *bridge* just before midnight.
The stone arch was tagged with fresh coded graffiti, still wet.
sentences.cn: 石拱门上满是新鲜的密码涂鸦，还湿漉漉的。

sentences.en: He spread a map on the railing and circled three points.
sentences.cn: 他在栏杆上铺开地图，圈了三个点。

sentences.en: 'Zero will cross here,' he said.
sentences.cn: "零点会从这里穿过，"他说。

sentences.en: 'This is the only route left open.'
sentences.cn: "这是仅有的通路了。"

casual:1.en: Zero walked past the night market stalls in a *casual* grey jacket, hands in pockets, as if shopping for food. But his eyes never stopped moving. Ali nudged me. 'He is too relaxed,' she whispered. 'That is a performance. He knows someone is watching.'
casual:1.cnHint: 零号穿着____的衣服出现在夜市，阿里提醒我他的放松只是伪装。
casual:1.hook: He paused at a stall and looked directly our way.
casual:1.line: 'A *casual* walk in a crowd is the oldest trick there is.'

sentences.en: Zero walked past the night market stalls in a *casual* grey jacket, hands in pockets, as if shopping for food.
But his eyes never stopped moving.
sentences.cn: 但他的眼神从未停止扫动。

sentences.en: Ali nudged me.
sentences.cn: 阿栗推了我一下。

sentences.en: 'He is too relaxed,' she whispered.
sentences.cn: "他太放松了，"她低声说。

sentences.en: 'That is a performance.
sentences.cn: "这是表演。

sentences.en: He knows someone is watching.'
sentences.cn: 他知道有人在看。"

closely:1.en: I followed Zero *closely* through the narrow back streets near the port, keeping three steps behind, matching his pace. Every time he slowed, I slowed. Every turn he made, I made. Then he stopped under a yellow lamp, and without turning around, he spoke my name.
closely:1.cnHint: 我在港口附近的小巷中____跟踪零号，他突然叫出了我的名字。
closely:1.hook: He knew I was there the entire time.
closely:1.line: 'You followed too *closely* — I heard every step you took.'

sentences.en: I followed Zero *closely* through the narrow back streets near the port, keeping three steps behind, matching his pace.
Every time he slowed, I slowed.
sentences.cn: 他每次放慢速度，我就跟着放慢。

sentences.en: Every turn he made, I made.
sentences.cn: 他转的每个弯，我都转。

sentences.en: Then he stopped under a yellow lamp, and without turning around, he spoke my name.
sentences.cn: 然后他在一盏黄灯下停住了，没有转身，却直接叫出了我的名字。

commit:1.en: Grey Crow pulled me into a doorway off the main street. 'If you move now, you *commit* to the whole plan,' he said, his voice flat and serious. 'There is no stepping back once you cross that checkpoint.' The rain fell hard. I looked at the lit booth fifty metres ahead.
commit:1.cnHint: 灰鸦警告我，一旦越过检查站，就意味着____于整个计划，无法回头。
commit:1.hook: My foot was already moving forward.
commit:1.line: 'The moment you cross, you *commit* — no turning back after that.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow pulled me into a doorway off the main street.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把我拉进了主街道旁的一扇门。

sentences.en: 'If you move now, you *commit* to the whole plan,' he said, his voice flat and serious.
'There is no stepping back once you cross that checkpoint.'
sentences.cn: "过了那个检查站就没有回头路了。"

sentences.en: The rain fell hard.
sentences.cn: 雨下得很急。

sentences.en: I looked at the lit booth fifty metres ahead.
sentences.cn: 我望向五十米外那个亮着的小亭子。

concentrate:1.en: The signal was buried in noise. Ali pressed the receiver to her ear and told me to stay quiet. 'I need to *concentrate*,' she said. Around us the street market roared, horns blared, and neon signs buzzed. Then she went very still. 'There,' she breathed. 'I have it.'
concentrate:1.cnHint: 阿里在嘈杂的街市中努力____，终于从噪音里捕捉到了隐藏的信号。
concentrate:1.hook: Whatever she heard drained the colour from her face.
concentrate:1.line: 'Stay quiet — I need to *concentrate* or I will lose the signal.'

sentences.en: The signal was buried in noise.
sentences.cn: 信号淹没在噪音里。

sentences.en: Ali pressed the receiver to her ear and told me to stay quiet.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把接收器贴在耳朵上，示意我保持安静。

sentences.en: 'I need to *concentrate*,' she said.
Around us the street market roared, horns blared, and neon signs buzzed.
sentences.cn: 周围街市喧嚣，汽笛尖鸣，霓虹灯嗡嗡作响。

sentences.en: Then she went very still.
sentences.cn: 然后她突然静住了。

sentences.en: 'There,' she breathed.
sentences.cn: "在这儿，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: 'I have it.'
sentences.cn: "我找到了。"

conscious:1.en: The explosion of light from the security drone made everyone on the street freeze. I stayed still, *conscious* of the camera sweeping slowly our way. If it caught my face, the whole operation was finished. Grey Crow moved one step to his left, blocking its view. Just enough.
conscious:1.cnHint: 无人机探照灯扫来，我____地屏住呼吸，灰鸦挡在镜头前保住了我。
conscious:1.hook: The drone hovered, then turned away into the dark.
conscious:1.line: 'Stay *conscious* of the camera — one wrong move ends this.'

sentences.en: The explosion of light from the security drone made everyone on the street freeze.
sentences.cn: 安全无人机射出的光芒炸裂了整条街。

sentences.en: I stayed still, *conscious* of the camera sweeping slowly our way.
If it caught my face, the whole operation was finished.
sentences.cn: 如果它扫到我的脸，整个行动就完了。

sentences.en: Grey Crow moved one step to his left, blocking its view.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦向左挪了一步，挡住了它的视线。

sentences.en: Just enough.
sentences.cn: 刚刚好。

relative:1.en: The rain hit the street like static. Grey Crow pointed to two signals on my scanner. 'One is strong, one is weak,' he said. 'But everything is *relative*.' A weak signal in a quiet alley could mean far more danger than a loud one in the open. I chose the alley.
relative:1.cnHint: 灰鸦提醒我，信号的强弱是____的，安静小巷里微弱的信号可能更危险。
relative:1.hook: The alley lights died before I took my first step.
relative:1.line: 'Danger and safety are *relative* — the quiet ones kill you first.'

sentences.en: The rain hit the street like static.
sentences.cn: 雨像静电一样砸在街道上。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pointed to two signals on my scanner.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦指向我扫描仪上的两个信号。

sentences.en: 'One is strong, one is weak,' he said.
sentences.cn: "一个强，一个弱，"他说。

sentences.en: 'But everything is *relative*.'
A weak signal in a quiet alley could mean far more danger than a loud one in the open.
sentences.cn: 安静小巷里的弱信号可能比开放地带的强信号危险得多。

sentences.en: I chose the alley.
sentences.cn: 我选了小巷。

rent:1.en: Zero had vanished for three days. Ali tracked a payment trail through the city grid. 'Someone is paying *rent* on a unit in the east block,' she said, voice tight. 'Cash transfer, no name.' A safe house. Zero was hiding close. Too close.
rent:1.cnHint: 阿栗发现有人在东区支付____，零点可能就藏在附近。
rent:1.hook: The address on the screen matched the alley outside our window.
rent:1.line: 'Someone just paid *rent* on that unit — in cash, one hour ago.'

sentences.en: Zero had vanished for three days.
sentences.cn: 零点消失了三天。

sentences.en: Ali tracked a payment trail through the city grid.
sentences.cn: 阿栗追踪了一条支付轨迹穿过城市电网。

sentences.en: 'Someone is paying *rent* on a unit in the east block,' she said, voice tight.
'Cash transfer, no name.'
sentences.cn: "无名现金转账。"

sentences.en: A safe house.
sentences.cn: 一个安全屋。

sentences.en: Zero was hiding close.
sentences.cn: 零点就躲在附近。

sentences.en: Too close.
sentences.cn: 近得有点吓人。

round:1.en: Grey Crow called it the final *round*. Each time we thought we had Zero cornered, the cycle reset: new route, new signal, same ghost. I stood at the crossroads under a flickering neon sign, watching the pattern repeat on my scanner. This time felt different.
round:1.cnHint: 灰鸦说这是最后一____，但每次我们以为抓住零点，一切又重来。
round:1.hook: My scanner beeped once — then Zero's signal split into three.
round:1.line: 'This is the last *round*. One of us ends it tonight.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow called it the final *round*.
Each time we thought we had Zero cornered, the cycle reset: new route, new signal, same ghost.
sentences.cn: 每次我们以为逼住了零点，循环就重启：新路线、新信号、同样的幽灵。

sentences.en: I stood at the crossroads under a flickering neon sign, watching the pattern repeat on my scanner.
sentences.cn: 我站在霓虹灯闪烁的十字路口，看着扫描仪上的图案重复。

sentences.en: This time felt different.
sentences.cn: 这次感觉不一样了。

structure:1.en: The old transit hub rose against the grey sky. Ali circled it on our map. 'Look at the *structure*,' she said. 'Three entry points, one blind corner, and a roof with line of sight to the whole street.' Zero had chosen this place carefully. So had we.
structure:1.cnHint: 阿栗分析旧换乘站的____，指出零点选择此地的战略用意。
structure:1.hook: A shadow moved across the roof before we reached the door.
structure:1.line: 'Study the *structure* first — Zero never picks a place without a way out.'

sentences.en: The old transit hub rose against the grey sky.
sentences.cn: 老中转枢纽顶着灰蒙蒙的天空耸立着。

sentences.en: Ali circled it on our map.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在地图上圈了出来。

sentences.en: 'Look at the *structure*,' she said.
'Three entry points, one blind corner, and a roof with line of sight to the whole street.'
sentences.cn: "三个出入口，一个死角，屋顶能看到整条街。"

sentences.en: Zero had chosen this place carefully.
sentences.cn: 零点精心选择了这个地方。

sentences.en: So had we.
sentences.cn: 我们也是。

typical:1.en: '*Typical* Zero,' Ali muttered, staring at the empty rooftop. A decoy signal, a false trail, and we had wasted forty minutes in the cold rain chasing nothing. The city hummed around us, indifferent. This was the pattern: lead us out, wear us down, then strike when we were tired.
typical:1.cnHint: 阿栗看着空旷的屋顶，说这是____的零点风格——先把我们引开，再消耗我们的体力。
typical:1.hook: Behind us, the door to our own base swung open with no one there.
typical:1.line: '*Typical* move — send us chasing shadows while he circles back.'

sentences.en: '*Typical* Zero,' Ali muttered, staring at the empty rooftop.
A decoy signal, a false trail, and we had wasted forty minutes in the cold rain chasing nothing.
sentences.cn: 一个诱饵信号，一条假线索，我们在冷雨里白白浪费了四十分钟。

sentences.en: The city hummed around us, indifferent.
sentences.cn: 城市在周围嗡鸣，漠不关心。

sentences.en: This was the pattern: lead us out, wear us down, then strike when we were tired.
sentences.cn: 就是这个套路：把我们引出去，累垮我们，然后在我们筋疲力尽的时候发动。

vacation:1.en: I had not slept in thirty hours. Ali slid me a cold cup and said, 'After this, you deserve a long *vacation*.' I almost laughed. In Harbor City, rest was a myth. But her words carried something real — the idea that this could end, that there was an after. I held onto that.
vacation:1.cnHint: 阿栗说结束之后我值得好好____，这句话让我第一次相信事情真的可以结束。
vacation:1.hook: Then her wrist scanner lit up red — Zero was one block away.
vacation:1.line: 'Finish this, and I promise you a real *vacation* — somewhere without rain.'

sentences.en: I had not slept in thirty hours.
sentences.cn: 我已经三十个小时没睡了。

sentences.en: Ali slid me a cold cup and said, 'After this, you deserve a long *vacation*.'
I almost laughed.
sentences.cn: 我差点笑出来。

sentences.en: In Harbor City, rest was a myth.
sentences.cn: 在港湾城，休息是个神话。

sentences.en: But her words carried something real — the idea that this could end, that there was an after.
sentences.cn: 但她的话里有真实的东西——这一切可能结束，可能有之后。

sentences.en: I held onto that.
sentences.cn: 我紧紧抓住这个念头。

acquire:1.en: Zero did not guess passwords. Grey Crow explained it quietly, his breath misting in the cold. 'Zero finds people who already have access, then learns what they know.' To *acquire* the city's master frequency, Zero needed one insider. Our job was to reach that insider first. The clock was already running.
acquire:1.cnHint: 灰鸦解释零点如何____主频率的访问权——通过接触内部人员。
acquire:1.hook: The insider's contact number had been called four minutes ago.
acquire:1.line: 'Zero will *acquire* the frequency through a person, not a machine — find that person.'

sentences.en: Zero did not guess passwords.
sentences.cn: 零点不会破解密码。

sentences.en: Grey Crow explained it quietly, his breath misting in the cold.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在寒冷中轻声解释，呼吸在空气里结成白雾。

sentences.en: 'Zero finds people who already have access, then learns what they know.'
sentences.cn: 零点是找到已经有访问权限的人，然后学他们知道的。

sentences.en: To *acquire* the city's master frequency, Zero needed one insider.
Our job was to reach that insider first.
sentences.cn: 我们的工作是先找到那个内线。

sentences.en: The clock was already running.
sentences.cn: 时间已经开始计时了。

adequate:1.en: Ali checked our gear in the grey pre-dawn light. Two scanners, one jammer, a full charge. 'Is this *adequate*?' I asked. She gave a short nod. 'It has to be.' We had no backup, no extra time, no second chance. What we carried was what we had. The street waited, silent and wet.
adequate:1.cnHint: 阿栗检查装备，我问这些东西是否____，她说只能如此——没有备用方案。
adequate:1.hook: Grey Crow's voice cut through the earpiece: 'Zero is already in position.'
adequate:1.line: '*Adequate* or not, this is everything we have — let's move.'

sentences.en: Ali checked our gear in the grey pre-dawn light.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在灰蒙蒙的黎明前光线下检查我们的装备。

sentences.en: Two scanners, one jammer, a full charge.
sentences.cn: 两个扫描仪，一个干扰器，电量满格。

sentences.en: 'Is this *adequate*?'
I asked.
sentences.cn: 我问。

sentences.en: She gave a short nod.
sentences.cn: 她短促地点了点头。

sentences.en: 'It has to be.'
sentences.cn: 必须够。

sentences.en: We had no backup, no extra time, no second chance.
sentences.cn: 我们没有后援，没有额外的时间，没有第二次机会。

sentences.en: What we carried was what we had.
sentences.cn: 我们带着的就是我们有的全部。

sentences.en: The street waited, silent and wet.
sentences.cn: 街道在等，寂静又潮湿。

obvious:1.en: The rain had washed most of the coded graffiti from the wall, but one mark remained — a red circle with a broken arrow. It was *obvious* to anyone trained to read street signals: a warning left hours ago. I pressed my back against the cold brick. Someone had been here. Someone might still be.
obvious:1.cnHint: 街头暗号墙上有一个标记，对我来说____得令人不安。
obvious:1.hook: The mark was fresh. The paint was still wet.
obvious:1.line: 'It's *obvious* they wanted us to find this,' Grey Crow said softly.

sentences.en: The rain had washed most of the coded graffiti from the wall, but one mark remained — a red circle with a broken arrow.
sentences.cn: 雨水冲掉了墙上大部分的密码涂鸦，但一个标记留了下来——一个红圈，箭头断了。

sentences.en: It was *obvious* to anyone trained to read street signals: a warning left hours ago.
I pressed my back against the cold brick.
sentences.cn: 我背靠着冰冷的砖墙。

sentences.en: Someone had been here.
sentences.cn: 有人来过这里。

sentences.en: Someone might still be.
sentences.cn: 现在可能还有人在。

ordinary:1.en: From the outside, the noodle stall on Pier Nine looked *ordinary* — plastic stools, a fogged-up window, the smell of broth. But every customer sat with their back to the wall. Every cup held a folded slip of paper under it. I ordered tea and waited, hands flat on the table.
ordinary:1.cnHint: 码头边那个看起来____的小摊，其实暗流涌动。
ordinary:1.hook: The last customer stood up and left a key behind.
ordinary:1.line: 'Nothing *ordinary* survives this deep in the harbour district,' Ali warned.

sentences.en: From the outside, the noodle stall on Pier Nine looked *ordinary* — plastic stools, a fogged-up window, the smell of broth.
But every customer sat with their back to the wall.
sentences.cn: 但每个顾客都背靠着墙坐。

sentences.en: Every cup held a folded slip of paper under it.
sentences.cn: 每个杯子下面都垫着一张折叠的纸条。

sentences.en: I ordered tea and waited, hands flat on the table.
sentences.cn: 我点了茶，等着，两手平放在桌上。

pace:1.en: Grey Crow began to *pace* the length of the wet alley, three steps forward, three back, like a caged signal bouncing between walls. I knew that rhythm. He was decoding something in his head. Above us, a broadcast drone circled twice, then cut its lights and dropped below the rooftop line.
pace:1.cnHint: 引路人在小巷里来回____，试图在脑中解读信号。
pace:1.hook: He stopped mid-step and grabbed my arm.
pace:1.line: 'Stop. Match my *pace* exactly or the sensor trips,' he said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow began to *pace* the length of the wet alley, three steps forward, three back, like a caged signal bouncing between walls.
I knew that rhythm.
sentences.cn: 我认识这个节奏。

sentences.en: He was decoding something in his head.
sentences.cn: 他在脑子里解码什么东西。

sentences.en: Above us, a broadcast drone circled twice, then cut its lights and dropped below the rooftop line.
sentences.cn: 我们头顶上，一架广播无人机盘旋两圈，然后关掉灯降到了屋顶线以下。

participate:1.en: A crowd had gathered around a cracked public screen showing a city-wide alert. Zero's voice cut through the static: anyone who chose to *participate* in tonight's signal relay would be tracked, flagged, erased. Half the crowd walked away. The other half stayed perfectly still, which was its own kind of answer.
participate:1.cnHint: 零在广播中警告，任何选择____今晚行动的人都会被追踪。
participate:1.hook: Ali's hand moved slowly toward the relay switch.
participate:1.line: 'I choose to *participate*,' Ali said, voice low but steady.

sentences.en: A crowd had gathered around a cracked public screen showing a city-wide alert.
sentences.cn: 一群人围着一块裂了的公共屏幕，上面在播放城市范围的警报。

sentences.en: Zero's voice cut through the static: anyone who chose to *participate* in tonight's signal relay would be tracked, flagged, erased.
Half the crowd walked away.
sentences.cn: 半数人走开了。

sentences.en: The other half stayed perfectly still, which was its own kind of answer.
sentences.cn: 另一半纹丝不动，这本身就是个回答。

pilot:1.en: The small craft sat dark at the edge of the elevated rail platform, no markings, no running lights. The *pilot* — a woman with a shaved head and wire-frame goggles — said nothing when I climbed in. She just handed me a folded map and pointed at the skyline, where three signal towers were blinking in sequence.
pilot:1.cnHint: 一名____把折叠地图交给我，然后指向正在闪烁信号的塔楼。
pilot:1.hook: The craft lifted before I finished unfolding the map.
pilot:1.line: 'I'm the *pilot*. You're the cargo. Don't touch anything,' she said.

sentences.en: The small craft sat dark at the edge of the elevated rail platform, no markings, no running lights.
sentences.cn: 小飞艇停在高架轨道平台边缘，没有标记，没有航行灯。

sentences.en: The *pilot* — a woman with a shaved head and wire-frame goggles — said nothing when I climbed in.
She just handed me a folded map and pointed at the skyline, where three signal towers were blinking in sequence.
sentences.cn: 她只是递给我一张折叠的地图，指向天际线，那里三座信号塔在有序地闪烁。

primary:1.en: Grey Crow pulled up a cracked city diagram on his wrist screen. 'The *primary* route is flooded,' he said, tracing a red line through the harbour district. Every backup path crossed Zero's patrol grid. We were not lost — we were boxed. The rain hammered the street around us like a second wall closing in.
primary:1.cnHint: 引路人告诉我____路线被淹了，我们陷入了包围。
primary:1.hook: There was one path left, and it went through Zero's base.
primary:1.line: 'The *primary* objective hasn't changed — we move now,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow pulled up a cracked city diagram on his wrist screen.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在腕上屏幕上调出了一份破损的城市图表。

sentences.en: 'The *primary* route is flooded,' he said, tracing a red line through the harbour district.
Every backup path crossed Zero's patrol grid.
sentences.cn: 每条备用路线都穿过零点的巡逻网格。

sentences.en: We were not lost — we were boxed.
sentences.cn: 我们没有迷路——我们被困了。

sentences.en: The rain hammered the street around us like a second wall closing in.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在我们周围的街道上，像第二道墙在慢慢合拢。

priority:1.en: Ali sorted the signal fragments fast, fingers moving across the dim screen without hesitation. 'Decoding the address is the *priority*,' she said, not looking up. Around us, the street vendors were packing up too quickly, carts rolling in the wrong direction. The whole block was clearing out. Someone had sent a warning we had not received.
priority:1.cnHint: 阿里专注解码，把找到地址列为____，却没注意到周围街道正在悄悄清场。
priority:1.hook: The last vendor looked back at us once, then ran.
priority:1.line: 'Finding Zero's position is the *priority* right now,' Ali said firmly.

sentences.en: Ali sorted the signal fragments fast, fingers moving across the dim screen without hesitation.
sentences.cn: 阿栗快速分类信号碎片，手指在暗屏上毫不犹豫地掠过。

sentences.en: 'Decoding the address is the *priority*,' she said, not looking up.
Around us, the street vendors were packing up too quickly, carts rolling in the wrong direction.
sentences.cn: 我们周围，街道小贩也在收摊，但速度太快了，推车往错的方向滚。

sentences.en: The whole block was clearing out.
sentences.cn: 整个街区都在清空。

sentences.en: Someone had sent a warning we had not received.
sentences.cn: 有人发了我们没收到的警告。

throughout:1.en: *Throughout* the long walk down Signal Row, the coded lights above each shop door shifted colour in sequence — green, amber, red, amber, green. It was a message running the full length of the street, slow enough to miss if you were not watching. I was watching. It spelled one word: leave.
throughout:1.cnHint: 整条信号街____都亮着变换颜色的灯，那是一条完整的警告信息。
throughout:1.hook: The lights went dark all at once before I reached the end.
throughout:1.line: '*Throughout* the whole street — did you see it?' I asked Grey Crow.

sentences.en: *Throughout* the long walk down Signal Row, the coded lights above each shop door shifted colour in sequence — green, amber, red, amber, green.
It was a message running the full length of the street, slow enough to miss if you were not watching.
sentences.cn: 如果你没在看，很容易错过这条信息，但它在沿着整条街缓缓运行。

sentences.en: I was watching.
sentences.cn: 我在看。

sentences.en: It spelled one word: leave.
sentences.cn: 它拼出一个词：滚。

disappear:1.en: Ali pointed at the corner where a coded tag had blazed in red neon for three days. Now the wall was clean, bare concrete, no trace of pigment. Signals in Harbor City could *disappear* in minutes once the city's sweep drones passed. We had maybe thirty seconds of data left.
disappear:1.cnHint: 街角的暗语标记突然____，扫荡无人机刚刚飞过。
disappear:1.hook: The data fragment cut off mid-character, and the drone turned back toward us.
disappear:1.line: 'Watch it *disappear* — that means Zero already read it,' Ali whispered.

sentences.en: Ali pointed at the corner where a coded tag had blazed in red neon for three days.
sentences.cn: 阿栗指向那个角落，一个密码标签三天来一直在红色霓虹光中闪烁。

sentences.en: Now the wall was clean, bare concrete, no trace of pigment.
sentences.cn: 现在墙是干净的，裸露的混凝土，没有一丝颜料痕迹。

sentences.en: Signals in Harbor City could *disappear* in minutes once the city's sweep drones passed.
We had maybe thirty seconds of data left.
sentences.cn: 我们大概还有三十秒的数据可用。

district:1.en: Grey Crow led me east, past the water-treatment towers, into the Signal *District* — four blocks where every lamp post hummed a different frequency. I could hear all of them at once, a chord of stolen broadcasts layered under the rain. No rookie had ever mapped this zone and walked out with clean ears.
district:1.cnHint: 灰鸦带我深入信号____，那里每根灯柱都在传输不同的频率。
district:1.hook: Then every lamp post went silent at exactly the same second.
district:1.line: 'Welcome to the Signal *District* — keep your hearing sharp,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow led me east, past the water-treatment towers, into the Signal *District* — four blocks where every lamp post hummed a different frequency.
I could hear all of them at once, a chord of stolen broadcasts layered under the rain.
sentences.cn: 我能同时听到所有的声音，一和弦被盗窃的广播声叠压在雨声下。

sentences.en: No rookie had ever mapped this zone and walked out with clean ears.
sentences.cn: 没有新手能走出这个区域还保持耳朵干净。

greatly:1.en: The encoded graffiti on the underpass wall had *greatly* expanded overnight — what was six glyphs at sunset was now forty, wrapping around the curve and out of sight. Someone had been busy while the city slept. Each new glyph pulsed faintly, still warm, still live.
greatly:1.cnHint: 地下通道的加密涂鸦一夜之间____增加，仍在发光。
greatly:1.hook: The last glyph was not a word — it was my investigator ID number.
greatly:1.line: 'The message *greatly* changed — Zero must have sent backup,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The encoded graffiti on the underpass wall had *greatly* expanded overnight — what was six glyphs at sunset was now forty, wrapping around the curve and out of sight.
Someone had been busy while the city slept.
sentences.cn: 城市睡眠时有人在忙碌。

sentences.en: Each new glyph pulsed faintly, still warm, still live.
sentences.cn: 每个新的符号都微微闪烁，还热着，还活着。

imitate:1.en: Zero's signal had begun to *imitate* Grey Crow's voice pattern — same rhythm, same pauses, same coded suffix. I almost trusted it. Ali caught the error: one phoneme off, a ghost of a wrong tone. A fake guide in a city built on false signals was a death sentence.
imitate:1.cnHint: 零点开始____灰鸦的声音信号，差点骗过了我们。
imitate:1.hook: The fake signal said my name, perfectly, and kept walking ahead of us.
imitate:1.line: 'Zero can *imitate* any voice — never follow sound alone,' Ali warned.

sentences.en: Zero's signal had begun to *imitate* Grey Crow's voice pattern — same rhythm, same pauses, same coded suffix.
I almost trusted it.
sentences.cn: 我几乎相信了。

sentences.en: Ali caught the error: one phoneme off, a ghost of a wrong tone.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了错误：一个音素差了，一个错误音调的幽灵。

sentences.en: A fake guide in a city built on false signals was a death sentence.
sentences.cn: 在一座建立在虚假信号之上的城市里，一个假向导就是死刑。

implement:1.en: Grey Crow pulled a slim silver *implement* from his coat — a handheld node-scanner, older than the city grid, scraped clean of any serial mark. He pressed it flat against the wet wall. A map bloomed on its face: seven dead-drop points, all within one block, all active.
implement:1.cnHint: 灰鸦拿出一件金属____，扫描后显示出七个活跃的秘密投递点。
implement:1.hook: The seventh point was inside the building we were already standing in.
implement:1.line: 'This *implement* reads what no phone can see,' Grey Crow said quietly.

sentences.en: Grey Crow pulled a slim silver *implement* from his coat — a handheld node-scanner, older than the city grid, scraped clean of any serial mark.
He pressed it flat against the wet wall.
sentences.cn: 他把它压平贴在湿漉漉的墙上。

sentences.en: A map bloomed on its face: seven dead-drop points, all within one block, all active.
sentences.cn: 一张地图在它的屏幕上绽放：七个死信点，全在一个街区内，全都活跃着。

mood:1.en: The rain changed the *mood* of every signal I heard — wet air warped the frequencies, gave each broadcast a low, hollow edge, like a voice speaking from the bottom of a tank. I logged three new transmissions coming off the bridge cables. One of them was crying. Not a person — a machine, looping grief.
mood:1.cnHint: 雨水改变了信号的____，桥缆上传来一段像在哭泣的机器循环音。
mood:1.hook: The crying signal locked onto my frequency and would not let go.
mood:1.line: 'The *mood* of a signal tells you who sent it,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The rain changed the *mood* of every signal I heard — wet air warped the frequencies, gave each broadcast a low, hollow edge, like a voice speaking from the bottom of a tank.
I logged three new transmissions coming off the bridge cables.
sentences.cn: 我记录了三个从桥缆上发出的新传输。

sentences.en: One of them was crying.
sentences.cn: 其中一个在哭泣。

sentences.en: Not a person — a machine, looping grief.
sentences.cn: 不是一个人——一台机器，循环哀伤。

motivation:1.en: I could not read Zero's next move until I understood the *motivation* behind the coded broadcast — was it bait, a warning, or a plea? Ali spread the decoded fragments across the wet pavement like cards. Three words repeated: find, prove, before. Not threat. Desperation.
motivation:1.cnHint: 我们试图理解零点发出信号背后的____，碎片显示的是绝望而非威胁。
motivation:1.hook: Ali's hand froze over the last fragment — it had today's date and my name.
motivation:1.line: 'Tell me the *motivation* and I will tell you the next move,' Ali said.

sentences.en: I could not read Zero's next move until I understood the *motivation* behind the coded broadcast — was it bait, a warning, or a plea?
Ali spread the decoded fragments across the wet pavement like cards.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把解码的碎片像牌一样铺在湿漉漉的人行道上。

sentences.en: Three words repeated: find, prove, before.
sentences.cn: 三个词重复出现：寻找、证明、之前。

sentences.en: Not threat.
sentences.cn: 不是威胁。

sentences.en: Desperation.
sentences.cn: 绝望。

worldwide:1.en: Rain hammered the street outside Terminal Nine. Grey Crow pressed a data chip into my hand. 'This signal,' he said, 'is *worldwide* — every city, every hidden net, all listening at once.' I stared at the chip. Whatever was encoded there could flip the balance of power in Harbor City overnight.
worldwide:1.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我，这个信号____，整个地下网络都在监听。
worldwide:1.hook: The chip was already warm — someone else had touched it.
worldwide:1.line: 'This signal is *worldwide* — every city is already listening.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the street outside Terminal Nine.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在九号终端外的街道上。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pressed a data chip into my hand.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把一枚数据芯片塞进我的手心。

sentences.en: 'This signal,' he said, 'is *worldwide* — every city, every hidden net, all listening at once.'
I stared at the chip.
sentences.cn: 我盯着那枚芯片。

sentences.en: Whatever was encoded there could flip the balance of power in Harbor City overnight.
sentences.cn: 任何编码在那里面的东西都可能在一夜之间翻转港城的权力平衡。

accomplish:1.en: Zero stood at the far end of Crescent Alley, arms crossed. 'You can't *accomplish* anything without the key,' he said, voice flat as cold metal. I kept walking toward him, rain soaking through my coat. I had three minutes before the transit gate locked. He was right, but I wasn't stopping.
accomplish:1.cnHint: 零点嘲讽我没有密钥就无法____任何事，但我没有停下脚步。
accomplish:1.hook: My hand closed around something in my pocket — not a key, but close.
accomplish:1.line: 'You can't *accomplish* anything here without the key.'

sentences.en: Zero stood at the far end of Crescent Alley, arms crossed.
sentences.cn: 零点站在新月巷的远端，双臂交叉。

sentences.en: 'You can't *accomplish* anything without the key,' he said, voice flat as cold metal.
I kept walking toward him, rain soaking through my coat.
sentences.cn: 我继续走向他，雨水浸透了我的外套。

sentences.en: I had three minutes before the transit gate locked.
sentences.cn: 我有三分钟时间在过境门锁上之前。

sentences.en: He was right, but I wasn't stopping.
sentences.cn: 他说得对，但我没有停下。

address:1.en: Ali handed me a torn strip of paper. On it was a single *address*: Dock 7, Lower Wharf. 'That's where the broadcast originates,' she said, eyes scanning the crowd behind me. The street felt too quiet. In Harbor City, quiet meant someone had already cleared the way — not for us.
address:1.cnHint: 阿里给了我一个____，那是信号广播的源头所在。
address:1.hook: When I looked up, Ali had already disappeared into the crowd.
address:1.line: 'That *address* is where the signal comes from — go now.'

sentences.en: Ali handed me a torn strip of paper.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把一条撕裂的纸片递给我。

sentences.en: On it was a single *address*: Dock 7, Lower Wharf.
'That's where the broadcast originates,' she said, eyes scanning the crowd behind me.
sentences.cn: "那是广播的发源地，"她说，眼睛扫过我身后的人群。

sentences.en: The street felt too quiet.
sentences.cn: 街道感觉太安静了。

sentences.en: In Harbor City, quiet meant someone had already cleared the way — not for us.
sentences.cn: 在港城，安静意味着有人已经清空了那条路——不是为了我们。

barely:1.en: I *barely* made it past the checkpoint before the gate slammed shut behind me. The guard's flashlight swept the alley twice. I pressed flat against the wet wall, breathing through my nose. One second later and I would have been caught in the open, with no cover and no excuse left to give.
barely:1.cnHint: 我____赶在闸门关闭前通过了检查站，差一点就暴露了。
barely:1.hook: The guard stopped walking — and turned back toward my hiding spot.
barely:1.line: 'I *barely* got through — the next gate will be worse.'

sentences.en: I *barely* made it past the checkpoint before the gate slammed shut behind me.
The guard's flashlight swept the alley twice.
sentences.cn: 卫兵的手电筒扫过小巷两次。

sentences.en: I pressed flat against the wet wall, breathing through my nose.
sentences.cn: 我紧贴着湿漉漉的墙，用鼻子呼吸。

sentences.en: One second later and I would have been caught in the open, with no cover and no excuse left to give.
sentences.cn: 晚一秒钟我就会被困在开阔的地方，没有掩护，没有借口可说。

blame:1.en: Grey Crow met me under the broken sign at Fifth and Rail. 'If this goes wrong,' he said, 'the *blame* falls on you alone. I was never here.' He pulled his hood up and stepped back into the shadow. I understood. In Terminal Nine's world, no one shared the weight — only the fall.
blame:1.cnHint: 灰鸦警告我，如果行动失败，所有的____都会落在我一个人身上。
blame:1.hook: His last footstep echoed once, then the alley went completely silent.
blame:1.line: 'The *blame* falls on you alone if this fails tonight.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow met me under the broken sign at Fifth and Rail.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在第五街和铁路交汇处的破损标志下见了我。

sentences.en: 'If this goes wrong,' he said, 'the *blame* falls on you alone.
I was never here.'
sentences.cn: 我从来都没在这里。

sentences.en: He pulled his hood up and stepped back into the shadow.
sentences.cn: 他拉起兜帽，退入了阴影中。

sentences.en: I understood.
sentences.cn: 我明白了。

sentences.en: In Terminal Nine's world, no one shared the weight — only the fall.
sentences.cn: 在九号终端的世界里，没有人共担重量——只有坠落。

chat:1.en: Ali leaned against the railing of the upper walkway, pretending to *chat* with a street vendor below. Her lips barely moved, but I caught every word through the small receiver in my ear. 'Two guards. Roof access. Sixty seconds.' She laughed at something the vendor said. Perfect cover, perfect timing.
chat:1.cnHint: 阿里假装在与摊贩____，实际上是在向我传递关键情报。
chat:1.hook: Then the vendor reached under the counter, and Ali went still.
chat:1.line: 'I'll *chat* with the vendor — you move when I laugh.'

sentences.en: Ali leaned against the railing of the upper walkway, pretending to *chat* with a street vendor below.
Her lips barely moved, but I caught every word through the small receiver in my ear.
sentences.cn: 她嘴唇几乎没有动，但我通过耳朵里的小接收器听到了每一个词。

sentences.en: 'Two guards.
sentences.cn: "两个卫兵。

sentences.en: Roof access.
sentences.cn: 屋顶通道。

sentences.en: Sixty seconds.'
sentences.cn: 六十秒。"

sentences.en: She laughed at something the vendor said.
sentences.cn: 她对小贩说的什么话笑了。

sentences.en: Perfect cover, perfect timing.
sentences.cn: 完美的掩护，完美的时机。

combat:1.en: The street outside Node Bridge was a known zone of *combat* between rival signal gangs. I had to cross it alone, no backup, no cover ID. Ali's voice crackled once in my earpiece: 'Stay on the white line. They respect the white line.' I stepped off the kerb and started walking.
combat:1.cnHint: 节点桥外的街道是信号帮派____的地带，我必须独自穿越。
combat:1.hook: Halfway across, every light on the street went out at once.
combat:1.line: 'This block is a *combat* zone — respect the white line or run.'

sentences.en: The street outside Node Bridge was a known zone of *combat* between rival signal gangs.
I had to cross it alone, no backup, no cover ID.
sentences.cn: 我得独自穿过去，没有后援，没有掩护身份。

sentences.en: Ali's voice crackled once in my earpiece: 'Stay on the white line.
sentences.cn: 阿栗的声音在我耳机里吱地一声："沿着白线走。

sentences.en: They respect the white line.'
sentences.cn: 他们尊重白线。"

sentences.en: I stepped off the kerb and started walking.
sentences.cn: 我踏下路边，开始行走。

danger:1.en: Grey Crow stopped me at the mouth of Canal Street. 'There is *danger* in the next block,' he said, pointing to a faint red smear on the wall — a warning mark used by the old network runners. I had seen the symbol in training but never in the field. My pulse jumped.
danger:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在运河街口拦住我，警告前方有____，并指向墙上的暗号标记。
danger:1.hook: The mark was still wet — whoever left it had not gone far.
danger:1.line: 'There is *danger* past this corner — read the mark on the wall.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow stopped me at the mouth of Canal Street.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在运河街的路口拦住了我。

sentences.en: 'There is *danger* in the next block,' he said, pointing to a faint red smear on the wall — a warning mark used by the old network runners.
I had seen the symbol in training but never in the field.
sentences.cn: 我在训练中见过这个符号，但从没在实地见过。

sentences.en: My pulse jumped.
sentences.cn: 我的心跳加速。

dinner:1.en: The neon sign outside read GOLDEN TIDE, but this was no ordinary restaurant. Grey Crow had arranged a *dinner* for the city's top signal brokers — a cover to pass stolen code under the table. I watched from the rain-soaked alley across the street, counting faces as they arrived.
dinner:1.cnHint: 灰鸦安排了一场秘密____，用来掩护情报交易。
dinner:1.hook: One face in the crowd was never on the guest list.
dinner:1.line: 'This *dinner* is a trap, and every guest is a target.'

sentences.en: The neon sign outside read GOLDEN TIDE, but this was no ordinary restaurant.
sentences.cn: 外面的霓虹招牌写着"金潮"，但这绝不是一家普通餐厅。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had arranged a *dinner* for the city's top signal brokers — a cover to pass stolen code under the table.
I watched from the rain-soaked alley across the street, counting faces as they arrived.
sentences.cn: 我在街对面被雨水浸湿的小巷里观察，数着来访者的脸孔。

embrace:1.en: Zero's broadcast cut through the static like a blade. 'The city will *embrace* the new signal law,' his voice said, cold and smooth, 'or it will go dark.' On the wet pavement below, coded graffiti glowed in the rain — a warning only I could read.
embrace:1.cnHint: 零点在广播中要求市民____新的信号管控法令。
embrace:1.hook: The graffiti spelled out my name.
embrace:1.line: 'They want us to *embrace* silence — I say we refuse.'

sentences.en: Zero's broadcast cut through the static like a blade.
sentences.cn: 零点的广播切破静电，就像一把刀。

sentences.en: 'The city will *embrace* the new signal law,' his voice said, cold and smooth, 'or it will go dark.'
On the wet pavement below, coded graffiti glowed in the rain — a warning only I could read.
sentences.cn: 在下面被雨水打湿的人行道上，编码涂鸦在雨中发着光——只有我能读懂的警告。

explanation:1.en: Ali grabbed my arm at the corner of Ninth and Wire Street. 'They found the broken transmitter,' she said. 'Grey Crow wants an *explanation* before sunrise, or we are both cut off.' The rain hit hard. Every second I stood still was a second I didn't have.
explanation:1.cnHint: 阿栗警告我，灰鸦要求我们在天亮前给出____。
explanation:1.hook: I had no explanation — only a half-formed plan.
explanation:1.line: 'Your *explanation* had better be good — Grey Crow is already angry.'

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my arm at the corner of Ninth and Wire Street.
sentences.cn: 在第九街和电线街的角落，阿栗抓住了我的手臂。

sentences.en: 'They found the broken transmitter,' she said.
sentences.cn: "他们发现了那个坏掉的发射器。"她说。

sentences.en: 'Grey Crow wants an *explanation* before sunrise, or we are both cut off.'
The rain hit hard.
sentences.cn: 雨下得很急。

sentences.en: Every second I stood still was a second I didn't have.
sentences.cn: 我站着不动的每一秒都是我没有的一秒。

intend:1.en: I stood at the edge of the old broadcast tower's shadow, watching the street below fill with Grey Crow's scouts. They did not *intend* to let anyone pass tonight. Every exit was covered. I pressed my back to the cold wall and listened for Ali's signal.
intend:1.cnHint: 灰鸦的手下封锁了街道，显然____不让任何人通过。
intend:1.hook: Then Ali's signal came — one short pulse, then nothing.
intend:1.line: 'I *intend* to hold this street until the job is done.'

sentences.en: I stood at the edge of the old broadcast tower's shadow, watching the street below fill with Grey Crow's scouts.
sentences.cn: 我站在旧广播塔影子的边缘，看着下面的街道被灰鸦的侦察兵填满。

sentences.en: They did not *intend* to let anyone pass tonight.
Every exit was covered.
sentences.cn: 每个出口都被控制住了。

sentences.en: I pressed my back to the cold wall and listened for Ali's signal.
sentences.cn: 我把背靠在冰冷的墙上，等待阿栗的信号。

leadership:1.en: The graffiti on the underpass wall showed a broken crown — a message that the old *leadership* of the signal brokers had fallen. Grey Crow had told me this would happen. I read the coded lines twice and felt the city shift beneath my feet like cracked ground.
leadership:1.cnHint: 地下通道的涂鸦宣告了信号掮客旧有____的终结。
leadership:1.hook: If the crown had fallen, who held the power now?
leadership:1.line: 'The *leadership* is gone — the city belongs to whoever moves first.'

sentences.en: The graffiti on the underpass wall showed a broken crown — a message that the old *leadership* of the signal brokers had fallen.
Grey Crow had told me this would happen.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦告诉过我这会发生。

sentences.en: I read the coded lines twice and felt the city shift beneath my feet like cracked ground.
sentences.cn: 我读了两遍那些编码的线条，感觉城市在我脚下像裂开的地面一样移动。

locate:1.en: Ali had planted a micro-chip on Zero's courier three blocks east. Now I had to *locate* the drop point before the rain washed every trace away. The neon reflections on the street swam and merged. I followed the faint pulse on my wrist scanner, moving fast.
locate:1.cnHint: 我必须在雨水冲刷一切之前____零点的情报交换地点。
locate:1.hook: The pulse stopped — right beneath a sealed manhole.
locate:1.line: 'Can you *locate* the signal, or are we already too late?'

sentences.en: Ali had planted a micro-chip on Zero's courier three blocks east.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在东边三个街区的零点信使身上装了一个微芯片。

sentences.en: Now I had to *locate* the drop point before the rain washed every trace away.
The neon reflections on the street swam and merged.
sentences.cn: 街道上的霓虹反光晃动混合。

sentences.en: I followed the faint pulse on my wrist scanner, moving fast.
sentences.cn: 我跟着手腕扫描仪上的微弱脉冲，快速前进。

original:1.en: Grey Crow handed me a folded sheet under the bridge. 'This is the *original* broadcast key,' he said quietly, 'before Zero rewrote the code.' The paper was thin as a whisper. I understood then — whoever held this held the only proof of what had been stolen.
original:1.cnHint: 灰鸦交给我一份____广播密钥，那是被篡改之前的版本。
original:1.hook: A second set of footsteps echoed behind us on the bridge.
original:1.line: 'Guard the *original* — copies can lie, but this one cannot.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow handed me a folded sheet under the bridge.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在桥下给了我一张折好的纸。

sentences.en: 'This is the *original* broadcast key,' he said quietly, 'before Zero rewrote the code.'
The paper was thin as a whisper.
sentences.cn: 纸薄得像一声耳语。

sentences.en: I understood then — whoever held this held the only proof of what had been stolen.
sentences.cn: 我这才明白——谁拿到这个，谁就拿到了唯一的证据，证明什么被窃取了。

overcome:1.en: The encrypted wall between me and Zero's core signal was steep. Every rookie investigator learned one thing fast: fear was the first lock to pick. I had to *overcome* the static in my own head before I could crack his. I stepped into the open street and began.
overcome:1.cnHint: 我必须先____内心的恐惧，才能破解零点设下的信号壁障。
overcome:1.hook: Zero's voice crackled through my earpiece — 'I see you.'
overcome:1.line: 'You have to *overcome* your fear, or the signal will beat you.'

sentences.en: The encrypted wall between me and Zero's core signal was steep.
sentences.cn: 我和零点核心信号之间的加密墙很陡峭。

sentences.en: Every rookie investigator learned one thing fast: fear was the first lock to pick.
sentences.cn: 每个菜鸟调查员很快就学到一件事：恐惧是第一把要打开的锁。

sentences.en: I had to *overcome* the static in my own head before I could crack his.
I stepped into the open street and began.
sentences.cn: 我踏入开放的街道，开始了。

threaten:1.en: Rain hammered the cracked street outside Sector Nine. Zero stepped from the shadows, his voice flat and cold. 'Walk away,' he said. His eyes did the rest. He did not need a weapon to *threaten* me — his silence alone closed around my throat like wire.
threaten:1.cnHint: 零点在街头用冷酷的眼神____我，让我几乎无法呼吸。
threaten:1.hook: Behind him, three more figures stepped out of the dark.
threaten:1.line: 'I don't need a gun to *threaten* you — just ask the last one who stayed.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the cracked street outside Sector Nine.
sentences.cn: 雨敲打着第九区外裂开的街道。

sentences.en: Zero stepped from the shadows, his voice flat and cold.
sentences.cn: 零点从阴影中走出来，声音平冷刺骨。

sentences.en: 'Walk away,' he said.
sentences.cn: "走开。"他说。

sentences.en: His eyes did the rest.
sentences.cn: 他的眼神做了其他的事。

sentences.en: He did not need a weapon to *threaten* me — his silence alone closed around my throat like wire.

throw:1.en: The alley offered no cover. Zero's crew was thirty seconds behind me. Taking the fire-escape ladder was a long *throw* — the gap between rooftops looked fatal in the rain-blurred neon light. Ali's voice crackled in my earpiece: 'You have one shot. Make it count.'
throw:1.cnHint: 我站在楼顶边缘，这次____充满了危险，成败只在一跃之间。
throw:1.hook: My boots left the ledge before my brain said yes.
throw:1.line: 'A *throw* like that in the rain — only a fool or a ghost survives.'

sentences.en: The alley offered no cover.
sentences.cn: 小巷里没有掩体。

sentences.en: Zero's crew was thirty seconds behind me.
sentences.cn: 零点的人马在我身后三十秒。

sentences.en: Taking the fire-escape ladder was a long *throw* — the gap between rooftops looked fatal in the rain-blurred neon light.
Ali's voice crackled in my earpiece: 'You have one shot.
sentences.cn: 阿栗的声音在我耳机里吱地一声："你只有一次机会。

sentences.en: Make it count.'
sentences.cn: 把握好。"

unlike:1.en: Grey Crow moved through the market crowd without a sound. *Unlike* Zero, who ruled by fear, Grey Crow used trust — a quiet word here, a steady look there. People parted for him the way water parts for stone. I followed, trying to learn that language.
unlike:1.cnHint: 灰鸦与零点____，他靠信任而非恐惧在街头行走。
unlike:1.hook: Then Grey Crow stopped, and every stall owner looked away at once.
unlike:1.line: '*Unlike* you, I never run — running tells them exactly where you are.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow moved through the market crowd without a sound.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦无声地穿过市集的人群。

sentences.en: *Unlike* Zero, who ruled by fear, Grey Crow used trust — a quiet word here, a steady look there.
People parted for him the way water parts for stone.
sentences.cn: 人们为他分开，就像水为石头分开。

sentences.en: I followed, trying to learn that language.
sentences.cn: 我跟在后面，试图学会那种语言。

vast:1.en: From the elevated rail platform I could see all of Harbor City spread below — a *vast* grid of wet light and coded noise stretching to the black sea. Somewhere in that grid Zero was moving. Ali pulled up the signal map. The city felt suddenly, terribly small.
vast:1.cnHint: 站在高台上，我第一次感受到这座城市____的规模，而零点就藏在其中某处。
vast:1.hook: One signal blinked on the map, and it was moving toward us.
vast:1.line: 'A *vast* city hides nothing from someone who knows how to listen.'

sentences.en: From the elevated rail platform I could see all of Harbor City spread below — a *vast* grid of wet light and coded noise stretching to the black sea.
Somewhere in that grid Zero was moving.
sentences.cn: 零点在某处于那片网格中活动。

sentences.en: Ali pulled up the signal map.
sentences.cn: 阿栗调出了信号地图。

sentences.en: The city felt suddenly, terribly small.
sentences.cn: 城市突然间感觉可怕地小了。

absolutely:1.en: Grey Crow handed me a data chip, his face unreadable. 'This path,' he said, 'is *absolutely* the only one left open.' Outside, Zero had sealed the other exits in under ten minutes. I turned the chip over in my fingers. One road. No guarantee it led anywhere safe.
absolutely:1.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我，这条路____是唯一的出路，其他的路都已被封死。
absolutely:1.hook: The chip felt warm — someone had already accessed it once tonight.
absolutely:1.line: 'I am *absolutely* certain — every other door closed the moment you chose a side.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow handed me a data chip, his face unreadable.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦递给我一块数据芯片，脸上没有表情。

sentences.en: 'This path,' he said, 'is *absolutely* the only one left open.'
Outside, Zero had sealed the other exits in under ten minutes.
sentences.cn: 外面，零点在十分钟内封锁了其他出口。

sentences.en: I turned the chip over in my fingers.
sentences.cn: 我在手指间转动着芯片。

sentences.en: One road.
sentences.cn: 一条路。

sentences.en: No guarantee it led anywhere safe.
sentences.cn: 不保证它通往任何安全的地方。

accumulate:1.en: For weeks I had watched Zero *accumulate* control — a café owner silenced, a signal tower rerouted, a block captain replaced. Each step was small. Together they formed a wall. Standing on the wet street corner tonight, I finally saw the shape of it, and it was enormous.
accumulate:1.cnHint: 数周以来，零点一点点____着他的控制力，直到今晚我才看清全貌。
accumulate:1.hook: And at the centre of that wall was a door only I could open.
accumulate:1.line: 'You *accumulate* power quietly, and by the time anyone notices, it is already too late.'

sentences.en: For weeks I had watched Zero *accumulate* control — a café owner silenced, a signal tower rerouted, a block captain replaced.
Each step was small.
sentences.cn: 每一步都很小。

sentences.en: Together they formed a wall.
sentences.cn: 合起来就构成了一堵墙。

sentences.en: Standing on the wet street corner tonight, I finally saw the shape of it, and it was enormous.
sentences.cn: 今晚站在湿漉漉的街角，我终于看到了它的轮廓，它是巨大的。

breakfast:1.en: Ali and I sat on the kerb outside a shuttered noodle stall, passing one warm carton between us. It was nearly dawn — too late for sleep, too early for plans. 'We *breakfast* like champions,' Ali said softly, and for one thin moment the city felt almost ordinary.
breakfast:1.cnHint: 黎明前，我和阿栗在街边____，这短暂的平静让城市暂时失去了它的锋芒。
breakfast:1.hook: Then my scanner buzzed — Zero's signal was two blocks and closing.
breakfast:1.line: 'We *breakfast* fast and we move — this street will not stay quiet for long.'

sentences.en: Ali and I sat on the kerb outside a shuttered noodle stall, passing one warm carton between us.
sentences.cn: 阿栗和我坐在一家关闭的面馆外的路边石上，共享一个温热的餐盒。

sentences.en: It was nearly dawn — too late for sleep, too early for plans.
sentences.cn: 快天亮了——太晚了睡不了，太早了还没法计划。

sentences.en: 'We *breakfast* like champions,' Ali said softly, and for one thin moment the city felt almost ordinary.

capacity:1.en: The old broadcast tower had a *capacity* of ten thousand encoded signals at once, Grey Crow said. Zero wanted it for one reason: flood every channel, drown every voice but his. I stared up at the rusted frame rising into the low clouds. We had maybe four minutes to stop him.
capacity:1.cnHint: 这座旧广播塔的____足以让零点掌控全城所有频道，我们必须赶到。
capacity:1.hook: A light blinked at the top of the tower — someone was already up there.
capacity:1.line: 'Its *capacity* is greater than any weapon in this city — whoever holds it, wins.'

sentences.en: The old broadcast tower had a *capacity* of ten thousand encoded signals at once, Grey Crow said.
Zero wanted it for one reason: flood every channel, drown every voice but his.
sentences.cn: 零点想要它只有一个理由：淹没每一个频道，压制除他之外的每一个声音。

sentences.en: I stared up at the rusted frame rising into the low clouds.
sentences.cn: 我抬头凝视着那锈迹斑斑的框架升入低垂的云层。

sentences.en: We had maybe four minutes to stop him.
sentences.cn: 我们大概只有四分钟来阻止他。

partly:1.en: Rain hammered the old market street. The signal map on my visor showed the source of the illegal broadcast was *partly* hidden behind a wall of static — someone had jammed the eastern grid on purpose. Ali crouched beside a broken stall, fingers flying across her decoder. 'Half a picture,' she muttered. 'But half is enough.'
partly:1.cnHint: 非法广播的信号来源被____遮蔽，调查员和阿里在市场街试图锁定位置。
partly:1.hook: Then the static shifted — and a face looked back at us.
partly:1.line: Ali: 'The signal is *partly* blocked, but I can still trace it.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the old market street.
sentences.cn: 雨猛烈地敲打着老市集街道。

sentences.en: The signal map on my visor showed the source of the illegal broadcast was *partly* hidden behind a wall of static — someone had jammed the eastern grid on purpose.
Ali crouched beside a broken stall, fingers flying across her decoder.
sentences.cn: 阿栗蹲在一个破碎的摊位旁，手指在解码器上飞快地敲击。

sentences.en: 'Half a picture,' she muttered.
sentences.cn: "只有半张图，"她低声说。

sentences.en: 'But half is enough.'
sentences.cn: "但半张就够了。"

practical:1.en: Grey Crow met me at the corner of Dock Lane, rain pooling in the cracks at our feet. He unfolded a thin metal card and pressed it into my hand. 'Forget the fancy tech,' he said. 'This is *practical*.' It was a skeleton key, hand-cut, older than the city itself. Simple. Dangerous.
practical:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在码头巷给了调查员一件____的工具，暗示行动不能依赖高科技。
practical:1.hook: A patrol drone swept overhead — and Grey Crow was already gone.
practical:1.line: Grey Crow: 'In this city, *practical* beats perfect every time.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow met me at the corner of Dock Lane, rain pooling in the cracks at our feet.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在码头巷角与我相遇，雨水在我们脚下的裂缝中积聚。

sentences.en: He unfolded a thin metal card and pressed it into my hand.
sentences.cn: 他展开一张薄薄的金属卡片，把它按进我的手里。

sentences.en: 'Forget the fancy tech,' he said.
sentences.cn: "忘掉那些花哨的技术，"他说。

sentences.en: 'This is *practical*.'
It was a skeleton key, hand-cut, older than the city itself.
sentences.cn: 那是一把骨钥匙，手工切割，比这座城市还老。

sentences.en: Simple.
sentences.cn: 简单。

sentences.en: Dangerous.
sentences.cn: 危险。

profit:1.en: The black-market data broker called himself a businessman. He stood under a flickering sign on Vein Street, calm as stone. 'Every word you hack, every code you crack — someone takes a *profit*,' he said. I looked at the children running errands for him and felt something cold settle in my chest.
profit:1.cnHint: 在夜市街头，一个数据掮客向调查员解释他的非法买卖如何____，令人心寒。
profit:1.hook: Zero stepped out of the shadows behind the broker and smiled.
profit:1.line: Broker: 'There is always *profit* in other people's secrets.'

sentences.en: The black-market data broker called himself a businessman.
sentences.cn: 那个黑市数据经纪人自称生意人。

sentences.en: He stood under a flickering sign on Vein Street, calm as stone.
sentences.cn: 他站在静脉街一个闪烁的招牌下，平静得像石头一样。

sentences.en: 'Every word you hack, every code you crack — someone takes a *profit*,' he said.
I looked at the children running errands for him and felt something cold settle in my chest.
sentences.cn: 我看着为他跑腿的孩子们，感觉胸口有什么冷的东西沉了下去。

promise:1.en: Ali grabbed my sleeve before I crossed the bridge checkpoint. The wind off the harbor smelled like rust and rain. 'Make me a *promise*,' she said, eyes hard and steady. 'If this goes wrong, you pull back. No heroics.' I nodded. She held my gaze one second longer, then let go.
promise:1.cnHint: 在桥头检查站前，阿里要求调查员做出一个____，语气严肃而坚定。
promise:1.hook: The checkpoint light turned red before I could reach the other side.
promise:1.line: Ali: 'I need your *promise* — walk away if the signal drops.'

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my sleeve before I crossed the bridge checkpoint.
sentences.cn: 在我过桥哨卡前，阿栗抓住了我的袖子。

sentences.en: The wind off the harbor smelled like rust and rain.
sentences.cn: 港口吹来的风闻起来像铁锈和雨水。

sentences.en: 'Make me a *promise*,' she said, eyes hard and steady.
'If this goes wrong, you pull back.
sentences.cn: "如果出了问题，你就退回来。

sentences.en: No heroics.'
sentences.cn: 别搞英雄主义。"

sentences.en: I nodded.
sentences.cn: 我点了点头。

sentences.en: She held my gaze one second longer, then let go.
sentences.cn: 她多看了我一秒钟，然后松开了手。

rarely:1.en: Grey Crow *rarely* came to the surface streets anymore; the sky-cameras had his outline on file. So when I spotted his grey coat under the flyover on Steel Road, I knew the situation was serious. He said nothing at first, just pointed at a chalk mark on the pillar — a warning sign I had never seen before.
rarely:1.cnHint: 灰鸦____出现在地面街道，这一次他在高架桥下现身，令调查员感到事态严重。
rarely:1.hook: The chalk mark was still wet — drawn less than ten minutes ago.
rarely:1.line: Grey Crow: 'I *rarely* surface, so listen carefully.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow *rarely* came to the surface streets anymore; the sky-cameras had his outline on file.
So when I spotted his grey coat under the flyover on Steel Road, I knew the situation was serious.
sentences.cn: 所以当我在钢铁路的高架桥下看到他那件灰色外套时，我知道情况很严肃。

sentences.en: He said nothing at first, just pointed at a chalk mark on the pillar — a warning sign I had never seen before.
sentences.cn: 他一开始什么都没说，只是指了指柱子上的粉笔记号——一个我从未见过的警告标记。

severe:1.en: The notice was pasted on every wall along Harbor Front Road, black text on white paper. 'Unauthorized signal transmission: *severe* penalty.' Zero had put them up — I recognized the clean, mocking font he always used. He wanted us to see them. He wanted us to be afraid. I took a photo and kept walking.
severe:1.cnHint: 调查员在海港路看到零张贴的警示告示，威胁对非法信号传输施以____的惩罚。
severe:1.hook: At the last post, someone had scrawled three words: 'Too late, investigator.'
severe:1.line: Zero: 'The punishment will be *severe*, and I will enjoy watching.'

sentences.en: The notice was pasted on every wall along Harbor Front Road, black text on white paper.
sentences.cn: 那张告示贴在港湾前路的每一面墙上，黑色文字白纸。

sentences.en: 'Unauthorized signal transmission: *severe* penalty.'
Zero had put them up — I recognized the clean, mocking font he always used.
sentences.cn: 零点贴上去的——我认出了他总是用的那种干净、嘲讽的字体。

sentences.en: He wanted us to see them.
sentences.cn: 他想让我们看到它们。

sentences.en: He wanted us to be afraid.
sentences.cn: 他想让我们害怕。

sentences.en: I took a photo and kept walking.
sentences.cn: 我拍了张照片，继续往前走。

smell:1.en: I noticed the *smell* before I saw anything — burnt copper and something chemical, drifting down Lantern Alley from a vent in the wall. Ali pressed close behind me. 'Processing unit,' she whispered. 'Someone is running a live decode right here, right now.' We were standing on top of their operation and they did not know it yet.
smell:1.cnHint: 调查员在灯笼巷闻到一股____，阿里判断附近有人正在实时破解数据。
smell:1.hook: A door at the alley's end clicked open from the inside.
smell:1.line: Ali: 'That *smell* — they are burning code chips to hide the trace.'

sentences.en: I noticed the *smell* before I saw anything — burnt copper and something chemical, drifting down Lantern Alley from a vent in the wall.
Ali pressed close behind me.
sentences.cn: 阿栗紧紧贴在我身后。

sentences.en: 'Processing unit,' she whispered.
sentences.cn: "处理单元，"她低声说。

sentences.en: 'Someone is running a live decode right here, right now.'
sentences.cn: "有人正在这儿现场进行实时解码。"

sentences.en: We were standing on top of their operation and they did not know it yet.
sentences.cn: 我们就站在他们的行动正上方，而他们还不知道。

socialize:1.en: The night market on Copper Street existed so that people could *socialize* without cameras recording every word — or so they believed. I moved through the stalls, listening. Grey Crow had told me the contact would be carrying a red data chip. Around me, voices mixed with music and steam. Then I heard my own name in the crowd.
socialize:1.cnHint: 调查员在铜街夜市人群中____，寻找一名携带红色数据芯片的线人，却突然听到了自己的名字。
socialize:1.hook: Someone here already knew exactly who I was.
socialize:1.line: Grey Crow: 'Go *socialize* — your contact is somewhere in that crowd.'

sentences.en: The night market on Copper Street existed so that people could *socialize* without cameras recording every word — or so they believed.
I moved through the stalls, listening.
sentences.cn: 我在摊位间穿行，竖起耳朵。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told me the contact would be carrying a red data chip.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦告诉我接头人会拿着一块红色数据芯片。

sentences.en: Around me, voices mixed with music and steam.
sentences.cn: 四周是声音、音乐和蒸汽混在一起。

sentences.en: Then I heard my own name in the crowd.
sentences.cn: 然后我在人群里听到了自己的名字。

consideration:1.en: The rain hammered the cracked street outside Gate Seven. Grey Crow spread a folded map across a trash bin and pointed at three circled zones. 'Every *consideration* points here,' he said, tapping the port district. I studied the marks. Zero had been moving in patterns, and the patterns all converged on one block.
consideration:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在街头分析地图，将所有____指向港口区的同一地点。
consideration:1.hook: The block was already dark — every light cut at once.
consideration:1.line: 'Every *consideration* points to the port, so that is where we go.'

sentences.en: The rain hammered the cracked street outside Gate Seven.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在七号门外那条破碎的街道上。

sentences.en: Grey Crow spread a folded map across a trash bin and pointed at three circled zones.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把一张折叠的地图铺在垃圾桶上，指了指三个圈出来的区域。

sentences.en: 'Every *consideration* points here,' he said, tapping the port district.
I studied the marks.
sentences.cn: 我研究着这些标记。

sentences.en: Zero had been moving in patterns, and the patterns all converged on one block.
sentences.cn: 零点一直在按照一定的轨迹行动，所有轨迹都汇聚在同一个街区。

disaster:1.en: Ali grabbed my arm on the overpass, rain sheeting down around us. Below, a chemical tanker had jackknifed across the highway, spilling pale smoke into the neon glow. 'That was no accident,' she said. The *disaster* had blocked every route south — exactly the routes we needed. Zero had planned this.
disaster:1.cnHint: 高架桥上，一场突如其来的____封堵了我们南下的所有路线。
disaster:1.hook: Through the smoke, a single black van rolled north — toward us.
disaster:1.line: 'This *disaster* did not happen by chance — someone planned it tonight.'

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my arm on the overpass, rain sheeting down around us.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在高架桥上抓住了我的手臂，雨像瀑布一样倾泻下来。

sentences.en: Below, a chemical tanker had jackknifed across the highway, spilling pale smoke into the neon glow.
sentences.cn: 下面，一辆化学槽车横翻在高速公路上，淡色的烟雾向霓虹灯的光芒中升起。

sentences.en: 'That was no accident,' she said.
sentences.cn: "这不是意外，"她说。

sentences.en: The *disaster* had blocked every route south — exactly the routes we needed.
Zero had planned this.
sentences.cn: 零点精心计划了这一切。

emergency:1.en: A siren split the wet air above Dock Street. Red lights strobed across the walls as a city broadcast crackled: '*emergency* in grid nine, all units respond.' Grey Crow pulled me into a doorway. 'False call,' he whispered. 'Zero is clearing the street.' The officers turned and ran the other way, leaving us alone.
emergency:1.cnHint: 零点伪造____广播，将警察引开，让街道陷入空旷。
emergency:1.hook: An empty street in Harbor City is never truly empty.
emergency:1.line: 'That *emergency* broadcast is fake — Zero is emptying the street for a reason.'

sentences.en: A siren split the wet air above Dock Street.
sentences.cn: 码头街上空响起了刺耳的警报声。

sentences.en: Red lights strobed across the walls as a city broadcast crackled: '*emergency* in grid nine, all units respond.'
Grey Crow pulled me into a doorway.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把我拉进一个门廊里。

sentences.en: 'False call,' he whispered.
sentences.cn: "假警报，"他低声说。

sentences.en: 'Zero is clearing the street.'
sentences.cn: "零点在清空街道。"

sentences.en: The officers turned and ran the other way, leaving us alone.
sentences.cn: 警察掉头跑向另一个方向，只留下我们两个。

familiar:1.en: I had walked Anchor Lane a hundred times, but tonight every shadow felt wrong. The smell of salt and old wire was *familiar*, yet something beneath it was new — a sharp chemical note I could not place. Ali sniffed the air beside me and went still. She smelled it too. We both looked up at the same moment.
familiar:1.cnHint: 调查员在____的街道上嗅到一种陌生气味，两人同时抬头。
familiar:1.hook: On the roof above, a figure crouched and held something small and bright.
familiar:1.line: 'This lane is *familiar* to me, but that smell up there is not.'

sentences.en: I had walked Anchor Lane a hundred times, but tonight every shadow felt wrong.
sentences.cn: 我已经走过锚点街一百次了，但今晚每一道影子都感觉不对劲。

sentences.en: The smell of salt and old wire was *familiar*, yet something beneath it was new — a sharp chemical note I could not place.
Ali sniffed the air beside me and went still.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在我身边嗅了嗅空气，身体僵住了。

sentences.en: She smelled it too.
sentences.cn: 她也闻到了。

sentences.en: We both looked up at the same moment.
sentences.cn: 同一时刻，我们都抬起了头。

furthermore:1.en: Grey Crow blocked the alley exit with one outstretched arm. 'Going straight gets us caught,' he said. 'The cameras cover the main road, and *furthermore*, Zero has a spotter on the corner of Fifth.' I checked my earpiece. He was right on both counts. We needed a third path — one that did not exist on any map.
furthermore:1.cnHint: 灰鸦指出正面行进的两重危险，____还有线人在拐角守候。
furthermore:1.hook: Ali's voice came through static: 'There is a third path — under the street.'
furthermore:1.line: 'The cameras watch the road, and *furthermore*, Zero has eyes on Fifth Corner.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow blocked the alley exit with one outstretched arm.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦伸出一只手臂挡住了小巷出口。

sentences.en: 'Going straight gets us caught,' he said.
sentences.cn: "直走会被抓住，"他说。

sentences.en: 'The cameras cover the main road, and *furthermore*, Zero has a spotter on the corner of Fifth.'
I checked my earpiece.
sentences.cn: 我检查了耳机。

sentences.en: He was right on both counts.
sentences.cn: 他两个判断都对。

sentences.en: We needed a third path — one that did not exist on any map.
sentences.cn: 我们需要第三条路——一条不在任何地图上的路。

hardly:1.en: I reached the signal tower at the edge of the market, but I could *hardly* breathe. The air tasted of ozone and hot metal — someone had fired a pulse device nearby. My hands shook as I climbed the first rung. Three floors up, the encrypted transmitter was still blinking. It had not been destroyed yet. There was still time.
hardly:1.cnHint: 调查员赶到信号塔，因附近脉冲装置爆发而____能喘气，但发射器仍在闪烁。
hardly:1.hook: Then the blinking stopped — and a new light, red and steady, took its place.
hardly:1.line: 'I can *hardly* stand, but that transmitter is still live — I have to climb.'

sentences.en: I reached the signal tower at the edge of the market, but I could *hardly* breathe.
The air tasted of ozone and hot metal — someone had fired a pulse device nearby.
sentences.cn: 空气闻起来像臭氧和炽热的金属——有人刚在附近引爆过脉冲装置。

sentences.en: My hands shook as I climbed the first rung.
sentences.cn: 我的手在我爬第一个横档时开始发抖。

sentences.en: Three floors up, the encrypted transmitter was still blinking.
sentences.cn: 三层楼高的地方，加密信号发射器还在闪烁。

sentences.en: It had not been destroyed yet.
sentences.cn: 它还没有被摧毁。

sentences.en: There was still time.
sentences.cn: 还有时间。

hinder:1.en: Zero had scattered broken glass and looped wire across the loading yard, a crude trap meant to slow us down. 'Designed to *hinder*, not to hurt,' Grey Crow said, reading the pattern with calm eyes. He traced a narrow path through the debris with his flashlight beam. We moved single file, fast and silent, and cleared the yard in under a minute.
hinder:1.cnHint: 零点在货场布置障碍物，意图____我们前进，但灰鸦迅速找到了通道。
hinder:1.hook: Past the yard, a door stood open that should have been welded shut.
hinder:1.line: 'These traps are set to *hinder* us — someone wants us slow, not stopped.'

sentences.en: Zero had scattered broken glass and looped wire across the loading yard, a crude trap meant to slow us down.
sentences.cn: 零点在装卸场散落了碎玻璃和绕成圈的电线，一个粗糙的陷阱，目的是拖延我们。

sentences.en: 'Designed to *hinder*, not to hurt,' Grey Crow said, reading the pattern with calm eyes.
He traced a narrow path through the debris with his flashlight beam.
sentences.cn: 他用手电筒的光束描绘出了一条穿过碎片的狭窄通道。

sentences.en: We moved single file, fast and silent, and cleared the yard in under a minute.
sentences.cn: 我们排成一列纵队，快速无声地移动，不到一分钟就清空了整个院子。

injury:1.en: Ali limped out of the side street, one hand pressed against her knee. 'Small *injury*,' she said before I could ask, waving off my help. 'Wire trap on the steps.' She pulled out a cable cutter and held it up. 'But I got what we came for.' In her other hand was a data chip, still warm, still live.
injury:1.cnHint: 阿栗带着腿部____从小巷走出，却已拿到了我们需要的数据芯片。
injury:1.hook: The chip's surface showed a single word burned into it: 'ENDGAME.'
injury:1.line: 'It is only a small *injury* — look at what I pulled from that trap.'

sentences.en: Ali limped out of the side street, one hand pressed against her knee.
sentences.cn: 阿栗从侧街一瘸一拐地走出来，一只手压在膝盖上。

sentences.en: 'Small *injury*,' she said before I could ask, waving off my help.
'Wire trap on the steps.'
sentences.cn: "楼梯上的电线陷阱。"

sentences.en: She pulled out a cable cutter and held it up.
sentences.cn: 她拿出一把电缆剪，举了起来。

sentences.en: 'But I got what we came for.'
sentences.cn: "但我拿到了我们需要的东西。"

sentences.en: In her other hand was a data chip, still warm, still live.
sentences.cn: 她另一只手里拿着一块数据芯片，还是热的，还在工作。

register:1.en: Rain hammered the street outside the signal tower. I pressed my ear to the wet wall and let the hidden broadcast *register* in my mind — a string of numbers disguised as static. Ali grabbed my arm. 'Got it?' I nodded. Somewhere above us, Zero was already moving.
register:1.cnHint: 我让隐藏的广播信号在脑中____，破译出一串伪装成杂音的数字。
register:1.hook: The numbers spelled a name — and the name was mine.
register:1.line: 'Let the signal *register* before you move, or you will miss it.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the street outside the signal tower.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在信号塔外的街道上。

sentences.en: I pressed my ear to the wet wall and let the hidden broadcast *register* in my mind — a string of numbers disguised as static.
Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了我的手臂。

sentences.en: 'Got it?'
sentences.cn: "拿到了吗？"

sentences.en: I nodded.
sentences.cn: 我点了点头。

sentences.en: Somewhere above us, Zero was already moving.
sentences.cn: 在我们上方某处，零点已经在行动了。

skin:1.en: Coded graffiti covered every wall on Neon Lane. I ran my fingers across the painted letters, and the cold *skin* of the concrete seemed to pulse under my touch — a hidden message rising to the surface. Ali kept watch. Grey Crow had promised the answer was here, written in plain sight.
skin:1.cnHint: 我用手触摸墙上涂鸦，冰冷的混凝土____下似乎藏着一条浮现的密信。
skin:1.hook: Then the letters began to change, rearranging themselves in the dark.
skin:1.line: 'The *skin* of the wall hides the real message — read it, not the paint.'

sentences.en: Coded graffiti covered every wall on Neon Lane.
sentences.cn: 霓虹街上的每面墙都被涂满了密码标记。

sentences.en: I ran my fingers across the painted letters, and the cold *skin* of the concrete seemed to pulse under my touch — a hidden message rising to the surface.
Ali kept watch.
sentences.cn: 阿栗守着风。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had promised the answer was here, written in plain sight.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦承诺答案就在这儿，用白纸黑字写在了众目睽睽之下。

spirit:1.en: The old signal post at the edge of Market Street stood dark and silent. Grey Crow had said the city's *spirit* lived in its forbidden broadcasts — the ones the authorities could never fully kill. I tuned my hearing and caught a faint hum. Ali squeezed my shoulder. It was still alive.
spirit:1.cnHint: 老信号柱沉默伫立，灰鸦说城市的____藏于那些当局无法彻底抹杀的禁播之中。
spirit:1.hook: But the hum carried a warning we had not heard before.
spirit:1.line: 'The *spirit* of this city speaks through its hidden signals — listen.'

sentences.en: The old signal post at the edge of Market Street stood dark and silent.
sentences.cn: 市场街边缘那座老信号塔黑漆漆地矗立着，一片死寂。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had said the city's *spirit* lived in its forbidden broadcasts — the ones the authorities could never fully kill.
I tuned my hearing and caught a faint hum.
sentences.cn: 我竖起耳朵，捕捉到了一阵微弱的嗡鸣。

sentences.en: Ali squeezed my shoulder.
sentences.cn: 阿栗挤了挤我的肩膀。

sentences.en: It was still alive.
sentences.cn: 它还活着。

spread:1.en: Zero's encrypted message had *spread* across every public screen on the boulevard in under a minute. Coded words rolled from corner to corner like a slow flood. Ali pulled me behind a broken lamp post. The crowd stopped and stared, not understanding — but I understood every word.
spread:1.cnHint: 零点的加密信息在大街上迅速____，我躲在路灯柱后，是唯一看懂每个字的人。
spread:1.hook: The last word on the final screen was a direct challenge to me.
spread:1.line: 'Once a signal *spreads* that fast, you cannot take it back — ever.'

sentences.en: Zero's encrypted message had *spread* across every public screen on the boulevard in under a minute.
Coded words rolled from corner to corner like a slow flood.
sentences.cn: 密码字从一个街角滚向另一个街角，像一股缓缓而来的洪流。

sentences.en: Ali pulled me behind a broken lamp post.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把我拉到一盏破碎的路灯后面。

sentences.en: The crowd stopped and stared, not understanding — but I understood every word.
sentences.cn: 人群停了下来，盯着看，什么都不懂——但我每个词都听得清清楚楚。

totally:1.en: The alley behind the data market was *totally* dark — no neon, no screens, nothing. I switched to sound, letting the hidden frequencies guide me forward. A shape moved at the far end. Ali had gone left, I had gone right. We were alone out here, and Zero knew this street better than either of us.
totally:1.cnHint: 数据市场后的小巷____漆黑一片，我只能靠隐匿频率引路，而零点对这条街了如指掌。
totally:1.hook: A soft footstep behind me said I had already made a mistake.
totally:1.line: 'The signal is *totally* clean — no trace, no echo, no way to follow.'

sentences.en: The alley behind the data market was *totally* dark — no neon, no screens, nothing.
I switched to sound, letting the hidden frequencies guide me forward.
sentences.cn: 我切换到声音频道，让隐藏的电波为我指引方向。

sentences.en: A shape moved at the far end.
sentences.cn: 远端有个影子动了一下。

sentences.en: Ali had gone left, I had gone right.
sentences.cn: 阿栗往左走了，我往右走了。

sentences.en: We were alone out here, and Zero knew this street better than either of us.
sentences.cn: 我们在这儿孤立无援，而零点对这条街的了解比我们俩都深。

tree:1.en: The single dead *tree* at the center of Signal Square had been used as a message board for years — a trunk carved with coded marks that investigators like me were trained to read. I found tonight's mark low on the bark: three cuts, a circle. Grey Crow's sign. He had been here already.
tree:1.cnHint: 信号广场中央那棵枯____被当作留言板多年，我在树皮上发现了灰鸦留下的暗号。
tree:1.hook: Below Grey Crow's mark was a second sign — Zero's answer.
tree:1.line: 'Check the *tree* first — Grey Crow always leaves the real clue there.'

sentences.en: The single dead *tree* at the center of Signal Square had been used as a message board for years — a trunk carved with coded marks that investigators like me were trained to read.
I found tonight's mark low on the bark: three cuts, a circle.
sentences.cn: 我在树皮下方找到了今晚的记号：三道刻痕，一个圆圈。

sentences.en: Grey Crow's sign.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦的标记。

sentences.en: He had been here already.
sentences.cn: 他已经来过这儿了。

weigh:1.en: Two routes out of the broadcast district: the open road or the underground pipe tunnels. I had seconds to *weigh* the risk of each. Zero would expect the road. Grey Crow would take the tunnels. I was neither of them yet. Ali looked at me, waiting. The neon rain made every shadow move.
weigh:1.cnHint: 两条逃离路线，我只有几秒时间____两种风险，而阿栗正等着我的决定。
weigh:1.hook: Before I could choose, the open road behind us lit up bright red.
weigh:1.line: 'You must *weigh* every exit before you commit — one wrong step ends it.'

sentences.en: Two routes out of the broadcast district: the open road or the underground pipe tunnels.
sentences.cn: 从广播区逃出来有两条路：宽敞的大道或地下的管道隧道。

sentences.en: I had seconds to *weigh* the risk of each.
Zero would expect the road.
sentences.cn: 零点会守在大道上。

sentences.en: Grey Crow would take the tunnels.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦会走隧道。

sentences.en: I was neither of them yet.
sentences.cn: 我还不是他们中的任何一个。

sentences.en: Ali looked at me, waiting.
sentences.cn: 阿栗看着我，在等。

sentences.en: The neon rain made every shadow move.
sentences.cn: 霓虹雨让每一道影子都在晃动。

alive:1.en: At the end of Copper Bridge, a single low-frequency signal pulsed under the traffic noise. It was faint but steady — it was *alive*. Grey Crow had told me that dead signals never pulse like that. Ali crouched beside me, eyes wide. Somewhere in that pulse was the location of Zero's final broadcast tower.
alive:1.cnHint: 铜桥尽头有一道低频信号在脉动，灰鸦说过，____的信号才会这样跳——它指向零点最后的发射塔。
alive:1.hook: Then the pulse skipped a beat — as if it had noticed us listening.
alive:1.line: 'As long as that signal stays *alive*, we still have a chance to find him.'

sentences.en: At the end of Copper Bridge, a single low-frequency signal pulsed under the traffic noise.
sentences.cn: 铜桥尽头，一个低频信号在车流声下面脉冲式地跳动。

sentences.en: It was faint but steady — it was *alive*.
Grey Crow had told me that dead signals never pulse like that.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦跟我说过，死信号永远不会这样跳动。

sentences.en: Ali crouched beside me, eyes wide.
sentences.cn: 阿栗蹲在我身边，眼睛睁得很大。

sentences.en: Somewhere in that pulse was the location of Zero's final broadcast tower.
sentences.cn: 那个脉冲里藏着零点最后一座广播塔的位置。

lift:1.en: Rain hammered the street outside Central Tower. The *lift* doors opened on the ground floor, and a coded signal hit me like a fist — seven short pulses, the old investigator pattern. Ali grabbed my arm. 'Someone called us here on purpose,' she said. The number panel was dark. Every button had been removed.
lift:1.cnHint: 调查员在大楼电梯里感应到一段神秘____信号，阿栗意识到这是一个陷阱。
lift:1.hook: The doors slid shut, and the lift began to rise on its own.
lift:1.line: 'The *lift* is moving — and nobody pressed a button.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the street outside Central Tower.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在中央塔外的街道上。

sentences.en: The *lift* doors opened on the ground floor, and a coded signal hit me like a fist — seven short pulses, the old investigator pattern.
Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了我的手臂。

sentences.en: 'Someone called us here on purpose,' she said.
sentences.cn: "有人故意把我们叫来这儿,"她说。

sentences.en: The number panel was dark.
sentences.cn: 数字面板是黑的。

sentences.en: Every button had been removed.
sentences.cn: 所有的按钮都被拆掉了。

mainly:1.en: The neon signs of Harbor City were *mainly* used for ads, but I could read the second layer — hidden pulses coded into the flicker. Tonight every sign on Dock Street flashed the same broken pattern. Ali stood beside me, breath clouding in the cold air. 'Zero rewrote them all,' she said quietly.
mainly:1.cnHint: 调查员发现港口街的霓虹灯____被用来传递零点的隐藏信息。
mainly:1.hook: Then one sign went dark, and a figure stepped out of the shadow beneath it.
mainly:1.line: 'These signs are *mainly* ads — but look at the flicker underneath.'

sentences.en: The neon signs of Harbor City were *mainly* used for ads, but I could read the second layer — hidden pulses coded into the flicker.
Tonight every sign on Dock Street flashed the same broken pattern.
sentences.cn: 今晚码头街上的每个标志都闪着同样的破损图案。

sentences.en: Ali stood beside me, breath clouding in the cold air.
sentences.cn: 阿栗站在我身边，冷空气中呼出的气息在打转。

sentences.en: 'Zero rewrote them all,' she said quietly.
sentences.cn: "零点改写了所有的标志,"她轻声说。

moral:1.en: Grey Crow had left a message scratched into the wet concrete: a short coded line and, below it, one plain word — 'choose'. I stood in the drizzle reading it twice. The *moral* was clear: every path I picked tonight would cost someone something. Ali read it over my shoulder and said nothing.
moral:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在街道上留下一条刻字，其____令调查员陷入两难抉择。
moral:1.hook: A second message was carved on the other side — in Zero's handwriting.
moral:1.line: 'The *moral* is simple: every choice here has a price.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow had left a message scratched into the wet concrete: a short coded line and, below it, one plain word — 'choose'.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在湿漉漉的水泥地上刻了一条信息：一行密码，下面是一个纯文字——"选择"。

sentences.en: I stood in the drizzle reading it twice.
sentences.cn: 我站在细雨中读了两遍。

sentences.en: The *moral* was clear: every path I picked tonight would cost someone something.
Ali read it over my shoulder and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 阿栗从我肩膀后面读了一遍，什么都没说。
