nor:1.en: The street was empty. Neither the patrol drones *nor* the night vendors were anywhere in sight — and in Harbor City, that silence meant only one thing. Ali checked her signal device: nothing. I checked mine: nothing. Grey Crow had warned us about dead zones. We were standing in the middle of one.
nor:1.cnHint: 调查员发现街上无人也无信号，意识到自己身处灰鸦警告过的____盲区。
nor:1.hook: Then a single footstep echoed from the alley directly ahead.
nor:1.line: 'Neither the drones *nor* the vendors are here — we have been set up.'

sentences.en: The street was empty.
sentences.cn: 街道空无一人。

sentences.en: Neither the patrol drones *nor* the night vendors were anywhere in sight — and in Harbor City, that silence meant only one thing.
Ali checked her signal device: nothing.
sentences.cn: 阿栗查了查她的信号设备：没有。

sentences.en: I checked mine: nothing.
sentences.cn: 我查了查我的：没有。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned us about dead zones.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦早就警告过我们死区的事儿。

sentences.en: We were standing in the middle of one.
sentences.cn: 我们正站在一个死区的中间。

pick:1.en: Zero had scattered twelve coded chips across the wet pavement, each carrying a fragment of a stolen signal. I had time for only one. Grey Crow's voice crackled faintly in my ear: '*Pick* the one with a red edge — the others are decoys.' My hand hovered. Rain blurred the colours fast.
pick:1.cnHint: 调查员必须在零散的信号芯片中____出唯一真实的那一枚，时间紧迫。
pick:1.hook: The red edge I reached for crumbled to dust the moment I touched it.
pick:1.line: '*Pick* carefully — Zero made eleven of these to fool you.'

sentences.en: Zero had scattered twelve coded chips across the wet pavement, each carrying a fragment of a stolen signal.
sentences.cn: 零点在湿漉漉的人行道上散布了十二片密码芯片，每一片都携带着一段被盗信号的片段。

sentences.en: I had time for only one.
sentences.cn: 我只有时间拿一片。

sentences.en: Grey Crow's voice crackled faintly in my ear: '*Pick* the one with a red edge — the others are decoys.'
My hand hovered.
sentences.cn: 我的手悬在半空中。

sentences.en: Rain blurred the colours fast.
sentences.cn: 雨很快就把颜色模糊了。

pollution:1.en: The air filters on Dock Street had failed a week ago, and the *pollution* carried a second danger in 2099 — Zero had learned to encode signals in the chemical particles, invisible to city scanners. I breathed in and heard a burst of data: coordinates, a countdown, a name. My name.
pollution:1.cnHint: 调查员发现零点将隐藏信息编码在街头____颗粒中，并截获了一段涉及自己的倒计时信号。
pollution:1.hook: The countdown reached ten, and the street lights cut out all at once.
pollution:1.line: 'The *pollution* here carries Zero's signals — don't breathe too deep.'

sentences.en: The air filters on Dock Street had failed a week ago, and the *pollution* carried a second danger in 2099 — Zero had learned to encode signals in the chemical particles, invisible to city scanners.
I breathed in and heard a burst of data: coordinates, a countdown, a name.
sentences.cn: 我吸了一口气，数据爆发般地涌入：坐标、倒计时、一个名字。

sentences.en: My name.
sentences.cn: 我的名字。

quit:1.en: Grey Crow found me at the corner of Fifth and Neon, leaning against a cold wall. 'You look done,' he said. I told him I was thinking about it — thinking about walking away, letting Zero win the signal war. He shook his head. 'You *quit* now, and every coded word in this city belongs to them by morning.'
quit:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在街角找到疲惫的调查员，警告他若此刻____，整座城市的信号将落入敌手。
quit:1.hook: Behind Grey Crow, a red light on the wall began to blink — Zero was already listening.
quit:1.line: 'If you *quit* tonight, this city loses its last free voice.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow found me at the corner of Fifth and Neon, leaning against a cold wall.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在第五街和霓虹灯的转角处找到我，我靠着冰冷的墙。

sentences.en: 'You look done,' he said.
sentences.cn: "你看起来累坏了，"他说。

sentences.en: I told him I was thinking about it — thinking about walking away, letting Zero win the signal war.
sentences.cn: 我告诉他我在思考——思考着走开，让零点赢得信号战。

sentences.en: He shook his head.
sentences.cn: 他摇了摇头。

sentences.en: 'You *quit* now, and every coded word in this city belongs to them by morning.'

recall:1.en: I stood on the wet corner where it had all started and tried to *recall* the exact signal pattern Grey Crow had shown me on my first day: seven pulses, a pause, then three. My memory was close but not perfect. One wrong pulse would trigger Zero's counter-lock. Ali watched me, very still.
recall:1.cnHint: 调查员站在案件起点，努力____灰鸦最初传授的关键信号序列，一旦出错后果不堪设想。
recall:1.hook: I tapped the sixth pulse — and heard a sound I did not expect at all.
recall:1.line: '*Recall* every pulse Grey Crow taught you — get one wrong and we lose everything.'

sentences.en: I stood on the wet corner where it had all started and tried to *recall* the exact signal pattern Grey Crow had shown me on my first day: seven pulses, a pause, then three.
My memory was close but not perfect.
sentences.cn: 我的记忆接近，但并不完美。

sentences.en: One wrong pulse would trigger Zero's counter-lock.
sentences.cn: 一个脉冲错了就会触发零点的反制锁定。

sentences.en: Ali watched me, very still.
sentences.cn: 阿栗看着我，身体很静。

anyway:1.en: Rain hit the street in cold sheets. The signal was weak, the map was wrong, and my boots were soaked through. I had no backup and no clear route. *Anyway*, I kept moving — stopping meant losing Zero's trail for good, and that was not something I could let happen.
anyway:1.cnHint: 尽管天气恶劣、地图出错，叙述者还是____继续追踪零点的踪迹。
anyway:1.hook: Then the signal died — and something behind me did not.
anyway:1.line: '*Anyway*, standing still is the same as giving up.'

sentences.en: Rain hit the street in cold sheets.
sentences.cn: 雨冷冷地拍打着街道。

sentences.en: The signal was weak, the map was wrong, and my boots were soaked through.
sentences.cn: 信号很弱，地图错了，我的靴子完全湿透了。

sentences.en: I had no backup and no clear route.
sentences.cn: 我没有后援，也没有明确的路线。

sentences.en: *Anyway*, I kept moving — stopping meant losing Zero's trail for good, and that was not something I could let happen.

arise:1.en: Grey Crow had warned me: in Harbor City, new dangers *arise* without notice, growing out of the city's coded noise like weeds through cracked stone. I was three blocks from the meet point when the graffiti on the east wall changed — live, right before my eyes — spelling out a name I was not ready to read.
arise:1.cnHint: 灰鸦曾警告说，危险会突然____，而叙述者眼前的涂鸦正在实时变化。
arise:1.hook: The name on the wall was mine.
arise:1.line: 'Problems like this *arise* when someone is already watching you.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned me: in Harbor City, new dangers *arise* without notice, growing out of the city's coded noise like weeds through cracked stone.
I was three blocks from the meet point when the graffiti on the east wall changed — live, right before my eyes — spelling out a name I was not ready to read.
sentences.cn: 我离会面点三个街区远时，东墙上的涂鸦改变了——就在我眼前——拼出一个我还没准备好读的名字。

besides:1.en: The drop point was exposed — bad lighting, two open corners, no cover. I could try to reach Ali through the noise channel, but that would burn our last clean frequency. *Besides*, Ali had already risked enough tonight; the next move had to be mine alone.
besides:1.cnHint: 叙述者觉得联系阿栗会带来风险，____，阿栗今晚已经冒了太多险。
besides:1.hook: A red dot appeared on the wall beside my hand.
besides:1.line: '*Besides*, you were never supposed to come this far alone.'

sentences.en: The drop point was exposed — bad lighting, two open corners, no cover.
sentences.cn: 投放点暴露了——灯光差，两个开放的角落，没有掩护。

sentences.en: I could try to reach Ali through the noise channel, but that would burn our last clean frequency.
sentences.cn: 我可以试着通过噪音通道联系阿栗，但那会烧掉我们最后一条干净的频率。

sentences.en: *Besides*, Ali had already risked enough tonight; the next move had to be mine alone.

certainly:1.en: Zero had left a message burned into the pavement in heat-coded ink, visible only to someone who could read the city's hidden layer. It was short. It was direct. It would *certainly* reach me — Zero knew exactly how I saw the world, and that knowledge felt like a blade pressed against my ribs.
certainly:1.cnHint: 零点留下的信息一定____能被叙述者看到，因为零点深知叙述者的特殊能力。
certainly:1.hook: The message ended with a question I had no safe answer to.
certainly:1.line: 'You will *certainly* read this — that is why I wrote it here.'

sentences.en: Zero had left a message burned into the pavement in heat-coded ink, visible only to someone who could read the city's hidden layer.
sentences.cn: 零点在人行道上留下了一条用热编码墨水烧进去的信息，只有能读懂城市隐藏层的人才能看见。

sentences.en: It was short.
sentences.cn: 很短。

sentences.en: It was direct.
sentences.cn: 很直接。

sentences.en: It would *certainly* reach me — Zero knew exactly how I saw the world, and that knowledge felt like a blade pressed against my ribs.

challenging:1.en: Grey Crow called this district the Maze — and the name was fair. Every alley looped back. Every sign was *challenging* to read, layered with three false meanings before the true one. I spent six minutes on a single corner, hearing four different signals overlap, before I found the thread that led somewhere real.
challenging:1.cnHint: 这片区域的标识极具____性，每个符号都藏有多层含义，让叙述者花费大量时间解读。
challenging:1.hook: The thread led to a door that should not exist.
challenging:1.line: 'The language here is *challenging* — that is exactly the point.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow called this district the Maze — and the name was fair.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦称这个区域为迷宫——这个名字很贴切。

sentences.en: Every alley looped back.
sentences.cn: 每条小巷都绕回来。

sentences.en: Every sign was *challenging* to read, layered with three false meanings before the true one.
I spent six minutes on a single corner, hearing four different signals overlap, before I found the thread that led somewhere real.
sentences.cn: 我在一个角落花了六分钟，听到四个不同的信号重叠，才找到通往真实地方的线索。

circumstance:1.en: I had not planned to be in this part of Harbor City after dark. One wrong turn, one dead signal, one message from Ali rerouted by Zero's team — that was all it took. *Circumstance* had placed me in the worst possible spot, alone, with the sound of coded footsteps closing in from two directions.
circumstance:1.cnHint: 一系列意外的____使叙述者孤身陷入危险地带，四周传来逼近的脚步声。
circumstance:1.line: '*Circumstance* put you here — but choice will decide what happens next.'

sentences.en: I had not planned to be in this part of Harbor City after dark.
sentences.cn: 我没有计划在天黑后来港城的这一区。

sentences.en: One wrong turn, one dead signal, one message from Ali rerouted by Zero's team — that was all it took.
sentences.cn: 一个错误的转向，一个死信号，一条来自阿栗的被零点团队改路的信息——这就是全部了。

sentences.en: *Circumstance* had placed me in the worst possible spot, alone, with the sound of coded footsteps closing in from two directions.

comfort:1.en: Ali appeared from a side street, coat wet, eyes steady. No words at first — just a hand on my shoulder, brief and firm. It was a small thing, but in the cold noise of Harbor City, that single point of *comfort* was enough to slow my pulse and let me think again.
comfort:1.cnHint: 阿栗出现后给予叙述者一个简单的肢体____，让叙述者在混乱中重新冷静下来。
comfort:1.hook: Then Ali whispered a name, and the cold came back.
comfort:1.line: 'I am not here to give you *comfort* — I am here to keep you alive.'

sentences.en: Ali appeared from a side street, coat wet, eyes steady.
sentences.cn: 阿栗从一条侧街出现，大衣湿漉漉的，眼神坚定。

sentences.en: No words at first — just a hand on my shoulder, brief and firm.
sentences.cn: 最初没有言语——只是一只手按在我的肩膀上，短暂而有力。

sentences.en: It was a small thing, but in the cold noise of Harbor City, that single point of *comfort* was enough to slow my pulse and let me think again.

enrich:1.en: Zero did not steal data for money. Grey Crow had made that clear from the start. Zero collected rare signal-words — words that could *enrich* a coded message until it carried enough meaning to unlock a city-wide broadcast. I was standing on the street where the last word had been found, and the air still hummed.
enrich:1.cnHint: 零点收集稀有的信号词，用来____加密信息，而叙述者正站在最后一个词被发现的地点。
enrich:1.hook: My ear caught something — the hum was not fading.
enrich:1.line: 'One word can *enrich* a signal enough to wake the whole city.'

sentences.en: Zero did not steal data for money.
sentences.cn: 零点不是为了钱偷窃数据。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had made that clear from the start.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦从一开始就说得很清楚。

sentences.en: Zero collected rare signal-words — words that could *enrich* a coded message until it carried enough meaning to unlock a city-wide broadcast.
I was standing on the street where the last word had been found, and the air still hummed.
sentences.cn: 我站在最后一个词被发现的街道上，空气仍在嗡鸣。

egg:1.en: The signal came at dawn. Grey Crow had warned me: Zero always hides his broadcast keys inside ordinary objects. Today, the key was painted on a street vendor's cart — a cracked *egg*, its yellow centre forming the number nine. I read the code before the rain could wash it away.
egg:1.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我，零点把广播密钥藏在一个____里。
egg:1.hook: The cart was already moving, and someone was following it.
egg:1.line: 'The *egg* cracks at nine — that's your window,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The signal came at dawn.
sentences.cn: 信号在黎明时来临。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned me: Zero always hides his broadcast keys inside ordinary objects.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦警告过我：零点总是把他的广播密钥藏在普通物体里。

sentences.en: Today, the key was painted on a street vendor's cart — a cracked *egg*, its yellow centre forming the number nine.
I read the code before the rain could wash it away.
sentences.cn: 雨冲走前我读了这个代码。

hire:1.en: Ali pointed to the neon sign above the alley: RUNNERS FOR *HIRE*. It was not a real job board. In Harbor City's street code, each blinking letter stood for a district under Zero's watch. Three letters stayed dark. Three districts were unguarded tonight.
hire:1.cnHint: 那块____广告牌其实是零点监控地图的暗语。
hire:1.hook: Ali counted the dark letters twice, then went very still.
hire:1.line: 'They use the word *hire*, but what they're really selling is a map,' Ali whispered.

sentences.en: Ali pointed to the neon sign above the alley: RUNNERS FOR *HIRE*.
It was not a real job board.
sentences.cn: 这不是真正的工作板。

sentences.en: In Harbor City's street code, each blinking letter stood for a district under Zero's watch.
sentences.cn: 在港城的街头代码中，每个闪烁的字母代表一个零点控制下的区域。

sentences.en: Three letters stayed dark.
sentences.cn: 三个字母保持暗黑。

sentences.en: Three districts were unguarded tonight.
sentences.cn: 今晚有三个区域没人守卫。

aid:1.en: The old medic post on Canal Street had been shut for years, yet its red cross still glowed. Grey Crow told me that glow was a live signal — any investigator who needed *aid* could flash their badge light twice and receive an encoded reply from the underground network.
aid:1.cnHint: 运河街旧医疗站的红十字灯光其实是地下网络的____信号。
aid:1.hook: I flashed my badge light twice, and the cross blinked back — once.
aid:1.line: 'One blink means the *aid* comes with a cost,' Grey Crow said flatly.

sentences.en: The old medic post on Canal Street had been shut for years, yet its red cross still glowed.
sentences.cn: 运河街的老医疗站已经关了好多年，可那个红十字还在发光。

sentences.en: Grey Crow told me that glow was a live signal — any investigator who needed *aid* could flash their badge light twice and receive an encoded reply from the underground network.

bill:1.en: A torn *bill* — a single ten-credit note — was pinned to the crossing-light post at Fifth and Dock. Ali saw it first. In Zero's cipher, the serial number on a street-posted note told you which frequency to scan next. I photographed it fast before the light changed.
bill:1.cnHint: 路灯柱上贴着一张____，上面的序列号是下一个扫描频率。
bill:1.hook: When I checked the photo, the serial number was already scratched out.
bill:1.line: 'That *bill* isn't money — it's a frequency key,' Ali said, pulling me back.

sentences.en: A torn *bill* — a single ten-credit note — was pinned to the crossing-light post at Fifth and Dock.
Ali saw it first.
sentences.cn: 阿栗先看到的。

sentences.en: In Zero's cipher, the serial number on a street-posted note told you which frequency to scan next.
sentences.cn: 在零点的密码系统里，贴在街头的纸币上的序列号会告诉你接下来要扫描哪个频率。

sentences.en: I photographed it fast before the light changed.
sentences.cn: 红绿灯变之前我快速拍了下来。

paint:1.en: Zero's crew had been busy overnight. Fresh *paint* covered the east wall of the transit hub — bold white curves that looked like street art. I could hear the signal inside it: the curves were letters, compressed and rotated, spelling a meeting time that the city's cameras would never decode.
paint:1.cnHint: 东墙上的涂鸦____其实隐藏着一个加密的集合时间。
paint:1.hook: The *paint* was still wet — they had left less than an hour ago.
paint:1.line: 'Don't look at the *paint* like a picture — read it like a clock,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Zero's crew had been busy overnight.
sentences.cn: 零点的人昨晚忙活了一整夜。

sentences.en: Fresh *paint* covered the east wall of the transit hub — bold white curves that looked like street art.
I could hear the signal inside it: the curves were letters, compressed and rotated, spelling a meeting time that the city's cameras would never decode.
sentences.cn: 我能听到里面的信号：那些曲线是字母，被压缩、旋转过，拼出一个集合时间，城市的摄像头永远破译不了。

bean:1.en: The night market on Pier Nine sold nothing worth eating, but Ali stopped at the last stall anyway. A jar of dried *bean* sat on the counter with a red lid — red meaning a live drop. Under the jar was a folded slip: Zero's next move, written in six words.
bean:1.cnHint: 夜市摊位上一罐____下面藏着零点的下一步行动计划。
bean:1.hook: The stall owner's eyes tracked me the entire time I stood there.
bean:1.line: 'Red lid on a *bean* jar — that's a live drop,' Ali said quietly.

sentences.en: The night market on Pier Nine sold nothing worth eating, but Ali stopped at the last stall anyway.
sentences.cn: 九号码头的夜市卖的东西没什么能吃的，可阿栗还是在最后一个摊子前停了下来。

sentences.en: A jar of dried *bean* sat on the counter with a red lid — red meaning a live drop.
Under the jar was a folded slip: Zero's next move, written in six words.
sentences.cn: 罐子下面压着一张折好的纸条：零点的下一步行动，六个字写的。

birthday:1.en: The graffiti tag on the bridge pillar read: HAPPY BIRTHDAY SEVEN. It looked like a cheerful message, nothing more. But Grey Crow had taught me that any street tag with the word *birthday* carried a countdown — the number after it was hours, not years. Seven hours left.
birthday:1.cnHint: 桥墩上的涂鸦写着____，其中的数字其实是倒计时小时数。
birthday:1.hook: I checked my watch: six hours and fifty-eight minutes, already ticking.
birthday:1.line: 'In street code, every *birthday* tag is a timer,' Grey Crow said, already walking.

sentences.en: The graffiti tag on the bridge pillar read: HAPPY BIRTHDAY SEVEN.
sentences.cn: 桥墩上的涂鸦签名写的是：祝七岁生日快乐。

sentences.en: It looked like a cheerful message, nothing more.
sentences.cn: 看起来只像一条友好的留言而已。

sentences.en: But Grey Crow had taught me that any street tag with the word *birthday* carried a countdown — the number after it was hours, not years.
Seven hours left.
sentences.cn: 还剩七个小时。

flight:1.en: The departure board outside the old harbour terminal still cycled through routes, though no ships had left in years. Ali read the board differently: each cancelled *flight* code mapped to a node in Zero's broadcast net. One code was new — added within the hour.
flight:1.cnHint: 港口航班板上每个取消的____编号对应零点广播网络中的一个节点。
flight:1.hook: The new code pointed to a node we had believed was dead.
flight:1.line: 'That *flight* code is live,' Ali said. 'Zero just woke something up.'

sentences.en: The departure board outside the old harbour terminal still cycled through routes, though no ships had left in years.
sentences.cn: 老港口码头外的出发板还在循环显示航线，虽然已经好多年没有船离开了。

sentences.en: Ali read the board differently: each cancelled *flight* code mapped to a node in Zero's broadcast net.
One code was new — added within the hour.
sentences.cn: 有一个代码是新加的——一小时内加的。

facilitate:1.en: The rain-slicked street market was loud, full of vendors shouting over each other. Grey Crow had chosen this chaos on purpose. 'Noise *facilitates* the transfer,' he said, sliding a data chip across a wet counter. I grabbed it fast. Somewhere behind us, Zero's boots splashed through a puddle.
facilitate:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在嘈杂的街市中用噪音来____数据芯片的秘密传递。
facilitate:1.hook: The chip felt warm — warmer than any data chip should.
facilitate:1.line: 'Noise *facilitates* the transfer — keep moving and don't look back.'

sentences.en: The rain-slicked street market was loud, full of vendors shouting over each other.
sentences.cn: 雨淋湿的街市很嘈杂，小贩们互相喊叫着压过彼此。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had chosen this chaos on purpose.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦特意选了这种混乱。

sentences.en: 'Noise *facilitates* the transfer,' he said, sliding a data chip across a wet counter.
I grabbed it fast.
sentences.cn: 我快速拿了起来。

sentences.en: Somewhere behind us, Zero's boots splashed through a puddle.
sentences.cn: 我们身后某个地方，零点的靴子踏过一个水坑，溅起水花。

insight:1.en: I stared at the coded graffiti on the harbor wall for a full minute before it hit me. Ali leaned close. 'You see it?' I nodded slowly. This single *insight* — three symbols that meant a meeting point — had cost Grey Crow two weeks of silence. Zero had been watching that wall too.
insight:1.cnHint: 我盯着港口墙上的涂鸦，终于得到了一个关键的____，但零点也一直在观察。
insight:1.hook: A shadow at the far end of the wall had not moved in three minutes.
insight:1.line: 'That *insight* just put a target on every person who reads this wall.'

sentences.en: I stared at the coded graffiti on the harbor wall for a full minute before it hit me.
sentences.cn: 我盯着港口墙上的密码涂鸦看了整整一分钟才反应过来。

sentences.en: Ali leaned close.
sentences.cn: 阿栗靠了过来。

sentences.en: 'You see it?'
sentences.cn: 你看到了吗？

sentences.en: I nodded slowly.
sentences.cn: 我慢慢点了点头。

sentences.en: This single *insight* — three symbols that meant a meeting point — had cost Grey Crow two weeks of silence.
Zero had been watching that wall too.
sentences.cn: 零点也一直在看那堵墙。

preparation:1.en: Ali spread the street map flat on a crate outside the old port gate. Every exit, every camera blind spot — marked in faint pencil. 'How long did this take?' I asked. 'A week of *preparation*,' she said without looking up. Across the canal, a red light blinked twice: Zero's signal.
preparation:1.cnHint: 阿栗花了整整一周时间做____，将每个出口和监控盲点都标在了地图上。
preparation:1.hook: The red light blinked a third time — that was not part of Zero's code.
preparation:1.line: 'A week of *preparation*, and it still might not be enough tonight.'

sentences.en: Ali spread the street map flat on a crate outside the old port gate.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把街道地图铺平放在旧港口大门外的木箱上。

sentences.en: Every exit, every camera blind spot — marked in faint pencil.
sentences.cn: 每个出口、每个摄像头的盲点——都用淡铅笔标好了。

sentences.en: 'How long did this take?'
sentences.cn: 这花了多长时间？

sentences.en: I asked.
sentences.cn: 我问道。

sentences.en: 'A week of *preparation*,' she said without looking up.
Across the canal, a red light blinked twice: Zero's signal.
sentences.cn: 运河对岸，一盏红灯闪了两下：零点的信号。

separate:1.en: The crowd on Neon Bridge moved like one body. Grey Crow's last instruction had been clear: if followed, we *separate* at the bridge and meet at the signal post by the fish market. I peeled left. Ali peeled right. For ten cold seconds I was completely alone in the city's noise.
separate:1.cnHint: 在霓虹桥上，我们按照灰鸦的指示____行动，各自前往集合点。
separate:1.hook: I reached the signal post — but Ali never came.
separate:1.line: 'We *separate* here — do not wait for me, no matter what you hear.'

sentences.en: The crowd on Neon Bridge moved like one body.
sentences.cn: 霓虹桥上的人群像一个整体一样流动。

sentences.en: Grey Crow's last instruction had been clear: if followed, we *separate* at the bridge and meet at the signal post by the fish market.
I peeled left.
sentences.cn: 我向左转身离开。

sentences.en: Ali peeled right.
sentences.cn: 阿栗向右转身离开。

sentences.en: For ten cold seconds I was completely alone in the city's noise.
sentences.cn: 有十秒钟的寒冷里，我在城市的噪声中完全孤独。

tie:1.en: The man in the gray coat had no badge, no weapon I could see — only a pale *tie* printed with a tiny repeating pattern. Grey Crow had warned me about that pattern. It was a cipher. The man smiled and said nothing. Around us, Harbor City hummed its cold electric hum.
tie:1.cnHint: 那个陌生人的____上印着一种暗语图案，灰鸦曾警告过我那意味着什么。
tie:1.hook: I looked away for one second, and the man in the gray coat was gone.
tie:1.line: 'Read the pattern on his *tie* — that is how Zero marks his messengers.'

sentences.en: The man in the gray coat had no badge, no weapon I could see — only a pale *tie* printed with a tiny repeating pattern.
Grey Crow had warned me about that pattern.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦警告过我关于那个图案的事。

sentences.en: It was a cipher.
sentences.cn: 那是一种密码。

sentences.en: The man smiled and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 那个人笑了笑，什么也没说。

sentences.en: Around us, Harbor City hummed its cold electric hum.
sentences.cn: 我们周围，港湾城发出它那冷冰冰的电子嗡嗡声。

jam:1.en: The signal *jammed* hard at the corner of Salt Lane — every channel gone flat in one second. I pressed against the wall, breathing fast. Ali's voice had cut out mid-word. Grey Crow had said jamming only happened when Zero was less than fifty meters away. I counted the doorways ahead.
jam:1.cnHint: 在Salt Lane街角，信号突然被____，灰鸦说这意味着零点就在附近。
jam:1.hook: Fifty meters. I counted only four doorways — and one of them was opening.
jam:1.line: 'If the signal *jams*, stop talking and start counting exits.'

sentences.en: The signal *jammed* hard at the corner of Salt Lane — every channel gone flat in one second.
I pressed against the wall, breathing fast.
sentences.cn: 我压靠在墙上，呼吸急促。

sentences.en: Ali's voice had cut out mid-word.
sentences.cn: 阿栗的声音在半句话的时候就断了。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had said jamming only happened when Zero was less than fifty meters away.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说过信号干扰只有在零点距离不到五十米的时候才会发生。

sentences.en: I counted the doorways ahead.
sentences.cn: 我数着前面的门廊。

supermarket:1.en: The meet was set for the loading bay behind the old *supermarket* on Dock Row — the one with the broken sign that buzzed in the rain. Nobody shopped there anymore. Ali said the back wall had a hidden relay node. I arrived three minutes early. The loading bay was already lit up.
supermarket:1.cnHint: 接头地点定在Dock Row旧____后面的卸货区，阿栗说那里藏有一个中继节点。
supermarket:1.hook: The light in the loading bay was the wrong color — Grey Crow always used blue.
supermarket:1.line: 'The *supermarket* is dead ground — no cameras, no crowds, no way to call for help.'

sentences.en: The meet was set for the loading bay behind the old *supermarket* on Dock Row — the one with the broken sign that buzzed in the rain.
Nobody shopped there anymore.
sentences.cn: 没人去那里买东西了。

sentences.en: Ali said the back wall had a hidden relay node.
sentences.cn: 阿栗说后墙有个隐藏的中继节点。

sentences.en: I arrived three minutes early.
sentences.cn: 我提前三分钟到了。

sentences.en: The loading bay was already lit up.
sentences.cn: 装卸区已经亮起来了。

debate:1.en: Ali and I crouched behind a signal box on the wet street, running out of time. *Debate* was pointless — Grey Crow had said trust the code or trust nothing. I trusted the code. I stood up, stepped into the light, and read the message spray-painted on the wall aloud. The street went silent.
debate:1.cnHint: 时间紧迫，阿栗和我没有时间____，我选择相信暗码，走进了灯光下。
debate:1.hook: The silence lasted one breath — then every screen on the street flickered off.
debate:1.line: 'There is no time to *debate* this — read the wall or we lose him forever.'

sentences.en: Ali and I crouched behind a signal box on the wet street, running out of time.
sentences.cn: 阿栗和我蹲在湿漉漉的街道上一个信号箱后面，时间不多了。

sentences.en: *Debate* was pointless — Grey Crow had said trust the code or trust nothing.
I trusted the code.
sentences.cn: 我相信这个代码。

sentences.en: I stood up, stepped into the light, and read the message spray-painted on the wall aloud.
sentences.cn: 我站起身，走进灯光，大声读出喷在墙上的信息。

sentences.en: The street went silent.
sentences.cn: 街道瞬间安静了。

housing:1.en: The rain hit hard on Sector Nine. Grey Crow led me past broken walls and dark windows. 'The city controls everything through *housing*,' he said. 'No address, no identity. No identity, no rights.' Rows of sealed doors lined the street — each one a person the city had erased. I counted twelve. Then I heard a signal hidden inside the lock codes.
housing:1.cnHint: 灰鸦带我穿过九区，解释城市如何用____来控制每个人的身份。
housing:1.hook: The thirteenth door had my name encoded on it.
housing:1.line: '*Housing* is not shelter here — it is a leash.'

sentences.en: The rain hit hard on Sector Nine.
sentences.cn: 雨猛烈地砸向九号区。

sentences.en: Grey Crow led me past broken walls and dark windows.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦领我穿过破碎的墙壁和黑漆漆的窗户。

sentences.en: 'The city controls everything through *housing*,' he said.
'No address, no identity.
sentences.cn: 没有地址，就没有身份。

sentences.en: No identity, no rights.'
sentences.cn: 没有身份，就没有权利。

sentences.en: Rows of sealed doors lined the street — each one a person the city had erased.
sentences.cn: 一排排密封的门沿着街道排列——每一扇都代表一个被城市抹去的人。

sentences.en: I counted twelve.
sentences.cn: 我数了十二扇。

sentences.en: Then I heard a signal hidden inside the lock codes.
sentences.cn: 然后我听到了藏在锁码里的信号。

behaviour:1.en: Ali watched the crowd from the corner. 'Track their *behaviour*,' she whispered, eyes moving fast. In Harbor City, how you walked, where you stopped, how long you looked at a wall — all of it fed the city's signal grid. One man paused too long near a coded sign. The grid pinged. I heard the alert before the patrol did.
behaviour:1.cnHint: 阿栗教我观察人群的____，因为每一个动作都被城市信号网记录。
behaviour:1.hook: The man looked straight at me before he ran.
behaviour:1.line: 'Unusual *behaviour* near coded signs triggers the grid in seconds.'

sentences.en: Ali watched the crowd from the corner.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在角落里观察人群。

sentences.en: 'Track their *behaviour*,' she whispered, eyes moving fast.
In Harbor City, how you walked, where you stopped, how long you looked at a wall — all of it fed the city's signal grid.
sentences.cn: 在港城，你怎么走路、在哪里停留、看一堵墙多久——这一切都会输入城市的信号网格。

sentences.en: One man paused too long near a coded sign.
sentences.cn: 一个男人在一个编码标志附近停留得太久了。

sentences.en: The grid pinged.
sentences.cn: 网格发出了ping。

sentences.en: I heard the alert before the patrol did.
sentences.cn: 我比巡逻队更早听到警报。

husband:1.en: The woman at the noodle stall spoke in a low voice. Her *husband* had vanished three nights ago — last seen copying signal graffiti from the east bridge. Ali squeezed my arm. People who copied those codes did not come back as the same person. The stall light buzzed once. A patrol drone turned the corner.
husband:1.cnHint: 一位女士告诉我们，她的____三天前失踪，最后一次被看见是在抄写信号涂鸦。
husband:1.hook: The graffiti he copied was still glowing on the bridge wall.
husband:1.line: 'My *husband* said the code on the bridge was a door, not a warning.'

sentences.en: The woman at the noodle stall spoke in a low voice.
sentences.cn: 面摊老板娘用很低的声音说话。

sentences.en: Her *husband* had vanished three nights ago — last seen copying signal graffiti from the east bridge.
Ali squeezed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗紧紧挤了一下我的手臂。

sentences.en: People who copied those codes did not come back as the same person.
sentences.cn: 复制那些代码的人回不来——至少回来的不是同一个人了。

sentences.en: The stall light buzzed once.
sentences.cn: 摊位上的灯嗡的一声响。

sentences.en: A patrol drone turned the corner.
sentences.cn: 一架巡逻无人机转过了街角。

tourist:1.en: No real *tourist* came to Harbor City anymore. So when I spotted one — bright jacket, slow steps, wide eyes fixed on every neon sign — I knew it was a cover. Zero used decoys dressed as lost visitors. Ali confirmed it with a short hand signal. The fake tourist stopped outside our safehouse and raised a small receiver.
tourist:1.cnHint: 我发现一名装扮成____的人在我们藏身处外停下，这是零点的眼线。
tourist:1.hook: The receiver pointed at the exact window where our files were stored.
tourist:1.line: 'A *tourist* who reads every sign in Sector Nine is no tourist at all.'

sentences.en: No real *tourist* came to Harbor City anymore.
So when I spotted one — bright jacket, slow steps, wide eyes fixed on every neon sign — I knew it was a cover.
sentences.cn: 所以当我发现一个游客——鲜艳的夹克、缓慢的步子、睁得很大的眼睛盯着每一块霓虹灯——我就知道这是幌子。

sentences.en: Zero used decoys dressed as lost visitors.
sentences.cn: 零点用扮成迷路游客的诱饵。

sentences.en: Ali confirmed it with a short hand signal.
sentences.cn: 阿栗用一个短暂的手势确认了。

sentences.en: The fake tourist stopped outside our safehouse and raised a small receiver.
sentences.cn: 那个假游客在我们安全屋外停了下来，举起一个小接收器。

female:1.en: Rain hammered the street market. A *female* crow landed on a signal post above me, head tilted, eyes locked on mine. Ali grabbed my arm. 'Grey Crow sent it,' she whispered. The bird dropped a folded paper strip — four encoded symbols — then flew straight into the neon fog.
female:1.cnHint: 一只____乌鸦落在信号柱上，向我投下一张写有暗码的纸条。
female:1.hook: The symbols matched the forbidden frequency I had heard only once before.
female:1.line: 'A *female* crow is Grey Crow's chosen messenger — never ignore it.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the street market.
sentences.cn: 雨砸打着街道市集。

sentences.en: A *female* crow landed on a signal post above me, head tilted, eyes locked on mine.
Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住我的手臂。

sentences.en: 'Grey Crow sent it,' she whispered.
sentences.cn: 她小声说，灰鸦派它来的。

sentences.en: The bird dropped a folded paper strip — four encoded symbols — then flew straight into the neon fog.
sentences.cn: 鸟掉下一条折叠的纸条——四个编码符号——然后直接飞进了霓虹雾。

holiday:1.en: The street was loud with fake cheer. The city had declared a *holiday* to mask the signal blackout, filling every corner with noise and colored lights. I moved through the crowd, coat up, ears open. Somewhere beneath the music, a coded pulse ticked like a clock counting down.
holiday:1.cnHint: 城市宣布____，用节日喧嚣掩盖信号中断，而我在人群中捕捉隐藏的脉冲。
holiday:1.hook: The countdown reached three — and the lights cut out all at once.
holiday:1.line: 'They called a *holiday* so no one would notice the broadcast going dark.'

sentences.en: The street was loud with fake cheer.
sentences.cn: 街道充满了虚假的欢呼声。

sentences.en: The city had declared a *holiday* to mask the signal blackout, filling every corner with noise and colored lights.
I moved through the crowd, coat up, ears open.
sentences.cn: 我穿过人群，衣领竖起，耳朵支棱着。

sentences.en: Somewhere beneath the music, a coded pulse ticked like a clock counting down.
sentences.cn: 在音乐下面的某处，一个编码的脉冲像倒计时钟一样滴答作响。

pain:1.en: I crouched behind a cargo stack, leg scraped from the fall. The *pain* was sharp but I kept my eyes on the rooftop across the road. Zero stood there, still as a statue, watching the crowd below. Ali's voice came through my earpiece: 'He knows you are here.'
pain:1.cnHint: 我带着____蹲伏在货堆后，对面屋顶上的零点已经察觉到了我的存在。
pain:1.hook: Zero raised one hand and pointed — directly at my hiding spot.
pain:1.line: 'Push through the *pain* — we have less than a minute before he moves.'

sentences.en: I crouched behind a cargo stack, leg scraped from the fall.
sentences.cn: 我蹲在一堆货物后面，腿从跌落中擦伤了。

sentences.en: The *pain* was sharp but I kept my eyes on the rooftop across the road.
Zero stood there, still as a statue, watching the crowd below.
sentences.cn: 零点站在那里，静如雕像，俯视下方的人群。

sentences.en: Ali's voice came through my earpiece: 'He knows you are here.'
sentences.cn: 阿栗的声音从我的耳机里传来："他知道你在这里。"

player:1.en: Grey Crow spread a worn map on the wet pavement. 'Every *player* in this city thinks they control one square,' he said quietly. I studied the map. Three zones, three signals, three names — but one of the names was mine, circled in red ink I had never put there.
player:1.cnHint: 灰鸦展开地图，指出每个____都以为自己掌控着一块区域，而我的名字赫然在列。
player:1.hook: Someone had known I would be here long before I decided to come.
player:1.line: 'You are not just an observer now — you are a *player* in their game.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow spread a worn map on the wet pavement.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在湿漉漉的路面上铺开一张旧地图。

sentences.en: 'Every *player* in this city thinks they control one square,' he said quietly.
I studied the map.
sentences.cn: 我研究了这张地图。

sentences.en: Three zones, three signals, three names — but one of the names was mine, circled in red ink I had never put there.
sentences.cn: 三个区域、三个信号、三个名字——但其中一个名字是我的，用我从未涂过的红墨水圈了起来。

production:1.en: The coded graffiti on the wall read: HALT *PRODUCTION*. Ali translated the cipher fast — a signal factory two blocks east was pushing illegal frequency codes into the city grid. Grey Crow had warned me about this place. I had thought it was already shut down.
production:1.cnHint: 墙上的暗语写着停止____，阿栗破译后发现一家非法信号工厂仍在运转。
production:1.hook: A low hum rose from the ground beneath my feet, steady and growing louder.
production:1.line: 'Stop the *production* now — every extra minute poisons the whole grid.'

sentences.en: The coded graffiti on the wall read: HALT *PRODUCTION*.
Ali translated the cipher fast — a signal factory two blocks east was pushing illegal frequency codes into the city grid.
sentences.cn: 阿栗很快翻译了密码——两个街区外一家信号工厂正在向城市网格推送非法频率代码。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned me about this place.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦曾经警告过我这个地方。

sentences.en: I had thought it was already shut down.
sentences.cn: 我以为它已经关闭了。

secure:1.en: Ali handed me a small device. 'This channel is *secure* — for the next four minutes,' she said, eyes on her timer. I pressed it to my ear. Grey Crow's voice came through, thin and careful: 'Zero has the key. Do not let him reach the east gate.' Then silence.
secure:1.cnHint: 阿栗给了我一个____的通话设备，灰鸦通过它传来了关于零点的紧急警告。
secure:1.hook: Four minutes was already down to two — and I was still six blocks from the east gate.
secure:1.line: 'I can only keep this line *secure* until the timer hits zero — talk fast.'

sentences.en: Ali handed me a small device.
sentences.cn: 阿栗递给我一个小设备。

sentences.en: 'This channel is *secure* — for the next four minutes,' she said, eyes on her timer.
I pressed it to my ear.
sentences.cn: 我把它贴在耳边。

sentences.en: Grey Crow's voice came through, thin and careful: 'Zero has the key.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦的声音传来，细弱而谨慎："零点有钥匙。

sentences.en: Do not let him reach the east gate.'
sentences.cn: 别让他到达东门。"

sentences.en: Then silence.
sentences.cn: 然后是沉默。

audience:1.en: Zero had chosen the open plaza for a reason. A crowd had gathered, drawn by a street display, giving him a perfect *audience* — dozens of eyes pointed away from the side door he was about to use. I saw it a second before Ali did. We split without a word.
audience:1.cnHint: 零点故意选在广场行动，利用围观____的人群掩护自己悄悄溜走。
audience:1.hook: Ali reached the door first — and came back two steps later, face pale.
audience:1.line: 'He needed an *audience* so everyone would look the wrong way.'

sentences.en: Zero had chosen the open plaza for a reason.
sentences.cn: 零点选择这个开放的广场是有原因的。

sentences.en: A crowd had gathered, drawn by a street display, giving him a perfect *audience* — dozens of eyes pointed away from the side door he was about to use.
I saw it a second before Ali did.
sentences.cn: 我比阿栗早一秒看到了。

sentences.en: We split without a word.
sentences.cn: 我们无言地分开了。

borrow:1.en: I had no signal key of my own. Grey Crow told me to find Zero's decoy unit and *borrow* its frequency for sixty seconds — just long enough to trace the source broadcast. Ali kept watch. I found the unit taped under a market bench, still warm, still live.
borrow:1.cnHint: 我需要____零点的解码装置来追踪信号源，阿栗在一旁放风。
borrow:1.hook: The moment I pulled the unit free, an alarm tone shrieked across the whole street.
borrow:1.line: 'Just *borrow* the frequency — sixty seconds and we put it back exactly as we found it.'

sentences.en: I had no signal key of my own.
sentences.cn: 我没有自己的信号钥匙。

sentences.en: Grey Crow told me to find Zero's decoy unit and *borrow* its frequency for sixty seconds — just long enough to trace the source broadcast.
Ali kept watch.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在望风。

sentences.en: I found the unit taped under a market bench, still warm, still live.
sentences.cn: 我在市集长凳下找到了那个装置，还温着，还在工作。

collection:1.en: Rain hit the street in cold sheets. Under the bridge, Zero had pinned a *collection* of coded notes to the wall — each one a stolen signal, a fragment of someone else's secret. I counted nine. Ali grabbed my arm. 'There should be ten,' she said. One note was missing. So was Zero.
collection:1.cnHint: 桥下，调查员发现了零点留下的一批____，但其中一张不见了。
collection:1.hook: The missing note was the only one with my name on it.
collection:1.line: 'This *collection* didn't come cheap — Zero traded something big for each piece.'

sentences.en: Rain hit the street in cold sheets.
sentences.cn: 冷雨铺天盖地砸下来。

sentences.en: Under the bridge, Zero had pinned a *collection* of coded notes to the wall — each one a stolen signal, a fragment of someone else's secret.
I counted nine.
sentences.cn: 我数了数，一共九个。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住我的胳膊。

sentences.en: 'There should be ten,' she said.
sentences.cn: "应该有十个的，"她说。

sentences.en: One note was missing.
sentences.cn: 有一张纸条不见了。

sentences.en: So was Zero.
sentences.cn: 零点也不见了。

depression:1.en: The street outside the old signal tower dipped into a wide *depression* where rainwater pooled black under the neon glow. Grey Crow met me there, coat soaked, eyes flat. 'Zero picked this spot for a reason,' he said, scanning the dark water. I looked down and saw a wire running beneath the surface.
depression:1.cnHint: 在信号塔外的低洼____处，灰鸦发现了一条藏在水下的电线。
depression:1.hook: One step forward and I would have completed the circuit.
depression:1.line: 'Meet me in the *depression* under the tower — and watch where you step.'

sentences.en: The street outside the old signal tower dipped into a wide *depression* where rainwater pooled black under the neon glow.
Grey Crow met me there, coat soaked, eyes flat.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在那里等我，大衣湿透了，眼神很冷。

sentences.en: 'Zero picked this spot for a reason,' he said, scanning the dark water.
sentences.cn: "零点选这个地方是有原因的，"他说，扫过黑漆漆的水面。

sentences.en: I looked down and saw a wire running beneath the surface.
sentences.cn: 我低头看，看到一根电线在水下伸过去。

foot:1.en: Every *foot* of Harbor City's old market street was covered in coded graffiti, layered so thick the bricks had turned gold and red. I walked slow, reading each mark. Ali walked ahead, faster, then stopped hard. She had found the one clean patch — no paint, no signal, no noise. Just a door.
foot:1.cnHint: 市场街的每____地方都涂满了密码涂鸦，但阿栗找到了唯一干净的地方。
foot:1.hook: Behind that door, something was already listening.
foot:1.line: 'Every *foot* of this street is a message — read them all before you move.'

sentences.en: Every *foot* of Harbor City's old market street was covered in coded graffiti, layered so thick the bricks had turned gold and red.
I walked slow, reading each mark.
sentences.cn: 我慢慢走，读着每一个标记。

sentences.en: Ali walked ahead, faster, then stopped hard.
sentences.cn: 阿栗走在前面，走得快，然后突然停住了。

sentences.en: She had found the one clean patch — no paint, no signal, no noise.
sentences.cn: 她找到了一块干净的地方——没有油漆，没有信号，什么都没有。

sentences.en: Just a door.
sentences.cn: 只有一扇门。

graduate:1.en: The suspect was a fresh *graduate* from Harbor City's code academy, badge still bright, hands still steady. Zero had sent them to delay us at the checkpoint while the real signal went out on another channel. I almost believed the young face. Almost. Then I noticed the earpiece, half-hidden under damp hair.
graduate:1.cnHint: 一名刚毕业的____被零点派来拖延调查员，但调查员发现了破绽。
graduate:1.hook: The earpiece was still transmitting — to someone right behind me.
graduate:1.line: 'A *graduate* with a clean badge is the best cover Zero ever used.'

sentences.en: The suspect was a fresh *graduate* from Harbor City's code academy, badge still bright, hands still steady.
Zero had sent them to delay us at the checkpoint while the real signal went out on another channel.
sentences.cn: 零点派他们去检查站拖延我们，真正的信号从另一个频道发了出去。

sentences.en: I almost believed the young face.
sentences.cn: 我差点信了那张年轻的脸。

sentences.en: Almost.
sentences.cn: 差一点。

sentences.en: Then I noticed the earpiece, half-hidden under damp hair.
sentences.cn: 然后我注意到了耳机，半隐在潮湿的头发下。

intake:1.en: At the old water station, each deep *intake* of breath made the air taste like copper and old code — the station's filters had been running forbidden signals through the pipes for weeks. Grey Crow pressed one hand to the wall and listened. I listened too. Somewhere below, a server was still running.
intake:1.cnHint: 在旧水站，调查员深深____一口气，察觉到管道中隐藏的非法信号。
intake:1.hook: The server log showed my own name in the last line.
intake:1.line: 'Every *intake* of air in this building carries a signal — they have been broadcasting for weeks.'

sentences.en: At the old water station, each deep *intake* of breath made the air taste like copper and old code — the station's filters had been running forbidden signals through the pipes for weeks.
Grey Crow pressed one hand to the wall and listened.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦一只手按在墙上，在听。

sentences.en: I listened too.
sentences.cn: 我也听。

sentences.en: Somewhere below, a server was still running.
sentences.cn: 下面某个地方，服务器还在运行。

screen:1.en: A cracked *screen* on the alley wall flickered to life as I passed — Zero's face, pale and sharp, filling every inch of it. 'You are close,' the voice said, 'but close is not enough.' The image cut out. Ali was already running toward the source signal. I ran after her into the dark.
screen:1.cnHint: 巷子里的____突然亮起，零点的脸出现其上，向调查员发出挑衅。
screen:1.hook: The source signal led straight into Zero's trap.
screen:1.line: 'That *screen* has been sending out a hidden frequency every time someone walks past.'

sentences.en: A cracked *screen* on the alley wall flickered to life as I passed — Zero's face, pale and sharp, filling every inch of it.
'You are close,' the voice said, 'but close is not enough.'
sentences.cn: "你很接近，"那声音说，"但接近还不够。"

sentences.en: The image cut out.
sentences.cn: 画面断了。

sentences.en: Ali was already running toward the source signal.
sentences.cn: 阿栗已经朝信号源跑过去了。

sentences.en: I ran after her into the dark.
sentences.cn: 我跟在她后面冲进黑暗里。

chair:1.en: In the center of the empty rooftop, a single metal *chair* faced the harbor. Ropes on its arms, a small device beneath its seat, a note pinned to the back. Grey Crow read it aloud: 'Sit down if you want the last key.' The rain came harder. No one sat. But someone had been here very recently.
chair:1.cnHint: 天台中央有一把____，上面留有纸条，暗示坐下才能获得最后的密钥。
chair:1.hook: The device under the seat had a thirty-second timer, already running.
chair:1.line: 'The *chair* is a test — Zero wants to see if you trust the message enough to sit.'

sentences.en: In the center of the empty rooftop, a single metal *chair* faced the harbor.
Ropes on its arms, a small device beneath its seat, a note pinned to the back.
sentences.cn: 椅子的扶手上有绳子，座位下有个小装置，背面钉着一张纸条。

sentences.en: Grey Crow read it aloud: 'Sit down if you want the last key.'
sentences.cn: 灰鸦大声读了出来："坐下，我就给你最后一把钥匙。"

sentences.en: The rain came harder.
sentences.cn: 雨下得更猛了。

sentences.en: No one sat.
sentences.cn: 没人坐下。

sentences.en: But someone had been here very recently.
sentences.cn: 但有人最近来过这里。

court:1.en: The old justice *court* on Fifth Street had been dark for thirty years, but tonight every window burned white. Ali said Zero had chosen it on purpose — the building still held the city's oldest legal broadcast codes in its walls, locked inside the stone. Whoever cracked them would rewrite Harbor City's every law.
court:1.cnHint: 零点选择了废弃的____大楼，因为其墙内藏有全市最古老的广播密码。
court:1.hook: The front door swung open before either of us touched it.
court:1.line: 'This *court* has not spoken in thirty years — tonight Zero wants it to speak for them.'

sentences.en: The old justice *court* on Fifth Street had been dark for thirty years, but tonight every window burned white.
Ali said Zero had chosen it on purpose — the building still held the city's oldest legal broadcast codes in its walls, locked inside the stone.
sentences.cn: 阿栗说零点是故意选的这栋楼——楼里还存着这座城市最古老的司法广播密码，被锁在石头里。

sentences.en: Whoever cracked them would rewrite Harbor City's every law.
sentences.cn: 谁破解了它，谁就能改写港城的每一条法律。

burn:1.en: The coded sign on the wall glowed orange in the rain. Grey Crow traced it with one finger. 'That mark is a *burn*,' he said quietly — a signal left by someone who had been caught and had no way out. I looked at the wet street and felt the cold reach my bones.
burn:1.cnHint: 灰鸦指着墙上发光的暗号，告诉我那是一种____，意味着留下它的人已经无路可退。
burn:1.hook: Somewhere in the dark, that person was still running.
burn:1.line: 'That mark is a *burn* — whoever left it knew they were finished.'

sentences.en: The coded sign on the wall glowed orange in the rain.
sentences.cn: 墙上的密码标记在雨里闪着橙色的光。

sentences.en: Grey Crow traced it with one finger.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦用一根手指描过它。

sentences.en: 'That mark is a *burn*,' he said quietly — a signal left by someone who had been caught and had no way out.
I looked at the wet street and felt the cold reach my bones.
sentences.cn: 我看着湿漉漉的街道，感到寒冷渗进了骨头。

cook:1.en: The night market stall filled the alley with steam. Ali pointed at the old man behind the fire. 'He used to *cook* for the city council,' she whispered, 'but now he feeds signal agents who pass coded orders with every bowl.' I watched him ladle soup with steady hands and wondered what he had heard tonight.
cook:1.cnHint: 阿里告诉我，那个在夜市____饭的老人曾为权贵服务，如今却暗中为信号特工传递密令。
cook:1.hook: The old man's eyes met mine across the steam.
cook:1.line: 'He used to *cook* for the council — now he serves a different master.'

sentences.en: The night market stall filled the alley with steam.
sentences.cn: 夜市摊子的蒸汽填满了整条小巷。

sentences.en: Ali pointed at the old man behind the fire.
sentences.cn: 阿栗指了指火堆后面的老人。

sentences.en: 'He used to *cook* for the city council,' she whispered, 'but now he feeds signal agents who pass coded orders with every bowl.'
I watched him ladle soup with steady hands and wondered what he had heard tonight.
sentences.cn: 我看他用稳定的手舀汤，想知道他今晚听到了什么。

corporate:1.en: The tower rose above the wet street, every floor dark except one. Grey Crow pulled me behind a broken sign. 'That is a *corporate* safe house,' he said, voice flat. 'Not city law — private money, private rules.' Rain hit the pavement hard. I had no badge that meant anything here.
corporate:1.cnHint: 灰鸦压低声音，说那栋大楼是某个____组织的秘密据点，不受城市法律管辖。
corporate:1.hook: A light moved past the window on the silent floor.
corporate:1.line: 'A *corporate* safe house plays by no rules you know.'

sentences.en: The tower rose above the wet street, every floor dark except one.
sentences.cn: 高塔在湿漉漉的街道上拔地而起，每一层都是一片漆黑，只有一层还亮着灯。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pulled me behind a broken sign.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把我拉到一个破碎的招牌后面。

sentences.en: 'That is a *corporate* safe house,' he said, voice flat.
'Not city law — private money, private rules.'
sentences.cn: 不是城市法律——私人的钱，私人的规则。

sentences.en: Rain hit the pavement hard.
sentences.cn: 雨重重地砸在人行道上。

sentences.en: I had no badge that meant anything here.
sentences.cn: 我的证件在这里一文不值。

dangerous:1.en: The bridge crossing was quiet, too quiet. Ali grabbed my arm. 'This stretch is *dangerous* after midnight,' she said. 'Zero's people watch every signal that crosses here.' Neon from the water below painted her face in cold blue. I took one slow step forward anyway.
dangerous:1.cnHint: 阿里警告我，这段桥路午夜后____极了，零点的人会监控每一个经过的信号。
dangerous:1.hook: A shadow at the far end of the bridge did not move.
dangerous:1.line: 'This crossing is *dangerous* — Zero has eyes on every step.'

sentences.en: The bridge crossing was quiet, too quiet.
sentences.cn: 桥梁通道很安静，安静得不太对劲。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了我的手臂。

sentences.en: 'This stretch is *dangerous* after midnight,' she said.
'Zero's people watch every signal that crosses here.'
sentences.cn: 零点的人在监视经过这里的每一个信号。

sentences.en: Neon from the water below painted her face in cold blue.
sentences.cn: 下面水面上的霓虹灯把她的脸照成了冷冷的蓝色。

sentences.en: I took one slow step forward anyway.
sentences.cn: 我还是缓缓迈出了一步。

debt:1.en: Grey Crow stopped at a cracked street lamp and looked at the graffiti below it. 'This symbol means *debt*,' he said. 'Someone owes Zero a signal, and Zero is marking the street so the whole network knows it.' I stared at the mark. My name could be next on that wall.
debt:1.cnHint: 灰鸦解释说，那个涂鸦符号代表____，是零点在向整个地下网络宣示有人欠了他一个信号。
debt:1.hook: I had given Zero exactly one signal three nights ago.
debt:1.line: 'That tag means *debt* — Zero does not forget what he is owed.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow stopped at a cracked street lamp and looked at the graffiti below it.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在一盏裂开的路灯前停下来，看着下面的涂鸦。

sentences.en: 'This symbol means *debt*,' he said.
'Someone owes Zero a signal, and Zero is marking the street so the whole network knows it.'
sentences.cn: 有人欠零点一个信号，零点就在街上做上记号，让整个网络的人都知道。

sentences.en: I stared at the mark.
sentences.cn: 我盯着那个标记。

sentences.en: My name could be next on that wall.
sentences.cn: 我的名字可能就是下一个出现在那堵墙上的。

discipline:1.en: The training yard behind the old station was empty at this hour. Ali walked its edge, reading faded marks on the ground. 'Zero runs his network on *discipline*,' she said. 'Miss one check-in and you vanish.' The rain had washed the marks almost clean, but not quite. Someone had missed their check-in here.
discipline:1.cnHint: 阿里说，零点用严格的____管理他的网络，只要有人漏报一次，就会凭空消失。
discipline:1.hook: A fresh boot print in the mud pointed toward the river.
discipline:1.line: 'Zero's network runs on *discipline* — one missed call and you are gone.'

sentences.en: The training yard behind the old station was empty at this hour.
sentences.cn: 旧车站后面的训练场在这个时间是空荡荡的。

sentences.en: Ali walked its edge, reading faded marks on the ground.
sentences.cn: 阿栗沿着边缘走，读着地上褪色的标记。

sentences.en: 'Zero runs his network on *discipline*,' she said.
'Miss one check-in and you vanish.'
sentences.cn: 漏掉一次打卡，你就消失了。

sentences.en: The rain had washed the marks almost clean, but not quite.
sentences.cn: 雨已经把标记冲得差不多干净了，但还不完全。

sentences.en: Someone had missed their check-in here.
sentences.cn: 有人在这里漏掉了他们的打卡。

error:1.en: The signal I heard was wrong — one tone off, repeating. Grey Crow went still beside me. 'That is an *error* code,' he said slowly. 'Someone in the network made a mistake and is broadcasting it without knowing.' Across the wet square a figure stood under a lamp, head down, holding a device. They had no idea what they were sending.
error:1.cnHint: 灰鸦听出广播中的____信号，意识到网络里有人在毫不知情地暴露自己的失误。
error:1.hook: Zero would hear that same tone within the minute.
error:1.line: 'That repeating tone is an *error* code — they are marking themselves.'

sentences.en: The signal I heard was wrong — one tone off, repeating.
sentences.cn: 我听到的信号不对——音调偏了一个半音，一直在重复。

sentences.en: Grey Crow went still beside me.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在我身边僵住了。

sentences.en: 'That is an *error* code,' he said slowly.
'Someone in the network made a mistake and is broadcasting it without knowing.'
sentences.cn: 有人在网络里犯了个错误，正在无意识地广播它。

sentences.en: Across the wet square a figure stood under a lamp, head down, holding a device.
sentences.cn: 在湿漉漉的广场对面，一个人站在灯下，低着头，握着一个设备。

sentences.en: They had no idea what they were sending.
sentences.cn: 他们根本不知道自己在发送什么。

gym:1.en: The old public *gym* at the end of Ninth Street had been dark for years, its windows painted over. Ali slowed as we passed. 'Zero runs his street contacts through there now,' she said quietly. 'The equipment is still inside — but so is a relay node no one is supposed to find.' I counted the cameras above the door. Three. All new.
gym:1.cnHint: 阿里说，街角废弃的____里藏着零点联络线人的中继节点，门口的摄像头全是新装的。
gym:1.hook: One of the cameras turned, very slowly, to follow us.
gym:1.line: 'That *gym* is Zero's meeting point — and something inside is live.'

sentences.en: The old public *gym* at the end of Ninth Street had been dark for years, its windows painted over.
Ali slowed as we passed.
sentences.cn: 阿栗放慢了脚步。

sentences.en: 'Zero runs his street contacts through there now,' she said quietly.
sentences.cn: 零点现在通过那里来联系他的街头线人，她小声说。

sentences.en: 'The equipment is still inside — but so is a relay node no one is supposed to find.'
sentences.cn: 设备还在里面——但还有一个中继节点，没人应该找到它。

sentences.en: I counted the cameras above the door.
sentences.cn: 我数了一下门上的摄像头。

sentences.en: Three.
sentences.cn: 三个。

sentences.en: All new.
sentences.cn: 全是新的。

mile:1.en: The encrypted broadcast pointed to a drop point one *mile* east of the old bridge. I ran hard, rain cutting my face, neon signs blurring into streaks of cold light. Ali was already there, breath fogging the air. 'Signal is live,' she said. Then the light went out.
mile:1.cnHint: 加密广播指向旧桥以东一____处的接头地点，我冲过去时灯突然熄灭了。
mile:1.hook: Someone had cut the power before we arrived.
mile:1.line: 'The drop point is exactly one *mile* east — don't be late.'

sentences.en: The encrypted broadcast pointed to a drop point one *mile* east of the old bridge.
I ran hard, rain cutting my face, neon signs blurring into streaks of cold light.
sentences.cn: 我拼命跑着，雨水打在脸上，霓虹灯牌模糊成一道道冷光的痕迹。

sentences.en: Ali was already there, breath fogging the air.
sentences.cn: 阿栗已经到了，呼吸在空气中冒起白烟。

sentences.en: 'Signal is live,' she said.
sentences.cn: 信号还活着，她说。

sentences.en: Then the light went out.
sentences.cn: 然后灯灭了。

movement:1.en: I pressed my back against the wet wall and watched. One *movement* in the alley below — a shadow, brief, deliberate. Ali gripped my arm. Grey Crow had warned us the street would feel empty. It never really was. The shadow stepped under a red light and looked straight up.
movement:1.cnHint: 我在墙边观察，发现小巷里有一个____，那道影子径直抬头看向了我们。
movement:1.hook: Zero knew exactly where we were hiding.
movement:1.line: 'One *movement* in that alley means Zero is already here.'

sentences.en: I pressed my back against the wet wall and watched.
sentences.cn: 我把背贴在湿漉漉的墙上，观察着。

sentences.en: One *movement* in the alley below — a shadow, brief, deliberate.
Ali gripped my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗紧紧抓住我的手臂。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned us the street would feel empty.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦警告过我们街道会显得很空荡。

sentences.en: It never really was.
sentences.cn: 但它永远不会真的空荡。

sentences.en: The shadow stepped under a red light and looked straight up.
sentences.cn: 那个影子走到一盏红灯下，直直地向上看。

party:1.en: The ruling *party* had banned seventeen words by dawn. Grey Crow read the list aloud in the cold street, voice flat. Each word was a door they were closing. Ali wrote them in the condensation on a shop window. A city patrol turned the corner. She wiped the glass clean, fast.
party:1.cnHint: 执政____禁用了十七个词，阿栗把它们写在玻璃上，巡逻队一出现她就擦掉了。
party:1.hook: But the patrol officer had already taken a photo.
party:1.line: 'The *party* just banned the word that unlocks our last safe channel.'

sentences.en: The ruling *party* had banned seventeen words by dawn.
Grey Crow read the list aloud in the cold street, voice flat.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在冷清的街道上大声读出了那份名单，声音很平淡。

sentences.en: Each word was a door they were closing.
sentences.cn: 每个词都是他们在关上的一扇门。

sentences.en: Ali wrote them in the condensation on a shop window.
sentences.cn: 阿栗用手指在店窗的冷凝水上写下这些词。

sentences.en: A city patrol turned the corner.
sentences.cn: 一辆城市巡逻车转过了街角。

sentences.en: She wiped the glass clean, fast.
sentences.cn: 她迅速擦掉了玻璃。

rescue:1.en: Grey Crow's signal went dark at 03:00. By 03:12 I was on the street, rain soaking through my coat. A *rescue* in Harbor City meant moving fast and speaking less. Ali met me at the corner with a cold look and a borrowed access card. 'Third floor,' she said. 'Hurry.'
rescue:1.cnHint: 灰鸦的信号中断了，我和阿栗展开____行动，赶到指定地点准备营救。
rescue:1.hook: The door on the third floor was already open.
rescue:1.line: 'This *rescue* has to be done in under four minutes — not a second more.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow's signal went dark at 03:00.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦的信号在凌晨三点消失了。

sentences.en: By 03:12 I was on the street, rain soaking through my coat.
sentences.cn: 到了三点十二分，我已经在街上，雨水透过我的外套浸湿了身体。

sentences.en: A *rescue* in Harbor City meant moving fast and speaking less.
Ali met me at the corner with a cold look and a borrowed access card.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在街角迎接我，脸色冷漠，手里拿着一张借来的通行卡。

sentences.en: 'Third floor,' she said.
sentences.cn: 第三层，她说。

sentences.en: 'Hurry.'
sentences.cn: 快点。

writing:1.en: The *writing* on the underpass wall was not graffiti. Each stroke was a compressed data string, disguised as art. I pressed my palm to the cold concrete and let my signal sense read it. A name surfaced: Zero. Ali exhaled slowly behind me. 'Then it was never random,' she said.
writing:1.cnHint: 通道墙上的____并非涂鸦，而是压缩数据，我解读后浮现出零点的名字。
writing:1.hook: Zero had left this message here months before we ever arrived.
writing:1.line: 'The *writing* on that wall is a live message — read it now.'

sentences.en: The *writing* on the underpass wall was not graffiti.
Each stroke was a compressed data string, disguised as art.
sentences.cn: 每一笔都是一串被伪装成艺术的压缩数据。

sentences.en: I pressed my palm to the cold concrete and let my signal sense read it.
sentences.cn: 我把手掌贴在冰冷的混凝土上，让我的信号感应读取它。

sentences.en: A name surfaced: Zero.
sentences.cn: 一个名字浮现出来：零点。

sentences.en: Ali exhaled slowly behind me.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在我身后缓缓呼了口气。

sentences.en: 'Then it was never random,' she said.
sentences.cn: 那就说明从来都不是随机的，她说。

bite:1.en: The air in the lower district had a chemical *bite* that made your eyes water. Zero liked to meet in places like this — where people walked fast and asked nothing. I spotted the package under a broken bench. Ali touched my shoulder. Somewhere above us, a drone changed course.
bite:1.cnHint: 空气中有一股刺鼻的____味，我发现了包裹，但无人机突然改变了方向。
bite:1.hook: That drone was not a city unit.
bite:1.line: 'There is a sharp *bite* in the air here — Zero picked this spot on purpose.'

sentences.en: The air in the lower district had a chemical *bite* that made your eyes water.
Zero liked to meet in places like this — where people walked fast and asked nothing.
sentences.cn: 零点喜欢在这样的地方见面——人们走得快，什么都不问。

sentences.en: I spotted the package under a broken bench.
sentences.cn: 我发现了一个破损的长椅下面的包裹。

sentences.en: Ali touched my shoulder.
sentences.cn: 阿栗碰了碰我的肩膀。

sentences.en: Somewhere above us, a drone changed course.
sentences.cn: 我们上方某处，一架无人机改变了航向。

capture:1.en: Zero's plan was simple: *capture* the signal at the relay tower before the city locked the frequency at midnight. Grey Crow had the timing. Ali had the tool. I had one job — keep the south entrance clear. The clock on the tower read 23:57. My earpiece crackled and went silent.
capture:1.cnHint: 我们计划在午夜前____信号塔的频率，但耳机在23:57突然没了声音。
capture:1.hook: Grey Crow had missed the three-minute window.
capture:1.line: 'We have to *capture* that signal before midnight or the whole operation fails.'

sentences.en: Zero's plan was simple: *capture* the signal at the relay tower before the city locked the frequency at midnight.
Grey Crow had the timing.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦掌握了时机。

sentences.en: Ali had the tool.
sentences.cn: 阿栗有工具。

sentences.en: I had one job — keep the south entrance clear.
sentences.cn: 我只有一个任务——保持南出口畅通。

sentences.en: The clock on the tower read 23:57.
sentences.cn: 塔楼上的时钟显示 23:57。

sentences.en: My earpiece crackled and went silent.
sentences.cn: 我的耳机里传来一阵噪音，然后陷入了沉默。

cope:1.en: Three patrol drones, two blocked exits, one dead communicator. I stood in the rain and tried to *cope* with the numbers. Grey Crow always said the city was designed to overwhelm you slowly. Ali sent a single blink on the backup light — she had a way out. I moved toward her signal.
cope:1.cnHint: 面对三架无人机和两个封堵的出口，我努力____这一局面，阿栗的备用信号给了我方向。
cope:1.hook: The way out led directly under Zero's last known position.
cope:1.line: 'I don't know how you *cope* with this city — it beats you down every single night.'

sentences.en: Three patrol drones, two blocked exits, one dead communicator.
sentences.cn: 三架巡逻无人机，两个被堵的出口，一部失效的通讯器。

sentences.en: I stood in the rain and tried to *cope* with the numbers.
Grey Crow always said the city was designed to overwhelm you slowly.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦总说这座城市的设计就是要慢慢压垮你。

sentences.en: Ali sent a single blink on the backup light — she had a way out.
sentences.cn: 阿栗用备用灯发出了一次闪光——她找到了出路。

sentences.en: I moved toward her signal.
sentences.cn: 我朝她的信号移动。

salary:1.en: The neon job board on Fifth Street flickered with offers I could not take. Undercover work paid no *salary* — just a thin envelope of untraceable coins left under a broken bench. Ali spotted me staring and said nothing. We both knew the city only paid in secrets and risk.
salary:1.cnHint: 调查员盯着街边的招聘板，想到自己做卧底没有正式____，只能靠秘密报酬维生。
salary:1.hook: Then the board went dark, and a single line blinked: 'We know who you are.'
salary:1.line: 'My *salary* fits in one envelope — and tonight that envelope is gone.'

sentences.en: The neon job board on Fifth Street flickered with offers I could not take.
sentences.cn: 第五街的霓虹招聘板闪烁着我无法接受的工作。

sentences.en: Undercover work paid no *salary* — just a thin envelope of untraceable coins left under a broken bench.
Ali spotted me staring and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 阿栗看到我在盯着那些招聘，什么也没说。

sentences.en: We both knew the city only paid in secrets and risk.
sentences.cn: 我们都知道这座城市只用秘密和风险来支付报酬。

shopping:1.en: The market on Canal Row never closed. Vendors sold words as easily as food, and coded phrases changed hands like coins. I followed Zero into the crowd, watching his *shopping* — each item he picked up was a signal, a dead drop wrapped in ordinary life. Ali tagged behind, silent as rain.
shopping:1.cnHint: 调查员跟踪零点在夜市____，发现他挑选的每件商品都是某种暗号传递。
shopping:1.hook: Zero set down a jar, looked straight at me, and smiled.
shopping:1.line: 'His *shopping* list is not a list — it is a map.'

sentences.en: The market on Canal Row never closed.
sentences.cn: 运河街的市场从不关门。

sentences.en: Vendors sold words as easily as food, and coded phrases changed hands like coins.
sentences.cn: 小贩像卖食物一样卖信息，密码短语像硬币一样流转。

sentences.en: I followed Zero into the crowd, watching his *shopping* — each item he picked up was a signal, a dead drop wrapped in ordinary life.
Ali tagged behind, silent as rain.
sentences.cn: 阿栗无声地跟在后面，像雨一样无迹可寻。

tendency:1.en: Grey Crow pulled me under a bridge where coded graffiti covered every wall. 'Zero has a *tendency* to mark exits before he enters a place,' she said, tracing a symbol with one finger. I looked back at the alley we had just walked through. Every wall had been clean. Every single one.
tendency:1.cnHint: 灰鸦提醒调查员，零点有一种特殊的____——进入某地前会先标记出口。
tendency:1.hook: Which meant Zero had not entered yet — he was already inside.
tendency:1.line: 'His *tendency* to mark exits has just told us he is behind us.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow pulled me under a bridge where coded graffiti covered every wall.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把我拉到桥下，那里的每一面墙都被密码涂鸦覆盖。

sentences.en: 'Zero has a *tendency* to mark exits before he enters a place,' she said, tracing a symbol with one finger.
I looked back at the alley we had just walked through.
sentences.cn: 我回头看了看我们刚才走过的巷子。

sentences.en: Every wall had been clean.
sentences.cn: 每一面墙都干干净净的。

sentences.en: Every single one.
sentences.cn: 真的每一面都是。

tough:1.en: The road to the signal tower was *tough* — cracked stone, broken lights, and a wind that cut through every layer I wore. Ali moved ahead without complaint, her boots loud on the wet ground. Grey Crow had warned us: this path was designed to slow people down and make them turn back.
tough:1.cnHint: 通往信号塔的路十分____，狂风与破损路面让调查员举步维艰，但阿栗仍然毅然前行。
tough:1.hook: At the tower door, Ali stopped and whispered, 'Someone already opened this.'
tough:1.line: 'The road is *tough*, but whoever came before us did not slow down.'

sentences.en: The road to the signal tower was *tough* — cracked stone, broken lights, and a wind that cut through every layer I wore.
Ali moved ahead without complaint, her boots loud on the wet ground.
sentences.cn: 阿栗走在前面，毫无怨言，靴子踩在湿漉漉的地上声音很大。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned us: this path was designed to slow people down and make them turn back.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦警告过我们：这条路是为了让人慢下来、让人放弃而设计的。

tour:1.en: Grey Crow arranged a public *tour* of the Harbor City archive as our cover. Twenty people, bright badges, a bored guide. I drifted from the group and slipped into the sealed lower floor where Zero's old signal logs were stored. Forty seconds. I had forty seconds before the count came up short.
tour:1.cnHint: 调查员以参加档案馆____为掩护，趁机溜入封存区查阅零点的旧信号记录。
tour:1.hook: The guide's voice stopped mid-sentence, and footsteps turned toward the stairs.
tour:1.line: 'The *tour* is our only cover — do not leave the group for more than a minute.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow arranged a public *tour* of the Harbor City archive as our cover.
Twenty people, bright badges, a bored guide.
sentences.cn: 二十个人，明亮的徽章，一个厌倦的导游。

sentences.en: I drifted from the group and slipped into the sealed lower floor where Zero's old signal logs were stored.
sentences.cn: 我离开了团队，溜进了存放零点旧信号日志的密封下层。

sentences.en: Forty seconds.
sentences.cn: 四十秒。

sentences.en: I had forty seconds before the count came up short.
sentences.cn: 在人数不对之前我只有四十秒。

wake:1.en: I sat in the *wake* of the armored truck, close enough to catch the signal it dragged behind it like a tail. The encrypted broadcast lasted three seconds. Ali decoded four words: 'final move, midnight, roof.' Grey Crow had not told us about any roof. That silence felt deliberate.
wake:1.cnHint: 调查员跟在装甲车____中，捕获了一段加密广播，其中提到了一个灰鸦从未提起的屋顶。
wake:1.hook: Grey Crow's face, when I told her, showed something I had never seen: fear.
wake:1.line: 'Stay in the *wake* of the truck — the signal only carries this close.'

sentences.en: I sat in the *wake* of the armored truck, close enough to catch the signal it dragged behind it like a tail.
The encrypted broadcast lasted three seconds.
sentences.cn: 加密广播持续了三秒钟。

sentences.en: Ali decoded four words: 'final move, midnight, roof.'
sentences.cn: 阿栗破译出了四个字："最后一步，午夜，屋顶。"

sentences.en: Grey Crow had not told us about any roof.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦没有告诉我们任何关于屋顶的事。

sentences.en: That silence felt deliberate.
sentences.cn: 那种沉默感觉很有意图。

annual:1.en: The city posted its *annual* broadcast from the top of the data tower every January. This year the feed was forty seconds late. Forty seconds was enough for Zero to splice a hidden message into the stream — one only I could hear, a low hum beneath the official words: 'You are already too late.'
annual:1.cnHint: 城市每年一次的____广播延迟了四十秒，调查员在官方信号中听到了零点植入的隐秘声音。
annual:1.hook: The broadcast ended, but the hum did not stop.
annual:1.line: 'The *annual* feed is his best cover — no one watches the signal, they just hear it.'

sentences.en: The city posted its *annual* broadcast from the top of the data tower every January.
This year the feed was forty seconds late.
sentences.cn: 今年的信号延迟了四十秒。

sentences.en: Forty seconds was enough for Zero to splice a hidden message into the stream — one only I could hear, a low hum beneath the official words: 'You are already too late.'
sentences.cn: 四十秒足够零点在广播流中插入一条隐藏信息——只有我能听到，是官方词语下的低沉嗡鸣："你已经太晚了。"

charity:1.en: Zero's front was a street *charity* near the south dock, handing out warm food and signal-free radios to people with nowhere to go. I stood in line, hood low. The radio I received had one extra wire soldered inside. Ali confirmed it back at the safe house: it was a receiver, not a gift.
charity:1.cnHint: 零点以南码头的街头____为掩护，而调查员领到的"捐赠"收音机内竟藏有一根多余的导线。
charity:1.hook: Ali turned the radio over and found a frequency already locked in.
charity:1.line: 'His *charity* hands out ears — every radio on that street is listening.'

sentences.en: Zero's front was a street *charity* near the south dock, handing out warm food and signal-free radios to people with nowhere to go.
I stood in line, hood low.
sentences.cn: 我排队站着，帽檐压低。

sentences.en: The radio I received had one extra wire soldered inside.
sentences.cn: 我收到的收音机内部多焊了一根导线。

sentences.en: Ali confirmed it back at the safe house: it was a receiver, not a gift.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在安全屋里确认了：这是一个接收器，不是礼物。

strength:1.en: The signal came from the old port. Grey Crow had mapped every guard post along the wall. 'They pulled extra units from the south sector,' he said. 'The *strength* of their patrol here has doubled since last night.' I counted twelve moving lights in the rain. We had three. The numbers did not comfort me.
strength:1.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我，这一带敌方的____已经翻倍，我方只有三人。
strength:1.hook: Somewhere in the dark, a boot scraped stone — on our side of the wall.
strength:1.line: 'The *strength* of their patrol has doubled — we move only if I say.'

sentences.en: The signal came from the old port.
sentences.cn: 信号来自旧港口。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had mapped every guard post along the wall.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦绘制了墙边每个警卫岗位的位置。

sentences.en: 'They pulled extra units from the south sector,' he said.
sentences.cn: "他们从南区调派了额外的单位，"他说。

sentences.en: 'The *strength* of their patrol here has doubled since last night.'
I counted twelve moving lights in the rain.
sentences.cn: 我数了数雨中移动的十二盏灯。

sentences.en: We had three.
sentences.cn: 我们只有三盏。

sentences.en: The numbers did not comfort me.
sentences.cn: 这些数字让我没有半分安心。

survive:1.en: The flooded underpass smelled of rust and old code. Ali pulled me behind a broken signal post as a drone swept its light across the street. 'Stay flat,' she whispered. 'Anyone who moves will not *survive* the next scan.' The light passed. My heart did not slow down. A second drone was already turning the corner.
survive:1.cnHint: 阿栗警告我，任何移动的人都无法____下一次扫描。
survive:1.hook: The second drone stopped directly above us and held still.
survive:1.line: 'Move now and you will not *survive* the scan — trust me.'

sentences.en: The flooded underpass smelled of rust and old code.
sentences.cn: 被淹没的地下通道闻起来像锈和陈旧的代码。

sentences.en: Ali pulled me behind a broken signal post as a drone swept its light across the street.
sentences.cn: 阿栗拉着我躲在一个破损的信号杆后面，无人机的灯光扫过街道。

sentences.en: 'Stay flat,' she whispered.
sentences.cn: "趴下，"她低声说。

sentences.en: 'Anyone who moves will not *survive* the next scan.'
The light passed.
sentences.cn: 灯光扫过去了。

sentences.en: My heart did not slow down.
sentences.cn: 我的心跳没有放缓。

sentences.en: A second drone was already turning the corner.
sentences.cn: 第二架无人机已经转过了拐角。

touch:1.en: Zero had left a message burned into the pavement in acid ink — visible only to someone who could hear the frequency I heard. It was a single word. The *touch* of that coded signal on my mind felt like cold water, sharp and deliberate. He knew I would find it. He had written it for me alone.
touch:1.cnHint: 零点留下的暗号____到了我的感知，像冷水一样清晰，他是专门留给我的。
touch:1.hook: Below the word, a second line appeared — my own name.
touch:1.line: 'That *touch* of signal on your mind — Zero planned it from the start.'

sentences.en: Zero had left a message burned into the pavement in acid ink — visible only to someone who could hear the frequency I heard.
sentences.cn: 零点在柏油路上用酸性墨水烧出了一条信息——只有能听到我听到的频率的人才能看见。

sentences.en: It was a single word.
sentences.cn: 只有一个字。

sentences.en: The *touch* of that coded signal on my mind felt like cold water, sharp and deliberate.
He knew I would find it.
sentences.cn: 他知道我会找到它。

sentences.en: He had written it for me alone.
sentences.cn: 他是为我一个人写的。

trap:1.en: Grey Crow stopped at the edge of Neon Alley and held up one hand. 'The whole street is a *trap*,' he said quietly, eyes on the graffiti above the arch. The letters spelled a warning only we could read: DO NOT ENTER — SIGNAL LOCKED. Ali was already ten steps ahead. She had not seen it.
trap:1.cnHint: 灰鸦认出整条街都是个____，但阿栗已经走进去了。
trap:1.hook: The arch lights went red, and the gate at the far end slid shut.
trap:1.line: 'This street is a *trap* — every exit has been locked from above.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow stopped at the edge of Neon Alley and held up one hand.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在霓虹巷的边缘停下来，抬起一只手。

sentences.en: 'The whole street is a *trap*,' he said quietly, eyes on the graffiti above the arch.
The letters spelled a warning only we could read: DO NOT ENTER — SIGNAL LOCKED.
sentences.cn: 拱门上方的字母拼成了只有我们才能读懂的警告：禁止进入——信号锁定。

sentences.en: Ali was already ten steps ahead.
sentences.cn: 阿栗已经冲到前面十步远了。

sentences.en: She had not seen it.
sentences.cn: 她没有看到。

tv:1.en: The old broadcast tower still stood at the harbor edge, dead for fifty years. But tonight its single cracked screen glowed. A face appeared on the *tv* — Zero's face, live and sharp, looking straight into the camera. 'I know you are watching,' he said. He was not talking to the city. He was talking to me.
tv:1.cnHint: 废弃的____突然亮起，零点的脸出现在屏幕上，直视着镜头对我说话。
tv:1.hook: Behind Zero on the screen, I saw Ali's jacket hanging on a chair.
tv:1.line: 'Turn on any *tv* in the zone — my face will already be there.'

sentences.en: The old broadcast tower still stood at the harbor edge, dead for fifty years.
sentences.cn: 那座老广播塔还矗立在港口边缘，已经死了五十年。

sentences.en: But tonight its single cracked screen glowed.
sentences.cn: 但今晚它唯一的破裂屏幕亮了起来。

sentences.en: A face appeared on the *tv* — Zero's face, live and sharp, looking straight into the camera.
'I know you are watching,' he said.
sentences.cn: "我知道你在看，"他说。

sentences.en: He was not talking to the city.
sentences.cn: 他不是在对这座城市说话。

sentences.en: He was talking to me.
sentences.cn: 他是在对我说话。

victim:1.en: The name was carved into the base of the signal post: MIN-7, a code I recognized from the case file. The first *victim* of the language hack — a courier who had heard a forbidden broadcast and gone silent three days later. Now someone had marked this post with his code. A message, or a warning. I was not sure which.
victim:1.cnHint: 信号柱底部刻着第一个____的代号，有人特意把它留在这里。
victim:1.hook: My scanner picked up the same forbidden frequency — broadcasting right now.
victim:1.line: 'The first *victim* left a code here — someone wants us to read it.'

sentences.en: The name was carved into the base of the signal post: MIN-7, a code I recognized from the case file.
sentences.cn: 信号柱底部刻着一个名字：MIN-7，这是我从案卷里认出的代码。

sentences.en: The first *victim* of the language hack — a courier who had heard a forbidden broadcast and gone silent three days later.
Now someone had marked this post with his code.
sentences.cn: 现在有人用他的代码标记了这根柱子。

sentences.en: A message, or a warning.
sentences.cn: 一条信息，或者一个警告。

sentences.en: I was not sure which.
sentences.cn: 我不确定是哪一个。

zone:1.en: The city map divided Harbor City into six sectors, but the one we needed had no name on any official chart. Grey Crow called it the dead *zone* — a four-block area where signals died and cameras showed only static. 'Nothing that goes in comes back clean,' he said. The mission required us to go in anyway.
zone:1.cnHint: 灰鸦把那片没有名字的区域叫作死____，进去的信号都会消失。
zone:1.hook: As we crossed the boundary line, my earpiece gave one short burst of static — then silence.
zone:1.line: 'Welcome to the dead *zone* — your signal just went dark.'

sentences.en: The city map divided Harbor City into six sectors, but the one we needed had no name on any official chart.
sentences.cn: 城市地图把港城分成六个区域，但我们需要的那一个在任何官方图表上都没有名字。

sentences.en: Grey Crow called it the dead *zone* — a four-block area where signals died and cameras showed only static.
'Nothing that goes in comes back clean,' he said.
sentences.cn: "任何进去的东西都出不来干净，"他说。

sentences.en: The mission required us to go in anyway.
sentences.cn: 任务还是要求我们进去。

afraid:1.en: Ali handed me the decoded sheet without a word. I read it twice. The plan Zero had built was not *afraid* of our best move — it accounted for every route we had prepared, every signal trick Grey Crow had taught me. He had studied us. The paper shook slightly in my hand, and I realized the shaking was mine.
afraid:1.cnHint: 零点的计划对我们所有的准备都不____，他早已把我们研究透了。
afraid:1.hook: At the bottom of the sheet, in small letters, was tonight's date and our current address.
afraid:1.line: 'He is not *afraid* of anything we planned — he built this around us.'

sentences.en: Ali handed me the decoded sheet without a word.
sentences.cn: 阿栗没有说话就把解密后的纸递给了我。

sentences.en: I read it twice.
sentences.cn: 我读了两遍。

sentences.en: The plan Zero had built was not *afraid* of our best move — it accounted for every route we had prepared, every signal trick Grey Crow had taught me.
He had studied us.
sentences.cn: 他研究过我们。

sentences.en: The paper shook slightly in my hand, and I realized the shaking was mine.
sentences.cn: 纸在我手里微微颤抖，我意识到颤抖是我的。

couple:1.en: Rain hammered the bridge. A *couple* of coded signs had been painted on the railing overnight — two symbols, side by side, that Grey Crow said would never appear together unless the final message was live. Ali counted them twice. Both were there. The city held its breath around us.
couple:1.cnHint: 桥上出现了两个特殊暗号，灰鸦说它们同时出现意味着____的信号已激活。
couple:1.hook: Someone had been here minutes ago — the paint was still wet.
couple:1.line: 'A *couple* of signs together means the drop is tonight,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Rain hammered the bridge.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在桥上。
