grain:1.en: I knelt beside the storm drain. Under my light, every *grain* of pale dust along the curb formed a near-perfect line leading east — too clean to be wind, too thin to be sand. Someone had laid a dry chemical trail on purpose. I followed it three steps before the street lamp above me died.
grain:1.cnHint: 路边每一____粉末都指向东方，像是被人刻意留下的引路痕迹。
grain:1.hook: In the sudden dark, something moved at the far end of the trail.
grain:1.line: 'Each *grain* is a step — don't skip even one,' the static voice crackled in my ear.

sentences.en: I knelt beside the storm drain.
sentences.cn: 我跪在风水沟旁。

sentences.en: Under my light, every *grain* of pale dust along the curb formed a near-perfect line leading east — too clean to be wind, too thin to be sand.
Someone had laid a dry chemical trail on purpose.
sentences.cn: 有人故意在这儿撒了干燥的化学粉——太整齐了，不像风吹的，太细了，不像沙子。

sentences.en: I followed it three steps before the street lamp above me died.
sentences.cn: 我沿着痕迹走了三步，头顶的路灯就灭了。

implication:1.en: The spray-painted word on the harbour wall seemed innocent — just a number, 7. But Grey Crow had taught me its *implication*: seven meant a city official was already bought. Ali read it over my shoulder and went silent. We both understood. The operation was bigger than our unit had been told.
implication:1.cnHint: 墙上那个数字的____让我和阿栗意识到，有官员已被收买，整个行动远比想象的复杂。
implication:1.hook: Ali looked at me and said one word: 'Run.'
implication:1.line: 'You feel the *implication*, yes? Someone above us is already theirs,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The spray-painted word on the harbour wall seemed innocent — just a number, 7.
sentences.cn: 港湾墙上的喷漆字看起来很无害——只是个数字，7。

sentences.en: But Grey Crow had taught me its *implication*: seven meant a city official was already bought.
Ali read it over my shoulder and went silent.
sentences.cn: 阿栗从我肩膀后面读到这个，陷入了沉默。

sentences.en: We both understood.
sentences.cn: 我们都明白了。

sentences.en: The operation was bigger than our unit had been told.
sentences.cn: 这次行动的规模比我们收到的情报要大得多。

incredible:1.en: The signal strength was *incredible* — strong enough to burn through every scrambler on the block. I pressed against the wet wall and listened. Zero was broadcasting in open air, no encryption, no fear. That kind of confidence meant one thing: Zero already knew we were here and wanted us to hear every word.
incredible:1.cnHint: 那个____的信号强度让我意识到零点根本没有隐藏自己——他是故意让我们听到的。
incredible:1.hook: Then Zero said my name, slowly, like a question.
incredible:1.line: '*Incredible* signal, right? I left it open just for you,' Zero said.

sentences.en: The signal strength was *incredible* — strong enough to burn through every scrambler on the block.
I pressed against the wet wall and listened.
sentences.cn: 我贴着湿漉漉的墙，侧耳倾听。

sentences.en: Zero was broadcasting in open air, no encryption, no fear.
sentences.cn: 零点在空中直播，没有加密，毫无畏惧。

sentences.en: That kind of confidence meant one thing: Zero already knew we were here and wanted us to hear every word.
sentences.cn: 这种自信只能说明一件事：零点早就知道我们在这儿，想让我们听到每一个字。

net:1.en: Grey Crow had mapped the city's signal *net* on a torn paper sheet — every node a dot, every link a thin line. I unfolded it in the alley rain. Three nodes around the central tower formed a triangle. Whatever Zero was planning, it would cut the whole district dark in one move.
net:1.cnHint: 灰鸦绘制的信号____地图显示，零点只需切断三个节点就能让整个街区陷入黑暗。
net:1.hook: One of the three nodes was directly beneath my feet.
net:1.line: 'The *net* is his cage for us — we have to break one line before dawn,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow had mapped the city's signal *net* on a torn paper sheet — every node a dot, every link a thin line.
I unfolded it in the alley rain.
sentences.cn: 我在巷子里的雨中展开了地图。

sentences.en: Three nodes around the central tower formed a triangle.
sentences.cn: 中央塔周围的三个节点形成了一个三角形。

sentences.en: Whatever Zero was planning, it would cut the whole district dark in one move.
sentences.cn: 不管零点想做什么，一步就能切断整个区域的电力。

obtain:1.en: To *obtain* the override key, I had to reach the roof terminal before the clock tower struck three. Ali created a distraction at the south gate — loud, bright, just long enough. I hit the fire stairs at a run. The terminal light was green. Someone had been here already and left it unlocked on purpose.
obtain:1.cnHint: 为了____超控密钥，我趁阿栗制造混乱冲上屋顶，却发现终端早已被人刻意解锁。
obtain:1.hook: A single muddy boot print faced the wrong direction on the wet roof.
obtain:1.line: '*Obtain* the key first — ask questions after you are safe,' Ali called through the earpiece.

sentences.en: To *obtain* the override key, I had to reach the roof terminal before the clock tower struck three.
Ali created a distraction at the south gate — loud, bright, just long enough.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在南门制造了骚动——响、亮，时间刚刚好。

sentences.en: I hit the fire stairs at a run.
sentences.cn: 我冲上了疏散楼梯。

sentences.en: The terminal light was green.
sentences.cn: 终端的灯是绿色的。

sentences.en: Someone had been here already and left it unlocked on purpose.
sentences.cn: 有人比我早到了，故意把它解了锁。

pair:1.en: Pinned to the lamp post was a single glove. Not a lost glove — a signal. In Grey Crow's system, one glove meant its *pair* held the next clue, and the pair was always on a body, living or not. I scanned the crowd. Every hand in the neon-lit street was hidden in a pocket or a sleeve.
pair:1.cnHint: 路灯上的一只手套暗示它的____藏有下一条线索，而那只手套此刻戴在某个人手上。
pair:1.hook: Then one figure at the corner slowly raised a gloved right hand.
pair:1.line: 'Find the *pair* — whoever wears it is either your next contact or your next problem,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Pinned to the lamp post was a single glove.
sentences.cn: 一只手套被别在路灯杆上。

sentences.en: Not a lost glove — a signal.
sentences.cn: 不是遗失的手套——这是个信号。

sentences.en: In Grey Crow's system, one glove meant its *pair* held the next clue, and the pair was always on a body, living or not.
I scanned the crowd.
sentences.cn: 我扫过人群。

sentences.en: Every hand in the neon-lit street was hidden in a pocket or a sleeve.
sentences.cn: 街上每一双手都藏在口袋里或袖子里。

somewhat:1.en: Rain hammered the cracked street outside Sector Nine. Grey Crow handed me a folded map, its edges burned. 'Zero changed the drop point,' he said. I studied the new route. It looked *somewhat* safer than the last one, but my gut said otherwise. Nothing in Harbor City stayed safe for long.
somewhat:1.cnHint: 灰鸦交给叙述者一张地图，新路线____比之前好一点，但直觉让人不安。
somewhat:1.hook: A shadow peeled off the wall and began to follow.
somewhat:1.line: 'It looks *somewhat* better, but do not trust your eyes here.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the cracked street outside Sector Nine.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在第九区外的裂纹街道上。

sentences.en: Grey Crow handed me a folded map, its edges burned.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦递给我一张折叠的地图，边角被烧焦了。

sentences.en: 'Zero changed the drop point,' he said.
sentences.cn: "零点改了交接地点，"他说。

sentences.en: I studied the new route.
sentences.cn: 我研究了新的路线。

sentences.en: It looked *somewhat* safer than the last one, but my gut said otherwise.
Nothing in Harbor City stayed safe for long.
sentences.cn: 港城里没有什么能一直安全下去。

stable:1.en: Ali crouched behind a rusted cargo crate in the open freight yard, fingers on her scanner. 'Signal is *stable*,' she whispered. Steady green light. For once, something was holding. I exhaled. Across the yard, a door creaked open — the one that was supposed to be sealed from the inside.
stable:1.cnHint: 阿栗报告信号____，但封闭的大门突然从内部打开了。
stable:1.hook: Someone had been waiting inside that sealed room all along.
stable:1.line: 'The signal is *stable* — but that door should not move.'

sentences.en: Ali crouched behind a rusted cargo crate in the open freight yard, fingers on her scanner.
sentences.cn: 阿栗蹲在开阔货场里一个生锈的货柜后面，手指搭在扫描仪上。

sentences.en: 'Signal is *stable*,' she whispered.
Steady green light.
sentences.cn: 稳定的绿灯。

sentences.en: For once, something was holding.
sentences.cn: 总算有什么东西稳住了。

sentences.en: I exhaled.
sentences.cn: 我呼出了一口气。

sentences.en: Across the yard, a door creaked open — the one that was supposed to be sealed from the inside.
sentences.cn: 货场对面，一扇本该从内部锁死的门吱呀一声打开了。

persuade:1.en: Rain hammered the street outside the old signal tower. Grey Crow stood in the doorway, calm as stone. I needed him to open the locked channel, but he shook his head twice. I spent ten minutes laying out every reason I had. Finally, I managed to *persuade* him — he pulled a key from his coat and handed it over without a word.
persuade:1.cnHint: 叙述者费尽口舌，终于____了灰鸦打开那条加密频道。
persuade:1.hook: The key was warm — as if someone else had just held it.
persuade:1.line: 'You *persuade* me not with words, but with the signal you carry.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the street outside the old signal tower.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在旧信号塔外的街道上。

sentences.en: Grey Crow stood in the doorway, calm as stone.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦站在门口，稳得像块石头。

sentences.en: I needed him to open the locked channel, but he shook his head twice.
sentences.cn: 我需要他打开那条锁定的频道，但他摇了两次头。

sentences.en: I spent ten minutes laying out every reason I had.
sentences.cn: 我花了十分钟摆出我所有的理由。

sentences.en: Finally, I managed to *persuade* him — he pulled a key from his coat and handed it over without a word.

preference:1.en: Zero had left a coded message on the alley wall. Two routes glowed under my scanner — north through the market, or east past the dead towers. Ali checked both and shrugged. I knew Zero well enough: speed was always the *preference*. I chose east. The market lights vanished behind me, and the towers rose like broken teeth.
preference:1.cnHint: 叙述者根据零点的____，选择了向东的那条危险路线。
preference:1.hook: Something moved between the towers — and it was waiting.
preference:1.line: 'My *preference* is the path no one else dares to take.'

sentences.en: Zero had left a coded message on the alley wall.
sentences.cn: 零点在巷子的墙上留下了一条密码信息。

sentences.en: Two routes glowed under my scanner — north through the market, or east past the dead towers.
sentences.cn: 扫描仪下闪出两条路线——北边穿过市集，或者东边绕过那些死塔。

sentences.en: Ali checked both and shrugged.
sentences.cn: 阿栗查了两条都耸了耸肩。

sentences.en: I knew Zero well enough: speed was always the *preference*.
I chose east.
sentences.cn: 我选了东边。

sentences.en: The market lights vanished behind me, and the towers rose like broken teeth.
sentences.cn: 市集的灯火在身后消失，塔楼像碎裂的牙齿一样耸立起来。

reliable:1.en: The neon rain turned everything slick and orange. Ali handed me a small device — a signal reader, older than the city itself. 'Is it still good?' I asked. Ali nodded. In Harbor City, old tech was often more *reliable* than new; no one had coded traps into it yet. I clipped it to my collar and stepped into the fog.
reliable:1.cnHint: 阿栗给了叙述者一件旧设备，因为它比新技术更____。
reliable:1.hook: The device beeped once — a frequency that should not exist.
reliable:1.line: 'Old tools are *reliable* precisely because no one bothers to break them.'

sentences.en: The neon rain turned everything slick and orange.
sentences.cn: 霓虹雨把一切都染得湿漉漉的，闪烁着橙色。

sentences.en: Ali handed me a small device — a signal reader, older than the city itself.
sentences.cn: 阿栗递给我一个小装置——一台信号读取器，比这座城市还要古老。

sentences.en: 'Is it still good?'
sentences.cn: 我问。

sentences.en: I asked.
sentences.cn: 我问。

sentences.en: Ali nodded.
sentences.cn: 阿栗点了点头。

sentences.en: In Harbor City, old tech was often more *reliable* than new; no one had coded traps into it yet.
I clipped it to my collar and stepped into the fog.
sentences.cn: 我把它夹在领子上，踏进了雾里。

suspect:1.en: I moved through the night market, shoulders low. Coded paper lanterns swung overhead, each one hiding a byte of forbidden data. Grey Crow had warned me: someone in the crowd was watching. I began to *suspect* the woman selling signal-paper at the corner — she never looked at her goods, only at faces. I turned left. Fast.
suspect:1.cnHint: 叙述者在夜市中开始____那个卖信号纸的女人是线人。
suspect:1.hook: She turned left too — three seconds after me.
suspect:1.line: 'I *suspect* she already knows your name and your route.'

sentences.en: I moved through the night market, shoulders low.
sentences.cn: 我穿过夜间市集，肩膀压得很低。

sentences.en: Coded paper lanterns swung overhead, each one hiding a byte of forbidden data.
sentences.cn: 密码纸灯笼在头顶摇晃，每一盏都藏着一个字节的禁忌数据。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned me: someone in the crowd was watching.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦警告过我：人群里有人在盯梢。

sentences.en: I began to *suspect* the woman selling signal-paper at the corner — she never looked at her goods, only at faces.
I turned left.
sentences.cn: 我转身向左。

sentences.en: Fast.
sentences.cn: 很快。

yield:1.en: Zero had blocked every broadcast channel on the street. I ran three decryption passes. Nothing. Ali tried a fourth. Still nothing. Then Grey Crow pressed two fingers to the cracked wall panel and whispered a six-digit code. The panel gave a low hum. The channel began to *yield* its hidden traffic, word by word, into our earpieces.
yield:1.cnHint: 经过多次尝试，那条被封锁的频道终于开始____出隐藏的数据。
yield:1.hook: The first word decoded was my own name.
yield:1.line: 'Even the strongest lock must *yield* when you know the right silence.'

sentences.en: Zero had blocked every broadcast channel on the street.
sentences.cn: 零点封锁了街上的每一个广播频道。

sentences.en: I ran three decryption passes.
sentences.cn: 我跑了三遍解密程序。

sentences.en: Nothing.
sentences.cn: 什么都没有。

sentences.en: Ali tried a fourth.
sentences.cn: 阿栗试了第四遍。

sentences.en: Still nothing.
sentences.cn: 还是什么都没有。

sentences.en: Then Grey Crow pressed two fingers to the cracked wall panel and whispered a six-digit code.
sentences.cn: 然后灰鸦用两根手指按住裂开的墙板，低声说出了六位数密码。

sentences.en: The panel gave a low hum.
sentences.cn: 墙板发出了低沉的嗡鸣声。

sentences.en: The channel began to *yield* its hidden traffic, word by word, into our earpieces.

abandon:1.en: The safe house on Wire Street had gone dark. I reached the door and found it open, food still warm on the table. Grey Crow had told me to hold this position no matter what. But the signal reader screamed a red tone — a sweep was coming, sixty seconds out. I had to *abandon* the post and run before the net closed.
abandon:1.cnHint: 扫描警报逼近，叙述者不得不____据点，仓皇出逃。
abandon:1.hook: Behind me, the door clicked shut — from the inside.
abandon:1.line: 'We never *abandon* a post lightly — remember the cost of what we leave.'

sentences.en: The safe house on Wire Street had gone dark.
sentences.cn: 电线街上的安全屋已经熄灯了。

sentences.en: I reached the door and found it open, food still warm on the table.
sentences.cn: 我来到门前，发现门开着，桌上的食物还温热的。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told me to hold this position no matter what.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦告诉我无论如何都要守住这个位置。

sentences.en: But the signal reader screamed a red tone — a sweep was coming, sixty seconds out.
sentences.cn: 但信号读取器发出了红色的尖鸣——扫荡队六十秒后就要来。

sentences.en: I had to *abandon* the post and run before the net closed.

anxious:1.en: Grey Crow had not checked in for two hours. Ali paced the wet pavement, counting steps. I stood at the edge of the overpass, watching coded light pulse across the harbour. I was *anxious* — not the soft worry of waiting, but the hard, cold kind that tells you something has already gone wrong. Then my earpiece crackled once and went dead.
anxious:1.cnHint: 灰鸦失联两小时，叙述者感到极度____，预感大事不妙。
anxious:1.hook: The earpiece crackled again — in Zero's voice.
anxious:1.line: 'Stay *anxious*, rookie — the moment you relax is the moment they win.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow had not checked in for two hours.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦已经两小时没有报到了。

sentences.en: Ali paced the wet pavement, counting steps.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在湿漉漉的人行道上踱步，数着步子。

sentences.en: I stood at the edge of the overpass, watching coded light pulse across the harbour.
sentences.cn: 我站在高架桥边缘，看着密码灯光在港口脉冲般闪烁。

sentences.en: I was *anxious* — not the soft worry of waiting, but the hard, cold kind that tells you something has already gone wrong.
Then my earpiece crackled once and went dead.
sentences.cn: 然后我的耳机吱呀一声，彻底没声了。

assess:1.en: The intersection of Cable and Fourth was covered in fresh graffiti — each tag a fragment of an encrypted address. I crouched beside a rusted post and began to *assess* the pattern: color, angle, stroke order, all of it data. Ali kept watch. After ninety seconds I had the address. It pointed directly to the harbor's sealed grid.
assess:1.cnHint: 叙述者蹲在路口，仔细____涂鸦中隐藏的加密信息。
assess:1.hook: The sealed grid had been officially empty for eleven years.
assess:1.line: '*Assess* the marks quickly — they repaint this wall every dawn.'

sentences.en: The intersection of Cable and Fourth was covered in fresh graffiti — each tag a fragment of an encrypted address.
sentences.cn: 电缆街和第四大道的交叉口覆满了新鲜的涂鸦——每一个标签都是一个密码地址的碎片。

sentences.en: I crouched beside a rusted post and began to *assess* the pattern: color, angle, stroke order, all of it data.
Ali kept watch.
sentences.cn: 阿栗守望。

sentences.en: After ninety seconds I had the address.
sentences.cn: 九十秒后我破译了地址。

sentences.en: It pointed directly to the harbor's sealed grid.
sentences.cn: 它直指港口的密闭网格区。

consultant:1.en: Rain hammered the street market. Grey Crow pulled me behind a stall. 'That man,' he whispered, pointing at a figure in a grey coat, 'is no trader. He is a *consultant* hired by Zero — someone paid to find weak points in our network.' The figure turned slowly toward us.
consultant:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在街市认出了一个被零点雇来的____，对方正慢慢转身。
consultant:1.hook: His eyes found mine before I could move.
consultant:1.line: 'A *consultant* never works alone — watch the rooftops.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the street market.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在街市上。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pulled me behind a stall.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把我拉到了一个摊位后面。

sentences.en: 'That man,' he whispered, pointing at a figure in a grey coat, 'is no trader.
sentences.cn: "那个人，"他指着一个穿灰色大衣的身影，低声说，"不是商人。

sentences.en: He is a *consultant* hired by Zero — someone paid to find weak points in our network.'
The figure turned slowly toward us.
sentences.cn: 那身影慢慢向我们转过来。

direct:1.en: Ali grabbed my arm at the crossing. The coded billboard above us flickered — a *direct* signal meant only for us, no relay, no middleman. 'Zero is close,' she said. Puddles reflected neon red. Somewhere behind the crowd, a door slammed. We had maybe thirty seconds.
direct:1.cnHint: 阿栗和我在路口收到了一条____信号，意识到零点就在附近。
direct:1.hook: The billboard went dark before I could read the last word.
direct:1.line: 'This is a *direct* warning — Zero already knows our position.'

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my arm at the crossing.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在十字路口抓住了我的手臂。

sentences.en: The coded billboard above us flickered — a *direct* signal meant only for us, no relay, no middleman.
'Zero is close,' she said.
sentences.cn: "零点很近，"她说。

sentences.en: Puddles reflected neon red.
sentences.cn: 水洼倒映着霓虹红光。

sentences.en: Somewhere behind the crowd, a door slammed.
sentences.cn: 人群后面的某处，一扇门砰地关上了。

sentences.en: We had maybe thirty seconds.
sentences.cn: 我们最多还有三十秒。

discourage:1.en: Painted words covered the underpass wall: NO SIGNAL HERE. Grey Crow said the city authority put them there to *discourage* anyone from using hidden radio bands in public spaces. Ali traced the letters with one finger and smiled. 'Funny,' she said. 'Fear only works on people who have something to lose.'
discourage:1.cnHint: 通道墙上的标语试图____人们使用隐秘频道，但阿栗并不在乎。
discourage:1.hook: Then the painted letters began to glow faint green.
discourage:1.line: 'They *discourage* us so we stop looking — that tells me we are close.'

sentences.en: Painted words covered the underpass wall: NO SIGNAL HERE.
sentences.cn: 下穿通道的墙上涂满了字：此处无信号。

sentences.en: Grey Crow said the city authority put them there to *discourage* anyone from using hidden radio bands in public spaces.
Ali traced the letters with one finger and smiled.
sentences.cn: 阿栗用一根手指描着那些字母，笑了。

sentences.en: 'Funny,' she said.
sentences.cn: "滑稽，"她说。

sentences.en: 'Fear only works on people who have something to lose.'
sentences.cn: "恐惧只对有东西可失去的人有效。"

essentially:1.en: We stood at the edge of the floating market. Grey Crow spoke low: 'This whole district is *essentially* a server farm hidden under canal water — every vendor, every lamp post, every bridge wire carries encrypted data.' I stared at the quiet boats. Nothing looked like a machine. Everything was.
essentially:1.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我，这片水上市场____是一个隐藏的数据中心。
essentially:1.hook: A lamp post beside me let out one soft, mechanical click.
essentially:1.line: 'It is *essentially* a trap — built to look ordinary, designed to catch you.'

sentences.en: We stood at the edge of the floating market.
sentences.cn: 我们站在浮动市集的边缘。

sentences.en: Grey Crow spoke low: 'This whole district is *essentially* a server farm hidden under canal water — every vendor, every lamp post, every bridge wire carries encrypted data.'
I stared at the quiet boats.
sentences.cn: 我盯着那些静谧的船。

sentences.en: Nothing looked like a machine.
sentences.cn: 看不出任何机器的样子。

sentences.en: Everything was.
sentences.cn: 但一切都是机器。

extent:1.en: Ali spread a hand-drawn map on a wet crate. The marked zone stretched six city blocks. 'We did not know the *extent* of Zero's network until now,' she said quietly. Rain erased the ink at the edges even as she spoke. The centre of the map showed one building — and it was already circled in red.
extent:1.cnHint: 阿栗的地图显示出了零点网络的____，核心建筑已被标红。
extent:1.hook: The red circle was still wet — drawn no more than an hour ago.
extent:1.line: 'The *extent* of his reach surprises even me — and I have been watching him for years.'

sentences.en: Ali spread a hand-drawn map on a wet crate.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在湿漉漉的板条箱上铺开了手绘地图。

sentences.en: The marked zone stretched six city blocks.
sentences.cn: 标记的区域延伸了六个街区。

sentences.en: 'We did not know the *extent* of Zero's network until now,' she said quietly.
Rain erased the ink at the edges even as she spoke.
sentences.cn: 雨把边缘的墨迹冲掉了，她还在说话的时候。

sentences.en: The centre of the map showed one building — and it was already circled in red.
sentences.cn: 地图的中心显示了一栋楼——已经被红圈标出来了。

finance:1.en: A cracked screen on the corner shop looped a public notice: all independent broadcasts require city *finance* approval, signed and sealed. Grey Crow read it once and laughed, a short cold sound. 'Zero wrote that rule,' he said. 'Control the money, control the voice.' Traffic noise swallowed his last word.
finance:1.cnHint: 街角的公告要求广播必须获得____审批，灰鸦说这条规则出自零点之手。
finance:1.hook: The notice changed without warning to a single flashing question mark.
finance:1.line: 'Without *finance* approval, your signal is illegal — Zero made sure of that.'

sentences.en: A cracked screen on the corner shop looped a public notice: all independent broadcasts require city *finance* approval, signed and sealed.
Grey Crow read it once and laughed, a short cold sound.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦读了一遍，冷冷地笑了一声。

sentences.en: 'Zero wrote that rule,' he said.
sentences.cn: "零点写的那条规则，"他说。

sentences.en: 'Control the money, control the voice.'
sentences.cn: "控制金钱，就控制了声音。"

sentences.en: Traffic noise swallowed his last word.
sentences.cn: 交通噪音吞没了他的最后一个字。

freedom:1.en: Ali stopped beside a painted bird on a concrete pillar. Its wings were open wide. 'Every cell in this network tags that image,' she said, 'because *freedom* is the word they cannot encrypt — it means the same thing in every code.' A car rolled slowly past. The driver's window was already down.
freedom:1.cnHint: 街柱上的涂鸦图案象征着____，是整个网络无法加密的词。
freedom:1.hook: The car did not stop — but a folded note landed at my feet.
freedom:1.line: '*Freedom* is the one word Zero has never been able to silence.'

sentences.en: Ali stopped beside a painted bird on a concrete pillar.
sentences.cn: 阿栗停在一根混凝土柱子上的彩绘鸟旁边。

sentences.en: Its wings were open wide.
sentences.cn: 它的翅膀张得很开。

sentences.en: 'Every cell in this network tags that image,' she said, 'because *freedom* is the word they cannot encrypt — it means the same thing in every code.'
A car rolled slowly past.
sentences.cn: 一辆车缓缓驶过。

sentences.en: The driver's window was already down.
sentences.cn: 司机的车窗已经摇了下来。

highlight:1.en: Grey Crow pointed at the digital news board above the market gate. One line of text pulsed brighter than the rest — a deliberate *highlight* buried in a routine weather report. 'That is our meeting point,' he said. Ali read it and went pale. I read it next. It was my own name.
highlight:1.cnHint: 新闻栏中有一行刻意____的文字，内容竟然是我的名字。
highlight:1.hook: Someone had known we would be standing here, reading this, right now.
highlight:1.line: 'Grey Crow always said to *highlight* the signal — not hide it — so they fear you.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow pointed at the digital news board above the market gate.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦指向市场大门上方的数字新闻板。

sentences.en: One line of text pulsed brighter than the rest — a deliberate *highlight* buried in a routine weather report.
'That is our meeting point,' he said.
sentences.cn: "那是我们的碰头点，"他说。

sentences.en: Ali read it and went pale.
sentences.cn: 阿栗读了一眼，脸色苍白。

sentences.en: I read it next.
sentences.cn: 接着我读了。

sentences.en: It was my own name.
sentences.cn: 是我自己的名字。

vigorous:1.en: Rain hammered the street outside the signal tower. I pressed my ear to the wall and caught it — a *vigorous* pulse beating inside the encrypted broadcast, too strong to be background noise. Ali grabbed my sleeve. 'That rhythm,' she said. 'It's a countdown.' Somewhere above us, boots scraped concrete.
vigorous:1.cnHint: 我在信号塔外听到加密广播中藏着一个____的脉冲节拍，阿栗说那是倒计时。
vigorous:1.hook: The boots stopped directly above our heads.
vigorous:1.line: 'That signal is too *vigorous* to be random noise — someone is driving it.'

sentences.en: Rain hammered the street outside the signal tower.
sentences.cn: 雨敲打着信号塔外的街道。

sentences.en: I pressed my ear to the wall and caught it — a *vigorous* pulse beating inside the encrypted broadcast, too strong to be background noise.
Ali grabbed my sleeve.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了我的袖子。

sentences.en: 'That rhythm,' she said.
sentences.cn: "那个节奏，"她说。

sentences.en: 'It's a countdown.'
sentences.cn: "是个倒计时。"

sentences.en: Somewhere above us, boots scraped concrete.
sentences.cn: 我们上方某处，靴子踩过混凝土。

wide:1.en: The market street stretched *wide* under a ceiling of neon signs, every surface tagged with coded graffiti I had learned to read. Zero had been here. His mark — three slashed circles — was still fresh on the east pillar. Ali scanned the crowd. 'He left this for you,' she said quietly.
wide:1.cnHint: 在____的霓虹街道上，我发现零点刚留下的暗号标记。
wide:1.hook: Then the mark began to glow.
wide:1.line: 'Cast your eyes *wide* — his next tag could be anywhere on this block.'

sentences.en: The market street stretched *wide* under a ceiling of neon signs, every surface tagged with coded graffiti I had learned to read.
Zero had been here.
sentences.cn: 零点曾在这里。

sentences.en: His mark — three slashed circles — was still fresh on the east pillar.
sentences.cn: 他的标记——三道划过的圆圈——在东边柱子上还很新鲜。

sentences.en: Ali scanned the crowd.
sentences.cn: 阿栗扫过人群。

sentences.en: 'He left this for you,' she said quietly.
sentences.cn: "他留这个给你的，"她轻声说。

agriculture:1.en: The coded poster showed rows of dead crops under a black sun — a symbol the underground used for *agriculture* networks that grew illegal data instead of food. I had seen this image once before, in Grey Crow's files. Ali pointed to the fine print at the bottom. It was a frequency. A live one.
agriculture:1.cnHint: 海报上的____暗语指向一个种植违禁数据的地下网络，细字处藏着一个活跃频率。
agriculture:1.hook: My earpiece crackled and went silent.
agriculture:1.line: 'They use *agriculture* as cover — every seed crate hides a signal node.'

sentences.en: The coded poster showed rows of dead crops under a black sun — a symbol the underground used for *agriculture* networks that grew illegal data instead of food.
I had seen this image once before, in Grey Crow's files.
sentences.cn: 我以前见过这张图，在灰鸦的文件里。

sentences.en: Ali pointed to the fine print at the bottom.
sentences.cn: 阿栗指向底部的小字。

sentences.en: It was a frequency.
sentences.cn: 那是一个频率。

sentences.en: A live one.
sentences.cn: 一个活的。

assign:1.en: Grey Crow appeared at the mouth of the alley, coat soaked through. 'I came to *assign* you a new route,' he said, pushing a folded card into my hand. 'Zero has eyes on the main road.' The card was blank until rain touched it. Words rose from the surface, then faded in three seconds.
assign:1.cnHint: 灰鸦出现在小巷口，____给我一条新路线，纸卡上的字遇水才显现。
assign:1.hook: The last word I read was my own name.
assign:1.line: 'I *assign* this route to you alone — trust no one who knows it.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow appeared at the mouth of the alley, coat soaked through.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦出现在小巷口，外套湿透了。

sentences.en: 'I came to *assign* you a new route,' he said, pushing a folded card into my hand.
'Zero has eyes on the main road.'
sentences.cn: "零点在监视主干道。"

sentences.en: The card was blank until rain touched it.
sentences.cn: 那张卡片一开始是空白的，直到雨水触到它。

sentences.en: Words rose from the surface, then faded in three seconds.
sentences.cn: 字迹浮现出来，三秒后消褪。

broad:1.en: The *broad* slope of the overpass was covered end to end in shifting light — projection graffiti cycling through forbidden phrases so fast that only someone like me could catch them. I read three words before the cycle reset. They spelled a location. Ali was already moving toward it.
broad:1.cnHint: 宽阔的天桥斜面上投影着违禁词语，我在循环重置前读到三个字，拼出了一个地点。
broad:1.hook: Ali stopped at the edge and looked down.
broad:1.line: 'Stay low on the *broad* side — the city cameras have full view there.'

sentences.en: The *broad* slope of the overpass was covered end to end in shifting light — projection graffiti cycling through forbidden phrases so fast that only someone like me could catch them.
I read three words before the cycle reset.
sentences.cn: 我在周期重置前读了三个字。

sentences.en: They spelled a location.
sentences.cn: 它们拼成一个地点。

sentences.en: Ali was already moving toward it.
sentences.cn: 阿栗已经朝那里移动了。

careful:1.en: I moved along the wall, each step *careful* on the wet tiles, listening for the hidden signal buried in the street noise. Zero had booby-trapped the frequency last time, and one wrong move would flood my earpiece with a scream of white noise. Ali watched from the doorway, fingers crossed.
careful:1.cnHint: 我____地沿湿滑墙壁前行，试图分辨零点在街道噪音中藏下的信号。
careful:1.hook: A soft click sounded under my left foot.
careful:1.line: 'Be *careful* with that channel — Zero laced it with a noise trap.'

sentences.en: I moved along the wall, each step *careful* on the wet tiles, listening for the hidden signal buried in the street noise.
Zero had booby-trapped the frequency last time, and one wrong move would flood my earpiece with a scream of white noise.
sentences.cn: 零点上次在频率上装了陷阱，一步错就会让我的耳机充满尖啸的白噪音。

sentences.en: Ali watched from the doorway, fingers crossed.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在门口看着，双手交叉。

combination:1.en: The lock on the signal box required a *combination* of a spoken word and a tapped rhythm — language and pulse working together, the way all things in Harbor City worked. Grey Crow had drilled me on it for a week. My voice steadied. I tapped. The box clicked open — and then an alarm I had never heard began to sound.
combination:1.cnHint: 信号箱需要声音与节奏____才能打开，我成功解锁后却触发了一个陌生的警报。
combination:1.hook: The alarm was not from the box.
combination:1.line: 'The *combination* of voice and rhythm is the only key — get both right.'

sentences.en: The lock on the signal box required a *combination* of a spoken word and a tapped rhythm — language and pulse working together, the way all things in Harbor City worked.
Grey Crow had drilled me on it for a week.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦花了一周时间给我训练。

sentences.en: My voice steadied.
sentences.cn: 我的声音平稳了下来。

sentences.en: I tapped.
sentences.cn: 我敲了敲。

sentences.en: The box clicked open — and then an alarm I had never heard began to sound.
sentences.cn: 盒子咔哒一声打开——然后一个我从未听过的警报声开始鸣响。

constant:1.en: The street outside was *constant* noise — vendors, drones, coded arguments bouncing off wet walls — but under all of it I heard one clean tone, holding steady. Grey Crow had told me to find that tone. Ali leaned close. 'You've got it, haven't you,' she said. It was not a question. Zero's broadcast was live.
constant:1.cnHint: 在街头____的喧嚣之下，我终于听到了那个稳定的单音，零点的广播正在直播。
constant:1.hook: The tone shifted pitch, and began to speak.
constant:1.line: 'That *constant* hum beneath the noise — that is what we have been tracking.'

sentences.en: The street outside was *constant* noise — vendors, drones, coded arguments bouncing off wet walls — but under all of it I heard one clean tone, holding steady.
Grey Crow had told me to find that tone.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦告诉我要找到那个音。

sentences.en: Ali leaned close.
sentences.cn: 阿栗靠近了。

sentences.en: 'You've got it, haven't you,' she said.
sentences.cn: "你听到了，是不是，"她说。

sentences.en: It was not a question.
sentences.cn: 这不是疑问句。

sentences.en: Zero's broadcast was live.
sentences.cn: 零点的广播已经开始了。

himself:1.en: The rain hammered the old bridge. Zero stood at its centre, alone. He had come *himself*, no allies, no backup — just a coat and a cold stare. I watched from the shadow of a broken lamp post. Grey Crow had warned me: when Zero moves in person, the trap is already set.
himself:1.cnHint: 零点亲自出现在桥上，叙述者意识到这可能是一个____的陷阱。
himself:1.hook: The bridge had only one way out, and Zero was blocking it.
himself:1.line: 'I came *himself* — no tricks, no crew. Just talk.'

sentences.en: The rain hammered the old bridge.
sentences.cn: 雨敲打着老桥。

sentences.en: Zero stood at its centre, alone.
sentences.cn: 零点独自站在桥中央。

sentences.en: He had come *himself*, no allies, no backup — just a coat and a cold stare.
I watched from the shadow of a broken lamp post.
sentences.cn: 我从一根破损灯柱的阴影里看着。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned me: when Zero moves in person, the trap is already set.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦警告过我：当零点亲自出动时，陷阱已经布好了。

landscape:1.en: From the rooftop access ladder I finally pulled myself up and looked out. The *landscape* of Harbor City stretched below: neon signs bleeding colour into wet streets, towers wrapped in fog, coded billboards flashing warnings no civilian could read. Somewhere in that maze, Ali was waiting for my signal.
landscape:1.cnHint: 叙述者爬上屋顶，望见城市____，试图找到阿栗的位置。
landscape:1.hook: Then one billboard went dark — the exact one Ali had marked on the map.
landscape:1.line: 'Look at this *landscape* — every light down there is a lie.'

sentences.en: From the rooftop access ladder I finally pulled myself up and looked out.
sentences.cn: 我终于从顶层的梯子爬上来，向外看去。

sentences.en: The *landscape* of Harbor City stretched below: neon signs bleeding colour into wet streets, towers wrapped in fog, coded billboards flashing warnings no civilian could read.
Somewhere in that maze, Ali was waiting for my signal.
sentences.cn: 在那迷宫般的城市某处，阿栗在等我的信号。

mentally:1.en: Ali and I crouched behind a market stall as patrol drones swept the alley. I ran the route *mentally* — three turns, a locked gate, the old cable-car platform. If my count was right, we had forty seconds. If it was wrong, we had none. Ali tapped my arm: 'Ready?'
mentally:1.cnHint: 叙述者在脑海中____推演逃跑路线，时间只剩四十秒。
mentally:1.hook: The drone's red eye swung back, slower this time, as if it had noticed us.
mentally:1.line: 'I mapped it all *mentally* — trust me, I know every step.'

sentences.en: Ali and I crouched behind a market stall as patrol drones swept the alley.
sentences.cn: 巡逻无人机扫过小巷时，阿栗和我蜷缩在市集摊位后。

sentences.en: I ran the route *mentally* — three turns, a locked gate, the old cable-car platform.
If my count was right, we had forty seconds.
sentences.cn: 如果我的计算没错，我们还有四十秒。

sentences.en: If it was wrong, we had none.
sentences.cn: 如果算错了，就一秒都没有。

sentences.en: Ali tapped my arm: 'Ready?'
sentences.cn: 阿栗拍了拍我的手臂："准备好了吗？"

neither:1.en: Grey Crow met me at the crossroads and slid a data card across the wet pavement. '*Neither* the east tunnel nor the harbour gate is safe,' she said quietly. I looked both ways. Every route I had planned was now closed. The city had folded around me like a trap with no exit.
neither:1.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉叙述者____两条路都不安全，所有退路似乎都被封死了。
neither:1.hook: Grey Crow was already gone before I could ask her which way she had come.
neither:1.line: '*Neither* path is clear — they sealed both ends an hour ago.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow met me at the crossroads and slid a data card across the wet pavement. '*Neither* the east tunnel nor the harbour gate is safe,' she said quietly.
I looked both ways.
sentences.cn: 我向两边看了看。

sentences.en: Every route I had planned was now closed.
sentences.cn: 我计划的每条路线现在都被封死了。

sentences.en: The city had folded around me like a trap with no exit.
sentences.cn: 这座城市像一个没有出口的陷阱一样围困了我。

onto:1.en: I sprinted across the rain-slicked plaza and jumped *onto* the low wall that divided it from the freight yard. The impact shook my legs but I kept moving. Below, Zero's agents fanned out, flashlight beams cutting white lines through the dark. One beam climbed the wall — inches from my boots.
onto:1.cnHint: 叙述者跳____低墙逃入货运场，零点的手下紧随其后。
onto:1.hook: The beam stopped moving, and for one second the whole yard went silent.
onto:1.line: 'Get *onto* that wall and don't look down — move now!'

sentences.en: I sprinted across the rain-slicked plaza and jumped *onto* the low wall that divided it from the freight yard.
The impact shook my legs but I kept moving.
sentences.cn: 冲击力震动了我的腿，但我没有停下。

sentences.en: Below, Zero's agents fanned out, flashlight beams cutting white lines through the dark.
sentences.cn: 下面，零点的特务们展开搜索，手电筒的光在黑暗中划出白色的直线。

sentences.en: One beam climbed the wall — inches from my boots.
sentences.cn: 一束光爬上了城墙——距离我的靴子只有几英寸。

plus:1.en: Grey Crow handed me a slim device. 'Signal range: four city blocks, *plus* a coded pulse that jams their trackers for sixty seconds,' she said. Sixty seconds. I turned the device over in my hand. It was small enough to hide in a coat pocket and heavy enough to feel serious.
plus:1.cnHint: 灰鸦给了叙述者一个设备，____它还能干扰追踪器六十秒。
plus:1.hook: She did not mention what would happen the moment those sixty seconds ran out.
plus:1.line: 'Four blocks of range, *plus* sixty seconds of cover — use them well.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow handed me a slim device.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦递给我一个纤薄的装置。

sentences.en: 'Signal range: four city blocks, *plus* a coded pulse that jams their trackers for sixty seconds,' she said.
Sixty seconds.
sentences.cn: 六十秒。

sentences.en: I turned the device over in my hand.
sentences.cn: 我在手中翻转着这个装置。

sentences.en: It was small enough to hide in a coat pocket and heavy enough to feel serious.
sentences.cn: 它小得足以藏在大衣口袋里，沉得足以感受到它的分量。

root:1.en: Ali found the signal tower at the edge of the old market. She pressed her hand against the base. 'The *root* of every broadcast in this district runs through here,' she said. A single cut and the coded warnings would go silent — and so would every alarm protecting Zero's hideout.
root:1.cnHint: 阿栗发现信号塔是整个区域广播的____，切断它就能让零点的藏身处失去保护。
root:1.hook: A footstep crunched on gravel behind us — someone else had found the tower too.
root:1.line: 'This tower is the *root* — cut it and everything they built falls.'

sentences.en: Ali found the signal tower at the edge of the old market.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在老市集的边缘找到了信号塔。

sentences.en: She pressed her hand against the base.
sentences.cn: 她把手按在塔的底座上。

sentences.en: 'The *root* of every broadcast in this district runs through here,' she said.
A single cut and the coded warnings would go silent — and so would every alarm protecting Zero's hideout.
sentences.cn: 只要切断一处，编码的警告就会沉寂——零点藏身处的每一个警报也会随之消音。

satisfy:1.en: Zero stepped out of the shadow at the far end of the street and spread his hands wide. 'Come on,' he called. 'Nothing you have found will *satisfy* the people above me. They want more — and they will keep coming.' I did not answer. I pressed record on the device in my pocket.
satisfy:1.cnHint: 零点声称叙述者所掌握的证据不足以____幕后之人，但叙述者已悄悄开始录音。
satisfy:1.hook: The device in my pocket blinked once — it had already captured every word.
satisfy:1.line: 'Nothing you carry will *satisfy* them — they always ask for more.'

sentences.en: Zero stepped out of the shadow at the far end of the street and spread his hands wide.
sentences.cn: 零点从街道那头的影子里走出来，张开双手。

sentences.en: 'Come on,' he called.
sentences.cn: 他喊道，来吧。

sentences.en: 'Nothing you have found will *satisfy* the people above me.
They want more — and they will keep coming.'
sentences.cn: 他们还会继续来。

sentences.en: I did not answer.
sentences.cn: 我没有回答。

sentences.en: I pressed record on the device in my pocket.
sentences.cn: 我按下了口袋里设备的录音键。

invite:2.en: A sealed card arrived at my desk before dawn. No sender name, just a cold instruction: report to Sub-level Nine at midnight. Grey Crow stepped from the shadows. 'They *invite* only those they plan to silence,' he said. The card began to dissolve in my fingers.
invite:2.cnHint: 一张神秘卡片____我去地下九层，灰鸦警告这是危险的召唤。
invite:2.hook: The card was gone, but the address burned in my mind.
invite:2.line: 'They *invite* only those they plan to silence.'

sentences.en: A sealed card arrived at my desk before dawn.
sentences.cn: 天亮前一张密封的卡片送到了我的桌上。

sentences.en: No sender name, just a cold instruction: report to Sub-level Nine at midnight.
sentences.cn: 没有寄件人的名字，只有冷冰冰的指令：午夜时分到第九地下层报到。

sentences.en: Grey Crow stepped from the shadows.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦从阴影中走出来。

sentences.en: 'They *invite* only those they plan to silence,' he said.
The card began to dissolve in my fingers.
sentences.cn: 这张卡片在我的指尖开始溶解。

million:2.en: Zero's voice cut through the static. 'One *million* encrypted credits, transferred the moment you hand over the signal core.' I stared at the device in my palm — small, cold, worth more than ten years of my life. Ali grabbed my arm and shook her head slowly.
million:2.cnHint: 零点开出____信用点的高价收买我，阿栗示意我不要答应。
million:2.hook: My fingers tightened around the core, and I said nothing.
million:2.line: 'One *million* credits — think carefully before you say no.'

sentences.en: Zero's voice cut through the static.
sentences.cn: 零点的声音穿过静电噪音传来。

sentences.en: 'One *million* encrypted credits, transferred the moment you hand over the signal core.'
I stared at the device in my palm — small, cold, worth more than ten years of my life.
sentences.cn: 我盯着手心里的装置——小小的、冷冷的、值得我十年的生命。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my arm and shook her head slowly.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住我的手臂，缓缓摇了摇头。

represent:2.en: The coded graffiti covered the entire tunnel wall. Grey Crow traced one symbol with his finger. 'Each mark here *represents* a person who disappeared,' he said quietly. I counted thirty-seven marks. The newest one was still wet, its red paint running down the concrete like a wound.
represent:2.cnHint: 隧道墙上的涂鸦每一个符号都____一个失踪的人，最新的一个墨迹未干。
represent:2.hook: The thirty-eighth space on the wall was blank — and waiting.
represent:2.line: 'Each mark *represents* someone the city chose to forget.'

sentences.en: The coded graffiti covered the entire tunnel wall.
sentences.cn: 编码的涂鸦覆盖了整条隧道的墙壁。

sentences.en: Grey Crow traced one symbol with his finger.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦用手指追踪了其中一个符号。

sentences.en: 'Each mark here *represents* a person who disappeared,' he said quietly.
I counted thirty-seven marks.
sentences.cn: 我数了数，一共三十七个标记。

sentences.en: The newest one was still wet, its red paint running down the concrete like a wound.
sentences.cn: 最新的一个还没干，红色的油漆像伤口一样沿着混凝土流淌下来。

surprise:2.en: Ali slid a folded document across the table without a word. I opened it and felt cold. My own name was listed as a primary suspect in Zero's network. The *surprise* hit me like a fist — I had been framed before the operation even started. Every move I made was already expected.
surprise:2.cnHint: 阿栗给我看一份文件，里面的内容让我大为____——我已被人陷害。
surprise:2.hook: Someone had written my name in that file weeks ago.
surprise:2.line: 'Your *surprise* tells me you still trust the wrong people.'

sentences.en: Ali slid a folded document across the table without a word.
sentences.cn: 阿栗无言地把一份折叠的文件推过桌面。

sentences.en: I opened it and felt cold.
sentences.cn: 我打开它，感到一阵寒意。

sentences.en: My own name was listed as a primary suspect in Zero's network.
sentences.cn: 我的名字被列为零点网络中的主要嫌疑人。

sentences.en: The *surprise* hit me like a fist — I had been framed before the operation even started.
Every move I made was already expected.
sentences.cn: 我做的每一步都已经被预料到了。

topic:2.en: The underground broadcast switched on at exactly 03:00. A flat, altered voice announced the *topic* for the night: 'The location of the signal core.' My stomach dropped. This was not a random transmission — someone was guiding every listener in Harbor City straight toward me.
topic:2.cnHint: 深夜广播宣布当晚的____直指信号核心的下落，矛头指向了我。
topic:2.hook: Every receiver in the city had just been told where I stood.
topic:2.line: 'When the *topic* is your life, choose your words with care.'

sentences.en: The underground broadcast switched on at exactly 03:00.
sentences.cn: 地下广播在凌晨三点整打开了。

sentences.en: A flat, altered voice announced the *topic* for the night: 'The location of the signal core.'
My stomach dropped.
sentences.cn: 我的胃一沉。

sentences.en: This was not a random transmission — someone was guiding every listener in Harbor City straight toward me.
sentences.cn: 这不是一次随机的广播——有人在引导港口市的每一位听众直奔我而来。

meat:2.en: The night market stall was our agreed meeting point. Ali was late. I bought a stick of grilled *meat* from the vendor and waited, watching the crowd. A child bumped into me and pressed a folded note into my hand, then vanished between the neon-lit stalls before I could react.
meat:2.cnHint: 我在夜市摊位等待阿栗时，一个孩子悄悄塞给我一张纸条后消失了。
meat:2.hook: The note had only four words: 'Do not look back.'
meat:2.line: 'Eat your *meat* and act normal — they are watching.'

sentences.en: The night market stall was our agreed meeting point.
sentences.cn: 夜市摊位是我们约定的见面地点。

sentences.en: Ali was late.
sentences.cn: 阿栗迟到了。

sentences.en: I bought a stick of grilled *meat* from the vendor and waited, watching the crowd.
A child bumped into me and pressed a folded note into my hand, then vanished between the neon-lit stalls before I could react.
sentences.cn: 一个小孩撞了我一下，把一张折叠的纸条塞进我手里，然后在霓虹灯闪烁的摊位间消失了，我根本反应不过来。

drink:2.en: Grey Crow set two cups on the table in the safe house. 'You should *drink*,' he said. 'The next few hours will ask everything of you.' I wrapped my hands around the cup. Outside, the rain intensified, hammering the thin walls, and somewhere in the dark a door opened that should have been locked.
drink:2.cnHint: 灰鸦让我____点东西，为接下来的行动做准备，此时门外传来异响。
drink:2.hook: Someone had a key to a room only we were supposed to know about.
drink:2.line: '*Drink* — cold hands make slow decisions, and we have no time.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow set two cups on the table in the safe house.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在安全屋的桌子上放了两杯茶。

sentences.en: 'You should *drink*,' he said.
'The next few hours will ask everything of you.'
sentences.cn: "接下来的几个小时会把你逼到极限。"

sentences.en: I wrapped my hands around the cup.
sentences.cn: 我用两只手握住杯子。

sentences.en: Outside, the rain intensified, hammering the thin walls, and somewhere in the dark a door opened that should have been locked.
sentences.cn: 外面雨势更猛了，敲打着薄薄的墙壁，黑暗中某个本不该开启的门吱呀一声打开了。

sleep:2.en: Forty-eight hours without *sleep* and the signals were starting to blur. I pressed my back against the cold server rack and forced my eyes open. Ali's voice came through the earpiece: 'Grey Crow is not responding.' A single cursor blinked on the screen in front of me, waiting for a code I no longer remembered.
sleep:2.cnHint: 我已两天没有____，灰鸦失联，屏幕上的光标在等待一个我忘记的密码。
sleep:2.hook: If I typed the wrong code, the whole operation would vanish.
sleep:2.line: 'No *sleep* until we know Grey Crow is still alive.'

sentences.en: Forty-eight hours without *sleep* and the signals were starting to blur.
I pressed my back against the cold server rack and forced my eyes open.
sentences.cn: 我把后背贴着冰冷的服务器架，强行睁大眼睛。

sentences.en: Ali's voice came through the earpiece: 'Grey Crow is not responding.'
sentences.cn: 阿栗的声音从耳机里传来："灰鸦没有回应。"

sentences.en: A single cursor blinked on the screen in front of me, waiting for a code I no longer remembered.
sentences.cn: 我面前屏幕上一个光标在闪烁，等待一个我已经记不清的代码。

shop:2.en: The rain hit the street like static. Grey Crow led me down a narrow lane to a small *shop* wedged between two dead terminals. Its window displayed old data chips and cracked signal keys — the kind of place nobody remembered existed. 'This is where Zero left the drop,' Grey Crow said.
shop:2.cnHint: 灰鸦带我来到一家隐蔽的____，据说零点曾在此留下情报。
shop:2.hook: Behind the counter, the owner's eyes said he was expecting someone else.
shop:2.line: 'This *shop* sells more than chips — it sells silence.'

sentences.en: The rain hit the street like static.
sentences.cn: 雨砸在街道上，像一阵静电噪音。

sentences.en: Grey Crow led me down a narrow lane to a small *shop* wedged between two dead terminals.
Its window displayed old data chips and cracked signal keys — the kind of place nobody remembered existed.
sentences.cn: 窗口里摆着老旧的数据芯片和碎裂的信号钥匙——那种没人记得存在过的地方。

sentences.en: 'This is where Zero left the drop,' Grey Crow said.
sentences.cn: "这就是零点留下的落地点，"灰鸦说。

electronic:2.en: Ali spread the parts across the wet floor: wires, a cracked lens, and one *electronic* core still humming with stolen signal. It was no ordinary device. Someone had built it to intercept the city's forbidden broadcasts and store every word. I pressed my ear close and heard Zero's voice.
electronic:2.cnHint: 阿栗发现了一个仍在运作的____装置，里面储存着零点的声音。
electronic:2.hook: The signal it held was dated three hours from now.
electronic:2.line: 'This *electronic* core has been listening longer than we have.'

sentences.en: Ali spread the parts across the wet floor: wires, a cracked lens, and one *electronic* core still humming with stolen signal.
It was no ordinary device.
sentences.cn: 这不是什么普通的装置。

sentences.en: Someone had built it to intercept the city's forbidden broadcasts and store every word.
sentences.cn: 有人把它造出来，就是为了截取城市禁播的信号，把每一个字都存下来。

sentences.en: I pressed my ear close and heard Zero's voice.
sentences.cn: 我把耳朵贴近，听到了零点的声音。

wild:2.en: The coded graffiti on the bridge wall had gone *wild* overnight — symbols layered over symbols, a frantic message nobody could decode at a glance. Ali said it looked like fear. Grey Crow said it looked like a warning. I stepped closer and felt the signal beneath the paint begin to pulse.
wild:2.cnHint: 桥墙上的涂鸦变得____而混乱，隐藏着一条无人能轻易破解的信息。
wild:2.hook: One symbol at the center kept changing, as if someone was still writing.
wild:2.line: 'When a signal goes this *wild*, someone is running out of time.'

sentences.en: The coded graffiti on the bridge wall had gone *wild* overnight — symbols layered over symbols, a frantic message nobody could decode at a glance.
Ali said it looked like fear.
sentences.cn: 阿栗说看起来像恐惧。

sentences.en: Grey Crow said it looked like a warning.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说看起来像一个警告。

sentences.en: I stepped closer and felt the signal beneath the paint begin to pulse.
sentences.cn: 我往前靠了靠，感觉到油漆下的信号开始脉动。

rich:2.en: The old archive room beneath the port was *rich* with data — layer upon layer of encrypted logs going back forty years. Most were locked. One was not. Ali's hands shook as she opened it. Inside was a single file named after me, created long before I joined the force.
rich:2.cnHint: 港口地下档案室里____含着大量数据，其中一个文件令阿栗震惊。
rich:2.hook: The file had been accessed once before — yesterday at midnight.
rich:2.line: 'A room this *rich* with secrets never stays hidden for long.'

sentences.en: The old archive room beneath the port was *rich* with data — layer upon layer of encrypted logs going back forty years.
Most were locked.
sentences.cn: 大部分被锁了。

sentences.en: One was not.
sentences.cn: 有一个没有。

sentences.en: Ali's hands shook as she opened it.
sentences.cn: 阿栗打开它时，手在发抖。

sentences.en: Inside was a single file named after me, created long before I joined the force.
sentences.cn: 里面只有一个文件，用我的名字命名，创建时间远早于我加入部队的日期。

special:2.en: Grey Crow handed me a *special* key card — matte black, no markings, warm to the touch as if it had just been used. He said Zero had left it at the east gate and walked away without looking back. I turned it over. A single frequency was etched into its edge.
special:2.cnHint: 灰鸦交给我一张____的门卡，零点曾在东门将其遗留。
special:2.hook: The frequency matched the one locked inside my own signal receiver.
special:2.line: 'Zero only leaves a *special* key when the door matters.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow handed me a *special* key card — matte black, no markings, warm to the touch as if it had just been used.
He said Zero had left it at the east gate and walked away without looking back.
sentences.cn: 他说零点在东门留下了它，然后头也不回地走了。

sentences.en: I turned it over.
sentences.cn: 我翻转了一下。

sentences.en: A single frequency was etched into its edge.
sentences.cn: 一串单独的频率刻在了它的边缘。

text:2.en: The *text* carved into the tunnel wall was short — seven words — but every letter buzzed with a live signal I could feel in my teeth. Ali read it aloud once, then went silent. Grey Crow took a photo and deleted it immediately. I memorized it before he could stop me.
text:2.cnHint: 隧道墙上刻着一段____，短短七个字却带着令人不安的信号。
text:2.hook: Grey Crow's hands were trembling as he put his phone away.
text:2.line: 'Read the *text* once, then forget it — for your own good.'

sentences.en: The *text* carved into the tunnel wall was short — seven words — but every letter buzzed with a live signal I could feel in my teeth.
Ali read it aloud once, then went silent.
sentences.cn: 阿栗读出声来一遍，然后沉默了。

sentences.en: Grey Crow took a photo and deleted it immediately.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦拍了张照片，立刻删掉了。

sentences.en: I memorized it before he could stop me.
sentences.cn: 我在他阻止我之前就全背下来了。

front:2.en: We reached the *front* of the Signal Court building just as the lights cut to red. The doors were sealed. A notice had been fixed to the glass — official stamp, zero explanation. Ali read it twice and stepped back. Grey Crow had warned us this place would close before we arrived.
front:2.cnHint: 我们赶到信号法庭____时，大门已被封锁，通告上没有任何解释。
front:2.hook: Through the glass, a single light still moved on the floor above.
front:2.line: 'Meet me at the *front* gate — and do not let them see your face.'

sentences.en: We reached the *front* of the Signal Court building just as the lights cut to red.
The doors were sealed.
sentences.cn: 门被封死了。

sentences.en: A notice had been fixed to the glass — official stamp, zero explanation.
sentences.cn: 玻璃上贴了一张通知——官方印章，没有任何解释。

sentences.en: Ali read it twice and stepped back.
sentences.cn: 阿栗读了两遍，往后退了退。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned us this place would close before we arrived.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦早就警告过我们这个地方会在我们到达前关闭。

law:2.en: A broadcast crackled through the alley speakers — a cold voice reading out a new *law*: any person found carrying unregistered signal keys would be detained without question. Ali grabbed my arm. The key Grey Crow had given me was still in my coat pocket, warm and very much unregistered.
law:2.cnHint: 广播中宣读了一条新____，而我口袋里的东西恰好触犯了它。
law:2.hook: At the end of the alley, a patrol drone turned its lens toward us.
law:2.line: 'They passed the *law* an hour ago — which means they knew we were coming.'

sentences.en: A broadcast crackled through the alley speakers — a cold voice reading out a new *law*: any person found carrying unregistered signal keys would be detained without question.
Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了我的手臂。

sentences.en: The key Grey Crow had given me was still in my coat pocket, warm and very much unregistered.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦给我的那把钥匙还在我的外套口袋里，温热的，而且完全没有注册过。

thinking:2.en: Ali slid a data chip across the wet table. 'Grey Crow left this before he vanished,' she said. I pressed it into my reader. His *thinking* was recorded in raw text — every doubt, every dead end, every name he was afraid to write. The last entry stopped mid-sentence.
thinking:2.cnHint: 灰鸦失踪前留下了一块芯片，里面存着他所有的____。
thinking:2.hook: The final word in the file was my name.
thinking:2.line: 'His *thinking* is all in there — read it before Zero does.'

sentences.en: Ali slid a data chip across the wet table.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把一块数据芯片滑过湿漉漉的桌子。

sentences.en: 'Grey Crow left this before he vanished,' she said.
sentences.cn: "灰鸦在消失前留下了这个，"她说。

sentences.en: I pressed it into my reader.
sentences.cn: 我把它插进了读取器。

sentences.en: His *thinking* was recorded in raw text — every doubt, every dead end, every name he was afraid to write.
The last entry stopped mid-sentence.
sentences.cn: 最后一条记录在中间就停下了。

cover:2.en: The drop point was a news kiosk on Level 7. Ali had hidden the drive behind a stack of print sheets. The top sheet was a *cover* story — fake headlines, fake dates, fake city. But the ink was still wet, and someone had already read it.
cover:2.cnHint: 线报藏在报摊里，表面上是一篇假新闻作为____。
cover:2.hook: The wet ink meant someone had been here less than ten minutes ago.
cover:2.line: 'That *cover* story bought us maybe one hour — move now.'

sentences.en: The drop point was a news kiosk on Level 7.
sentences.cn: 暗点就在七层的新闻报亭。

sentences.en: Ali had hidden the drive behind a stack of print sheets.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把那个芯片藏在一摞印刷纸后面。

sentences.en: The top sheet was a *cover* story — fake headlines, fake dates, fake city.
But the ink was still wet, and someone had already read it.
sentences.cn: 但墨迹还没干，已经有人读过了。

earth:2.en: Deep in the server tunnels beneath Harbor City, the walls were raw *earth* — soil and stone older than the neon above. Grey Crow had told me to dig here. I found a sealed box, cold and heavy, buried at exactly the depth he described.
earth:2.cnHint: 调查员在地下隧道的____里，找到了灰鸦藏下的密封箱。
earth:2.hook: Inside the box was a key — and a list of names I recognised.
earth:2.line: 'Dig into the *earth* at marker nine. Trust nothing above it.'

sentences.en: Deep in the server tunnels beneath Harbor City, the walls were raw *earth* — soil and stone older than the neon above.
Grey Crow had told me to dig here.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦告诉我要在这里挖。

sentences.en: I found a sealed box, cold and heavy, buried at exactly the depth he described.
sentences.cn: 我找到了一个密封的盒子，冷冰冰的，沉甸甸的，就埋在他说的那个深度。

paper:2.en: Zero left a single sheet of *paper* on the archive table — no data, no code, just ink on an old white sheet. It read: 'You are already too late.' I turned it over. On the back, in tiny script, were twelve numbers I had seen before.
paper:2.cnHint: 零点只留下一张____，上面的字让调查员背脊发凉。
paper:2.hook: Those twelve numbers matched the lock on Grey Crow's private channel.
paper:2.line: 'One sheet of *paper* — and it tells us everything Zero wants us to know.'

sentences.en: Zero left a single sheet of *paper* on the archive table — no data, no code, just ink on an old white sheet.
It read: 'You are already too late.'
sentences.cn: 上面写着："你已经太晚了。"

sentences.en: I turned it over.
sentences.cn: 我翻过纸张。

sentences.en: On the back, in tiny script, were twelve numbers I had seen before.
sentences.cn: 背面用细小的笔迹写着十二个数字，都是我见过的。

art:2.en: The message was hidden in a street mural — that was Grey Crow's *art*, turning paint into code. I stood in the rain and read the colours as letters. Slowly, an address appeared. Ali grabbed my arm before I could write it down.
art:2.cnHint: 灰鸦把信息藏进了壁画里，这是他独特的____。
art:2.hook: Ali whispered that someone behind us was reading the same mural.
art:2.line: 'The *art* is the message — every colour is a letter, start from the left.'

sentences.en: The message was hidden in a street mural — that was Grey Crow's *art*, turning paint into code.
I stood in the rain and read the colours as letters.
sentences.cn: 我站在雨里，把颜色当字母来读。

sentences.en: Slowly, an address appeared.
sentences.cn: 慢慢地，一个地址浮现了出来。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my arm before I could write it down.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在我来得及记下来之前就抓住了我的胳膊。

street:2.en: The file named a single location: a dead *street* in the old port district, number blocked out, timestamp set for midnight. I knew that road — it flooded every night and the cameras there had been dark for a year. Ali said she would not go alone.
street:2.cnHint: 文件里只有一个地点：一条废弃的____，时间定在午夜。
street:2.hook: Midnight was forty minutes away and we still had no plan.
street:2.line: 'That *street* has been off the map for a reason — someone keeps it that way.'

sentences.en: The file named a single location: a dead *street* in the old port district, number blocked out, timestamp set for midnight.
I knew that road — it flooded every night and the cameras there had been dark for a year.
sentences.cn: 我认得那条路——它每晚都会进水，那里的摄像头已经黑了一整年。

sentences.en: Ali said she would not go alone.
sentences.cn: 阿栗说她不会一个人去。

talent:2.en: Grey Crow had trained Ali himself. Her *talent* was not combat or code — it was listening. She could pull a signal out of static that no machine caught. In the archive room, she went still, raised one hand, and said: 'Someone is broadcasting right now, from inside this building.'
talent:2.cnHint: 阿栗有一种特殊的____，能从杂音中捕捉到别人听不见的信号。
talent:2.hook: The broadcast was on a frequency only investigators were supposed to know.
talent:2.line: 'Her *talent* is real — she heard Zero's signal before any of our systems did.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow had trained Ali himself.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦亲自训练过阿栗。

sentences.en: Her *talent* was not combat or code — it was listening.
She could pull a signal out of static that no machine caught.
sentences.cn: 她能从静电噪音里拽出任何机器都捕不到的信号。

sentences.en: In the archive room, she went still, raised one hand, and said: 'Someone is broadcasting right now, from inside this building.'
sentences.cn: 在档案室里，她突然静止不动，抬起一只手，说："有人正在从这栋楼里面广播。"

meaning:2.en: The old data chip Grey Crow handed me looked blank. But when I pressed it against the signal reader, letters burned across the screen — a message hidden in dead code. The *meaning* of those words hit me like cold water: someone inside the city grid had been waiting for us.
meaning:2.cnHint: 灰鸦交给我一块芯片，其中隐藏的____让我震惊不已。
meaning:2.hook: The name at the bottom of the message was mine.
meaning:2.line: 'The *meaning* of this code will change everything you think you know.'

sentences.en: The old data chip Grey Crow handed me looked blank.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦递给我的那块老芯片看起来是空白的。

sentences.en: But when I pressed it against the signal reader, letters burned across the screen — a message hidden in dead code.
sentences.cn: 但我把它贴在信号读取器上时，字母在屏幕上燃烧般浮现——一条隐藏在死代码里的信息。

sentences.en: The *meaning* of those words hit me like cold water: someone inside the city grid had been waiting for us.

strengthen:2.en: Ali had spent three nights rebuilding the signal net in our safe room. Each new layer of encryption would *strengthen* our position against Zero's jamming attacks. She taped the last wire and looked up. 'Done,' she said quietly. Outside, the neon rain kept falling.
strengthen:2.cnHint: 阿栗连续三夜重建信号网络，目的是____我们的防御。
strengthen:2.hook: Then every screen in the room went dark at once.
strengthen:2.line: 'We need to *strengthen* the outer channel before Zero finds this node.'

sentences.en: Ali had spent three nights rebuilding the signal net in our safe room.
sentences.cn: 阿栗花了三个晚上在我们的安全屋里重建信号网。

sentences.en: Each new layer of encryption would *strengthen* our position against Zero's jamming attacks.
She taped the last wire and looked up.
sentences.cn: 她贴上最后一根电线，抬起头。

sentences.en: 'Done,' she said quietly.
sentences.cn: "搞定了，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: Outside, the neon rain kept falling.
sentences.cn: 外面，霓虹雨还在不断坠落。

competitive:2.en: Zero's crew controlled three of the five broadcast towers. The black market for clean signal was fierce and *competitive*, with dozens of small operators undercutting each other by the hour. Grey Crow said the only way to win was not to play by those rules. I was starting to understand what he meant.
competitive:2.cnHint: Harbor City的信号黑市竞争激烈，灰鸦认为我们不能按____的规则出牌。
competitive:2.hook: Grey Crow slid a folded map across the table and said nothing.
competitive:2.line: 'This market is too *competitive* — the real game is played somewhere else.'

sentences.en: Zero's crew controlled three of the five broadcast towers.
sentences.cn: 零点的人控制了五座广播塔中的三座。

sentences.en: The black market for clean signal was fierce and *competitive*, with dozens of small operators undercutting each other by the hour.
Grey Crow said the only way to win was not to play by those rules.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说唯一赢的办法就是不按那些规则玩。

sentences.en: I was starting to understand what he meant.
sentences.cn: 我开始明白他的意思了。

recently:2.en: The graffiti on the lower dock wall had changed. I had walked past it a hundred times, but *recently* someone had added a small circle above the third letter — a sign Grey Crow once told me meant 'emergency drop.' Ali checked her watch. The circle was still wet.
recently:2.cnHint: 码头墙上的涂鸦____被人动过了手脚，留下了紧急信号。
recently:2.hook: Footsteps echoed from the far end of the dock, getting closer.
recently:2.line: 'Someone *recently* left a mark here — they wanted us to find it fast.'

sentences.en: The graffiti on the lower dock wall had changed.
sentences.cn: 下码头的墙上的涂鸦变了。

sentences.en: I had walked past it a hundred times, but *recently* someone had added a small circle above the third letter — a sign Grey Crow once told me meant 'emergency drop.'
Ali checked her watch.
sentences.cn: 阿栗看了看表。

sentences.en: The circle was still wet.
sentences.cn: 那个圆圈还是湿的。

nation:2.en: The broadcast began with a single word: silence. Then a voice filled my earpiece, calm and flat. 'Every *nation* that tried to own language ended up losing it,' it said. I recognized the voice. It was Grey Crow — speaking on a channel he told me he had destroyed months ago.
nation:2.cnHint: 我在耳机里听到灰鸦的声音，他谈到了____与语言控制的关系。
nation:2.hook: The channel code matched a frequency listed as permanently dead.
nation:2.line: 'A *nation* that controls words controls minds — that is Zero's real plan.'

sentences.en: The broadcast began with a single word: silence.
sentences.cn: 广播以一个词开始：寂静。

sentences.en: Then a voice filled my earpiece, calm and flat.
sentences.cn: 然后一个声音充满了我的耳机，平静而冷漠。

sentences.en: 'Every *nation* that tried to own language ended up losing it,' it said.
I recognized the voice.
sentences.cn: 我认出了那个声音。

sentences.en: It was Grey Crow — speaking on a channel he told me he had destroyed months ago.
sentences.cn: 是灰鸦——在他几个月前告诉我已经销毁的频道上说话。

perceive:2.en: Most people in Harbor City could not *perceive* the thin signal layer beneath the public feed — a ghost network, always there, never seen. I heard it as a low hum behind my left ear. Ali called it my one useful talent. Tonight the hum had turned into words, and the words were an address.
perceive:2.cnHint: 我能____到普通人感知不到的隐藏信号层，今晚它变成了一个地址。
perceive:2.hook: The address pointed to a building that city records said did not exist.
perceive:2.line: 'Can you *perceive* the second layer? It is transmitting right now.'

sentences.en: Most people in Harbor City could not *perceive* the thin signal layer beneath the public feed — a ghost network, always there, never seen.
I heard it as a low hum behind my left ear.
sentences.cn: 我听到了左耳后的低鸣。

sentences.en: Ali called it my one useful talent.
sentences.cn: 阿栗说这是我唯一有用的天赋。

sentences.en: Tonight the hum had turned into words, and the words were an address.
sentences.cn: 今晚那嗡鸣变成了词语，词语是一个地址。

pound:2.en: The server room door was sealed with a magnetic lock, but the lock was old. Ali said one sharp *pound* on the lower corner would reset its timer. She was right. The door clicked open. Inside, on a single desk under a blue light, sat a data drive labeled with tomorrow's date.
pound:2.cnHint: 阿栗告诉我用力____一下门角，老旧的磁力锁就会重置。
pound:2.hook: The drive was still warm, as if someone had just set it down.
pound:2.line: 'One hard *pound* on that corner — the old lock cannot take it.'

sentences.en: The server room door was sealed with a magnetic lock, but the lock was old.
sentences.cn: 服务器室的门用磁力锁封着，不过这把锁已经很旧了。

sentences.en: Ali said one sharp *pound* on the lower corner would reset its timer.
She was right.
sentences.cn: 她说对了。

sentences.en: The door clicked open.
sentences.cn: 门咔地打开了。

sentences.en: Inside, on a single desk under a blue light, sat a data drive labeled with tomorrow's date.
sentences.cn: 里面单独的书桌下亮着蓝光，桌上放着一个标注了明天日期的数据驱动器。

purpose:2.en: Zero had left a message burned into the wall of the empty relay station: a single sentence in plain text, no code, no encryption. 'You still do not know my *purpose*,' it read. Grey Crow studied it for a long moment, then turned to me with an expression I had never seen on his face before — something close to fear.
purpose:2.cnHint: 零点留下的明文信息让灰鸦第一次露出了接近恐惧的表情，因为我们还不懂他的____。
purpose:2.hook: Grey Crow whispered, 'We have been solving the wrong problem all along.'
purpose:2.line: 'You still do not know my *purpose* — and that is exactly how I need it.'

sentences.en: Zero had left a message burned into the wall of the empty relay station: a single sentence in plain text, no code, no encryption.
sentences.cn: 零点在空荡荡的中继站墙上烧进了一条信息——一句白文本，没有密码，没有加密。

sentences.en: 'You still do not know my *purpose*,' it read.
Grey Crow studied it for a long moment, then turned to me with an expression I had never seen on his face before — something close to fear.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦盯着看了很久，然后转向我，脸上是我从未见过的表情——接近恐惧。

satisfaction:2.en: The old server room smelled of burnt wire and cold rain. I found the hidden drive behind a loose panel — exactly where Grey Crow said it would be. A quiet *satisfaction* settled in my chest as my fingers closed around it. The data inside could end Zero's operation tonight.
satisfaction:2.cnHint: 调查员找到了隐藏的驱动器，内心感到深深的____。
satisfaction:2.hook: Then the door behind me clicked open.
satisfaction:2.line: 'Finding the right piece brings its own *satisfaction*,' Grey Crow had warned me.

sentences.en: The old server room smelled of burnt wire and cold rain.
sentences.cn: 旧服务器室里弥漫着烧焦的电线味和冷雨的气息。

sentences.en: I found the hidden drive behind a loose panel — exactly where Grey Crow said it would be.
sentences.cn: 我在松动的面板后面找到了隐藏的驱动器——正好是灰鸦说的位置。

sentences.en: A quiet *satisfaction* settled in my chest as my fingers closed around it.
The data inside could end Zero's operation tonight.
sentences.cn: 里面的数据今晚就能瓦解零点的整个行动。

cultivate:2.en: Ali slid a folded note across the wet bench. 'Zero spent years trying to *cultivate* loyal followers inside the Signal Bureau,' she said, voice low. The rain hissed on the neon signs above us. Each name on the list was a seed Zero had planted deep in the city's nervous system.
cultivate:2.cnHint: 阿栗透露零点花了多年时间____自己在信号局内的忠实追随者。
cultivate:2.hook: One of those names was someone I trusted completely.
cultivate:2.line: 'It takes patience to *cultivate* a network no one can see,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Ali slid a folded note across the wet bench.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把一张折叠的纸条推过湿漉漉的长椅。

sentences.en: 'Zero spent years trying to *cultivate* loyal followers inside the Signal Bureau,' she said, voice low.
The rain hissed on the neon signs above us.
sentences.cn: 霓虹灯招牌上的雨声嘶鸣。

sentences.en: Each name on the list was a seed Zero had planted deep in the city's nervous system.
sentences.cn: 名单上的每个名字都是零点在这座城市神经系统深处埋下的种子。

productive:2.en: Grey Crow and I spent three hours sorting through intercepted code fragments in the back of a dark repair shop. It was slow, careful work. By midnight we had mapped four hidden relay points — a *productive* night by any measure. Ali was waiting outside with news that changed everything.
productive:2.cnHint: 调查员和灰鸦度过了一个富有____的夜晚，绘制出四个隐秘中继点。
productive:2.hook: Ali's face told me the news was not good.
productive:2.line: 'Three hours, four leads — I call that a *productive* night,' Grey Crow said quietly.

sentences.en: Grey Crow and I spent three hours sorting through intercepted code fragments in the back of a dark repair shop.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦和我在一家黑漆漆的维修店后间花了三小时整理拦截的代码碎片。

sentences.en: It was slow, careful work.
sentences.cn: 这是缓慢而谨慎的工作。

sentences.en: By midnight we had mapped four hidden relay points — a *productive* night by any measure.
Ali was waiting outside with news that changed everything.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在外面等着，带来了能改变一切的消息。

vision:2.en: The stolen lens from Zero's lab could decode light-based messages hidden in Harbor City's neon grid. Grey Crow called it a *vision* device — it did not just help you see; it showed you a future that Zero had already planned for the city, written in forbidden color frequencies.
vision:2.cnHint: 那个镜片装置给了调查员一种特殊的____，让他看见零点为城市规划的隐秘未来。
vision:2.hook: What I saw through it made my hands go cold.
vision:2.line: 'This device is more than sight — it is *vision*,' Grey Crow whispered.

sentences.en: The stolen lens from Zero's lab could decode light-based messages hidden in Harbor City's neon grid.
sentences.cn: 从零点实验室偷来的镜片能破译隐藏在港口城霓虹网格里的光学信息。

sentences.en: Grey Crow called it a *vision* device — it did not just help you see; it showed you a future that Zero had already planned for the city, written in forbidden color frequencies.

distance:2.en: The signal was coming from the far docks, at least two kilometers out. I could feel the coded pulse even across that *distance*, a low hum at the edge of my hearing. Ali checked her tracker and nodded. Zero had moved the transmitter again, but not far enough.
distance:2.cnHint: 即使隔着遥远的____，调查员也能感受到来自码头的编码脉冲信号。
distance:2.hook: The tracker blinked once, then went dark.
distance:2.line: 'Even at this *distance* I can hear it,' I told Ali.

sentences.en: The signal was coming from the far docks, at least two kilometers out.
sentences.cn: 信号来自远码头，至少两公里外。

sentences.en: I could feel the coded pulse even across that *distance*, a low hum at the edge of my hearing.
Ali checked her tracker and nodded.
sentences.cn: 阿栗检查了她的追踪器，点了点头。

sentences.en: Zero had moved the transmitter again, but not far enough.
sentences.cn: 零点又挪了发射器，但还不够远。

forward:2.en: Grey Crow laid the city map flat on the table and pressed one finger to a point near the eastern wall. 'We move *forward* from here,' he said. 'Zero expects us to pull back.' The plan was risky and the path was narrow, but every other road had already been cut off.
forward:2.cnHint: 灰鸦指着地图上的某点，坚持认为调查小组应该继续____推进。
forward:2.hook: Ali studied the route and said nothing for a long moment.
forward:2.line: 'The only safe choice now is to push *forward*,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow laid the city map flat on the table and pressed one finger to a point near the eastern wall.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把城市地图平铺在桌子上，一根手指按在东墙附近的一个点。

sentences.en: 'We move *forward* from here,' he said.
'Zero expects us to pull back.'
sentences.cn: 零点预计我们会后退。

sentences.en: The plan was risky and the path was narrow, but every other road had already been cut off.
sentences.cn: 计划很冒险，路也很窄，但其他所有道路都已经被切断了。

harmful:2.en: Ali decoded the broadcast in under a minute. The signal was not an attack — it was a warning, wrapped in layers of noise. 'The words Zero is hiding are *harmful* to the Bureau itself,' she said. Someone high up had been feeding Zero secrets for years, and the proof was right here.
harmful:2.cnHint: 阿栗解码后发现，零点隐藏的信息对信号局本身是____的。
harmful:2.hook: The name at the end of the file was one I recognized.
harmful:2.line: 'These hidden words are *harmful* to everyone who trusts the Bureau,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Ali decoded the broadcast in under a minute.
sentences.cn: 阿栗不到一分钟就破译了广播。

sentences.en: The signal was not an attack — it was a warning, wrapped in layers of noise.
sentences.cn: 信号不是攻击——是个警告，裹在层层噪音里。

sentences.en: 'The words Zero is hiding are *harmful* to the Bureau itself,' she said.
Someone high up had been feeding Zero secrets for years, and the proof was right here.
sentences.cn: 有人高层一直在向零点泄露秘密，证据就在这儿。

impossible:2.en: The lock on Zero's archive should have taken a full day to crack. Grey Crow opened it in four minutes flat. 'How?' I asked. He handed me a small chip etched with a pattern I had never seen. '*Impossible* problems,' he said, 'usually have a door that no one thought to check.'
impossible:2.cnHint: 灰鸦仅用四分钟就破解了那个看似____的锁，令调查员震惊。
impossible:2.hook: Inside the archive, one file had already been deleted thirty seconds ago.
impossible:2.line: 'Nothing is truly *impossible* if you know which door to try,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The lock on Zero's archive should have taken a full day to crack.
sentences.cn: 零点档案库上的锁应该要花整整一天才能破开。

sentences.en: Grey Crow opened it in four minutes flat.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦四分钟就打开了。

sentences.en: 'How?'
sentences.cn: 怎么做到的？

sentences.en: I asked.
sentences.cn: 我问。

sentences.en: He handed me a small chip etched with a pattern I had never seen. '*Impossible* problems,' he said, 'usually have a door that no one thought to check.'

admit:2.en: The server room smelled of burnt wire and old code. A single terminal glowed in the dark. I touched the screen and a message appeared: *Admit* your frequency or the gate stays locked. Grey Crow had warned me about this test. I typed my signal ID with cold fingers. The gate clicked.
admit:2.cnHint: 终端要求我____自己的信号频率，才肯开门放行。
admit:2.hook: Behind the gate, something was already moving toward me.
admit:2.line: 'You have to *admit* your signal, or the system locks you out forever.'

sentences.en: The server room smelled of burnt wire and old code.
sentences.cn: 服务器室闻起来有烧焦的电线和陈旧代码的味道。

sentences.en: A single terminal glowed in the dark.
sentences.cn: 一台单独的终端在黑暗中发光。

sentences.en: I touched the screen and a message appeared: *Admit* your frequency or the gate stays locked.
Grey Crow had warned me about this test.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦警告过我这个测试。

sentences.en: I typed my signal ID with cold fingers.
sentences.cn: 我用冰冷的手指输入了我的信号ID。

sentences.en: The gate clicked.
sentences.cn: 大门咔嗒一声打开了。

association:2.en: Ali slid a folded paper across the wet bench. On it was a symbol — a crow inside a broken circle. 'This is their mark,' she said. The *association* ran seventeen districts of Harbor City, and they spoke only in encoded graffiti. I had just found their calling card in my own coat pocket.
association:2.cnHint: 阿栗给我看了一个神秘____的标记，而我发现那个标记就藏在我自己的口袋里。
association:2.hook: Someone had put it there while I slept.
association:2.line: 'The *association* leaves that mark on people it has already chosen.'

sentences.en: Ali slid a folded paper across the wet bench.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把一张折叠的纸推过湿漉漉的长椅。

sentences.en: On it was a symbol — a crow inside a broken circle.
sentences.cn: 纸上是个符号——一只乌鸦在破碎的圆圈里。

sentences.en: 'This is their mark,' she said.
sentences.cn: 她说，这是他们的标记。

sentences.en: The *association* ran seventeen districts of Harbor City, and they spoke only in encoded graffiti.
I had just found their calling card in my own coat pocket.
sentences.cn: 我刚才在自己的外套口袋里找到了他们的名片。

brand:2.en: The wall of the old data vault was covered in faded signs. One line stood out, burned deep into the concrete: a single word, a *brand* left by Zero years ago. Grey Crow said that word was a warning to every investigator who followed. I pressed my hand against it. The stone was still warm.
brand:2.cnHint: 零点在混凝土墙上留下了一个深深的____，至今石头仍有余温。
brand:2.hook: Then the wall began to hum.
brand:2.line: 'Zero used that *brand* to mark every trap he ever set.'

sentences.en: The wall of the old data vault was covered in faded signs.
sentences.cn: 老数据库的墙上贴满了褪色的标记。

sentences.en: One line stood out, burned deep into the concrete: a single word, a *brand* left by Zero years ago.
Grey Crow said that word was a warning to every investigator who followed.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说那个词是对每一个后来的调查员的警告。

sentences.en: I pressed my hand against it.
sentences.cn: 我把手按在上面。

sentences.en: The stone was still warm.
sentences.cn: 石头还是温的。

deep:2.en: I pulled up the signal map on my visor. Most noise sat near the surface — street chatter, ad loops, empty static. But one thread ran *deep*, far below the city grid, steady and cold as a heartbeat. Ali had never seen a signal that low. Neither had I. I locked on and started to trace it.
deep:2.cnHint: 信号图上有一条____藏在城市电网最底层的信号线，稳定得像心跳。
deep:2.hook: The thread suddenly pulsed twice, then went silent.
deep:2.line: 'That signal is *deep* — deeper than any legal channel in this city.'

sentences.en: I pulled up the signal map on my visor.
sentences.cn: 我在护目镜上拉起信号地图。

sentences.en: Most noise sat near the surface — street chatter, ad loops, empty static.
sentences.cn: 大多数噪音都在表层——街道的嗡嗡声、广告循环、空白的静电。

sentences.en: But one thread ran *deep*, far below the city grid, steady and cold as a heartbeat.
Ali had never seen a signal that low.
sentences.cn: 阿栗从没见过这么深的信号。

sentences.en: Neither had I.
sentences.cn: 我也没有。

sentences.en: I locked on and started to trace it.
sentences.cn: 我锁定了信号，开始追踪。
