Exposure to UV light would *render* the ink visible for exactly ninety seconds before it faded back to nothing. I had a pen and no time to waste.
render:2.cnHint: 灰鸦给的卡片在紫外线下会____隐藏的文字可见，但只有九十秒。
render:2.hook: My hand was already moving but the lines were fading faster than I could copy.
render:2.line: 'UV light will *render* the text visible — you have ninety seconds, not more.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow slid a thin card across the table without a word.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦无言地把一张薄卡片推过桌子。

sentences.en: It looked blank.
sentences.cn: 看起来是空白的。

sentences.en: I held it under the UV lamp above the sink and the surface lit up — a dense grid of micro-text, every line a frequency, every frequency a name.
sentences.cn: 我把它放在水槽上方的紫外灯下，卡片表面亮了起来——密密麻麻的超微小文字，每一行都是一个频率，每个频率都对应一个名字。

sentences.en: Exposure to UV light would *render* the ink visible for exactly ninety seconds before it faded back to nothing.
I had a pen and no time to waste.
sentences.cn: 我有笔，没有时间浪费。

resolve:2.en: I stood at the end of the corridor for a long moment, rain loud on the roof, the drive in my coat pocket, Zero's last signal still ringing in my ear. Every path forward had a cost. But doubt was a luxury I had already spent. I fixed my *resolve*, stepped through the door, and let it lock behind me. No exit now — only the next move, and whatever waited on the other side.
resolve:2.cnHint: 调查员在走廊尽头下定____，迈步走入房间，身后的门随之锁上。
resolve:2.hook: The click of the lock was the loudest sound in Harbor City that night.
resolve:2.line: 'Fix your *resolve* now — once we cross that line there is no coming back.'

sentences.en: I stood at the end of the corridor for a long moment, rain loud on the roof, the drive in my coat pocket, Zero's last signal still ringing in my ear.
sentences.cn: 我站在走廊尽头停留了很久，雨敲打着屋顶，零点最后的信号还在我耳边回响，驱动装置在我的外套口袋里。

sentences.en: Every path forward had a cost.
sentences.cn: 每条出路都要付代价。

sentences.en: But doubt was a luxury I had already spent.
sentences.cn: 但犹豫是我早就花光了的奢侈品。

sentences.en: I fixed my *resolve*, stepped through the door, and let it lock behind me.
No exit now — only the next move, and whatever waited on the other side.
sentences.cn: 现在没有出口了——只有下一步行动，和另一边等待着的东西。

seemingly:2.en: The broadcast came through on a clean channel at exactly midnight — calm music, soft and low, the kind that plays in empty waiting rooms. *Seemingly* harmless, the kind of noise the city filters ignored by design. But underneath the melody, threaded into the lowest frequency, Ali caught a repeating pattern: eleven pulses, pause, three pulses, pause, seven. A countdown, or a code. Neither answer was good.
seemingly:2.cnHint: 那段____无害的广播音乐，在最低频率中隐藏着阿栗察觉到的重复信号。
seemingly:2.hook: Ali's face went pale the moment she worked out what the numbers meant.
seemingly:2.line: 'It sounds *seemingly* normal — that is exactly why I almost missed it.'

sentences.en: The broadcast came through on a clean channel at exactly midnight — calm music, soft and low, the kind that plays in empty waiting rooms.
sentences.cn: 广播准时在午夜通过干净的频道传来——平静的音乐，柔和低缓，像空荡荡的候诊室里播放的那种。

sentences.en: *Seemingly* harmless, the kind of noise the city filters ignored by design.
But underneath the melody, threaded into the lowest frequency, Ali caught a repeating pattern: eleven pulses, pause, three pulses, pause, seven.
sentences.cn: 但在旋律下面，穿插在最低频率里，阿栗捕捉到了一个重复的模式：十一声脉冲，停顿，三声脉冲，停顿，七声。

sentences.en: A countdown, or a code.
sentences.cn: 倒计时，或者密码。

sentences.en: Neither answer was good.
sentences.cn: 哪个答案都不好。

therefore:2.en: The abandoned signal tower on Pier 9 had gone silent for three years. Tonight, its light blinked twice — the old distress code. Grey Crow pressed a folded note into my hand: the tower was compromised, and *therefore* every safe route on the eastern docks was now suspect.
therefore:2.cnHint: 信号塔重新亮起，灰鸦认为____所有东码头的安全路线都不可信了。
therefore:2.hook: Someone wanted us moving — straight into the open.
therefore:2.line: 'The tower is burned, and *therefore* we trust no map made before midnight.'

sentences.en: The abandoned signal tower on Pier 9 had gone silent for three years.
sentences.cn: 九号码头上那座废弃信号塔已经沉默了三年。

sentences.en: Tonight, its light blinked twice — the old distress code.
sentences.cn: 今晚，它的灯闪了两次——老式求救信号。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pressed a folded note into my hand: the tower was compromised, and *therefore* every safe route on the eastern docks was now suspect.

truth:2.en: Ali pulled a cracked data chip from beneath a loose floor tile in the old customs hall. The chip held one file: a recording of Zero's voice, calm and certain, admitting everything. 'This is the *truth* they buried,' Ali whispered, hand shaking as the audio played on.
truth:2.cnHint: 阿栗在海关大厅地砖下发现了一块芯片，里面藏着令人震惊的____。
truth:2.hook: But the file's timestamp was three hours from now.
truth:2.line: 'I found the *truth* — and it hasn't happened yet.'

sentences.en: Ali pulled a cracked data chip from beneath a loose floor tile in the old customs hall.
sentences.cn: 阿栗从旧关税大厅地板下的松动瓷砖下面拉出一块裂纹数据芯片。

sentences.en: The chip held one file: a recording of Zero's voice, calm and certain, admitting everything.
sentences.cn: 芯片里只有一个文件：零点的录音，声音平静而笃定，承认了一切。

sentences.en: 'This is the *truth* they buried,' Ali whispered, hand shaking as the audio played on.

protein:2.en: The night market stall sold hot bowls of grey broth. Grey Crow pointed at the label on the canister behind the counter: a banned synthetic *protein* formula, the same compound Zero's network used to smuggle data capsules through the city's food checkpoints. We had our entry point.
protein:2.cnHint: 夜市摊位的肉汤罐头上贴着违禁____配方标签，这正是零点走私数据的通道。
protein:2.hook: The cook reached under the counter without being asked.
protein:2.line: 'Every capsule rides inside a *protein* shell — customs never checks the food line.'

sentences.en: The night market stall sold hot bowls of grey broth.
sentences.cn: 夜市摊位卖热汤碗，装的是灰色清汤。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pointed at the label on the canister behind the counter: a banned synthetic *protein* formula, the same compound Zero's network used to smuggle data capsules through the city's food checkpoints.
We had our entry point.
sentences.cn: 我们找到了入口点。

traffic:2.en: From the overpass, Harbor City's *traffic* below looked like slow blood in a clogged vein — delivery drones, cargo carts, and coded courier bikes all funnelled through Checkpoint Seven. Grey Crow said Zero's package was already in that stream. We had four minutes to find it.
traffic:2.cnHint: 灰鸦说零点的包裹就混在检查站七号的____人流中，我们只有四分钟。
traffic:2.hook: A green courier bike peeled away from the queue and accelerated hard.
traffic:2.line: 'Watch the *traffic* — Zero's package is already moving through Checkpoint Seven.'

sentences.en: From the overpass, Harbor City's *traffic* below looked like slow blood in a clogged vein — delivery drones, cargo carts, and coded courier bikes all funnelled through Checkpoint Seven.
Grey Crow said Zero's package was already in that stream.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说零点的包裹已经在那个物流里了。

sentences.en: We had four minutes to find it.
sentences.cn: 我们有四分钟时间去找到它。

cat:2.en: The only living thing in the abandoned data vault was a thin grey *cat*, sitting on a humming server rack as if it owned the room. Ali noticed its collar first — a tiny copper tag engraved with coordinates. Someone had used the animal as a living dead drop.
cat:2.cnHint: 废弃数据仓库里，一只____的项圈上刻着某个关键坐标。
cat:2.hook: The cat turned its head toward the far wall and did not blink.
cat:2.line: 'Don't scare it — that *cat* is carrying the only copy of the address.'

sentences.en: The only living thing in the abandoned data vault was a thin grey *cat*, sitting on a humming server rack as if it owned the room.
Ali noticed its collar first — a tiny copper tag engraved with coordinates.
sentences.cn: 阿栗先注意到它的项圈——一枚很小的铜牌，上面刻着坐标。

sentences.en: Someone had used the animal as a living dead drop.
sentences.cn: 有人用这只动物当活的暗点。

sugar:2.en: The coded graffiti on the sub-level wall read clean to any passing officer, but Grey Crow traced the letters slowly. '*Sugar*,' he murmured — street slang for a bribe log, a list of every official Zero had paid off. The wall itself was a confession, hidden in plain sight.
sugar:2.cnHint: 地下通道墙上的涂鸦里，____一词是行贿记录的暗语，藏着零点收买官员的名单。
sugar:2.hook: One name on that list made Grey Crow go very still.
sugar:2.line: 'In this district, *sugar* on a wall means someone powerful has already been paid.'

sentences.en: The coded graffiti on the sub-level wall read clean to any passing officer, but Grey Crow traced the letters slowly. '*Sugar*,' he murmured — street slang for a bribe log, a list of every official Zero had paid off.
The wall itself was a confession, hidden in plain sight.
sentences.cn: 墙本身就是一场忏悔，藏在光天化日之下。

balance:2.en: The rooftop relay dish tilted in the wind, and the encrypted feed it carried kept cutting out. I had to *balance* on the narrow service rail, arms wide, to reach the cable junction without knocking the dish offline. One wrong shift and Zero's signal — our only lead — was gone.
balance:2.cnHint: 我必须在狭窄的维修栏杆上____身体，才能接触到电缆接口而不破坏信号。
balance:2.hook: The wind picked up the moment my fingers touched the wire.
balance:2.line: '*Balance* — if that dish moves even one degree, we lose the feed forever.'

sentences.en: The rooftop relay dish tilted in the wind, and the encrypted feed it carried kept cutting out.
sentences.cn: 屋顶的中继盘在风中倾斜，它传输的加密信号不断中断。

sentences.en: I had to *balance* on the narrow service rail, arms wide, to reach the cable junction without knocking the dish offline.
One wrong shift and Zero's signal — our only lead — was gone.
sentences.cn: 一步踏错，零点的信号——我们唯一的线索——就会消失。

baby:2.en: The note tucked inside the locker read: 'Don't play *baby* — this is the last warning.' It was signed with Zero's mark. Ali stared at it, jaw tight. The locker belonged to a port inspector who had been feeding us information for weeks. His last check-in was forty hours ago.
baby:2.cnHint: 储物柜里的纸条用零点的标记署名，警告某人不要____，而我们的线人已失联四十小时。
baby:2.hook: Ali's hand moved to the locker's lower shelf and found it empty.
baby:2.line: 'Don't go *baby* on me now — Zero left that note inside an hour ago.'

sentences.en: The note tucked inside the locker read: 'Don't play *baby* — this is the last warning.'
It was signed with Zero's mark.
sentences.cn: 上面签的是零点的标记。

sentences.en: Ali stared at it, jaw tight.
sentences.cn: 阿栗盯着纸条，下颌紧绷。

sentences.en: The locker belonged to a port inspector who had been feeding us information for weeks.
sentences.cn: 这个柜子是港口检查员的，他已经给我们通风报信好几周了。

sentences.en: His last check-in was forty hours ago.
sentences.cn: 他最后一次联系是在四十小时前。

teenager:2.en: The message was carved into a school desk — not random damage, but code. A *teenager* had sat here recently; the ink on the carved letters was still fresh. Grey Crow had told me young runners were Zero's best messengers. Nobody watches a kid. I photographed every word before the cleaners arrived.
teenager:2.cnHint: 一个年轻的____刚刚在这张课桌上刻下了密码信息，墨迹未干。
teenager:2.hook: The last carved word was my own name.
teenager:2.line: 'A *teenager* carved that message — Zero is recruiting younger every cycle.'

sentences.en: The message was carved into a school desk — not random damage, but code.
sentences.cn: 信息刻在一张学校课桌上——不是随意的破坏，而是密码。

sentences.en: A *teenager* had sat here recently; the ink on the carved letters was still fresh.
Grey Crow had told me young runners were Zero's best messengers.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦告诉过我，年轻的信使是零点最好的传令员。

sentences.en: Nobody watches a kid.
sentences.cn: 没人会注意一个小孩。

sentences.en: I photographed every word before the cleaners arrived.
sentences.cn: 清洁工来之前我把每个字都拍了下来。

patient:2.en: Ali slid a folded note under the door of the clinic's waiting room. The *patient* list on the wall was fake — each name a dead-drop code. I cross-checked three entries and found a pickup time buried in the diagnosis column. Zero had been using this place for months.
patient:2.cnHint: 诊所墙上的____名单是伪装成医疗记录的密码，我从中找到了接头时间。
patient:2.hook: The fourth name on the list was Ali's.
patient:2.line: 'Be *patient* — the real message is hidden in the last diagnosis entry.'

sentences.en: Ali slid a folded note under the door of the clinic's waiting room.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把折叠的纸条从诊所候诊室的门缝塞了进去。

sentences.en: The *patient* list on the wall was fake — each name a dead-drop code.
I cross-checked three entries and found a pickup time buried in the diagnosis column.
sentences.cn: 我对照了三个条目，在诊断栏里找到了一个接头时间。

sentences.en: Zero had been using this place for months.
sentences.cn: 零点已经用这个地方好几个月了。

classroom:2.en: The abandoned *classroom* on Level Nine smelled of old paper and burnt wire. Someone had rewritten every equation on the board using Zero's cipher alphabet. Ali recognised two of the symbols. I copied the rest fast — the building's sensor net had just switched back on.
classroom:2.cnHint: 废弃____的黑板上，每一道方程式都被改写成了密码字符。
classroom:2.hook: The sensor log showed Grey Crow had been here an hour before us.
classroom:2.line: 'This *classroom* is Zero's message board — every equation is an order.'

sentences.en: The abandoned *classroom* on Level Nine smelled of old paper and burnt wire.
Someone had rewritten every equation on the board using Zero's cipher alphabet.
sentences.cn: 有人用零点的密码字母重写了黑板上的每一个方程。

sentences.en: Ali recognised two of the symbols.
sentences.cn: 阿栗认出了其中两个符号。

sentences.en: I copied the rest fast — the building's sensor net had just switched back on.
sentences.cn: 我快速抄下了剩下的——建筑的传感网刚刚重新启动。

vehicle:2.en: Grey Crow left the key inside a hollow tile near the east dock. The *vehicle* it opened was unmarked, engine already warm — someone had used it minutes ago. Under the seat I found a sealed chip wrapped in a hand-drawn map of the harbor's lower tunnels.
vehicle:2.cnHint: 灰鸦藏在瓷砖里的钥匙打开了一辆____，座椅下藏着一张手绘地图。
vehicle:2.hook: The map had a route marked in the same ink as the coded graffiti downtown.
vehicle:2.line: 'That *vehicle* was Zero's — check every panel for hidden compartments.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow left the key inside a hollow tile near the east dock.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把钥匙留在了东码头附近一块空心瓷砖里。

sentences.en: The *vehicle* it opened was unmarked, engine already warm — someone had used it minutes ago.
Under the seat I found a sealed chip wrapped in a hand-drawn map of the harbor's lower tunnels.
sentences.cn: 座位下我找到了一个密封芯片，用手绘港口下层隧道地图包裹着。

remote:2.en: The signal came from a *remote* server node buried three layers below Harbor City's public grid. Grey Crow had warned me about ghost nodes — illegal, untraceable, perfect for Zero. I locked the frequency and began recording. The broadcast was only thirty seconds long.
remote:2.cnHint: 信号来自城市公共网络深处一个____的非法服务器节点。
remote:2.hook: The final second of the broadcast was my own voice, played back to me.
remote:2.line: 'That *remote* node has been live for six months — Zero planned this long ago.'

sentences.en: The signal came from a *remote* server node buried three layers below Harbor City's public grid.
Grey Crow had warned me about ghost nodes — illegal, untraceable, perfect for Zero.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦警告过我幽灵节点的事——非法的，无法追踪，完美适合零点。

sentences.en: I locked the frequency and began recording.
sentences.cn: 我锁定了频率开始录音。

sentences.en: The broadcast was only thirty seconds long.
sentences.cn: 广播只持续了三十秒。

zoo:2.en: The meeting point was the old *zoo* on Harbor Hill, closed since the floods of 2071. Ali found a metal case chained to the main gate — inside, a drive and a single printed line: GREY CROW KNOWS THE PRICE. Zero had been watching our every step.
zoo:2.cnHint: 在废弃的____大门上，阿栗发现了一个金属箱，里面装着驱动器和一条警告。
zoo:2.hook: The chain lock used a code only I was supposed to know.
zoo:2.line: 'The *zoo* drop was never meant for us — someone intercepted Grey Crow's route.'

sentences.en: The meeting point was the old *zoo* on Harbor Hill, closed since the floods of 2071.
Ali found a metal case chained to the main gate — inside, a drive and a single printed line: GREY CROW KNOWS THE PRICE.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在大门上发现了一个用链子锁着的金属箱——里面有一个硬盘和一行打印文字：灰鸦知道代价。

sentences.en: Zero had been watching our every step.
sentences.cn: 零点一直在监视我们的每一步。

card:2.en: Tucked inside a cracked junction box near the night market, I found a small *card* — blank on one side, micro-printed on the other. Under my scanner it resolved into a floor plan of Zero's relay station. Grey Crow had left it three days ago. The timing felt wrong.
card:2.cnHint: 在夜市附近的配电箱里，我找到了一张____，扫描后显示出零点中继站的平面图。
card:2.hook: The floor plan showed a room that did not appear on any official record.
card:2.line: 'That *card* holds the only map of Zero's inner relay — guard it with your life.'

sentences.en: Tucked inside a cracked junction box near the night market, I found a small *card* — blank on one side, micro-printed on the other.
Under my scanner it resolved into a floor plan of Zero's relay station.
sentences.cn: 在扫描仪下，它解析成了零点中继站的平面图。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had left it three days ago.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦三天前留下的。

sentences.en: The timing felt wrong.
sentences.cn: 时间感觉不太对劲。

gene:2.en: The lab report Ali smuggled out listed a single anomaly: a *gene* sequence tagged with a code string matching Zero's broadcast header. Someone was embedding identity markers in biological data — a living key, impossible to copy. Grey Crow had gone quiet the moment I found it.
gene:2.cnHint: 阿栗带出的实验室报告显示，一段____序列中隐藏着与零点广播一致的身份标记。
gene:2.hook: The sequence matched Grey Crow's own medical file on record.
gene:2.line: 'That *gene* marker is a living password — delete it and the whole network goes dark.'

sentences.en: The lab report Ali smuggled out listed a single anomaly: a *gene* sequence tagged with a code string matching Zero's broadcast header.
Someone was embedding identity markers in biological data — a living key, impossible to copy.
sentences.cn: 有人在生物数据里嵌入身份标记——一把活钥匙，无法复制。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had gone quiet the moment I found it.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在我发现它的那一刻就沉默了。

modern:2.en: The safe house looked ordinary from outside, but inside it was packed with *modern* equipment — screens that bent like paper, keyboards made of light. Ali ran a hand over the nearest panel. 'Zero built this,' she said quietly. I scanned the room and felt a cold signal humming beneath the floor.
modern:2.cnHint: 安全屋内藏有____设备，阿栗认出这是零点的手笔。
modern:2.hook: The signal beneath the floor was spelling out my name.
modern:2.line: 'This *modern* setup didn't come cheap — Zero paid for it with someone's data.'

sentences.en: The safe house looked ordinary from outside, but inside it was packed with *modern* equipment — screens that bent like paper, keyboards made of light.
Ali ran a hand over the nearest panel.
sentences.cn: 阿栗的手划过最近的面板。

sentences.en: 'Zero built this,' she said quietly.
sentences.cn: "零点造的，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: I scanned the room and felt a cold signal humming beneath the floor.
sentences.cn: 我扫了一眼房间，感到一阵冷信号在地板下嗡鸣。

officer:2.en: The badge on the wall read HARBOR CITY LANGUAGE CONTROL DIVISION. An *officer* in a grey coat stood with his back to me, reading a printed list of forbidden words. Ali grabbed my sleeve. 'He has the intercept logs,' she whispered. I steadied my breath and kept walking.
officer:2.cnHint: 一名____正在查阅禁用词名单，阿栗说他手里有截获记录。
officer:2.hook: My name was almost certainly on that list.
officer:2.line: 'Every *officer* in this building answers to Zero — trust no one here.'

sentences.en: The badge on the wall read HARBOR CITY LANGUAGE CONTROL DIVISION.
sentences.cn: 墙上的徽章写着港口城市语言管制部。

sentences.en: An *officer* in a grey coat stood with his back to me, reading a printed list of forbidden words.
Ali grabbed my sleeve.
sentences.cn: 阿栗拉住我的袖子。

sentences.en: 'He has the intercept logs,' she whispered.
sentences.cn: "他有截获的日志，"她低声说。

sentences.en: I steadied my breath and kept walking.
sentences.cn: 我稳了稳呼吸继续往前走。

convince:2.en: Grey Crow spread three data chips across the table. 'Pick the wrong one and the whole network burns,' he said. I had to *convince* Ali that the middle chip was clean — the signal I heard told me so. She studied my face for a long moment, then reached out.
convince:2.cnHint: 我需要____阿栗相信中间那枚芯片是安全的，她最终伸出了手。
convince:2.hook: Her fingers stopped just before they touched it.
convince:2.line: 'You have thirty seconds to *convince* me, or I walk out that door.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow spread three data chips across the table.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把三块数据芯片铺开在桌子上。

sentences.en: 'Pick the wrong one and the whole network burns,' he said.
sentences.cn: "选错一个，整个网络就烧掉，"他说。

sentences.en: I had to *convince* Ali that the middle chip was clean — the signal I heard told me so.
She studied my face for a long moment, then reached out.
sentences.cn: 她盯着我的脸看了很久，然后伸出了手。

directly:2.en: The coded graffiti covered the east wall of the tunnel — layers of color, years of tags. I walked *directly* to the third column, third row, just as the signal in my head had guided me. Behind a loose brick I found a folded note. It carried Zero's mark.
directly:2.cnHint: 我____走向墙上某个位置，在砖缝后找到了带有零点印记的纸条。
directly:2.hook: The note had today's date — and tomorrow's body count.
directly:2.line: 'Go *directly* to the east tunnel — do not stop, do not look back.'

sentences.en: The coded graffiti covered the east wall of the tunnel — layers of color, years of tags.
sentences.cn: 隧道东墙被涂鸦覆盖——层层叠叠的色彩，多年的标记。

sentences.en: I walked *directly* to the third column, third row, just as the signal in my head had guided me.
Behind a loose brick I found a folded note.
sentences.cn: 松动的砖头后面我找到了一张折叠的纸条。

sentences.en: It carried Zero's mark.
sentences.cn: 上面有零点的记号。

extend:2.en: Grey Crow tapped the map on the table. The red zone had grown again. 'They plan to *extend* the signal blackout across the whole port district by midnight,' he said. Ali went pale. I felt a new frequency flicker at the edge of my hearing and then vanish.
extend:2.cnHint: 灰鸦警告说，信号封锁区将____至整个港区，我隐约听到了新的频率。
extend:2.hook: Whatever I had just heard, Zero had heard it too.
extend:2.line: 'If they *extend* the blackout tonight, we lose every contact we have.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow tapped the map on the table.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦敲了敲桌上的地图。

sentences.en: The red zone had grown again.
sentences.cn: 红色区域又扩大了。

sentences.en: 'They plan to *extend* the signal blackout across the whole port district by midnight,' he said.
Ali went pale.
sentences.cn: 阿栗的脸变得苍白。

sentences.en: I felt a new frequency flicker at the edge of my hearing and then vanish.
sentences.cn: 我感觉到一阵新的频率在听觉边缘闪烁，然后消失了。

rat:2.en: Ali slid a photo across the table — a figure caught by a roof camera, passing a chip to someone in a grey coat. 'There is a *rat* inside our unit,' she said, voice flat. I looked at the blurred face and felt the signal in my skull tighten like a fist.
rat:2.cnHint: 阿栗拿出照片，指出我们队伍里有一个____正在向对方传递芯片。
rat:2.hook: The blurred face in the photo looked uncomfortably familiar.
rat:2.line: 'Find the *rat* before sunrise, or Grey Crow takes the blame.'

sentences.en: Ali slid a photo across the table — a figure caught by a roof camera, passing a chip to someone in a grey coat.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把一张照片滑过桌子——监控摄像头拍到的人影，正在把芯片传给穿着灰色外套的人。

sentences.en: 'There is a *rat* inside our unit,' she said, voice flat.
I looked at the blurred face and felt the signal in my skull tighten like a fist.
sentences.cn: 我看着那张模糊的脸，感觉脑子里的信号像拳头一样紧了起来。

saturday:2.en: The date stamp on the intercepted file read *Saturday*, 14 March 2099 — six days ago. Grey Crow had told me the drop happened last week. The times matched. I cross-checked the port logs and felt ice settle in my chest.
saturday:2.cnHint: 截获文件的时间戳显示是上周____，与灰鸦所说的时间吻合，我心里一沉。
saturday:2.hook: If the times matched, then Grey Crow was there.
saturday:2.line: 'The file is dated *Saturday* — that is the night Grey Crow said he was alone.'

sentences.en: The date stamp on the intercepted file read *Saturday*, 14 March 2099 — six days ago.
Grey Crow had told me the drop happened last week.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦告诉我上周进行了一次交接。

sentences.en: The times matched.
sentences.cn: 时间对上了。

sentences.en: I cross-checked the port logs and felt ice settle in my chest.
sentences.cn: 我交叉检查了港口日志，感觉冷意沁入胸腔。

april:2.en: The archived broadcast was short: three notes of static, then a voice reading a date — '*April* the first, 2099.' Ali said dates in coded signals were never real dates. They were targets. I ran the cipher Grey Crow had taught me and the number that came out turned my blood cold.
april:2.cnHint: 加密广播中出现了____一日的日期，阿栗说这是一个目标代号，我破译后心寒不已。
april:2.hook: The target was not a place — it was a person.
april:2.line: 'Every message tagged with *April* points back to the same source — and that source is you.'

sentences.en: The archived broadcast was short: three notes of static, then a voice reading a date — '*April* the first, 2099.'
Ali said dates in coded signals were never real dates.
sentences.cn: 阿栗说编码信号里的日期从来不是真实日期。

sentences.en: They were targets.
sentences.cn: 它们是目标。

sentences.en: I ran the cipher Grey Crow had taught me and the number that came out turned my blood cold.
sentences.cn: 我用灰鸦教我的密码运算了一遍，得出的数字让我血液都凝固了。

childhood:2.en: The locked file carried a tag I did not expect: *childhood*. Inside were voice records — a small girl learning secret codes from an old man in a wet alley. The girl's voice was familiar. Too familiar. Grey Crow had been in this game far longer than I ever knew.
childhood:2.cnHint: 我发现一份加密档案，其中藏着灰鸦____时期的语音记录。
childhood:2.hook: The voice in the file matched the one standing behind me.
childhood:2.line: 'My *childhood* trained me for exactly this moment,' Grey Crow said quietly.

sentences.en: The locked file carried a tag I did not expect: *childhood*.
Inside were voice records — a small girl learning secret codes from an old man in a wet alley.
sentences.cn: 里面是语音记录——一个小女孩在湿漉漉的小巷里跟一个老人学习秘密代码。

sentences.en: The girl's voice was familiar.
sentences.cn: 女孩的声音很熟悉。

sentences.en: Too familiar.
sentences.cn: 太熟悉了。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had been in this game far longer than I ever knew.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在这个游戏里的资历远比我想象的要深。

equal:2.en: Zero's signal hit every street screen at once. The message read: 'No badge makes you *equal* to the city's voice.' Ali grabbed my arm. The screens flickered and died. In the sudden dark, I heard footsteps — steady, unhurried — closing in from three directions.
equal:2.cnHint: 零点向全城发出挑衅信号，声称没人能与城市之声____。
equal:2.hook: Three directions, two of us, and the exits were already sealed.
equal:2.line: 'We are not *equal* yet — but tonight that changes,' Zero broadcast.

sentences.en: Zero's signal hit every street screen at once.
sentences.cn: 零点的信号同时轰击了每一块街道屏幕。

sentences.en: The message read: 'No badge makes you *equal* to the city's voice.'
Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了我的手臂。

sentences.en: The screens flickered and died.
sentences.cn: 屏幕闪烁着熄灭了。

sentences.en: In the sudden dark, I heard footsteps — steady, unhurried — closing in from three directions.
sentences.cn: 在突然的黑暗中，我听到脚步声——稳定而不急不躁——从三个方向逼近。

inspire:2.en: Coded graffiti covered the underpass wall — layer on layer of forbidden signs. Ali said someone had spent years painting it. 'Who could *inspire* this much risk?' I whispered. Then I read the lowest line, the oldest one, and felt the air leave my lungs.
inspire:2.cnHint: 地道墙上布满禁忌涂鸦，我想知道是谁能____人们冒险留下这些印记。
inspire:2.hook: The signature at the bottom was my own name.
inspire:2.line: 'Only the truth can *inspire* people to paint over their fear,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Coded graffiti covered the underpass wall — layer on layer of forbidden signs.
sentences.cn: 地下通道墙上覆满了涂鸦代码——层层叠叠的禁忌符号。

sentences.en: Ali said someone had spent years painting it.
sentences.cn: 阿栗说有人花了多年时间画这些。

sentences.en: 'Who could *inspire* this much risk?'
I whispered.
sentences.cn: 我低声说。

sentences.en: Then I read the lowest line, the oldest one, and felt the air leave my lungs.
sentences.cn: 然后我读到了最下面那一行，最古老的那一行，感觉空气被吸出了我的肺。

narrow:2.en: The passage behind the signal tower was *narrow* — barely wide enough for one person. I moved through it sideways, my back against cold steel. At the far end, a thin light pulsed in a coded rhythm. Someone was already there, reading it, and had not heard me yet.
narrow:2.cnHint: 我侧身穿过信号塔后的____通道，发现前方有人正在破译脉冲信号。
narrow:2.hook: The figure turned, and I recognized the coat before the face.
narrow:2.line: 'This *narrow* path is the only one Zero does not watch,' Grey Crow breathed.

sentences.en: The passage behind the signal tower was *narrow* — barely wide enough for one person.
I moved through it sideways, my back against cold steel.
sentences.cn: 我侧身穿过，背贴着冰冷的钢铁。

sentences.en: At the far end, a thin light pulsed in a coded rhythm.
sentences.cn: 远端有一束细光按照编码节奏跳动。

sentences.en: Someone was already there, reading it, and had not heard me yet.
sentences.cn: 有人已经在那里了，在读它，还没听到我。

quantity:2.en: The data drop contained a shocking *quantity* of stolen city codes — enough to rewrite every public broadcast for a week. Ali counted the files, her face pale under the neon. Someone had been collecting these for months. The time stamp on the oldest file matched the night I joined the force.
quantity:2.cnHint: 数据包里藏着惊人____的城市密码，最早一份的时间戳让我不寒而栗。
quantity:2.hook: The collector's ID was one I had trusted completely.
quantity:2.line: 'That *quantity* of codes buys control of every voice in Harbor City,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The data drop contained a shocking *quantity* of stolen city codes — enough to rewrite every public broadcast for a week.
Ali counted the files, her face pale under the neon.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在霓虹灯下数着文件，脸色苍白。

sentences.en: Someone had been collecting these for months.
sentences.cn: 有人已经收集了好几个月。

sentences.en: The time stamp on the oldest file matched the night I joined the force.
sentences.cn: 最旧文件的时间戳和我加入警队的那晚吻合。

sustainable:2.en: Grey Crow spread the map on the wet floor. 'This resistance is not *sustainable*,' he said, his voice flat. 'Zero keeps cutting our signals faster than we restore them.' He tapped a single node at the harbor's edge. If that node fell tonight, the whole network went dark by morning.
sustainable:2.cnHint: 灰鸦警告说，我们目前的抵抗方式不____，零点的速度远超我们。
sustainable:2.hook: The harbor node was already showing a red warning light.
sustainable:2.line: 'Nothing *sustainable* was ever built in a single night,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow spread the map on the wet floor.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在湿漉漉的地板上铺开了地图。

sentences.en: 'This resistance is not *sustainable*,' he said, his voice flat.
'Zero keeps cutting our signals faster than we restore them.'
sentences.cn: "零点切断我们信号的速度比我们恢复的快。"

sentences.en: He tapped a single node at the harbor's edge.
sentences.cn: 他敲了敲港口边缘的一个节点。

sentences.en: If that node fell tonight, the whole network went dark by morning.
sentences.cn: 如果那个节点今晚失陷，整个网络明早就会彻底黑掉。

delay:2.en: The broadcast was set to go live in four minutes. Ali's hands moved fast across the panel, but a loop in the code kept throwing errors. Every *delay* cost us signal range. I stood at the door, listening to the corridor, counting seconds we did not have.
delay:2.cnHint: 广播即将上线，但代码错误造成的每一次____都让我们损失信号覆盖范围。
delay:2.hook: The corridor lights cut out at exactly the three-minute mark.
delay:2.line: 'One more *delay* and Zero owns the airwaves till dawn,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The broadcast was set to go live in four minutes.
sentences.cn: 直播定在四分钟后上线。

sentences.en: Ali's hands moved fast across the panel, but a loop in the code kept throwing errors.
sentences.cn: 阿栗的手在面板上飞速移动，但代码里的一个循环不断抛出错误。

sentences.en: Every *delay* cost us signal range.
I stood at the door, listening to the corridor, counting seconds we did not have.
sentences.cn: 我站在门口，听着走廊里的声音，数着我们没有的那些秒数。

identity:2.en: The final encrypted file held a single image: a city ID card. The face on it was mine. The name was not. Grey Crow said every investigator in the unit had a hidden *identity* built before birth — a cover so deep even we did not know it. I stared at the card and felt the floor shift.
identity:2.cnHint: 最后一份加密文件揭示了我从未知晓的隐藏____，灰鸦说这是出生前就设定好的。
identity:2.hook: The card's issue date was the same day my parents disappeared.
identity:2.line: 'Your real *identity* is the city's oldest secret,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The final encrypted file held a single image: a city ID card.
sentences.cn: 最后那份加密文件里只有一张图片：一张城市身份证。

sentences.en: The face on it was mine.
sentences.cn: 证件上的脸是我的。

sentences.en: The name was not.
sentences.cn: 名字不是。

sentences.en: Grey Crow said every investigator in the unit had a hidden *identity* built before birth — a cover so deep even we did not know it.
I stared at the card and felt the floor shift.
sentences.cn: 我盯着那张证看，感觉地板在移动。

store:2.en: The signal led me to a narrow *store* on Dock Street — shelves of old radio parts, dust on everything, no customers. Behind the counter, a locked drawer hummed with live current. Someone had hidden a transmitter inside. Ali pulled me back before I touched it. The whole place was a trap.
store:2.cnHint: 信号把我引到了一家破旧的____，藏在柜台后面的抽屉里有一个发射器。
store:2.hook: The lock clicked open on its own.
store:2.line: 'This *store* is not selling anything — it's broadcasting,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The signal led me to a narrow *store* on Dock Street — shelves of old radio parts, dust on everything, no customers.
Behind the counter, a locked drawer hummed with live current.
sentences.cn: 柜台后面有个抽屉，嗡嗡地传出实时电流的声音。

sentences.en: Someone had hidden a transmitter inside.
sentences.cn: 有人在里面藏了一台发射器。

sentences.en: Ali pulled me back before I touched it.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在我碰到它之前把我拉了回来。

sentences.en: The whole place was a trap.
sentences.cn: 整个地方都是陷阱。

budget:2.en: Grey Crow slid a torn paper across the table. It was a city *budget* report, but someone had encoded a map inside the numbers — each figure a coordinate, each total a frequency. I ran the cipher twice to be sure. The map pointed straight to the old port tower. Ali went pale.
budget:2.cnHint: 灰鸦给我看了一份____文件，数字里藏着一张秘密地图。
budget:2.hook: The coordinates matched a place that burned down in 2087.
budget:2.line: 'The *budget* is a lie — read the remainders, not the totals,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow slid a torn paper across the table.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把一张撕破的纸推过桌子。

sentences.en: It was a city *budget* report, but someone had encoded a map inside the numbers — each figure a coordinate, each total a frequency.
I ran the cipher twice to be sure.
sentences.cn: 我运行了两次密码才确认。

sentences.en: The map pointed straight to the old port tower.
sentences.cn: 这张图指向了老港口塔楼。

sentences.en: Ali went pale.
sentences.cn: 阿栗的脸色变了。

grant:2.en: The city seal on the document looked real. It was a *grant* of access to the deep network archives — signed, stamped, official. But the date was three days in the future. Either someone had forged it, or they already knew exactly how this night would end. My hands went cold.
grant:2.cnHint: 这份____文件看起来是真的，但日期是三天后，有人似乎早就知道结局。
grant:2.hook: The signature belonged to someone who died last year.
grant:2.line: 'A *grant* with a future date means someone is very sure of themselves,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The city seal on the document looked real.
sentences.cn: 文件上的城市印章看起来很真。

sentences.en: It was a *grant* of access to the deep network archives — signed, stamped, official.
But the date was three days in the future.
sentences.cn: 但日期是三天后。

sentences.en: Either someone had forged it, or they already knew exactly how this night would end.
sentences.cn: 要么有人伪造了它，要么他们已经知道今晚会怎样结束。

sentences.en: My hands went cold.
sentences.cn: 我的手冰冷了。

hospital:2.en: The hidden frequency cut out at midnight, then resumed from a new source — the old *hospital* on the north hill, closed for twenty years, dark every night until now. One window glowed faint blue. I told Ali to stay back. Someone up there was still transmitting, still waiting.
hospital:2.cnHint: 神秘信号的新来源是北山上一座废弃的____，那里有一扇窗户亮着蓝光。
hospital:2.hook: A second light appeared in the window below the first.
hospital:2.line: 'That *hospital* has been off the grid since 2079 — nothing should be running up there,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The hidden frequency cut out at midnight, then resumed from a new source — the old *hospital* on the north hill, closed for twenty years, dark every night until now.
One window glowed faint blue.
sentences.cn: 一扇窗户泛着淡淡的蓝光。

sentences.en: I told Ali to stay back.
sentences.cn: 我告诉阿栗留在后面。

sentences.en: Someone up there was still transmitting, still waiting.
sentences.cn: 上面有人还在发射信号，还在等待。

island:2.en: The decoded map showed a small *island* in the middle of Harbor Bay, unmarked on every public chart I had ever seen. Grey Crow said it had no name. Zero's last three transmissions had all bounced off a relay tower built on its shore. I checked the tide tables. Low water in forty minutes.
island:2.cnHint: 解码后的地图显示海湾中央有一座____，零点的信号就是从那里中转的。
island:2.hook: Grey Crow's face told me they had been there before.
island:2.line: 'That *island* does not exist on any legal map — that is exactly why they chose it,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The decoded map showed a small *island* in the middle of Harbor Bay, unmarked on every public chart I had ever seen.
Grey Crow said it had no name.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说它没有名字。

sentences.en: Zero's last three transmissions had all bounced off a relay tower built on its shore.
sentences.cn: 零点最后三次发射都是从建在岸上的中继塔反弹出来的。

sentences.en: I checked the tide tables.
sentences.cn: 我查了潮汐表。

sentences.en: Low water in forty minutes.
sentences.cn: 四十分钟后就是低潮。

native:2.en: The graffiti was in an old script, a *native* code used by the first harbor workers a century ago, long before the city banned unlicensed language. Zero had dug up something ancient and repurposed it. I photographed every line. Ali said only three people alive could still read it.
native:2.cnHint: 那些涂鸦使用了一种古老的____密码，零点把它重新用于传递信息。
native:2.hook: One of those three people was already dead.
native:2.line: 'This is a *native* script — Zero didn't invent it, they found it in the archive ruins,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The graffiti was in an old script, a *native* code used by the first harbor workers a century ago, long before the city banned unlicensed language.
Zero had dug up something ancient and repurposed it.
sentences.cn: 零点挖掘了什么古老的东西，然后重新利用了它。

sentences.en: I photographed every line.
sentences.cn: 我把每一行都拍了下来。

sentences.en: Ali said only three people alive could still read it.
sentences.cn: 阿栗说全世界只有三个人还能读懂它。

tradition:2.en: Grey Crow lit a single match and held it over the drain. An old *tradition* among the harbor runners — if the flame bent east, the route was safe. It bent west. I asked if the ritual was reliable. Grey Crow said it had never been wrong in forty years. We took a different street.
tradition:2.cnHint: 灰鸦用一根火柴遵循古老的____来判断路线是否安全，火焰弯向了西边。
tradition:2.hook: The eastern street exploded two minutes later.
tradition:2.line: '*Tradition* is just pattern recognition with a longer memory,' Grey Crow said quietly.

sentences.en: Grey Crow lit a single match and held it over the drain.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦划亮一根火柴，在排水沟上方举起。

sentences.en: An old *tradition* among the harbor runners — if the flame bent east, the route was safe.
It bent west.
sentences.cn: 火焰向西弯了。

sentences.en: I asked if the ritual was reliable.
sentences.cn: 我问这个仪式是否可靠。

sentences.en: Grey Crow said it had never been wrong in forty years.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说四十年来它从未出过错。

sentences.en: We took a different street.
sentences.cn: 我们走了另一条街。

africa:2.en: The signal tag at the end of Zero's broadcast was a phrase in a dialect traced back to *Africa* — specifically a coastal region whose encryption methods the city had studied and then quietly banned in 2061. Someone had kept the knowledge alive in secret for thirty-eight years. Ali looked at me. 'Grey Crow taught me that phrase,' they said.
africa:2.cnHint: 零点广播末尾的标记来自____的一种方言，这种加密方式已被禁止了38年。
africa:2.hook: Ali's voice did not shake, and that was the worst part.
africa:2.line: 'This code came from *Africa* — someone kept it hidden for nearly four decades,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The signal tag at the end of Zero's broadcast was a phrase in a dialect traced back to *Africa* — specifically a coastal region whose encryption methods the city had studied and then quietly banned in 2061.
Someone had kept the knowledge alive in secret for thirty-eight years.
sentences.cn: 有人在暗地里把这些知识保存了三十八年。

sentences.en: Ali looked at me.
sentences.cn: 阿栗看着我。

sentences.en: 'Grey Crow taught me that phrase,' they said.
sentences.cn: 她说，"灰鸦教过我那句话。"

artificial:2.en: The signal led me to a locked server room deep in Harbor City's data district. Inside, a single lamp cast pale light over rows of plants — each one perfect, each one *artificial*, plastic leaves dusted with real rain. Hidden among their stems was a data chip Grey Crow had told me to find.
artificial:2.cnHint: 调查员在数据区找到了一个藏有芯片的房间，里面摆满了____的植物。
artificial:2.hook: The chip was warm — someone had pulled it only minutes before.
artificial:2.line: 'These *artificial* flowers hide the real secrets,' Grey Crow said softly.

sentences.en: The signal led me to a locked server room deep in Harbor City's data district.
sentences.cn: 信号把我引到了港城数据区深处的一间上了锁的服务器室。

sentences.en: Inside, a single lamp cast pale light over rows of plants — each one perfect, each one *artificial*, plastic leaves dusted with real rain.
Hidden among their stems was a data chip Grey Crow had told me to find.
sentences.cn: 藏在它们茎部之间的是灰鸦告诉我要找的一块数据芯片。

confirm:2.en: Ali slid a folded note across the wet steel table. 'Read it fast,' she said. The note listed three names — mine was the last. I needed Grey Crow to *confirm* whether the list was a warning or a death order before Zero's next broadcast hit the city's signal grid.
confirm:2.cnHint: 调查员收到一张名单，急需灰鸦____这份名单究竟意味着什么。
confirm:2.hook: Grey Crow's reply channel had gone completely silent.
confirm:2.line: 'I need you to *confirm* the list before midnight,' Ali urged.

sentences.en: Ali slid a folded note across the wet steel table.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在潮湿的钢桌上推过一张折叠的纸条。

sentences.en: 'Read it fast,' she said.
sentences.cn: 她说，"快读。"

sentences.en: The note listed three names — mine was the last.
sentences.cn: 纸条上列了三个名字——我的名字排在最后。

sentences.en: I needed Grey Crow to *confirm* whether the list was a warning or a death order before Zero's next broadcast hit the city's signal grid.

context:2.en: Zero's graffiti covered the east wall of the old port — symbols, numbers, broken words. Alone, each mark meant nothing. But Grey Crow had taught me to read the *context*: the order of symbols, the direction of the spray, the height of each line. Together they formed a map.
context:2.cnHint: 调查员通过理解涂鸦的____，将一堆符号拼成了一张地图。
context:2.hook: The map pointed to a place that should not exist.
context:2.line: 'Without *context*, the marks are just noise,' Grey Crow told me once.

sentences.en: Zero's graffiti covered the east wall of the old port — symbols, numbers, broken words.
sentences.cn: 零点的涂鸦覆盖了老港口的东墙——符号、数字、支离破碎的文字。

sentences.en: Alone, each mark meant nothing.
sentences.cn: 单独看，每一个记号都毫无意义。

sentences.en: But Grey Crow had taught me to read the *context*: the order of symbols, the direction of the spray, the height of each line.
Together they formed a map.
sentences.cn: 合起来，它们构成了一张地图。

date:2.en: The message was scratched into the floor beneath a rusted bench in Harbor City's old transit hall — seven digits, nothing more. Ali knelt beside me, voice low. The *date* carved there matched the day the city's language law had passed, the day everything changed, the day Zero first appeared.
date:2.cnHint: 调查员在旧车站地板上发现了一个____，它与一切混乱的起点惊人地吻合。
date:2.hook: Below the date, barely visible, was my own case number.
date:2.line: 'That *date* is not a coincidence,' Ali whispered.

sentences.en: The message was scratched into the floor beneath a rusted bench in Harbor City's old transit hall — seven digits, nothing more.
sentences.cn: 讯息被刻在港城旧中转站一条生锈长椅下的地板上——七位数字，仅此而已。

sentences.en: Ali knelt beside me, voice low.
sentences.cn: 阿栗跪在我身边，声音很低。

sentences.en: The *date* carved there matched the day the city's language law had passed, the day everything changed, the day Zero first appeared.

flexible:2.en: Grey Crow had built the dead-drop box from soft polymer — *flexible* enough to bend flat and slide under any door in the city. Inside I found a voice chip, still warm. The recording was short: Zero's next move, a target, a time. Three pieces of information I was never meant to hear.
flexible:2.cnHint: 调查员从一个____材质的传递盒里取出了一段本不该落入自己耳中的录音。
flexible:2.hook: The voice on the chip belonged to someone I trusted.
flexible:2.line: 'The casing is *flexible* — it fits anywhere,' Grey Crow had said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow had built the dead-drop box from soft polymer — *flexible* enough to bend flat and slide under any door in the city.
Inside I found a voice chip, still warm.
sentences.cn: 我在里面找到了一块声音芯片，还是温热的。

sentences.en: The recording was short: Zero's next move, a target, a time.
sentences.cn: 录音很短：零点的下一步行动、一个目标、一个时间。

sentences.en: Three pieces of information I was never meant to hear.
sentences.cn: 三条我本不该听到的信息。

fly:2.en: The drone was small enough to *fly* through a broken window without a sound. Ali had sent it ahead into the abandoned signal tower while we waited in the rain below. Its tiny camera fed images back to my lens. What it showed on the top floor stopped my breath cold.
fly:2.cnHint: 阿栗放飞无人机进入信号塔，镜头传回的画面让调查员倒吸一口凉气。
fly:2.hook: Zero was already there, reading a file with my name on it.
fly:2.line: 'I'll let it *fly* in first — safer that way,' Ali said quietly.

sentences.en: The drone was small enough to *fly* through a broken window without a sound.
Ali had sent it ahead into the abandoned signal tower while we waited in the rain below.
sentences.cn: 阿栗先把无人机送进了那座废弃信号塔，我们在下面雨中等待。

sentences.en: Its tiny camera fed images back to my lens.
sentences.cn: 它的小摄像头把画面传回我的镜片。

sentences.en: What it showed on the top floor stopped my breath cold.
sentences.cn: 它在顶楼拍到的东西让我的呼吸停住了。

judge:2.en: The sealed envelope bore an official stamp — Harbor City Signal Court. Inside was a single printed order signed by a *judge* I had never heard of, granting Zero full access to the city's encrypted public channels. Someone powerful had made this legal. Someone had let Zero in through the front door.
judge:2.cnHint: 调查员发现一份法庭文件，一位____已正式授权零点进入城市加密频道。
judge:2.hook: The signature on the order matched a name Grey Crow had warned me never to speak.
judge:2.line: 'A *judge* signed this,' I said. 'Zero has cover from the top.'

sentences.en: The sealed envelope bore an official stamp — Harbor City Signal Court.
sentences.cn: 密封的信封上有官方印章——港城信号法院。

sentences.en: Inside was a single printed order signed by a *judge* I had never heard of, granting Zero full access to the city's encrypted public channels.
Someone powerful had made this legal.
sentences.cn: 有人赋予了零点进入这座城市加密公共频道的全部权限。

sentences.en: Someone had let Zero in through the front door.
sentences.cn: 有人让零点从正门进来了。

oil:2.en: The hidden room smelled of *oil* and old metal — machinery that had not run in years, or so I had thought. But the floor was clean, the gears bright. Someone had been here recently, maintaining every part in silence. On the central console, a single red light blinked in a pattern I recognized.
oil:2.cnHint: 调查员发现一间气味中弥漫着____的秘密机房，里面的设备竟然被人秘密维护着。
oil:2.hook: The blinking pattern spelled out Ali's name.
oil:2.line: 'Smell that *oil* — this machine ran tonight,' Grey Crow said grimly.

sentences.en: The hidden room smelled of *oil* and old metal — machinery that had not run in years, or so I had thought.
But the floor was clean, the gears bright.
sentences.cn: 但地板很干净，齿轮闪闪发亮。

sentences.en: Someone had been here recently, maintaining every part in silence.
sentences.cn: 最近有人来过这里，在沉默中维护着每个部件。

sentences.en: On the central console, a single red light blinked in a pattern I recognized.
sentences.cn: 在中央控制台上，一盏红灯按我认出的节奏闪烁。

passion:2.en: The coded message was not a threat — it was a confession. Whoever wrote it had poured *passion* into every hidden syllable, a burning need to be heard beneath Harbor City's silence. Ali read it twice and went quiet. Grey Crow had warned us: true believers are the most dangerous signals of all.
passion:2.cnHint: 破译的信息里藏着强烈的____，阿栗看完后沉默了。
passion:2.hook: The signature at the bottom matched a name we thought was dead.
passion:2.line: 'This kind of *passion* doesn't fade — it waits.'

sentences.en: The coded message was not a threat — it was a confession.
sentences.cn: 那条密码信息不是威胁——它是一份忏悔。

sentences.en: Whoever wrote it had poured *passion* into every hidden syllable, a burning need to be heard beneath Harbor City's silence.
Ali read it twice and went quiet.
sentences.cn: 阿栗读了两遍就沉默了。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned us: true believers are the most dangerous signals of all.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦曾警告我们：真正的信徒是最危险的信号。

temperature:2.en: The server room under Dock Nine had no lights, only heat. I checked my scanner: the *temperature* inside was rising fast, far past safe levels. Someone had locked the cooling system from outside. Ali pressed her back against the door. The data we needed was still uploading.
temperature:2.cnHint: 地下服务器房间的____急剧上升，有人从外部锁住了冷却系统。
temperature:2.hook: The upload bar hit ninety percent, then the power cut out.
temperature:2.line: 'Watch the *temperature* — when it hits sixty, we leave, data or not.'

sentences.en: The server room under Dock Nine had no lights, only heat.
sentences.cn: 九号码头下的服务器间没有灯光，只有热。

sentences.en: I checked my scanner: the *temperature* inside was rising fast, far past safe levels.
Someone had locked the cooling system from outside.
sentences.cn: 有人从外面锁死了冷却系统。

sentences.en: Ali pressed her back against the door.
sentences.cn: 阿栗靠住了门背。

sentences.en: The data we needed was still uploading.
sentences.cn: 我们需要的数据还在上传。

board:2.en: Pinned to the wall of the empty safe house was a *board* covered in torn paper and wire. Each fragment held a word, a date, a district. Together they mapped every signal I had ever tracked. Zero had been watching me far longer than I knew. Ali touched one of the wires and stepped back.
board:2.cnHint: 废弃安全屋的墙上钉着一块____，上面记录了调查员所有的追踪记录。
board:2.hook: At the center of the board was a photo — my own face, circled in red.
board:2.line: 'This *board* is not a plan — it is a warning meant for you.'

sentences.en: Pinned to the wall of the empty safe house was a *board* covered in torn paper and wire.
Each fragment held a word, a date, a district.
sentences.cn: 每一张纸片上都有一个词、一个日期、一个区域。

sentences.en: Together they mapped every signal I had ever tracked.
sentences.cn: 合起来，它们标绘了我追踪过的每一个信号。

sentences.en: Zero had been watching me far longer than I knew.
sentences.cn: 零点监视我的时间比我想的要长得多。

sentences.en: Ali touched one of the wires and stepped back.
sentences.cn: 阿栗碰了碰其中一根电线，退了回去。

handle:2.en: The locker in Sub-Station Four had no number, only a cold metal *handle* shaped like a broken signal wave. Grey Crow said touch nothing. I touched it anyway. Inside was a single data chip wrapped in a note that read: deliver this and the city goes quiet. My hand would not stop shaking.
handle:2.cnHint: 四号变电站的储物柜只有一个奇特的____，里面藏着一枚能让全城噤声的芯片。
handle:2.hook: The note had today's date printed at the bottom — in my own handwriting.
handle:2.line: 'Turn the *handle* slowly — the mechanism inside is older than this city.'

sentences.en: The locker in Sub-Station Four had no number, only a cold metal *handle* shaped like a broken signal wave.
Grey Crow said touch nothing.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说别碰任何东西。

sentences.en: I touched it anyway.
sentences.cn: 我还是碰了。

sentences.en: Inside was a single data chip wrapped in a note that read: deliver this and the city goes quiet.
sentences.cn: 里面是一块单独的数据芯片，包在一张纸条里，上面写着：交付这个，这座城市就会沉默。

sentences.en: My hand would not stop shaking.
sentences.cn: 我的手止不住地颤抖。

ideal:2.en: Zero's broadcast cut through every filter I had. The voice was calm, almost kind: the *ideal* city, it said, is one where only the right people speak. Ali killed the feed before it finished. Grey Crow stared at the dead screen for a long moment and said nothing. That silence told me everything.
ideal:2.cnHint: 零点的广播描绘了一种____城市的图景，阿栗紧急切断了信号。
ideal:2.hook: The broadcast had already reached forty thousand receivers before we stopped it.
ideal:2.line: 'His *ideal* city has no room for voices like ours.'

sentences.en: Zero's broadcast cut through every filter I had.
sentences.cn: 零点的广播突破了我所有的过滤——那个声音平静得近乎温柔：它说，理想的城市就是只有合适的人说话的地方。

sentences.en: The voice was calm, almost kind: the *ideal* city, it said, is one where only the right people speak.
Ali killed the feed before it finished.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在播放完成前掐断了信号。

sentences.en: Grey Crow stared at the dead screen for a long moment and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦盯着黑屏沉默了很久，什么也没说。

sentences.en: That silence told me everything.
sentences.cn: 那个沉默告诉了我一切。

ride:2.en: The freight elevator was our only way out of the archive level. Grey Crow called it a *ride* with no promises. It groaned and dropped two floors before catching. In the dark, pressed against crates of old encrypted drives, I heard Zero's signal bleeding through the walls, clear and close.
ride:2.cnHint: 调查员乘坐一段危险的____逃出档案层，零点的信号在黑暗中越来越清晰。
ride:2.hook: The elevator stopped between floors, and someone above us began cutting the cable.
ride:2.line: 'This *ride* ends at the top — after that, we run.'

sentences.en: The freight elevator was our only way out of the archive level.
sentences.cn: 货运电梯是我们唯一的出路。

sentences.en: Grey Crow called it a *ride* with no promises.
It groaned and dropped two floors before catching.
sentences.cn: 它呻吟着下降了两层才卡住。

sentences.en: In the dark, pressed against crates of old encrypted drives, I heard Zero's signal bleeding through the walls, clear and close.
sentences.cn: 在黑暗中，贴着装满旧加密硬盘的箱子，我听到零点的信号从墙壁里渗出来，清晰而近在咫尺。

adjust:2.en: The signal was almost perfectly hidden inside a weather report. I had to *adjust* the filter three times before the real message emerged, letter by letter, from beneath the noise. Ali watched the screen over my shoulder. Grey Crow had taught me this method. I had never needed it this badly before.
adjust:2.cnHint: 调查员多次____滤波器，终于从气象播报中提取出了隐藏的真实信息。
adjust:2.hook: The message ended with coordinates — and a countdown already below four minutes.
adjust:2.line: '*Adjust* the lower band first — Zero always hides his signal near the floor.'

sentences.en: The signal was almost perfectly hidden inside a weather report.
sentences.cn: 信号几乎完美地藏在了天气预报里。

sentences.en: I had to *adjust* the filter three times before the real message emerged, letter by letter, from beneath the noise.
Ali watched the screen over my shoulder.
sentences.cn: 阿栗从我肩膀后面看着屏幕。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had taught me this method.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦教过我这套方法。

sentences.en: I had never needed it this badly before.
sentences.cn: 我从未这么急切地需要过它。

basis:2.en: Grey Crow spread the recovered files across the table. On what *basis* had Zero chosen his targets? Every name, every district, every silenced broadcast — all of it pointed to one thing: the people who still taught others to read between the lines. Ali looked at me. I was on the list.
basis:2.cnHint: 灰鸦试图找出零点选择目标的____，而调查员发现自己也在名单上。
basis:2.hook: The list had one blank slot at the end, dated tomorrow.
basis:2.line: 'On what *basis* did he choose these people — and why did he stop at you?'

sentences.en: Grey Crow spread the recovered files across the table.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把恢复的文件铺开放在桌上。

sentences.en: On what *basis* had Zero chosen his targets?
Every name, every district, every silenced broadcast — all of it pointed to one thing: the people who still taught others to read between the lines.
sentences.cn: 每个名字、每个地区、每条被消音的广播——全部指向一个事实：那些还在教人在字里行间读出真相的人。

sentences.en: Ali looked at me.
sentences.cn: 阿栗看着我。

sentences.en: I was on the list.
sentences.cn: 我在名单上。

conventional:2.en: The message arrived in a *conventional* paper envelope — no encryption, no code. That was wrong. In Harbor City, only traps came without layers. I set it on the wet table and did not open it. Ali watched from the corner, her breath slow. Someone wanted me to think this was normal.
conventional:2.cnHint: 调查员收到一个看似____的纸质信封，但在港湾城，这反而令人起疑。
conventional:2.hook: The envelope began to hiss, very softly.
conventional:2.line: 'Nothing *conventional* lands on your desk in this city without a reason.'

sentences.en: The message arrived in a *conventional* paper envelope — no encryption, no code.
That was wrong.
sentences.cn: 这不对。

sentences.en: In Harbor City, only traps came without layers.
sentences.cn: 在港湾城，没有加密的东西只有陷阱。

sentences.en: I set it on the wet table and did not open it.
sentences.cn: 我把信放在湿漉漉的桌子上，没有打开。

sentences.en: Ali watched from the corner, her breath slow.
sentences.cn: 阿栗从角落看着，呼吸很缓。

sentences.en: Someone wanted me to think this was normal.
sentences.cn: 有人想让我觉得这很正常。

disappear:2.en: The signal map lit up for three seconds — twelve active nodes in the East Grid. Then they began to *disappear*, one by one, like lights going out in a storm. Ali counted aloud. I watched the last node blink off. Someone was cutting the network by hand, working fast, moving closer.
disappear:2.cnHint: 信号地图上的节点开始一个接一个地____，阿栗大声数着倒计时。
disappear:2.hook: The final node was our location.
disappear:2.line: 'If we *disappear* from that map, no one will know where to look.'

sentences.en: The signal map lit up for three seconds — twelve active nodes in the East Grid.
sentences.cn: 信号地图亮了三秒钟——东网格十二个活跃节点。

sentences.en: Then they began to *disappear*, one by one, like lights going out in a storm.
Ali counted aloud.
sentences.cn: 阿栗数着。

sentences.en: I watched the last node blink off.
sentences.cn: 我看着最后一个节点熄灭。

sentences.en: Someone was cutting the network by hand, working fast, moving closer.
sentences.cn: 有人在手动切割网络，动作很快，越来越近。

district:2.en: Grey Crow sent one line: meet in the Salt *District*, sub-level four, before the rain shifts. I had never been that far east. The Salt District had no streetlights — only glow from cracked pipes and old signal boards. Nobody went there by choice. Grey Crow knew that too.
district:2.cnHint: 灰鸦约调查员在盐____的地下第四层碰面，那是一个无人愿意踏入的地方。
district:2.hook: My tracker showed the sub-level did not exist on any official map.
district:2.line: 'The Salt *District* has ears, so choose every word with care.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow sent one line: meet in the Salt *District*, sub-level four, before the rain shifts.
I had never been that far east.
sentences.cn: 我从没去过那么东的地方。

sentences.en: The Salt District had no streetlights — only glow from cracked pipes and old signal boards.
sentences.cn: 盐区没有街灯——只有裂开的管道和旧信号板的荧光。

sentences.en: Nobody went there by choice.
sentences.cn: 没人会主动去那里。

sentences.en: Grey Crow knew that too.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦也知道。

greatly:2.en: The decoded file *greatly* changed what I thought I knew about Zero. He was not hunting us — he had been feeding us clues all along, each one a step in a path he built months ago. Ali read the last line twice. I felt the floor shift under my thinking.
greatly:2.cnHint: 解码后的文件____改变了调查员对零点的判断，原来他一直在引导他们。
greatly:2.hook: If Zero built the path, he also built the end of it.
greatly:2.line: 'This file has *greatly* changed the shape of everything we planned.'

sentences.en: The decoded file *greatly* changed what I thought I knew about Zero.
He was not hunting us — he had been feeding us clues all along, each one a step in a path he built months ago.
sentences.cn: 他不是在追捕我们——他一直在给我们喂线索，每一条都是他几个月前铺好的路上的一步。

sentences.en: Ali read the last line twice.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把最后一行读了两遍。

sentences.en: I felt the floor shift under my thinking.
sentences.cn: 我感觉思维的地板在移动。

imitate:2.en: The graffiti on the relay box was almost perfect — but I could see it was not Grey Crow's hand. Someone had studied his style and tried to *imitate* it, copying the sharp turns and the double loop on the letter S. The false tag carried a different code. A trap coded to look like a guide.
imitate:2.cnHint: 调查员发现有人试图____灰鸦的涂鸦风格，在墙上留下了一条伪装成指引的陷阱信息。
imitate:2.hook: The real Grey Crow never used the letter S.
imitate:2.line: 'To *imitate* his marks so well, they must have watched him for months.'

sentences.en: The graffiti on the relay box was almost perfect — but I could see it was not Grey Crow's hand.
sentences.cn: 中继器盒子上的涂鸦几乎完美——但我能看出不是灰鸦的手笔。

sentences.en: Someone had studied his style and tried to *imitate* it, copying the sharp turns and the double loop on the letter S.
The false tag carried a different code.
sentences.cn: 假标签里藏着不同的代码。

sentences.en: A trap coded to look like a guide.
sentences.cn: 一个假装成指引的陷阱。

implement:2.en: Ali pulled a small metal *implement* from her coat — a signal probe, homemade, no wider than a pen. She pressed it against the wall panel and it gave a low tone. Behind the panel was a live wire, transmitting on a banned frequency. Someone was broadcasting from inside this building, right now.
implement:2.cnHint: 阿栗用一件自制的____探测工具发现墙后藏有非法信号源。
implement:2.hook: The broadcast had been running for exactly seventy-two hours.
implement:2.line: 'This *implement* is the only thing standing between us and going in blind.'

sentences.en: Ali pulled a small metal *implement* from her coat — a signal probe, homemade, no wider than a pen.
She pressed it against the wall panel and it gave a low tone.
sentences.cn: 她把它压在墙面板上，发出低鸣。

sentences.en: Behind the panel was a live wire, transmitting on a banned frequency.
sentences.cn: 面板后面是一根活线，在禁频上传输。

sentences.en: Someone was broadcasting from inside this building, right now.
sentences.cn: 有人现在就在这栋楼里广播。

mood:2.en: The room read the *mood* of everyone who entered — sensors in the floor, in the air, hidden in the paint. Grey Crow had warned me: the system flags calm people as threats, because no one is calm in Harbor City without a reason. I breathed slow. The light above me turned red.
mood:2.cnHint: 房间里的传感器能感知每个人的____，调查员越是表现镇定，系统越是发出警报。
mood:2.hook: A door I had not seen before clicked open behind me.
mood:2.line: 'Control your *mood* or the system will decide you are the danger here.'

sentences.en: The room read the *mood* of everyone who entered — sensors in the floor, in the air, hidden in the paint.
Grey Crow had warned me: the system flags calm people as threats, because no one is calm in Harbor City without a reason.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦曾经警告过我——这套系统会把冷静的人标记为威胁，因为在港湾城没人能真正保持冷静，除非另有目的。

sentences.en: I breathed slow.
sentences.cn: 我放慢了呼吸。

sentences.en: The light above me turned red.
sentences.cn: 头顶的灯亮起了红色。

motivation:2.en: Zero left no name, no face — only a message carved into the server casing: find the *motivation* before you find the man. I stared at it for a long time. Ali said it sounded like a warning. It sounded to me like a test. Somewhere in the data, the reason for all of this was waiting.
motivation:2.cnHint: 零点留下的信息让调查员去寻找事件背后真正的____，而不是追人本身。
motivation:2.line: 'Once you find the *motivation*, the rest of the case will fall into place.'

sentences.en: Zero left no name, no face — only a message carved into the server casing: find the *motivation* before you find the man.
I stared at it for a long time.
sentences.cn: 我盯着它看了很久。

sentences.en: Ali said it sounded like a warning.
sentences.cn: 阿栗说听起来像个警告。

sentences.en: It sounded to me like a test.
sentences.cn: 对我来说，像是个考验。

sentences.en: Somewhere in the data, the reason for all of this was waiting.
sentences.cn: 数据的某个角落里，所有这一切的原因在等着。

attribute:2.en: The data chip felt warm in my palm. Grey Crow had told me every *attribute* of the signal — its frequency, its shape, its hidden code — but reading it live was different. The numbers on my screen matched nothing in the city database. Someone had built this from scratch.
attribute:2.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我这个信号的每一个____，但屏幕上的数据与城市数据库毫无吻合。
attribute:2.hook: The chip's final field read: origin — unknown, owner — me.
attribute:2.line: 'Every *attribute* of that signal points to one source,' Grey Crow said quietly.

sentences.en: The data chip felt warm in my palm.
sentences.cn: 数据芯片在我掌心发热。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told me every *attribute* of the signal — its frequency, its shape, its hidden code — but reading it live was different.
The numbers on my screen matched nothing in the city database.
sentences.cn: 我屏幕上的数字和城市数据库里的任何东西都对不上。

sentences.en: Someone had built this from scratch.
sentences.cn: 有人从零开始造的这个。

badly:2.en: Ali found the message folded inside a broken street lamp on Deck Nine. The paper was *badly* damaged by rain, but three words survived: 'Zero knows you.' My hands went cold. We had been careful. We had been silent. It had not been enough.
badly:2.cnHint: 阿栗在路灯里找到一张____受损的纸条，上面只剩三个字让我们背脊发凉。
badly:2.hook: The lamp above us flickered once, then died.
badly:2.line: 'This note is *badly* torn — but the warning is clear,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Ali found the message folded inside a broken street lamp on Deck Nine.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在九号甲板一盏破损的街灯里面找到了这张纸条。

sentences.en: The paper was *badly* damaged by rain, but three words survived: 'Zero knows you.'
My hands went cold.
sentences.cn: 我的手冰冷了。

sentences.en: We had been careful.
sentences.cn: 我们一直在小心。

sentences.en: We had been silent.
sentences.cn: 我们一直在沉默。

sentences.en: It had not been enough.
sentences.cn: 还是不够。

bridge:2.en: The encrypted file acted as a *bridge* between two dead networks — one shut down by the city three years ago, the other owned by Zero. I stared at the connection map on my screen. Someone had kept this link alive in secret, passing data through the dark for years.
bridge:2.cnHint: 这份加密文件是两个断网之间的____，有人秘密维持着它多年。
bridge:2.hook: And the last packet had been sent sixty seconds ago.
bridge:2.line: 'This file is the *bridge* — destroy it and Zero loses everything,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The encrypted file acted as a *bridge* between two dead networks — one shut down by the city three years ago, the other owned by Zero.
I stared at the connection map on my screen.
sentences.cn: 我盯着屏幕上的连接图。

sentences.en: Someone had kept this link alive in secret, passing data through the dark for years.
sentences.cn: 有人在暗处偷偷保活了这条线路，多年来一直在传输数据。

casual:2.en: Zero left a *casual* note tucked under my door — no code, no encryption, just plain handwriting on grey paper. 'Nice work tonight.' That easy tone was the most frightening thing I had read all week. It meant Zero had been close. It meant Zero was not worried at all.
casual:2.cnHint: 零点留下一张语气____的便条，这种轻松才是最令人不安的威胁。
casual:2.hook: The handwriting matched no record in the city system.
casual:2.line: 'A *casual* note from Zero means we have already lost the advantage,' Grey Crow warned.

sentences.en: Zero left a *casual* note tucked under my door — no code, no encryption, just plain handwriting on grey paper.
'Nice work tonight.'
sentences.cn: "今晚干得不错。"

sentences.en: That easy tone was the most frightening thing I had read all week.
sentences.cn: 这种轻松的语气是我整周读到的最恐怖的东西。

sentences.en: It meant Zero had been close.
sentences.cn: 说明零点离我很近。

sentences.en: It meant Zero was not worried at all.
sentences.cn: 说明零点一点都不担心。

closely:2.en: I studied the graffiti tag *closely*, pressing my face near the wet wall of the lower market. Ali had spotted it first — a tiny spiral mark that matched the signal pattern from last night. The lines were too precise to be random. Someone had painted this as a message for me.
closely:2.cnHint: 我____地研究墙上的涂鸦，那个螺旋标记与昨晚的信号图案完全吻合。
closely:2.hook: Behind me, I heard slow footsteps stop.
closely:2.line: 'Look *closely* at the center mark,' Ali whispered, 'it is a frequency map.'

sentences.en: I studied the graffiti tag *closely*, pressing my face near the wet wall of the lower market.
Ali had spotted it first — a tiny spiral mark that matched the signal pattern from last night.
sentences.cn: 阿栗先发现的——一个微小的螺旋标记，和昨晚的信号图案一模一样。

sentences.en: The lines were too precise to be random.
sentences.cn: 线条精准得不可能是随意涂鸦。

sentences.en: Someone had painted this as a message for me.
sentences.cn: 有人把这个当成了留给我的信息。

commit:2.en: The document on screen asked me to *commit* to the operation — one tap, no way back. Grey Crow had vanished. Ali was waiting in the street below. Zero's signal was moving closer on my tracker. I read the terms one last time, my finger hovering over the cold glass.
commit:2.cnHint: 屏幕上的文件要求我____执行这次行动，一旦确认便无法撤回。
commit:2.hook: Then the tracker beeped — Zero's signal had stopped moving, right outside.
commit:2.line: 'Once you *commit*, the city system locks you in,' Grey Crow had warned me earlier.

sentences.cn: 阿栗在楼下街道上等着。

sentences.en: Zero's signal was moving closer on my tracker.
sentences.cn: 零点的信号在我的追踪器上越来越近。

sentences.en: I read the terms one last time, my finger hovering over the cold glass.
sentences.cn: 我最后读了一遍条款，手指悬在冰冷的玻璃屏幕上方。

concentrate:2.en: '*Concentrate*,' Ali said sharply. I pulled my attention back to the signal. Three overlapping frequencies, each carrying a fragment of the same hidden name. I filtered out the city noise, layer by layer, until one voice came through — cold, steady, and aimed directly at me.
concentrate:2.cnHint: 阿栗让我____，我逐层过滤城市噪音，直到一个声音清晰地直指我而来。
concentrate:2.hook: The voice said my real name — the one I had never told anyone.
concentrate:2.line: '*Concentrate* on the middle frequency — the message is buried there,' Ali said.

sentences.en: '*Concentrate*,' Ali said sharply.
I pulled my attention back to the signal.
sentences.cn: 我把注意力拉回信号上。

sentences.en: Three overlapping frequencies, each carrying a fragment of the same hidden name.
sentences.cn: 三个重叠的频率，每一个都承载着同一个隐秘名字的碎片。

sentences.en: I filtered out the city noise, layer by layer, until one voice came through — cold, steady, and aimed directly at me.
sentences.cn: 我逐层过滤掉城市噪音，直到一个声音穿透出来——冷漠、平稳，直指向我。

conscious:2.en: I was *conscious* of every camera on Deck Four as I slid the data card under the locked door. Twelve lenses, two guards, one blind spot — I had counted them all. The card vanished. A moment later, a single light on the panel turned green. Someone inside had been waiting.
conscious:2.cnHint: 我____地注意着四层甲板上的每一个摄像头，将数据卡悄悄递了进去。
conscious:2.hook: The green light turned red, and the whole building went silent.
conscious:2.line: 'Stay *conscious* of the east camera — it resets every forty seconds,' Grey Crow had said.

sentences.en: I was *conscious* of every camera on Deck Four as I slid the data card under the locked door.
Twelve lenses, two guards, one blind spot — I had counted them all.
sentences.cn: 十二个摄像头，两个守卫，一个盲点——我全部数过了。

sentences.cn: 卡片消失了。

sentences.en: A moment later, a single light on the panel turned green.
sentences.cn: 片刻后，控制面板上一盏灯亮了绿色。

sentences.en: Someone inside had been waiting.
sentences.cn: 里面有人在等。

relative:2.en: Grey Crow spread the city map under a cold blue lamp. 'Nothing is fixed here,' he said. The position of every safe house was *relative* to a signal tower that Zero moved each night. I stared at the shifting grid and felt the ground under my plan dissolve.
relative:2.cnHint: 格雷·克劳解释说，每个安全屋的位置都是____的，因为零每晚都会移动信号塔。
relative:2.hook: The tower had already moved — and we were standing in the wrong place.
relative:2.line: 'The safe distance is *relative* to where Zero planted the new tower.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow spread the city map under a cold blue lamp.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在冷蓝色灯下铺开了城市地图。

sentences.en: 'Nothing is fixed here,' he said.
sentences.cn: "这里没有什么是固定的，"他说。

sentences.en: The position of every safe house was *relative* to a signal tower that Zero moved each night.
I stared at the shifting grid and felt the ground under my plan dissolve.
sentences.cn: 我盯着不断变化的网格，感觉自己的计划地基消散了。

rent:2.en: The drop point was a storage unit in the old port district. Ali checked the tag on the door: paid in cash, no name, no record. 'Whoever left this paid three months *rent* in advance,' she said, her voice flat. Inside, a single data chip sat under a dead light.
rent:2.cnHint: 阿里发现，有人提前支付了三个月的____，在旧港区留下了一个没有名字的储藏单元。
rent:2.hook: The chip was still warm — someone had been here minutes ago.
rent:2.line: 'Three months of *rent* paid in cash — this drop was planned long before us.'

sentences.en: The drop point was a storage unit in the old port district.
sentences.cn: 投送点是旧港口区的一个仓储单位。

sentences.en: Ali checked the tag on the door: paid in cash, no name, no record.
sentences.cn: 阿栗检查了门上的标签：现金付款，没有名字，没有记录。

sentences.en: 'Whoever left this paid three months *rent* in advance,' she said, her voice flat.
Inside, a single data chip sat under a dead light.
sentences.cn: 里面，一枚数据芯片躺在一盏死了的灯下。

round:2.en: Grey Crow called it the final *round* of the signal war. Each side had sent one coded broadcast per night for seven nights. Tonight was night seven. I sat in the relay station, headset on, waiting for Zero's last transmission to cut through the static.
round:2.cnHint: 格雷·克劳说，信号战的最后一____即将到来，我在中继站等待着零的最后一次传输。
round:2.hook: The static broke — but the voice on the line was not Zero's.
round:2.line: 'This *round* ends tonight, and only one signal will survive.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow called it the final *round* of the signal war.
Each side had sent one coded broadcast per night for seven nights.
sentences.cn: 双方每晚各发一条编码广播，连续七晚。

sentences.en: Tonight was night seven.
sentences.cn: 今晚是第七晚。

sentences.en: I sat in the relay station, headset on, waiting for Zero's last transmission to cut through the static.
sentences.cn: 我坐在中继站里，戴着耳机，等着零点最后的信号穿过静电。

structure:2.en: The building looked abandoned, but I could hear a low hum inside its walls. Ali pointed her scanner at the concrete. 'The *structure* has been modified,' she said quietly. 'There is a second floor that does not appear on any city plan.' My pulse jumped.
structure:2.cnHint: 阿里的扫描仪显示，这栋建筑的____已被改动，有一层楼在城市规划图上根本不存在。
structure:2.hook: Something moved behind the wall where no room was supposed to exist.
structure:2.line: 'The *structure* was rebuilt in secret — there is a hidden level inside.'

sentences.en: The building looked abandoned, but I could hear a low hum inside its walls.
sentences.cn: 这栋楼看起来废弃了，但我能听到墙壁内有低沉的嗡鸣。

sentences.en: Ali pointed her scanner at the concrete.
sentences.cn: 阿栗用扫描仪指向混凝土。

sentences.en: 'The *structure* has been modified,' she said quietly.
'There is a second floor that does not appear on any city plan.'
sentences.cn: "上面没有任何城市规划里记载的第二层楼。"

sentences.en: My pulse jumped.
sentences.cn: 我的心跳加速了。

typical:2.en: Zero left a message burned into the wall of the empty café. Ali read it aloud: 'This is not a *typical* warning.' The letters were arranged in a pattern I had only seen once before, in a case file marked closed three years ago. Cold settled in my chest.
typical:2.cnHint: 零在咖啡馆墙上留下的信息说，这不是一次____的警告，而那种字母排列方式让我想起了一个早已结案的档案。
typical:2.hook: That closed case had put two investigators in the hospital.
typical:2.line: 'This is not a *typical* warning — Zero is changing the rules.'

sentences.en: Zero left a message burned into the wall of the empty café.
sentences.cn: 零点在一家空荡的咖啡馆的墙上烧入了一条信息。

sentences.en: Ali read it aloud: 'This is not a *typical* warning.'
The letters were arranged in a pattern I had only seen once before, in a case file marked closed three years ago.
sentences.cn: 这些字母排成的图案我只在一份三年前标记为结案的档案里见过一次。

sentences.en: Cold settled in my chest.
sentences.cn: 寒意蔓延进我的胸膛。

vacation:2.en: The coded broadcast was hidden inside a tourism ad — sunny beaches, cheap hotels, the word *vacation* repeating like a soft drum. But beneath the sound I caught a secondary pulse: coordinates, two sets, switching every four beats. Grey Crow had taught me to hear exactly this.
vacation:2.cnHint: 一段旅游广告里反复出现____这个词，但我在声音背后听到了隐藏的坐标信号。
vacation:2.hook: One set of coordinates pointed directly to Ali's home address.
vacation:2.line: 'They hid the data inside a *vacation* ad — Zero is getting bold.'

sentences.en: The coded broadcast was hidden inside a tourism ad — sunny beaches, cheap hotels, the word *vacation* repeating like a soft drum.
But beneath the sound I caught a secondary pulse: coordinates, two sets, switching every four beats.
sentences.cn: 但在声音下面我捕捉到了一个次级脉冲：坐标，两组，每四拍切换一次。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had taught me to hear exactly this.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦教过我怎么听到正好是这个。

acquire:2.en: Ali slid a small drive across the table. 'I had to call in every favor I had left to *acquire* this,' she said, eyes steady. The drive held Zero's original signal key — the one tool that could unravel every coded broadcast in Harbor City in under a minute.
acquire:2.cnHint: 阿里用尽了所有的人情，终于____到了零的原始信号密钥，那是解开整座城市所有加密广播的唯一工具。
acquire:2.hook: When I plugged it in, the screen showed my own name at the top of Zero's list.
acquire:2.line: 'It took everything I had to *acquire* this key — do not waste it.'

sentences.en: Ali slid a small drive across the table.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把一个小硬盘轻轻推过桌子。

sentences.en: 'I had to call in every favor I had left to *acquire* this,' she said, eyes steady.
The drive held Zero's original signal key — the one tool that could unravel every coded broadcast in Harbor City in under a minute.
sentences.cn: 硬盘里装着零点的原始信号密钥——那个能在一分钟内破解港城每一条编码广播的工具。

adequate:2.en: Grey Crow reviewed my plan in silence. Then he set it down. 'The data you have is *adequate* for one move,' he said, 'but Zero is already three moves ahead.' He tapped the final line of my report. It was the one line I had written without proof.
adequate:2.cnHint: 格雷·克劳认为我收集的数据____应付一步棋，但零已经领先了三步，而我报告的最后一行根本没有证据支撑。
adequate:2.hook: That unsupported line was the one Zero had clearly read first.
adequate:2.line: 'Your data is *adequate* for tonight — but tonight may not be enough.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow reviewed my plan in silence.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦沉默着审视我的计划。

sentences.en: Then he set it down.
sentences.cn: 然后她放下了。

sentences.en: 'The data you have is *adequate* for one move,' he said, 'but Zero is already three moves ahead.'
He tapped the final line of my report.
sentences.cn: 她敲了敲我报告的最后一行。

sentences.en: It was the one line I had written without proof.
sentences.cn: 那是我唯一没有证据就写下来的一行。

comfortable:2.en: The safe house smelled of cold metal and old rain. Ali had set up a cot in the corner, and I dropped onto it, too tired to think. Nothing about this place was *comfortable* — the walls hummed with scanner noise, the light was a sick yellow — but for one minute I closed my eyes and let myself believe we were safe.
comfortable:2.cnHint: 我躺在临时据点的简陋床铺上，这里并不____，但我短暂地放松了警惕。
comfortable:2.hook: Then the scanner noise stopped, all at once.
comfortable:2.line: 'Nothing here is *comfortable*, but at least the door locks,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The safe house smelled of cold metal and old rain.
sentences.cn: 安全屋闻起来冷冰冰的，还混着陈年的雨水味。

sentences.en: Ali had set up a cot in the corner, and I dropped onto it, too tired to think.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在角落搭了张行军床，我一头栽上去，累得没有思考的力气。

sentences.en: Nothing about this place was *comfortable* — the walls hummed with scanner noise, the light was a sick yellow — but for one minute I closed my eyes and let myself believe we were safe.

conclusion:2.cnHint: 我拼好所有碎纸片，得出了一个令人不安的____：内部有人是内鬼。
conclusion:2.hook: The last symbol was my own ID number.
conclusion:2.line: 'The *conclusion* is right there in front of you,' Grey Crow said quietly.
