sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned me: the city's forgotten networks sometimes grew their own *creature*, a living program wearing a body of scrap.

crime:2.en: The document Grey Crow placed before me listed every hidden broadcast in the city over ten years. At the bottom, one entry was circled in red. The signal had come from inside the Investigation Bureau itself. Sending forbidden code from a protected building was the highest *crime* on the books, and the sender's ID was someone I trusted.
crime:2.cnHint: 文件底部那条被红圈标注的记录显示，最严重的____来自调查局内部，发送者让我震惊。
crime:2.hook: The ID belonged to the one person who had vouched for me on my first day.
crime:2.line: 'A *crime* committed inside these walls is far harder to prove — that is why they chose this place.'

sentences.en: The document Grey Crow placed before me listed every hidden broadcast in the city over ten years.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦摆在我面前的文件列出了十年来城里每一条隐秘的广播。

sentences.en: At the bottom, one entry was circled in red.
sentences.cn: 最下面，一条记录用红笔圈了起来。

sentences.en: The signal had come from inside the Investigation Bureau itself.
sentences.cn: 信号来自调查局内部。

sentences.en: Sending forbidden code from a protected building was the highest *crime* on the books, and the sender's ID was someone I trusted.

deeply:2.en: Ali handed me the decoded letter without a word. I read it once, then again. Whoever had written it knew Harbor City *deeply* — every side door, every dead signal zone, every guard rotation. This was not outside knowledge. The author had lived here, worked here, and then chosen to vanish without a trace.
deeply:2.cnHint: 解码后的信显示，写信人对海港城了解得极为____，绝非外来者所写。
deeply:2.hook: The letter ended with a question addressed directly to me by name.
deeply:2.line: 'Whoever wrote this knows the city *deeply* — and they knew we would be the ones to find it.'

sentences.en: Ali handed me the decoded letter without a word.
sentences.cn: 阿栗没说话，直接把解密后的信递给我。

sentences.en: I read it once, then again.
sentences.cn: 我读了一遍，又读了一遍。

sentences.en: Whoever had written it knew Harbor City *deeply* — every side door, every dead signal zone, every guard rotation.
This was not outside knowledge.
sentences.cn: 这不是来自外面的情报。

sentences.en: The author had lived here, worked here, and then chosen to vanish without a trace.
sentences.cn: 作者在这里住过、工作过，然后选择了无声消失。

demonstrate:2.en: Zero stepped into the light at the center of the relay platform, holding the stolen chip above his head. 'Let me *demonstrate* what this city has been hiding from you,' he said, and pressed the chip to the main broadcast tower. Every screen in Harbor City flickered at once. Then, for three seconds, the truth played on all of them.
demonstrate:2.cnHint: 零点站上中继平台，将芯片插入广播塔，向全城____隐藏已久的真相。
demonstrate:2.hook: Three seconds was enough — and now every citizen had seen it.
demonstrate:2.line: 'I will *demonstrate* the signal once, and after that, no one in this city can claim they did not know.'

sentences.en: Zero stepped into the light at the center of the relay platform, holding the stolen chip above his head.
sentences.cn: 零点走进中继平台中央的灯光下，把那片偷来的芯片高举过头顶。

sentences.en: 'Let me *demonstrate* what this city has been hiding from you,' he said, and pressed the chip to the main broadcast tower.
Every screen in Harbor City flickered at once.
sentences.cn: 港城每块屏幕都闪烁了一次。

sentences.en: Then, for three seconds, the truth played on all of them.
sentences.cn: 然后，持续三秒钟，真相在所有屏幕上播放了出来。

preserve:2.en: The old server room smelled of cold metal and burnt wire. Ali handed me a cracked data chip. 'This is the only copy,' she said. 'We have to *preserve* it.' I wrapped the chip in a signal-dead pouch and slipped it into my coat. Outside, footsteps echoed down the wet corridor.
preserve:2.cnHint: 阿栗交给我一块破损的数据芯片，我们必须____它，走廊里突然传来脚步声。
preserve:2.hook: The footsteps stopped right outside the door.
preserve:2.line: 'We have to *preserve* this chip — it's the only evidence left.'

sentences.en: The old server room smelled of cold metal and burnt wire.
sentences.cn: 老服务器房间闻起来是冷金属和烧焦电线的味道。

sentences.en: Ali handed me a cracked data chip.
sentences.cn: 阿栗递给我一片裂开的数据芯片。

sentences.en: 'This is the only copy,' she said.
sentences.cn: "这是唯一的副本，"她说。

sentences.en: 'We have to *preserve* it.'
I wrapped the chip in a signal-dead pouch and slipped it into my coat.
sentences.cn: 我把芯片包进了一个信号隔离袋，塞进了外套。

sentences.en: Outside, footsteps echoed down the wet corridor.
sentences.cn: 外面，脚步声在湿漉漉的走廊里回响。

procedure:2.en: Grey Crow slid a folded note under the archive door. Inside, one line: follow the *procedure*. I knew what that meant — three knocks, a pause, two more. I pressed my ear to the cold steel. Something on the other side was already counting.
procedure:2.cnHint: 灰鸦留下的纸条上写着要遵守某个____，钢门另一侧有东西在等待。
procedure:2.hook: Whatever was counting reached three and went silent.
procedure:2.line: 'Follow the *procedure* exactly — one wrong step and the archive locks forever.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow slid a folded note under the archive door.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把一张折好的纸条塞到档案室门下。

sentences.en: Inside, one line: follow the *procedure*.
I knew what that meant — three knocks, a pause, two more.
sentences.cn: 我知道那是什么意思——三下敲击，暂停，再两下。

sentences.en: I pressed my ear to the cold steel.
sentences.cn: 我把耳朵贴在冰冷的钢门上。

sentences.en: Something on the other side was already counting.
sentences.cn: 另一边的什么东西已经开始数数了。

reasonable:2.en: The signal map spread across the floor of the empty print shop. I studied the gaps. A *reasonable* reading put Zero's base somewhere in Sector Nine. Ali frowned at the data. 'That's too easy,' she said. The lights in the shop died without warning.
reasonable:2.cnHint: 我对信号地图做出了____的判断，找到了零点可能的藏身处，但灯光突然熄灭了。
reasonable:2.hook: In the dark, something cold pressed against the back of my neck.
reasonable:2.line: 'A *reasonable* reading of this map puts Zero right here — trust it.'

sentences.en: The signal map spread across the floor of the empty print shop.
sentences.cn: 信号地图铺满了那间空荡荡的印刷店的地板。

sentences.en: I studied the gaps.
sentences.cn: 我研究着那些空白处。

sentences.en: A *reasonable* reading put Zero's base somewhere in Sector Nine.
Ali frowned at the data.
sentences.cn: 阿栗皱着眉头看着数据。

sentences.en: 'That's too easy,' she said.
sentences.cn: "太容易了。"她说。

sentences.en: The lights in the shop died without warning.
sentences.cn: 店里的灯突然熄灭了。

reduction:2.en: The coded broadcast came in loud, then faded. Each pass brought a *reduction* in the noise layer until one clean word broke through: RUN. Ali was already at the door. I grabbed the drive, heart hammering against my ribs.
reduction:2.cnHint: 广播中的杂音逐渐____，一个清晰的词语浮现出来，阿栗已经冲向门口。
reduction:2.hook: Behind us, the broadcast cut to a single, steady tone.
reduction:2.line: 'Every *reduction* in the noise brings us one step closer to Zero.'

sentences.en: The coded broadcast came in loud, then faded.
sentences.cn: 编码广播传来时很大声，随后淡去。

sentences.en: Each pass brought a *reduction* in the noise layer until one clean word broke through: RUN.
Ali was already at the door.
sentences.cn: 阿栗已经冲向门口。

sentences.en: I grabbed the drive, heart hammering against my ribs.
sentences.cn: 我抓起了驱动器，心脏砰砰砰地撞击着肋骨。

season:2.en: Grey Crow met me on the rain-slicked bridge at the edge of the harbor district. 'The wet *season* is Zero's cover,' he said, voice low. 'Signals scatter in heavy rain. No one can trace a broadcast tonight.' He handed me a paper token and walked away into the dark.
season:2.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我这个____是零点行动的掩护，说完便消失在黑暗中。
season:2.hook: The paper token was already dissolving in the rain.
season:2.line: 'The wet *season* hides Zero's signals — tonight is the only chance we have.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow met me on the rain-slicked bridge at the edge of the harbor district.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在港区边缘被雨淋湿的桥上与我碰面。

sentences.en: 'The wet *season* is Zero's cover,' he said, voice low.
'Signals scatter in heavy rain.
sentences.cn: 信号在大雨里会散开。

sentences.en: No one can trace a broadcast tonight.'
sentences.cn: 今晚没人能追踪到任何广播。

sentences.en: He handed me a paper token and walked away into the dark.
sentences.cn: 他递给我一张纸质令牌，走进了黑暗里。

sector:2.en: Ali pulled up the city grid on a cracked tablet. 'The signal originates from *sector* four,' she said, tracing a glowing line with one finger. 'Sub-level three. Flooded since last year.' I checked my boots. They were not waterproof.
sector:2.cnHint: 阿栗在城市网格中锁定了信号来源的____，那里已经被洪水淹没了一年。
sector:2.hook: The tablet screen flickered and the grid went dark.
sector:2.line: '*Sector* four, sub-level three — that is where Zero is hiding the broadcast node.'

sentences.en: Ali pulled up the city grid on a cracked tablet.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在一台裂纹平板上调出了城市网格。

sentences.en: 'The signal originates from *sector* four,' she said, tracing a glowing line with one finger.
'Sub-level three.
sentences.cn: "第三层。

sentences.en: Flooded since last year.'
sentences.cn: 从去年起就被水淹了。"

sentences.en: I checked my boots.
sentences.cn: 我检查了我的靴子。

sentences.en: They were not waterproof.
sentences.cn: 它们不防水。

setting:2.en: I found the message carved into the back of a broken terminal in the server hall. Seven words: change the *setting* before midnight tonight. I scanned the room. Every screen showed the same frozen clock. Someone had already been here.
setting:2.cnHint: 我在废弃终端后发现了刻字，要求我在午夜前改变某个____，但有人已经捷足先登。
setting:2.hook: The frozen clocks all began counting down at once.
setting:2.line: 'Change the *setting* before midnight — or every node in the city goes dark.'

sentences.en: I found the message carved into the back of a broken terminal in the server hall.
sentences.cn: 我在服务器大厅里一台破损终端的背面找到了刻在上面的信息。

sentences.en: Seven words: change the *setting* before midnight tonight.
I scanned the room.
sentences.cn: 我扫视了房间。

sentences.en: Every screen showed the same frozen clock.
sentences.cn: 每个屏幕上都显示着同一个静止的时钟。

sentences.en: Someone had already been here.
sentences.cn: 有人已经来过这里了。

shrink:2.en: The hidden room was smaller than I expected. Under Zero's signal field the walls seemed to *shrink* inward, a trick of the broadcast or of my own fear. In the center, a single chair faced a blank screen. On the seat lay Grey Crow's badge.
shrink:2.cnHint: 在零点的信号场中，那个隐藏房间的四壁似乎在____，椅子上放着灰鸦的徽章。
shrink:2.hook: The blank screen switched on and showed my own face.
shrink:2.line: 'Do not let fear make the room *shrink* around you — stay focused and find the exit.'

sentences.en: The hidden room was smaller than I expected.
sentences.cn: 隐藏房间比我想象的要小。

sentences.en: Under Zero's signal field the walls seemed to *shrink* inward, a trick of the broadcast or of my own fear.
In the center, a single chair faced a blank screen.
sentences.cn: 房间中央只有一把椅子面朝着空白的屏幕。

sentences.en: On the seat lay Grey Crow's badge.
sentences.cn: 椅子上放着灰鸦的证章。

employment:2.en: The coded letter arrived sealed in a plain envelope. Inside, three lines: a location, a time, a price. Grey Crow had found me *employment* at last — not with any official agency, but with the underground network that kept Harbor City's real secrets moving. I folded the paper and burned it.
employment:2.cnHint: 一封密信为我带来了____，但这份工作来自地下网络，而非官方机构。
employment:2.hook: The address on the letter was my own building.
employment:2.line: 'Your *employment* starts at midnight — and no, you cannot say no.'

sentences.en: The coded letter arrived sealed in a plain envelope.
sentences.cn: 编码信件以普通信封的形式寄来，已经密封。

sentences.en: Inside, three lines: a location, a time, a price.
sentences.cn: 信里只有三行：一个地点，一个时间，一个价格。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had found me *employment* at last — not with any official agency, but with the underground network that kept Harbor City's real secrets moving.
I folded the paper and burned it.
sentences.cn: 我折叠了纸张，把它烧了。

entire:2.en: Ali spread the stolen map across the wet floor of the abandoned kitchen. The *entire* eastern grid of Harbor City was marked in red — every signal tower, every relay node, every hidden broadcast point. Someone had been planning this for years. I stared at the scale of it and felt cold.
entire:2.cnHint: 阿栗展开地图，____东区电网的标记令我震惊。
entire:2.hook: One red mark sat directly over my apartment block.
entire:2.line: 'The *entire* network goes dark at dawn — we have until then.'

sentences.en: Ali spread the stolen map across the wet floor of the abandoned kitchen.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在一间废弃厨房的湿漉漉的地板上展开了偷来的地图。

sentences.en: The *entire* eastern grid of Harbor City was marked in red — every signal tower, every relay node, every hidden broadcast point.
Someone had been planning this for years.
sentences.cn: 有人计划这一切已经很多年了。

sentences.en: I stared at the scale of it and felt cold.
sentences.cn: 我盯着它的规模看，感到一阵寒意。

gift:2.en: The package had no sender. Inside, wrapped in static-soaked paper, was a small receiver tuned to a forbidden frequency. Ali said it was a trap. Grey Crow said nothing. But I knew a *gift* like this — one that lets you hear what the city hides — was worth any risk. I pressed it to my ear.
gift:2.cnHint: 一个神秘包裹里藏着一件____，让人能听见城市隐藏的声音。
gift:2.hook: The first sound I heard was my own name, spoken in Zero's voice.
gift:2.line: 'A *gift* from someone who knows exactly what you can do.'

sentences.en: The package had no sender.
sentences.cn: 包裹没有寄件人。

sentences.en: Inside, wrapped in static-soaked paper, was a small receiver tuned to a forbidden frequency.
sentences.cn: 里面用被静电浸透的纸包裹着一个小型接收器，调到了一个禁用频率。

sentences.en: Ali said it was a trap.
sentences.cn: 阿栗说这是个陷阱。

sentences.en: Grey Crow said nothing.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦什么也没说。

sentences.en: But I knew a *gift* like this — one that lets you hear what the city hides — was worth any risk.
I pressed it to my ear.
sentences.cn: 我把它放到了耳边。

kitchen:2.en: The safe house was a gutted restaurant on Level 9. Grey Crow led me straight to the *kitchen*, past rusted pipes and cracked tiles, to a loose panel behind the cold stove. Behind it: a data drive, a folded note, and a city-wide broadcast key. Ali kept watch at the door.
kitchen:2.cnHint: 灰鸦在废弃餐厅的____里找到了关键的数据驱动器。
kitchen:2.hook: The note read: 'They already know you came here.'
kitchen:2.line: 'Everything we need is hidden in the *kitchen* — go, now.'

sentences.en: The safe house was a gutted restaurant on Level 9.
sentences.cn: 安全屋是九层楼一间被掏空的餐厅。

sentences.en: Grey Crow led me straight to the *kitchen*, past rusted pipes and cracked tiles, to a loose panel behind the cold stove.
Behind it: a data drive, a folded note, and a city-wide broadcast key.
sentences.cn: 后面：一个数据驱动器、一张折叠纸条，还有一把城市范围的广播密钥。

sentences.en: Ali kept watch at the door.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在门口守卫。

mystery:2.en: Zero left no prints, no voice trace, no signal shadow. Every investigator before me had hit the same wall. The *mystery* was not who Zero was — half the city whispered that name — but how Zero moved through locked systems like they were open doors. I needed to understand that before the next broadcast.
mystery:2.cnHint: 零点的____不在于身份，而在于如何穿透所有加密防线。
mystery:2.hook: Then Ali found a file with my photo inside Zero's last encrypted message.
mystery:2.line: 'The real *mystery* is not the who — it is the how.'

sentences.en: Zero left no prints, no voice trace, no signal shadow.
sentences.cn: 零点没有留下指纹、声音痕迹或信号影子。

sentences.en: Every investigator before me had hit the same wall.
sentences.cn: 在我之前的每一个调查员都撞到了同样的墙。

sentences.en: The *mystery* was not who Zero was — half the city whispered that name — but how Zero moved through locked systems like they were open doors.
I needed to understand that before the next broadcast.
sentences.cn: 我需要在下一次广播前理解这一点。

opposite:2.en: Grey Crow pointed to the two towers on the map. 'You and Zero are standing at *opposite* ends of the same signal chain,' they said quietly. One tower sent. One received. Whoever held both ends controlled every coded word in Harbor City. I was already at my end. Zero was already at theirs.
opposite:2.cnHint: 地图上两座信号塔分立____两端，各自掌控着信息链的一头。
opposite:2.hook: The chain was already active — someone had switched it on without us.
opposite:2.line: 'You two are at *opposite* ends, and the signal is live right now.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow pointed to the two towers on the map.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦指向地图上的两座塔。

sentences.en: 'You and Zero are standing at *opposite* ends of the same signal chain,' they said quietly.
One tower sent.
sentences.cn: 一座发送。

sentences.en: One received.
sentences.cn: 一座接收。

sentences.en: Whoever held both ends controlled every coded word in Harbor City.
sentences.cn: 谁掌握了两端，谁就控制了港口市的每一个编码字。

sentences.en: I was already at my end.
sentences.cn: 我已经在我的一端了。

sentences.en: Zero was already at theirs.
sentences.cn: 零点已经在他们的一端了。

permanent:2.en: The city wiped records every 72 hours. Nothing stayed. But Ali had found one node — deep in the old port district — where data left a *permanent* mark, carved into hardware no software update could reach. If Zero had ever sent a real message, the ghost of it lived there. We moved before dawn.
permanent:2.cnHint: 阿栗找到了一个能留下____痕迹的节点，零点的真实信息或许藏于其中。
permanent:2.hook: The port district had been sealed by city order three hours ago.
permanent:2.line: 'This is the only place in the city where a message becomes *permanent*.'

sentences.en: The city wiped records every 72 hours.
sentences.cn: 这座城市每72小时就清除一次记录。

sentences.en: Nothing stayed.
sentences.cn: 什么都留不下。

sentences.en: But Ali had found one node — deep in the old port district — where data left a *permanent* mark, carved into hardware no software update could reach.
If Zero had ever sent a real message, the ghost of it lived there.
sentences.cn: 如果零点曾经发过真实的信息，它的幽灵就藏在那儿。

sentences.en: We moved before dawn.
sentences.cn: 我们在天亮前出发了。

plenty:2.en: The broadcast hit every screen in Harbor City at once — raw, unencrypted, loud. Grey Crow's voice, calm and clear: 'There is *plenty* of proof now. Enough for the whole city to hear. Enough to end this.' Ali grabbed my arm. Across the wet street, a figure in a grey coat turned and looked straight at us.
plenty:2.cnHint: 灰鸦在全市广播中宣告有____证据，但对街的身影让我们紧张起来。
plenty:2.hook: The figure raised one hand — and the broadcast cut to silence.
plenty:2.line: 'We have *plenty* of proof — the city will hear every word of it.'

sentences.en: The broadcast hit every screen in Harbor City at once — raw, unencrypted, loud.
sentences.cn: 广播同时冲击了港城的每一块屏幕——原始、未加密、声音很大。

sentences.en: Grey Crow's voice, calm and clear: 'There is *plenty* of proof now.
Enough for the whole city to hear.
sentences.cn: 足以让整个城市听到。

sentences.en: Enough to end this.'
sentences.cn: 足以结束这一切。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了我的胳膊。

sentences.en: Across the wet street, a figure in a grey coat turned and looked straight at us.
sentences.cn: 在湿漉漉的街道对面，一个穿着灰色大衣的身影转过身，直直地看向我们。

strike:2.en: Deep inside the server vault, I found a folded notice pinned to a dead terminal. Workers across Harbor City's data grid had launched a *strike*, refusing to route any signal until the blackout order was lifted. Without their hands, the whole network sat silent — and Zero's message could not move.
strike:2.cnHint: 港城数据工人发动____，零点的信息被迫中断传输。
strike:2.hook: But one terminal was still warm.
strike:2.line: Ali said, 'The *strike* buys us maybe one hour — use it.'

sentences.en: Deep inside the server vault, I found a folded notice pinned to a dead terminal.
sentences.cn: 在服务器库的深处，我发现了一张折叠的通知贴在一台已经死了的终端上。

sentences.en: Workers across Harbor City's data grid had launched a *strike*, refusing to route any signal until the blackout order was lifted.
Without their hands, the whole network sat silent — and Zero's message could not move.
sentences.cn: 没有他们的手，整个网络陷入寂静——零点的信息无法传播。

television:2.en: Grey Crow led me into an abandoned repair shop on Pier 9. A cracked *television* on the shelf was still running, its screen looping a single frozen frame — a street corner, a time stamp, a face I recognised. Someone had left it playing on purpose, aimed exactly at the door.
television:2.cnHint: 一台旧____正在循环播放一个陌生却熟悉的面孔。
television:2.hook: The time stamp read three minutes from now.
television:2.line: Grey Crow said, 'That *television* is not broken — it is a signal.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow led me into an abandoned repair shop on Pier 9.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦带我进入了9号码头上一家废弃的修理店。

sentences.en: A cracked *television* on the shelf was still running, its screen looping a single frozen frame — a street corner, a time stamp, a face I recognised.
Someone had left it playing on purpose, aimed exactly at the door.
sentences.cn: 有人故意把它放在那儿，正对着门。

youth:2.en: I pulled a damp file from beneath the floor panel. It was a record of the early network days, full of names I did not know. One page stopped me cold: a photograph of a group in their *youth*, faces bright and unguarded. Ali was in the back row, eyes already sharp.
youth:2.cnHint: 档案里一张____时期的旧照片，让我对阿栗产生了新的疑问。
youth:2.hook: Her name in the file was not Ali.
youth:2.line: Grey Crow said, 'Everyone in this city traded their *youth* for a secret.'

sentences.en: I pulled a damp file from beneath the floor panel.
sentences.cn: 我从地板夹层下拉出一份潮湿的文件。

sentences.en: It was a record of the early network days, full of names I did not know.
sentences.cn: 这是早期网络时代的记录，满是我不认识的名字。

sentences.en: One page stopped me cold: a photograph of a group in their *youth*, faces bright and unguarded.
Ali was in the back row, eyes already sharp.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在后排，眼神已经很锐利。

alter:2.en: Ali handed me a data chip no bigger than a fingernail. She said Zero had used it to *alter* every timestamp in the city's traffic log, shifting records by exactly four minutes. Four minutes was enough to destroy any alibi, to erase any witness, to rewrite who was where and when.
alter:2.cnHint: 零点用一枚芯片____了全城交通日志里的时间戳。
alter:2.hook: My own entry log had been shifted too.
alter:2.line: Ali said, 'Zero can *alter* a record before you even know it existed.'

sentences.en: Ali handed me a data chip no bigger than a fingernail.
sentences.cn: 阿栗递给我一枚指甲大小的数据芯片。

sentences.en: She said Zero had used it to *alter* every timestamp in the city's traffic log, shifting records by exactly four minutes.
Four minutes was enough to destroy any alibi, to erase any witness, to rewrite who was where and when.
sentences.cn: 四分钟足以摧毁任何不在场证明，抹掉任何证人，改写谁在哪儿、什么时候。

approximately:2.en: The signal trace led me to a cooling pipe three levels below street level. Grey Crow had marked the wall in faint chalk: a circle, a cross, a number. The drop point was *approximately* forty metres ahead, close enough that I could hear the hum of hidden drives through the concrete.
approximately:2.cnHint: 暗号标记显示，目标地点距我____四十米处。
approximately:2.hook: Then the chalk mark began to glow.
approximately:2.line: Grey Crow said, '*Approximately* forty metres — but Zero knows you are counting.'

sentences.en: The signal trace led me to a cooling pipe three levels below street level.
sentences.cn: 信号轨迹把我引到了地下三层的一条冷却管道。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had marked the wall in faint chalk: a circle, a cross, a number.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在墙上用淡淡的粉笔标记了：一个圆圈，一个十字，一个数字。

sentences.en: The drop point was *approximately* forty metres ahead, close enough that I could hear the hum of hidden drives through the concrete.

attractive:2.en: The package Zero left was small and deliberately *attractive* — bright casing, clean edges, the kind of object that made your hand reach before your mind caught up. Ali grabbed my wrist before I touched it. She had seen this design before, she said. It was meant to be picked up.
attractive:2.cnHint: 零点留下的包裹外观____，但阿栗阻止了我去碰它。
attractive:2.hook: Underneath it, a pressure pad waited.
attractive:2.line: Ali said, 'The more *attractive* the trap, the worse what is inside.'

sentences.en: The package Zero left was small and deliberately *attractive* — bright casing, clean edges, the kind of object that made your hand reach before your mind caught up.
Ali grabbed my wrist before I touched it.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在我触摸之前抓住了我的手腕。

sentences.en: She had seen this design before, she said.
sentences.cn: 她说她以前见过这个设计。

sentences.en: It was meant to be picked up.
sentences.cn: 它是想被拿起来的。

bag:2.en: I found Grey Crow waiting in the stairwell, a worn canvas *bag* at his feet. He did not speak. He simply opened it: three forged access cards, a signal jammer the size of a pen, and one folded note with my name written in Zero's hand. He had been carrying it all night.
bag:2.cnHint: 灰鸦的____里装着伪造证件和一张写有我名字的纸条。
bag:2.line: Grey Crow said, 'Everything in this *bag* has one use — do not waste it.'

sentences.en: I found Grey Crow waiting in the stairwell, a worn canvas *bag* at his feet.
He did not speak.
sentences.cn: 他没有说话。

sentences.en: He simply opened it: three forged access cards, a signal jammer the size of a pen, and one folded note with my name written in Zero's hand.
sentences.cn: 他只是打开了它：三张伪造的通行证、一个笔尖大小的信号干扰器，还有一张用零点的笔迹写的折叠便条，上面写着我的名字。

sentences.en: He had been carrying it all night.
sentences.cn: 他整晚都在携带它。

beat:2.en: I pressed myself against the cold wall and listened. The encoded transmission came in a steady *beat*, one pulse per second, like a patient heart. Each pulse carried one letter. I wrote them down in order, hand shaking. By the twelfth letter the word was already clear, and it named someone in our team.
beat:2.cnHint: 加密信号以规律的____传来，逐字拼出了一个令人震惊的名字。
beat:2.line: Ali said, 'Follow the *beat* — it will not repeat itself.'

sentences.en: I pressed myself against the cold wall and listened.
sentences.cn: 我把自己贴在冰冷的墙上，静静地听。

sentences.en: The encoded transmission came in a steady *beat*, one pulse per second, like a patient heart.
Each pulse carried one letter.
sentences.cn: 每一脉搏携带一个字母。

sentences.en: I wrote them down in order, hand shaking.
sentences.cn: 我按顺序把它们写了下来，手在颤抖。

sentences.en: By the twelfth letter the word was already clear, and it named someone in our team.
sentences.cn: 到第十二个字母时，那个词已经很清楚了，它说出了我们团队中的某个人的名字。

bottom:2.en: The maintenance shaft was dark and narrow. I climbed down, rung by rung, until my boots hit the *bottom*. There, taped to the wall, was a data chip — the kind Grey Crow used to hide dead-drops. Someone had been here first. The tape was torn.
bottom:2.cnHint: 我在竖井____发现了一个数据芯片，但有人抢先一步。
bottom:2.hook: The chip was empty — wiped clean within the last hour.
bottom:2.line: 'Check the *bottom* of every shaft in sector nine,' Grey Crow had warned.

sentences.en: The maintenance shaft was dark and narrow.
sentences.cn: 维护竖井又暗又窄。

sentences.en: I climbed down, rung by rung, until my boots hit the *bottom*.
There, taped to the wall, was a data chip — the kind Grey Crow used to hide dead-drops.
sentences.cn: 贴在墙上的是一枚数据芯片——灰鸦过去用来隐藏死信的那种。

sentences.en: Someone had been here first.
sentences.cn: 有人先到了这儿。

sentences.en: The tape was torn.
sentences.cn: 胶带被撕破了。

breed:2.en: Ali spread the stolen files across the table. 'This isn't random crime,' she said. 'Zero recruits a specific *breed* — coders who lost someone to the city's purges.' I stared at the faces. Young, angry, erased from official records. A pattern I had missed entirely.
breed:2.cnHint: 阿栗发现零点专门招募某种特定____的黑客，我之前完全忽略了这个规律。
breed:2.hook: One of those faces looked exactly like mine.
breed:2.line: 'Zero only wants one *breed* of soldier — the ones with nothing left to lose.'

sentences.en: Ali spread the stolen files across the table.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把偷来的文件摊开在桌子上。

sentences.en: 'This isn't random crime,' she said.
sentences.cn: "这不是随机犯罪，"她说。

sentences.en: 'Zero recruits a specific *breed* — coders who lost someone to the city's purges.'
I stared at the faces.
sentences.cn: 我盯着那些面孔。

sentences.en: Young, angry, erased from official records.
sentences.cn: 年轻、愤怒、从官方记录中被抹去。

sentences.en: A pattern I had missed entirely.
sentences.cn: 我完全错过的一个模式。

classify:2.en: The terminal blinked. A prompt asked me to *classify* the intercepted signal: CIVILIAN, NOISE, or THREAT. I hesitated. The pattern was too clean to be noise, too quiet to be civilian. I pressed THREAT. Somewhere above us, an alarm began its slow, cold rise.
classify:2.cnHint: 我必须对截获的信号进行____，我的选择触发了警报。
classify:2.hook: The system locked me out before I could take it back.
classify:2.line: 'If you *classify* it wrong, every exit in this building seals.'

sentences.en: The terminal blinked.
sentences.cn: 终端屏幕闪烁着。

sentences.en: A prompt asked me to *classify* the intercepted signal: CIVILIAN, NOISE, or THREAT.
I hesitated.
sentences.cn: 我犹豫了。

sentences.en: The pattern was too clean to be noise, too quiet to be civilian.
sentences.cn: 这个信号太规律了，不像是噪音，又太微弱了，不像是民用信号。

sentences.en: I pressed THREAT.
sentences.cn: 我按下了威胁。

sentences.en: Somewhere above us, an alarm began its slow, cold rise.
sentences.cn: 我们头顶某处，警报器开始缓缓、冷酷地鸣起。

comment:2.en: Grey Crow left no voice message — only a single *comment* buried in the code of a public transit map, six words long: 'northwest tunnel, third door, don't knock.' I almost scrolled past it. Ali almost deleted it as spam. Almost.
comment:2.cnHint: 灰鸦把关键信息藏在公共地图的一条____里，我们差点错过。
comment:2.hook: The map had been updated — the comment was already gone.
comment:2.line: 'One *comment* in ten thousand lines — that is how he stays alive.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow left no voice message — only a single *comment* buried in the code of a public transit map, six words long: 'northwest tunnel, third door, don't knock.'
I almost scrolled past it.
sentences.cn: 我差点就滑过去了。

sentences.en: Ali almost deleted it as spam.
sentences.cn: 阿栗差点把它当垃圾信息删了。

sentences.en: Almost.
sentences.cn: 差一点。

component:2.en: The device on the bridge railing looked ordinary — a junction box, grey and rusted. But one *component* inside it did not belong: a micro-transmitter, live and pulsing. Zero was using city infrastructure as his own private broadcast tower. Every bridge. Every lamp post. Everywhere.
component:2.cnHint: 我在桥上的设备里发现了一个不属于原装的____，零点借此控制全城信号。
component:2.hook: Ali's scanner counted forty-seven identical boxes across Harbor City.
component:2.line: 'Remove that *component* and the whole network goes blind for sixty seconds.'

sentences.en: The device on the bridge railing looked ordinary — a junction box, grey and rusted.
sentences.cn: 桥栏杆上的装置看起来很普通——一个接线盒，灰色的，生了锈。

sentences.en: But one *component* inside it did not belong: a micro-transmitter, live and pulsing.
Zero was using city infrastructure as his own private broadcast tower.
sentences.cn: 零点用城市基础设施当成了自己的私人广播塔。

sentences.en: Every bridge.
sentences.cn: 每座桥。

sentences.en: Every lamp post.
sentences.cn: 每根灯柱。

sentences.en: Everywhere.
sentences.cn: 到处都是。

contrary:2.en: The report from Central Command said the docks were clear. *Contrary* to that, every shadow I passed held a figure in a grey coat. Ali counted nine. I counted eleven. We did not argue about the number. We agreed it was time to leave — quietly.
contrary:2.cnHint: 中央指挥部报告码头安全，但____实际情况让我们决定立刻撤离。
contrary:2.hook: The figure nearest the gate turned and looked directly at me.
contrary:2.line: '*Contrary* to your orders, I am telling you — this place is a trap.'

sentences.en: The report from Central Command said the docks were clear.
sentences.cn: 中央司令部的报告说码头一片安全。

sentences.en: *Contrary* to that, every shadow I passed held a figure in a grey coat.
Ali counted nine.
sentences.cn: 阿栗数了九个。

sentences.en: I counted eleven.
sentences.cn: 我数了十一个。

sentences.en: We did not argue about the number.
sentences.cn: 我们没有争论这个数字。

sentences.en: We agreed it was time to leave — quietly.
sentences.cn: 我们一致认为该离开了——悄悄地。

deny:2.en: Zero's face appeared on the cracked screen. 'You found nothing useful,' he said — flat, certain. I could *deny* that, or I could let him believe it. The data chip was warm in my pocket. I kept my face still and said, 'You're right. Nothing at all.'
deny:2.cnHint: 零点断言我一无所获，我选择不____他的判断，假装认同来保护证据。
deny:2.hook: His eyes stayed on mine three seconds too long.
deny:2.line: 'I will not *deny* what I saw — but I will not tell him either.'

sentences.en: Zero's face appeared on the cracked screen.
sentences.cn: 零点的脸出现在裂开的屏幕上。

sentences.en: 'You found nothing useful,' he said — flat, certain.
sentences.cn: "你什么都没找到。"他说——平板、确定的语气。

sentences.en: I could *deny* that, or I could let him believe it.
The data chip was warm in my pocket.
sentences.cn: 数据芯片在我口袋里烫手。

sentences.en: I kept my face still and said, 'You're right.
sentences.cn: 我面无表情，说道："你说得对。

sentences.en: Nothing at all.'
sentences.cn: 什么都没有。"

depth:2.en: The sonar map showed a flooded sub-level beneath the archive building. The *depth* marked on Grey Crow's note matched exactly: eleven metres. Whatever Zero buried down there had survived two floods and one city fire. Ali looked at the map, then at me. 'We need a boat.'
depth:2.cnHint: 地图显示档案楼下方积水区的____与灰鸦笔记上的数字完全吻合。
depth:2.hook: The sub-level entrance was sealed from the inside.
depth:2.line: 'At that *depth*, the pressure will destroy any chip not sealed in metal.'

sentences.en: The sonar map showed a flooded sub-level beneath the archive building.
sentences.cn: 声纳地图显示档案楼下方有一个被淹的地下室。

sentences.en: The *depth* marked on Grey Crow's note matched exactly: eleven metres.
Whatever Zero buried down there had survived two floods and one city fire.
sentences.cn: 不管零点埋在那下面的是什么，都熬过了两次洪水和一场城市大火。

sentences.en: Ali looked at the map, then at me.
sentences.cn: 阿栗看了看地图，又看了看我。

sentences.en: 'We need a boat.'
sentences.cn: "我们需要一条船。"

lower:2.en: The signal came from the *lower* levels of the port district — sub-deck 4, where the city forgot to shine its neon lights. I pulled up the map. Ali had marked a storage unit down there three days ago. Grey Crow had said never go below deck 3 alone. I went anyway.
lower:2.cnHint: 信号来自港区____层，我独自前往那个被城市遗忘的黑暗角落。
lower:2.hook: The storage unit door was already open.
lower:2.line: 'The *lower* floors are off the grid — no cameras, no witnesses.'

sentences.en: The signal came from the *lower* levels of the port district — sub-deck 4, where the city forgot to shine its neon lights.
I pulled up the map.
sentences.cn: 我调出了地图。

sentences.en: Ali had marked a storage unit down there three days ago.
sentences.cn: 阿栗三天前在下面的一个储藏室做过标记。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had said never go below deck 3 alone.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说过，千万不要一个人去三号甲板下面。

sentences.en: I went anyway.
sentences.cn: 我还是去了。

naturally:2.en: The coded message looked like noise at first — random glyphs sprayed across a ventilation shaft. But I had trained for this. The pattern revealed itself *naturally*, the way a face appears in static when you stop trying. Seven words. An address. A time. Tonight.
naturally:2.cnHint: 那串密码起初像乱码，但含义____地浮现在我眼前，指向一个地址和一个时间。
naturally:2.hook: Someone had sent this message knowing I would find it.
naturally:2.line: 'The meaning comes *naturally* once you stop forcing it.'

sentences.en: The coded message looked like noise at first — random glyphs sprayed across a ventilation shaft.
sentences.cn: 那条加密信息乍一看像是噪音——随机的字符洒在通风轴上。

sentences.en: But I had trained for this.
sentences.cn: 但我为这个受过训练。

sentences.en: The pattern revealed itself *naturally*, the way a face appears in static when you stop trying.
Seven words.
sentences.cn: 七个字。

sentences.en: An address.
sentences.cn: 一个地址。

sentences.en: A time.
sentences.cn: 一个时间。

sentences.en: Tonight.
sentences.cn: 今晚。

passionate:2.en: Zero left a voice note buried in the city broadcast — thirty seconds of static, then a *passionate* speech about freedom of language, raw and unfiltered. It was a trap, Grey Crow warned me. Passionate people make mistakes. I listened to it four times anyway.
passionate:2.cnHint: 零点在广播中留下了一段____的演讲，灰鸦说这是陷阱。
passionate:2.hook: The voice in the recording did not sound like Zero.
passionate:2.line: 'Only a *passionate* fool broadcasts their beliefs on an open channel.'

sentences.en: Zero left a voice note buried in the city broadcast — thirty seconds of static, then a *passionate* speech about freedom of language, raw and unfiltered.
It was a trap, Grey Crow warned me.
sentences.cn: 那是个陷阱，灰鸦警告我。

sentences.en: Passionate people make mistakes.
sentences.cn: 有激情的人容易犯错。

sentences.en: I listened to it four times anyway.
sentences.cn: 我还是听了四遍。

pop:2.en: I was scanning the dead channel when the signal began to *pop* — short bursts, irregular, like a heartbeat skipping. Ali grabbed my arm. Each burst carried a single character. Together they spelled a name: Grey Crow. Followed by one word: RUN.
pop:2.cnHint: 我扫描废弃频道时，信号开始____出现，拼出了一个名字和一个命令。
pop:2.hook: Grey Crow had not contacted either of us in six hours.
pop:2.line: 'Signals don't just *pop* on dead channels — someone lit that frequency on purpose.'

sentences.en: I was scanning the dead channel when the signal began to *pop* — short bursts, irregular, like a heartbeat skipping.
Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了我的手臂。

sentences.en: Each burst carried a single character.
sentences.cn: 每一阵脉冲都传来一个字符。

sentences.en: Together they spelled a name: Grey Crow.
sentences.cn: 组合起来拼出了一个名字：灰鸦。

sentences.en: Followed by one word: RUN.
sentences.cn: 后面跟着一个词：逃。

possibly:2.en: The file on the server was labeled VOID — *possibly* a dead archive, possibly the most dangerous document in Harbor City. Grey Crow had told me it did not exist. Ali had never heard of it. Yet here it sat, unlocked, waiting, as if someone wanted me to open it.
possibly:2.cnHint: 服务器上那个标注为VOID的文件____是最危险的档案，但它就这样敞开着等我。
possibly:2.hook: Opening it would tell Zero exactly where I was.
possibly:2.line: 'That file is *possibly* the reason three investigators went dark last month.'

sentences.en: The file on the server was labeled VOID — *possibly* a dead archive, possibly the most dangerous document in Harbor City.
Grey Crow had told me it did not exist.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦告诉我它不存在。

sentences.en: Ali had never heard of it.
sentences.cn: 阿栗从没听说过。

sentences.en: Yet here it sat, unlocked, waiting, as if someone wanted me to open it.
sentences.cn: 可它就摆在这儿，解锁了，等着，好像有人想让我打开它。

previously:2.en: The graffiti on the wall had been *previously* erased — I could see the ghost of old paint beneath the new coat. Someone had written here, someone had scrubbed it, and now a new message had appeared in its place. The ink was still wet. Minutes old.
previously:2.cnHint: 墙上的涂鸦____被人抹去过，但新的信息又出现了，墨迹未干。
previously:2.hook: The alley behind me was no longer empty.
previously:2.line: 'This same wall was *previously* used to pass signals during the blackout of 2091.'

sentences.en: The graffiti on the wall had been *previously* erased — I could see the ghost of old paint beneath the new coat.
Someone had written here, someone had scrubbed it, and now a new message had appeared in its place.
sentences.cn: 有人在这儿写过，有人擦掉了，现在一条新信息出现在了同一个地方。

sentences.en: The ink was still wet.
sentences.cn: 墨水还没干。

sentences.en: Minutes old.
sentences.cn: 才写了几分钟。

profession:2.en: The informant looked at my badge and smiled thin. 'Your *profession* is reading what others cannot see,' she said. She slid a folded paper across the table — a frequency map, hand-drawn, covering every illegal broadcast tower in the east grid. 'Read this, then burn it.'
profession:2.cnHint: 线人说我的____就是读懂别人看不见的东西，然后递给我一张手绘频率图。
profession:2.hook: She was gone before I could ask her name.
profession:2.line: 'In your *profession*, the things you cannot say out loud are the most important ones.'

sentences.en: The informant looked at my badge and smiled thin.
sentences.cn: 线人看了看我的证件，露出了淡淡的笑容。

sentences.en: 'Your *profession* is reading what others cannot see,' she said.
She slid a folded paper across the table — a frequency map, hand-drawn, covering every illegal broadcast tower in the east grid.
sentences.cn: 她推过来一张折叠的纸——一份频率地图，手绘的，标出了东区网格里每一座非法广播塔。

sentences.en: 'Read this, then burn it.'
sentences.cn: 「读完就烧了它。」

readily:2.en: The access code should have taken hours to crack. Instead it opened *readily*, like a door left unlocked on purpose. Ali shot me a look across the dim room. Grey Crow had warned us about gifts — in Harbor City, anything too easy was a message in itself.
readily:2.cnHint: 那道本该难以破解的密码____就打开了，阿栗和我都意识到这可能是个圈套。
readily:2.hook: The room beyond the door was full of our own case files.
readily:2.line: 'Systems like this don't open *readily* unless someone on the inside wants you through.'

sentences.en: The access code should have taken hours to crack.
sentences.cn: 破解访问码本该花上好几个小时。

sentences.en: Instead it opened *readily*, like a door left unlocked on purpose.
Ali shot me a look across the dim room.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在昏暗的房间对面朝我看了一眼。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had warned us about gifts — in Harbor City, anything too easy was a message in itself.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦警告过我们有关礼物的事——在港城，太容易得到的东西本身就是条信息。

distinguish:2.en: The signal room smelled of burnt wire and old rain. A dozen frequency bands filled my ears at once, each one bleeding into the next. Grey Crow had told me one band carried Zero's real orders. I trained my mind to *distinguish* that single cold thread from the noise — lower pitch, irregular gaps. There. I had it.
distinguish:2.cnHint: 在嘈杂的信号中，叙述者努力____出零点真正的指令频段。
distinguish:2.hook: The orders I heard were not what anyone expected.
distinguish:2.line: 'Learn to *distinguish* the real signal, or Zero wins tonight,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The signal room smelled of burnt wire and old rain.
sentences.cn: 信号室闻起来像焦线和陈雨的味道。

sentences.en: A dozen frequency bands filled my ears at once, each one bleeding into the next.
sentences.cn: 十来个频段同时灌进我的耳朵，一个接一个地混在一起。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told me one band carried Zero's real orders.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦告诉过我有一个频段装的是零点的真实命令。

sentences.en: I trained my mind to *distinguish* that single cold thread from the noise — lower pitch, irregular gaps.
There.
sentences.cn: 在这儿。

sentences.en: I had it.
sentences.cn: 我找到了。

document:2.en: Ali slid a folded card across the wet counter without a word. I opened it under the neon drip of a broken sign. It was a *document* — city-issue, stamped, real — but the name on it was mine and I had never seen it before. Someone had built me a second life on paper.
document:2.cnHint: 阿栗交给叙述者一份____，上面印着叙述者从未见过的第二个身份。
document:2.hook: Whoever forged it knew things only one person in Harbor City could know.
document:2.line: 'This *document* will open doors even Grey Crow cannot,' Ali whispered.

sentences.en: Ali slid a folded card across the wet counter without a word.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在湿漉漉的柜台上无言地推过来一张折叠的卡片。

sentences.en: I opened it under the neon drip of a broken sign.
sentences.cn: 我在一块破损招牌的霓虹光下打开了它。

sentences.en: It was a *document* — city-issue, stamped, real — but the name on it was mine and I had never seen it before.
Someone had built me a second life on paper.
sentences.cn: 有人在纸上给我造了第二条人生。

dozen:2.en: The storage unit was small and smelled of salt water. I swept my light across the shelves. A *dozen* identical black drives sat in a neat row, each one labeled with a single digit. Grey Crow had said only one held the real key. The other eleven were traps.
dozen:2.cnHint: 仓库里整齐排放着____个外形相同的硬盘，其中只有一个是真正的关键所在。
dozen:2.hook: My fingers were already over the wrong one when the door behind me clicked.
dozen:2.line: 'A *dozen* drives, one truth — choose fast,' Grey Crow's voice crackled in my ear.

sentences.en: The storage unit was small and smelled of salt water.
sentences.cn: 储物柜又小又闻起来像盐水。

sentences.en: I swept my light across the shelves.
sentences.cn: 我把手电扫过货架。

sentences.en: A *dozen* identical black drives sat in a neat row, each one labeled with a single digit.
Grey Crow had said only one held the real key.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说过只有一块存了真正的钥匙。

sentences.en: The other eleven were traps.
sentences.cn: 另外十一块都是陷阱。

dull:2.en: Zero's latest broadcast hit the public channels at midnight. Most investigators dismissed it as static — too flat, too *dull* to carry meaning. But flat signals were Zero's oldest trick. I ran it through my internal filter and the hidden layer lit up like a road map.
dull:2.cnHint: 零点的广播表面上____无味，但叙述者从中解读出了隐藏的地图信息。
dull:2.hook: The map pointed straight to the building where Ali was waiting alone.
dull:2.line: 'Only a *dull* mind would hear nothing in that broadcast,' I said to the empty room.

sentences.en: Zero's latest broadcast hit the public channels at midnight.
sentences.cn: 零点最新的广播在午夜砸上了公共频道。

sentences.en: Most investigators dismissed it as static — too flat, too *dull* to carry meaning.
But flat signals were Zero's oldest trick.
sentences.cn: 但平坦的信号是零点最老的把戏。

sentences.en: I ran it through my internal filter and the hidden layer lit up like a road map.
sentences.cn: 我用我的内部过滤器跑了一遍，隐层像路线图一样亮了起来。

fortune:2.en: The envelope had no sender. Inside was a single line of code and a transfer receipt for a very large sum. Someone had decided my *fortune* — built it overnight, moved it into accounts I did not own. It was a gift or a trap, and I had about ten minutes to decide which.
fortune:2.cnHint: 叙述者收到一封神秘信封，里面是一笔巨大____的转账凭证，来源不明。
fortune:2.hook: Ali's call came before I could decide, and her voice was shaking.
fortune:2.line: 'Your *fortune* is already in their system — they own your name now,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The envelope had no sender.
sentences.cn: 信封没有寄件人。

sentences.en: Inside was a single line of code and a transfer receipt for a very large sum.
sentences.cn: 里面是一行代码和一张很大笔金额的转账收据。

sentences.en: Someone had decided my *fortune* — built it overnight, moved it into accounts I did not own.
It was a gift or a trap, and I had about ten minutes to decide which.
sentences.cn: 这是礼物还是陷阱，我大概有十分钟来决定。

fulfil:2.en: Grey Crow had given me one task three weeks ago: find the source of the coded broadcasts. Tonight, standing in the relay room with the master key in my hand, I was about to *fulfil* that promise. The source was not a machine. It was a person I already knew.
fulfil:2.cnHint: 叙述者即将____三周前灰鸦交给他的任务，却发现信号源头是一个熟人。
fulfil:2.hook: The face on the monitor made my hand go still.
fulfil:2.line: '*Fulfil* the task — open the file and end this,' Grey Crow said quietly behind me.

sentences.en: Grey Crow had given me one task three weeks ago: find the source of the coded broadcasts.
sentences.cn: 三周前灰鸦给我一个任务：找到那些编码广播的源头。

sentences.en: Tonight, standing in the relay room with the master key in my hand, I was about to *fulfil* that promise.
The source was not a machine.
sentences.cn: 源头不是机器。

sentences.en: It was a person I already knew.
sentences.cn: 是一个我已经认识的人。

gradually:2.en: I plugged the black drive into the desk unit in the back room of the signal tower. The screen stayed dark. Then, *gradually*, line by line, a map of Harbor City took shape — every hidden channel, every coded node, every meeting point Zero had ever used. It was the whole network.
gradually:2.cnHint: 屏幕上____浮现出Harbor City的完整隐秘网络图，零点所有的节点一览无余。
gradually:2.hook: One node was blinking, live, three blocks away.
gradually:2.line: 'Watch it *gradually* load — every node Zero owns is on that screen,' Ali breathed.

sentences.en: I plugged the black drive into the desk unit in the back room of the signal tower.
sentences.cn: 我把黑色存储驱动插进了信号塔后间桌子上的主机。

sentences.en: The screen stayed dark.
sentences.cn: 屏幕保持黑暗。

sentences.en: Then, *gradually*, line by line, a map of Harbor City took shape — every hidden channel, every coded node, every meeting point Zero had ever used.
It was the whole network.
sentences.cn: 这是整个网络。

incentive:2.en: Zero sent the message through a cracked city line: step back and the blackout on my file gets lifted. Walk away and I get my name back. It was a clean *incentive* — almost generous. I read it twice, then deleted it. Some offers tell you exactly what the other side is afraid of.
incentive:2.cnHint: 零点以恢复叙述者档案为____，试图让其退出调查，却反而暴露了自己的软肋。
incentive:2.hook: I forwarded the deleted message to Grey Crow and started walking toward Zero's node.
incentive:2.line: 'That *incentive* tells us what Zero cannot afford to lose,' Grey Crow replied in seconds.

sentences.en: Zero sent the message through a cracked city line: step back and the blackout on my file gets lifted.
sentences.cn: 零点通过一条破裂的城市线路发来消息：退一步，我档案上的封锁就会解除。

sentences.en: Walk away and I get my name back.
sentences.cn: 走开，我就能要回我的名字。

sentences.en: It was a clean *incentive* — almost generous.
I read it twice, then deleted it.
sentences.cn: 我读了两遍，然后删了它。

sentences.en: Some offers tell you exactly what the other side is afraid of.
sentences.cn: 有些提议会精确地告诉你对方害怕什么。

relax:2.en: The server room hummed in the dark. Ali pressed a cold device into my hand. 'Don't *relax*,' she whispered. 'Zero is still in the building.' I gripped the decoder tight. Somewhere above us, a door clicked open. Footsteps. Slow, deliberate. Coming down.
relax:2.cnHint: 阿栗警告我不要____，因为零点还没有离开大楼。
relax:2.hook: The footsteps stopped directly above the ceiling panel.

sentences.en: The server room hummed in the dark.
sentences.cn: 服务器房间在黑暗中嗡嗡作响。

sentences.en: Ali pressed a cold device into my hand.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把一个冷冰冰的装置塞进我手里。

sentences.en: 'Don't *relax*,' she whispered.
'Zero is still in the building.'
sentences.cn: 「零点还在这栋楼里。」

sentences.en: I gripped the decoder tight.
sentences.cn: 我紧紧握住解码器。

sentences.en: Somewhere above us, a door clicked open.
sentences.cn: 我们上方的某个地方，一扇门咔嗒一声打开了。

sentences.en: Footsteps.
sentences.cn: 脚步声。

sentences.en: Slow, deliberate.
sentences.cn: 缓慢，有意为之。

sentences.en: Coming down.
sentences.cn: 正在下来。

release:2.en: Grey Crow's voice crackled through my earpiece: 'Do not *release* the signal yet.' I held my breath. The encoded file sat ready on the screen, one key away from flooding every city channel. Outside, rain hammered the glass. Then the timer hit zero.
release:2.cnHint: 灰鸦命令我还不能____那个信号，但倒计时已经归零。
release:2.hook: My finger was already moving toward the key.
release:2.line: 'Do not *release* it — not until every exit is sealed.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow's voice crackled through my earpiece: 'Do not *release* the signal yet.'
I held my breath.
sentences.cn: 我屏住了呼吸。

sentences.en: The encoded file sat ready on the screen, one key away from flooding every city channel.
sentences.cn: 编码文件在屏幕上蓄势待发，只需一个按键就能淹没每条城市频道。

sentences.en: Outside, rain hammered the glass.
sentences.cn: 窗外，雨猛烈地砸在玻璃上。

sentences.en: Then the timer hit zero.
sentences.cn: 然后计时器归零了。

route:2.en: The map on my screen showed three paths out of the data tower. Zero had blocked two of them. Grey Crow marked the last *route* in red — through the flooded lower level. Ali looked at it and said nothing. That silence told me everything I needed to know.
route:2.cnHint: 逃离数据塔的最后一条____穿越了被淹的底层，阿栗的沉默说明了一切。
route:2.hook: The water level indicator on the wall read: rising.
route:2.line: 'This *route* goes under — and there's no turning back.'

sentences.en: The map on my screen showed three paths out of the data tower.
sentences.cn: 我屏幕上的地图显示了三条离开数据塔的路线。

sentences.en: Zero had blocked two of them.
sentences.cn: 零点封锁了其中两条。

sentences.en: Grey Crow marked the last *route* in red — through the flooded lower level.
Ali looked at it and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 阿栗看了看，什么也没说。

sentences.en: That silence told me everything I needed to know.
sentences.cn: 那片沉默告诉我一切。

sight:2.en: I came around the corner and stopped cold. The whole server floor was dark except for one light — and in its glow stood Zero, face calm, hands open. The *sight* hit me like a door. I had planned for a dozen outcomes. None of them looked like this.
sight:2.cnHint: 看到零点就站在灯光下的____让我惊呆了，我的所有计划都没料到这一幕。
sight:2.hook: Zero smiled and said, 'I've been waiting for you.'
sight:2.line: 'The *sight* of you here tells me Grey Crow talked.'

sentences.en: I came around the corner and stopped cold.
sentences.cn: 我转过拐角，突然停住了。

sentences.en: The whole server floor was dark except for one light — and in its glow stood Zero, face calm, hands open.
sentences.cn: 整个服务器楼层黑漆漆的，只有一盏灯亮着——灯光下站着零点，脸上很平静，两手空空的。

sentences.en: The *sight* hit me like a door.
I had planned for a dozen outcomes.
sentences.cn: 我已经想过了一百种结果。

sentences.en: None of them looked like this.
sentences.cn: 没有一种是这样的。

speaker:2.en: A single *speaker* mounted above the door crackled to life. The voice was Zero's — calm, cold, and coming from everywhere at once. 'I know you're inside,' it said. Ali grabbed my arm. The voice was not a recording. It was live.
speaker:2.cnHint: 门上方的____突然传出零点的声音，而且那不是录音——是实时的。
speaker:2.hook: The speaker clicked off, and then the lights went out.
speaker:2.line: 'Every *speaker* in this building is mine now — listen carefully.'

sentences.en: A single *speaker* mounted above the door crackled to life.
The voice was Zero's — calm, cold, and coming from everywhere at once.
sentences.cn: 那个声音是零点的——冷静、冷漠，从四面八方传来。

sentences.en: 'I know you're inside,' it said.
sentences.cn: "我知道你在里面，"它说。

sentences.en: Ali grabbed my arm.
sentences.cn: 阿栗抓住了我的手臂。

sentences.en: The voice was not a recording.
sentences.cn: 这个声音不是录音。

sentences.en: It was live.
sentences.cn: 是实时的。

species:2.en: Grey Crow once told me there were two *species* of hacker in Harbor City: those who broke systems for power and those who broke them to set something free. I had always believed I was the second kind. Standing at that terminal, I was no longer sure.
species:2.cnHint: 灰鸦说这座城市的黑客有两个____，而我站在终端前开始怀疑自己属于哪一种。
species:2.hook: The cursor blinked, waiting for a choice only I could make.
species:2.line: 'There are two *species* here — and tonight you pick one.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow once told me there were two *species* of hacker in Harbor City: those who broke systems for power and those who broke them to set something free.
I had always believed I was the second kind.
sentences.cn: 我一直以为自己是第二种。

sentences.en: Standing at that terminal, I was no longer sure.
sentences.cn: 站在那个终端前，我已经不确定了。

specifically:2.en: Ali had told me *specifically* to avoid the east corridor. I had nodded. I had agreed. Then the main route sealed behind me and the only open door was east. The lights there were off. Something moved in the dark at the far end.
specifically:2.cnHint: 阿栗____叮嘱我不要走东边的走廊，但那现在是我唯一的出路。
specifically:2.hook: Whatever was in that corridor had already seen me.
specifically:2.line: 'I told you *specifically* — not the east hall, not ever.'

sentences.en: Ali had told me *specifically* to avoid the east corridor.
I had nodded.
sentences.cn: 我点了点头。

sentences.en: I had agreed.
sentences.cn: 我同意了。

sentences.en: Then the main route sealed behind me and the only open door was east.
sentences.cn: 然后主路线在身后密闭了，唯一打开的门就在东走廊。

sentences.en: The lights there were off.
sentences.cn: 那里的灯灭了。

sentences.en: Something moved in the dark at the far end.
sentences.cn: 远处黑暗中有什么东西动了一下。

unfortunately:2.en: I reached the backup terminal and entered the code Grey Crow had given me. The screen flashed green, then red. A single word appeared: INVALID. *Unfortunately*, Zero had changed the key hours before we arrived. Everything we had planned rested on this one door. It was locked.
unfortunately:2.cnHint: ____，零点早就更换了密钥，我们所有的计划都卡在了这扇打不开的门前。
unfortunately:2.hook: Behind me, the elevator hummed — someone was coming up.
unfortunately:2.line: '*Unfortunately*, the old code is dead — and so is your plan.'

sentences.en: I reached the backup terminal and entered the code Grey Crow had given me.
sentences.cn: 我到达备用终端，输入了灰鸦给我的代码。

sentences.en: The screen flashed green, then red.
sentences.cn: 屏幕闪了一下绿色，又闪红色。

sentences.en: A single word appeared: INVALID.
sentences.cn: 一个词出现了：无效。

sentences.en: *Unfortunately*, Zero had changed the key hours before we arrived.
Everything we had planned rested on this one door.
sentences.cn: 我们整个计划都押在这扇门上。

sentences.en: It was locked.
sentences.cn: 它被锁死了。

somewhat:2.en: The sealed data chip Grey Crow left under the broken lamp post felt *somewhat* warm to the touch — warmer than cold metal had any right to be. Ali pressed it against the scanner. A single line of text blinked onto the screen: ZERO KNOWS YOU FOUND IT. I looked up. The street was empty. Or it seemed to be.
somewhat:2.cnHint: 灰鸦留下的芯片让调查员____感到不安，屏幕上突然出现了零点的警告。
somewhat:2.hook: A shadow crossed the wall, but no one was there.
somewhat:2.line: 'This chip is *somewhat* too warm — someone activated it recently.'

sentences.en: The sealed data chip Grey Crow left under the broken lamp post felt *somewhat* warm to the touch — warmer than cold metal had any right to be.
Ali pressed it against the scanner.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把它按在了扫描仪上。

sentences.en: A single line of text blinked onto the screen: ZERO KNOWS YOU FOUND IT.
sentences.cn: 屏幕上闪出一行字：零点知道你找到了它。

sentences.en: I looked up.
sentences.cn: 我抬起头。

sentences.en: The street was empty.
sentences.cn: 街上空荡荡的。

sentences.en: Or it seemed to be.
sentences.cn: 至少看起来是这样。

stable:2.en: Deep in the old harbour district, Ali found the signal source: a rusted sign on a *stable* that had not held animals in fifty years. The graffiti on its door was fresh — sharp white lines forming a code only I could hear. My scanner locked on. The frequency was clear, strong, and deliberate. Someone wanted us here.
stable:2.cnHint: 阿栗在一座废弃的____上发现了新鲜的暗语涂鸦，信号异常清晰。
stable:2.hook: Then the signal cut out, and every light on the block died.
stable:2.line: 'The frequency is *stable* — this message was meant to last.'

sentences.en: Deep in the old harbour district, Ali found the signal source: a rusted sign on a *stable* that had not held animals in fifty years.
The graffiti on its door was fresh — sharp white lines forming a code only I could hear.
sentences.cn: 门上的涂鸦很新鲜——锋利的白色线条组成的代码，只有我能听懂。

sentences.en: My scanner locked on.
sentences.cn: 我的扫描仪锁定了。

sentences.en: The frequency was clear, strong, and deliberate.
sentences.cn: 频率很清晰、很强劲，而且是故意的。

sentences.en: Someone wanted us here.
sentences.cn: 有人想让我们来这里。

vigorous:2.en: The encoded message hit my receiver at 3 a.m. — not a whisper but a *vigorous* burst of signal, sharp and forceful, like someone hammering a fist on a steel door. Ali had left it in the dead drop under Pier Nine. Inside: three coordinates and a single warning word. My hands would not stop shaking.
vigorous:2.cnHint: 凌晨三点，阿栗藏在九号码头的信件发出一阵____的信号，附上三个坐标和一句警告。
vigorous:2.hook: The warning word was my own name.
vigorous:2.line: 'This is no quiet tip — the signal was *vigorous*, and that means they know we are close.'

sentences.en: The encoded message hit my receiver at 3 a.m. — not a whisper but a *vigorous* burst of signal, sharp and forceful, like someone hammering a fist on a steel door.
Ali had left it in the dead drop under Pier Nine.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把它留在了九号码头下的死信箱里。

sentences.en: Inside: three coordinates and a single warning word.
sentences.cn: 里面是三个坐标和一个警告词。

sentences.en: My hands would not stop shaking.
sentences.cn: 我的手停不下来地颤抖。

wide:2.en: Grey Crow spread the stolen city map across the wet floor of the safe room. Harbor City looked *wide* and merciless under the single lamp — a vast, sprawling grid of canals and dark towers with no safe corner marked anywhere. I counted six red crosses. Each one was a silenced investigator.
wide:2.cnHint: 灰鸦在庇护所铺开地图，这座城市显得如此____而冷酷，六处红叉标记着倒下的调查员。
wide:2.hook: My own street was not on the map at all.
wide:2.line: 'The net Zero cast is *wide* — no one in this city is truly outside it.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow spread the stolen city map across the wet floor of the safe room.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把偷来的城市地图铺在安全屋湿漉漉的地板上。

sentences.en: Harbor City looked *wide* and merciless under the single lamp — a vast, sprawling grid of canals and dark towers with no safe corner marked anywhere.
I counted six red crosses.
sentences.cn: 我数了数六个红叉。

sentences.en: Each one was a silenced investigator.
sentences.cn: 每一个都是一个被沉默的调查员。

agriculture:2.en: The file was labeled a report on *agriculture* — crop yields, soil data, rain records. Dull cover, perfect hiding place. But when I ran it through my signal filter, the numbers dissolved into something else: a full list of corrupted officials, names and prices, buried inside the harvest figures.
agriculture:2.cnHint: 那份标注着____数据的文件是完美的伪装，我的信号过滤器却从中读出了一份腐败官员名单。
agriculture:2.hook: The last name on the list was someone I trusted completely.
agriculture:2.line: 'They hid the whole network inside an *agriculture* report — no one ever checks the soil numbers.'

sentences.en: The file was labeled a report on *agriculture* — crop yields, soil data, rain records.
Dull cover, perfect hiding place.
sentences.cn: 很无聊的掩护，完美的藏身之处。

sentences.en: But when I ran it through my signal filter, the numbers dissolved into something else: a full list of corrupted officials, names and prices, buried inside the harvest figures.
sentences.cn: 但我用信号过滤器一运行，那些数字就化成了别的东西：一份完整的贪污官员名单和价格，都埋在了收获数据里。

assign:2.en: Grey Crow looked me in the eye and said the bureau had chosen to *assign* me this case alone — no partner on record, no backup channel, no file number. Ali pressed a cold hand on my shoulder. The silence in the room told me this was not an honor. It was a trap designed to look like one.
assign:2.cnHint: 灰鸦说上级决定____我独自处理此案，没有搭档，没有备份——阿栗的沉默说明这是个陷阱。
assign:2.hook: The order had been signed three days before the case even existed.
assign:2.line: 'They *assign* solo cases only when they want someone to disappear quietly.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow looked me in the eye and said the bureau had chosen to *assign* me this case alone — no partner on record, no backup channel, no file number.
Ali pressed a cold hand on my shoulder.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把一只冰冷的手按在了我的肩膀上。

sentences.en: The silence in the room told me this was not an honor.
sentences.cn: 房间里的沉默告诉我这不是荣誉。

sentences.en: It was a trap designed to look like one.
sentences.cn: 这是一个陷阱，只是伪装成了荣誉。

broad:2.en: Zero's broadcast ran on a *broad* frequency — wide open, meant to be caught by every scanner in Harbor City. That was the trick. While every investigator chased that obvious signal, the real message was threading through a single hair-thin channel none of us had thought to watch.
broad:2.cnHint: 零点故意用____的频段广播作为诱饵，真正的信息却藏在一条无人注意的细窄信道里。
broad:2.hook: I had already wasted four hours chasing the decoy.
broad:2.line: 'A *broad* signal is always bait — look for the one channel that is too quiet.'

sentences.en: Zero's broadcast ran on a *broad* frequency — wide open, meant to be caught by every scanner in Harbor City.
That was the trick.
sentences.cn: 这就是妙处。

sentences.en: While every investigator chased that obvious signal, the real message was threading through a single hair-thin channel none of us had thought to watch.
sentences.cn: 每个调查员都去追那个显眼的信号，真正的信息却从我们没想到要看的细如发丝的暗道里穿过去了。

careful:2.en: Ali was *careful* — meticulous in a way that border on fear. Every slip of paper was folded twice before burning. Every word was chosen like a tool for a specific lock. So when I found Ali's notebook left open on the table, its pages facing the window, I knew it was not an accident.
careful:2.cnHint: 阿栗向来____到近乎恐惧，所以那本敞开摆在窗边的笔记本绝不是无意间遗忘的。
careful:2.hook: The page it was open to showed only my face, sketched in grey ink.
careful:2.line: 'Be *careful* with that page — it is the only copy of what we found in the server.'

sentences.en: Ali was *careful* — meticulous in a way that border on fear.
Every slip of paper was folded twice before burning.
sentences.cn: 每张纸都要折两遍才烧掉。

sentences.en: Every word was chosen like a tool for a specific lock.
sentences.cn: 每个字都像是为某把锁精心打造的工具。

sentences.en: So when I found Ali's notebook left open on the table, its pages facing the window, I knew it was not an accident.
sentences.cn: 所以当我发现阿栗的笔记本摊开在桌上，书页对着窗户时，我知道这不是巧合。

combination:2.en: The vault under the old signal tower needed a *combination* of two things to open: a numeric code and a spoken word in the correct frequency. Grey Crow had the code. I had the word lodged in my skull like a splinter. Together we stood in the dark, rain loud on the iron roof above us.
combination:2.cnHint: 旧信号塔下的保险库需要数字密码与特定音频的____才能开启，灰鸦和我各持一半。
combination:2.hook: The vault clicked — then something inside it moved on its own.
combination:2.line: 'The lock responds to a *combination* of voice and code — neither of us can open it alone.'

sentences.en: The vault under the old signal tower needed a *combination* of two things to open: a numeric code and a spoken word in the correct frequency.
Grey Crow had the code.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦有密码。

sentences.en: I had the word lodged in my skull like a splinter.
sentences.cn: 我脑子里的那个词像刺一样扎着。

sentences.en: Together we stood in the dark, rain loud on the iron roof above us.
sentences.cn: 我们并肩站在黑暗里，雨水敲打着头顶的铁皮屋顶，声音很大。

constant:2.en: The interference was *constant* — an unbroken hum threaded through every channel I owned, never rising, never falling, steady as a held breath. Ali said it meant someone had locked onto my signal and was simply waiting. Not jamming. Not attacking. Just watching, with the patience of someone who already knew how the story ended.
constant:2.cnHint: 干扰信号____地持续着，阿栗说这意味着有人已经锁定了我的频道，只是在静静等待。
constant:2.hook: Then the hum stopped — and the silence was far worse.
constant:2.line: 'The watch on you has been *constant* for six hours — they are not in a hurry because they think you cannot escape.'

sentences.en: The interference was *constant* — an unbroken hum threaded through every channel I owned, never rising, never falling, steady as a held breath.
Ali said it meant someone had locked onto my signal and was simply waiting.
sentences.cn: 阿栗说这意味着有人锁定了我的信号，只是在等待。

sentences.en: Not jamming.
sentences.cn: 不是干扰。

sentences.en: Not attacking.
sentences.cn: 不是攻击。

sentences.en: Just watching, with the patience of someone who already knew how the story ended.
sentences.cn: 就是在看，像是早就知道故事怎么结束的人一样有耐心。

consultant:2.en: The sub-basement archive smelled of rust and old paper. A name badge lay on the floor: DR. VOSS, LANGUAGE *CONSULTANT*. Ali picked it up, fingers cold. Someone had been paid to study our signals — not to stop them, but to sell their secrets. The badge was still warm.
consultant:2.cnHint: 地下档案室里，我们发现了一个神秘____的证件，他似乎出卖了我们的信号。
consultant:2.hook: The photo on the badge matched a face we already knew.
consultant:2.line: 'A *consultant* who sells secrets is just a spy with better pay,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The sub-basement archive smelled of rust and old paper.
sentences.cn: 地下档案室闻起来是铁锈和陈纸的味道。

sentences.en: A name badge lay on the floor: DR.
sentences.cn: 地上丢着一张工作证。

sentences.en: VOSS, LANGUAGE *CONSULTANT*.
Ali picked it up, fingers cold.
sentences.cn: 阿栗冰冷的手指拿起了它。

sentences.en: Someone had been paid to study our signals — not to stop them, but to sell their secrets.
sentences.cn: 有人被雇来研究我们的信号——不是为了阻止它们，而是卖掉它们的秘密。

sentences.en: The badge was still warm.
sentences.cn: 证件还是温的。

direct:2.en: Grey Crow spread the decoded map across the wet table. Every signal route in Harbor City was charted — but one line ran *direct* from the port to the Council tower, no relay, no trace. No one should have had access to that channel. Someone at the top was listening from the start.
direct:2.cnHint: 灰鸦发现了一条____通往议会塔的信号线路，这意味着有人从一开始就在监听。
direct:2.hook: The line had been open for exactly three years — since my first day on the job.
direct:2.line: 'This *direct* link means the leak is not outside — it is inside,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow spread the decoded map across the wet table.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦把解码后的地图铺在湿漉漉的桌子上。

sentences.en: Every signal route in Harbor City was charted — but one line ran *direct* from the port to the Council tower, no relay, no trace.
No one should have had access to that channel.
sentences.cn: 不应该有人能接入那个频道。

sentences.en: Someone at the top was listening from the start.
sentences.cn: 最高层有人从一开始就在监听。

discourage:2.en: Zero left a message burned into the wall of the signal relay on Level Nine: STOP NOW. The words were meant to *discourage* anyone still searching. Ali read them twice, then looked at me with steady eyes and shook her head. We had come too far to turn back over scorched paint.
discourage:2.cnHint: 零点在信号站墙上留下警告，试图____我们，但阿栗毫不动摇。
discourage:2.hook: Below the warning, scratched in tiny letters, was a single word: 'please.'
discourage:2.line: 'Nothing will *discourage* us now — not words, not fire,' Ali said quietly.

sentences.en: Zero left a message burned into the wall of the signal relay on Level Nine: STOP NOW.
sentences.cn: 零点在九层信号中继站的墙上烧出了一条信息：住手。

sentences.en: The words were meant to *discourage* anyone still searching.
Ali read them twice, then looked at me with steady eyes and shook her head.
sentences.cn: 阿栗读了两遍，然后用稳定的眼神看着我，摇了摇头。

sentences.en: We had come too far to turn back over scorched paint.
sentences.cn: 为了烧焦的油漆就回头，我们已经走得太远了。

essentially:2.en: The cipher Zero used was *essentially* a language inside a language — common Harbor words rearranged by a key only two people had ever held. I had cracked the outer shell in an hour. The inner key, though, was still dark. One door open, one door sealed, and the clock on the wall still running.
essentially:2.cnHint: 零点使用的密码____是一种语言中的语言，我破解了外层，但内层钥匙仍是谜。
essentially:2.hook: Grey Crow said only one person alive still knew that inner key.
essentially:2.line: 'It is *essentially* a trap built from words — careful how you read it,' Grey Crow warned.

sentences.en: The cipher Zero used was *essentially* a language inside a language — common Harbor words rearranged by a key only two people had ever held.
I had cracked the outer shell in an hour.
sentences.cn: 一小时内我就破解了外层。

sentences.en: The inner key, though, was still dark.
sentences.cn: 但内层的钥匙还是黑漆漆的。

sentences.en: One door open, one door sealed, and the clock on the wall still running.
sentences.cn: 一扇门打开了，一扇门被封死了，墙上的钟还在走。

extent:2.en: The fog report from the harbor drone showed the *extent* of the blackout: fourteen city blocks, every signal dead, every camera blind. It was not a power fault. It was a planned silence, cut with precision. Someone had drawn a clean dark square over exactly the blocks we needed to cross tonight.
extent:2.cnHint: 无人机报告揭示了信号中断的____，整整十四个街区，一片黑暗，像是精心设计的。
extent:2.hook: The blackout was scheduled to end in twenty minutes — with or without us inside.
extent:2.line: 'The *extent* of this blackout tells me they knew our route,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The fog report from the harbor drone showed the *extent* of the blackout: fourteen city blocks, every signal dead, every camera blind.
It was not a power fault.
sentences.cn: 这不是停电。

sentences.en: It was a planned silence, cut with precision.
sentences.cn: 这是精心策划的沉默，切割得很干净。

sentences.en: Someone had drawn a clean dark square over exactly the blocks we needed to cross tonight.
sentences.cn: 有人在我们今晚要经过的区域上精确地画了一个黑方块。

finance:2.en: Buried in the archive was a single ledger page. Every secret broadcast in Harbor City for the past two years had been funded by one source. The entry read: COUNCIL SPECIAL FUND. The Council did not merely ignore the signal network — they chose to *finance* it. They built the cage they now pretended to fear.
finance:2.cnHint: 档案中的账本揭示，议会竟然____了这整个秘密广播网络。
finance:2.hook: The signature at the bottom belonged to the officer now leading the investigation against us.
finance:2.line: 'They *finance* the very crime they hunt — that is the oldest trick in power,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Buried in the archive was a single ledger page.
sentences.cn: 档案里埋着一页账簿。

sentences.en: Every secret broadcast in Harbor City for the past two years had been funded by one source.
sentences.cn: 过去两年里港市所有的秘密广播都由一个来源资助。

sentences.en: The entry read: COUNCIL SPECIAL FUND.
sentences.cn: 条目写着：议会特殊基金。

sentences.en: The Council did not merely ignore the signal network — they chose to *finance* it.
They built the cage they now pretended to fear.
sentences.cn: 议会不只是对信号网络视而不见——他们选择了资助它。

highlight:2.en: Zero's final file was mostly noise — static, broken dates, dead addresses. But one section was different. Grey Crow ran a filter and watched the screen: a single clean paragraph rose from the garbage, as if Zero had chosen to *highlight* it for whoever came looking. It named a time, a place, and one of us.
highlight:2.cnHint: 零点留下的文件中，灰鸦用过滤器找到一段被____的段落，其中点名了我们其中一人。
highlight:2.hook: The name in that paragraph was mine.
highlight:2.line: 'Zero chose to *highlight* this for a reason — read every word twice,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Zero's final file was mostly noise — static, broken dates, dead addresses.
sentences.cn: 零点的最后文件大多是噪音——静电、破碎的日期、死地址。

sentences.en: But one section was different.
sentences.cn: 但有一个部分不同。

sentences.en: Grey Crow ran a filter and watched the screen: a single clean paragraph rose from the garbage, as if Zero had chosen to *highlight* it for whoever came looking.
It named a time, a place, and one of us.
sentences.cn: 它记录了一个时间、一个地点，还有我们中的一个人。

himself:2.en: The coded letter had no signature. But the style — sharp, cold, precise — told me everything. Zero had written it *himself*, without using any of his usual tricks. No false names. No ghost writers. Just him, raw and exposed, daring me to find him.
himself:2.cnHint: 那封密信没有署名，但我认出了笔迹背后的人：零点____写下了它。
himself:2.hook: The last line of the letter was my home address.
himself:2.line: 'He sent it *himself* — no middleman, no cover. That means he wants to be found.'

sentences.en: The coded letter had no signature.
sentences.cn: 密码信没有署名。

sentences.en: But the style — sharp, cold, precise — told me everything.
sentences.cn: 但笔风——尖锐、冰冷、精准——告诉了我一切。

sentences.en: Zero had written it *himself*, without using any of his usual tricks.
No false names.
sentences.cn: 没有假名。

sentences.en: No ghost writers.
sentences.cn: 没有代笔。

sentences.en: Just him, raw and exposed, daring me to find him.
sentences.cn: 就是他本人，赤裸裸的，敢我去找他。

landscape:2.en: Ali pulled up the city grid on her screen. The *landscape* of Harbor City spread before us — a maze of neon towers, black canals, and dead signal zones. Somewhere inside that glowing map, Zero had hidden the final key. We had one hour to find it.
landscape:2.cnHint: 阿栗在屏幕上展开了海港城的地图____，我们必须在这片迷宫中找到那把钥匙。
landscape:2.hook: Then a whole city block vanished from the map.
landscape:2.line: 'Study this *landscape* carefully — one wrong turn and we lose him forever.'

sentences.en: Ali pulled up the city grid on her screen.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把城市网格调到屏幕上。

sentences.en: The *landscape* of Harbor City spread before us — a maze of neon towers, black canals, and dead signal zones.
Somewhere inside that glowing map, Zero had hidden the final key.
sentences.cn: 在那张闪闪发光的地图深处，零点藏了最后的钥匙。

sentences.en: We had one hour to find it.
sentences.cn: 我们只有一个小时去找到它。

mentally:2.en: Grey Crow handed me the encrypted file and said nothing. I closed my eyes and *mentally* traced each symbol, each gap, each silent beat in the code. The pattern was there. It always was. But this time, it felt like a trap set just for me.
mentally:2.cnHint: 我____在脑海中逐一梳理那串密码，试图找出隐藏的规律。
mentally:2.hook: The final symbol was not a letter — it was my badge number.
mentally:2.line: 'I *mentally* mapped the whole sequence. Something about it is designed to mislead you.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow handed me the encrypted file and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦递给我加密文件，什么都没说。

sentences.en: I closed my eyes and *mentally* traced each symbol, each gap, each silent beat in the code.
The pattern was there.
sentences.cn: 图案就在那儿。

sentences.en: It always was.
sentences.cn: 它总是在那儿。

sentences.en: But this time, it felt like a trap set just for me.
sentences.cn: 但这一次，感觉像是专门为我设的陷阱。

neither:2.en: Grey Crow looked at the two drives on the table. '*Neither* of these is the real one,' he said quietly. I stared at them. Both looked identical. Both were clean. If the true drive was somewhere else, Zero had already moved it — and we had just wasted our only lead.
neither:2.cnHint: 桌上两块硬盘，灰鸦说____是真正的目标，这意味着零点早已转移了真品。
neither:2.hook: Then the lights in the room cut to black.
neither:2.line: '*Neither* path is safe — but one of them leads to the truth.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow looked at the two drives on the table. '*Neither* of these is the real one,' he said quietly.
I stared at them.
sentences.cn: 我盯着它们。

sentences.en: Both looked identical.
sentences.cn: 两个看起来完全一样。

sentences.en: Both were clean.
sentences.cn: 两个都很干净。

sentences.en: If the true drive was somewhere else, Zero had already moved it — and we had just wasted our only lead.
sentences.cn: 如果真的驱动器在别的地方，零点早就移走了——我们刚才浪费了唯一的线索。

onto:2.en: Ali patched the signal *onto* the main screen. Static. Then a face — Zero's face, calm and cold, looking straight at us through the feed. He had hacked into our own display. He was not hiding anymore. He was watching us watch him.
onto:2.cnHint: 阿栗将信号投____主屏幕，零点的脸就这样出现在我们眼前。
onto:2.hook: Zero smiled, then the feed cut to a countdown.
onto:2.line: 'I pushed the signal *onto* the public grid — everyone in Harbor City can see it now.'

sentences.en: Ali patched the signal *onto* the main screen.
Static.
sentences.cn: 静电干扰。

sentences.en: Then a face — Zero's face, calm and cold, looking straight at us through the feed.
sentences.cn: 然后出现了一张脸——零点的脸，冷静而冷漠，直视我们的摄像头。

sentences.en: He had hacked into our own display.
sentences.cn: 他入侵了我们自己的显示屏。

sentences.en: He was not hiding anymore.
sentences.cn: 他不再躲了。

sentences.en: He was watching us watch him.
sentences.cn: 他在看我们看他。

plus:2.en: Ali laid out the facts: one stolen cipher, *plus* a missing investigator, plus three dead signal towers on the east side. The numbers added up to one thing. Zero was not running. He was building something. And whatever it was, it would go live at midnight.
plus:2.cnHint: 一个被盗密码____三座失联信号塔，这些线索叠加起来指向一个可怕的计划。
plus:2.line: 'Two hidden nodes *plus* the main relay — that is enough to crash the whole city grid.'

sentences.en: Ali laid out the facts: one stolen cipher, *plus* a missing investigator, plus three dead signal towers on the east side.
The numbers added up to one thing.
sentences.cn: 数字加起来只有一个答案。

sentences.en: Zero was not running.
sentences.cn: 零点没有逃跑。

sentences.en: He was building something.
sentences.cn: 他在制造什么东西。

sentences.en: And whatever it was, it would go live at midnight.
sentences.cn: 不管是什么，午夜就会上线。

root:2.en: Grey Crow knelt by the old terminal and brushed the dust away. 'The *root* command is still active,' he murmured. If that was true, whoever held this terminal held the city's entire signal network. Zero had not destroyed the system. He had buried himself inside it.
root:2.cnHint: 灰鸦发现旧终端的____命令仍然有效——零点已将自己藏入整个信号网络的核心。
root:2.hook: The screen flickered and typed one word: 'Hello.'
root:2.line: 'Find the *root* and you find him — he never left, he just went deeper.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow knelt by the old terminal and brushed the dust away.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦跪在旧终端旁，拂去灰尘。

sentences.en: 'The *root* command is still active,' he murmured.
If that was true, whoever held this terminal held the city's entire signal network.
sentences.cn: 如果那是真的，谁拥有这个终端，谁就掌控了城市的整个信号网络。

sentences.en: Zero had not destroyed the system.
sentences.cn: 零点没有摧毁系统。

sentences.en: He had buried himself inside it.
sentences.cn: 他把自己埋在了系统里面。

satisfy:2.en: Zero's message was brief: 'One question. Answer it correctly and I walk away. Fail, and Harbor City goes dark.' I read the question three times. It was simple — too simple. Whatever answer I gave, it would not *satisfy* him. This was never about the answer. It was about watching me choose.
satisfy:2.cnHint: 零点只提了一个问题，但我知道无论我如何作答，都无法____他——这是一个陷阱。
satisfy:2.hook: Ali grabbed my arm: 'Don't type anything yet.'
satisfy:2.line: 'Nothing you do will *satisfy* him — he built this game so no one can win.'

sentences.en: Zero's message was brief: 'One question.
sentences.cn: 零点的信息很简短："一个问题。

sentences.en: Answer it correctly and I walk away.
sentences.cn: 答对了我就走开。

sentences.en: Fail, and Harbor City goes dark.'
sentences.cn: 答错了港湾市就陷入黑暗。"

sentences.en: I read the question three times.
sentences.cn: 我读了三遍那个问题。

sentences.en: It was simple — too simple.
sentences.cn: 很简单——太简单了。

sentences.en: Whatever answer I gave, it would not *satisfy* him.
This was never about the answer.
sentences.cn: 这从来都不是关于答案。

sentences.en: It was about watching me choose.
sentences.cn: 而是看我怎么选。

farmer:1.en: Rain hammered the street market. A hunched old man sold root vegetables from a mud-caked cart — too calm, too still for the chaos around him. Grey Crow pressed close. 'That *farmer* is not selling food,' he muttered. 'He is selling coordinates.' The cart's wooden slats hid a blinking transmitter.
farmer:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在街头市集发现那个卖菜的____并非普通人，他的推车里藏着信号发射器。
farmer:1.hook: The transmitter's light turned red and began to count down.
farmer:1.line: 'That *farmer* has been here every night this week — watch him.'
